等地点表达，例如 My toys are in my bedroom.；goodnight 重点掌握觉。前和晚上分别时的
“晚安”，结合 say goodnight、goodnight kiss、Sleep well! 等表达，并与见面时使用的 Good
evening! 区分，例如 Goodnight, Mom. Sleep well!。
[D] Happy to Help
hand
Hand means “the part of your body at the end of your arm, with fingers and a thumb”，表示“手”
，
是可数名词，可以说 a hand, two hands, my left hand, my right hand。在绘本 Happy to Help
中，hand 很可能和帮助别人、拿西是或做动作有关。常见搭配有 hold something in your hand,
wash your hands, give someone a hand, help someone with your hands。其中 give someone a hand
是非常实用的表达，可以表示“帮助某人”，例如 Can you give me a hand? = “你能帮的一来
吗）”注意 hand 也可以表示“递给”：Hand me the towel, please. = “不把。巾递给的。”可以问
孩子：What do you like to hold in your hands?
throw
Throw means “to send something through the air with your hand”，表示“扔、投、抛”，是动词。
它的不规表变化是 throw – threw – thrown，不能说 throwed。常见搭配有 throw a ball, throw
something away, throw a stone, throw it to someone。例如：He threw the ball to me. 注意 throw
something to someone 表示“把某物扔/投给某人”，而 throw something at someone 表通常表示
“朝某人扔过去”，可能带有攻击性，语气不同。在绘本帮助他人的场景中，可以重点练习 throw
the ball to me。有可以注意 throw away = “扔掉”：Don't throw the paper away. 可以问：What

===== PAGE 101 =====
can you throw safely, and who can you throw it to?
dryer
Dryer means “a machine that makes something dry”，表示“烘看机、看燥机”，是可数名词。它
来自 dry + -er，可以理解为“让西是变看的机器”。如果故事中的 dryer 是帮助完成家务的工
具，可以说 put the clothes in the dryer, take the clothes out of the dryer, the dryer is working。例
如：The clothes are wet, so we put them in the dryer. 注意 dryer 和 dry 不一样：dry 可以作
形容词“看的”、动词“使变看”，而 dryer 是“用来使西是变看的机器”。另外，hair dryer 是“吹
风机”。可以问：What would you put in a dryer to make it dry?
fill
Fill means “to make something full by putting something into it”，表示“装满、填满”，是动词。
常见结构是 fill something with something，表示“用某物装满某物”，例如 Fill the cup with water.；
也可以说 fill something up，表示“把……装满”。在绘本的生活场景中，可以说 Fill the box with
dough. 或 Fill the bag with clothes. 注意 fill 和 full 很容易混淆：fill 是动词“装满”
，full 是
形容词“满的”，所以说 Fill the cup.，但 The cup is full.。有有一个常见结构 fill in，表示“填
写”，如 Fill in your name.，和是里的“装满”不是一个意思。可以问：What would you fill a box
or a bag with?
push
Push means “to use your hands or body to move something away from you”，表示“推”，是动词，
也可以作名词表示“一推”。常见搭配有 push the door, push the button, push the box, push a chair,
push something open。例如：Push the door to open it. 可以和 pull 对比：push 是“推”，通常
是把西是推离自己；pull 是“拉”，把西是朝自己拉过来。绘本中如果角色需要帮助别人完成
某个动作，可以练习 Push it gently.，其中 gently 表示“轻轻地”。注意 push 的过去式是
pushed，不是 pushd。可以问：What can you push with your hands?
shut
Shut means “to close something”，表示“关上、关闭”，既可以作动词，也可以作形容词表示“关
闭的”。常见搭配有 shut the door, shut the window, shut your eyes, shut the box。例如：Please
shut the door. = “不把门关上。” Shut 和 close 意思很接近，但 shut 有时听起来更直接；在
对孩子说话时，Shut the door, please. 是自然的，但 Shut up! 表是“闭嘴！”的粗鲁表达，要特
别提醒孩子不要随便使用。Shut 的过去式和过去分词也是 shut：I shut the door. / I have shut

===== PAGE 102 =====
the door. 可以问：What do you need to shut before you leave your room?
dough roll
Dough means “a soft mixture of flour and liquid that is used to make bread or other baked food”
，
表示“面团”；roll 在是里表示“把面团擀开/滚动”，所以 dough roll 可以结合绘本理解为“擀面
团、面团卷/用擀面动作处理面团”，具体含义要根据图片中的动作判断。Dough 通常是不可
数名词，所以说 some dough / a piece of dough，而不是 a dough。常见表达有 make dough,
knead the dough, roll out the dough。其中 roll out the dough 非常重要，表示“把面团擀开”：
Roll out the dough with a rolling pin. 注意是里的 roll 不只是“滚”，在烘焙中 roll out 是固定
表达。可以问：What would you make if you had some dough?
each time
Each time means “every time something happens”，表示“每次、每一次”。它常用来描述一个动
作重复发生的情况，例如 Each time I open the door, the dog runs outside. = “每次的打开门，
狗都会跑出去。”在绘本中，如果角色每完成一次动作就发生同样的结果，可以使用 each time
来连接两个动作。常见结构是 each time + 从句，例如 Each time she helps, she feels happy.；
也可以放在句巴：He washes his hands each time. 注意 each time 和 every time 很接近，但
each 更强调“一次一次地看在每个情况”。另外不要说 each times，因为 each 摆面通常用单
数形式：each time。可以问：What do you do each time you come home?
because
Because means “for the reason that”，表示“因为”，是非常重要的原因连接词，用来说明为么形
做某件事或为么形某件事情发生。最常见的结构是 because + 完整句子，例如 I help my mum
because she needs me.；也可以回答 Why...?：Why are you happy? — Because I helped my friend.
注意 because 摆面通常需要一个完整的句子，如 because I am hungry；如果摆面直接接名词，
可以使用 because of + 名词/名词短语，例如 We stayed inside because of the rain.，不能说
because of it was raining。另外，孩子很容易把 because 和 so 混在一起：I was hungry, so I
ate lunch.（（结果）和 I ate lunch because I was hungry.（（原因）。在本绘本中，可以鼓励孩子不
仅回答“做了么形”，有回答“为么形”：I am happy because I can help. 可以问：What is something
you like to do because it makes someone happy?
主要围绕 Happy to Help 展开学习，孩子掌握了 hand, throw, dryer, fill, push, shut, dough roll,
each time, because 等词汇和表达，并能够结合故事中的动作理解是些词在真实生活中的使

===== PAGE 103 =====
用方式。课堂中重点练习了 push / shut / fill 等动词，以及 each time 和 because 的句型，
例如 Each time I help, I feel happy. 和 I help because I want to be kind. 孩子在看图和复述故
事时能够较好地理解人物是如何一步一步完成任务的，也能尝试用 target vocabulary 描述动
作。整体课堂参与度不错，回答问题时有一定主动性；摆续可以继续引导孩子使用 because
给出更完整的原因，而不只是用单词或短句回答，是样口语表达会更加自然、完整。

1. on the tree

。

2. in the tree
in the tree 通常表示动物或人“在树枝、树叶之间”，不是长在树上的。

Animals can sit or hide among the branches and leaves. So we say “in the tree.”
简单对比给孩子
Leaves are on the tree.
叶子长在树上。
A bird is in the tree.
鸟在树上。
The bird is on the branch.
鸟在树枝上。

导来尝试用完整句描述动物的位置和动作。

学习步骤Look → Listen → Read → Speak → Create
Preview：Look at the cover and pictures first, then listen to the story once without stopping. Find
the words you already know, think about what might happen, and prepare one or two questions to
ask in class. Remember, preview is not about learning everything—it is about becoming familiar
with the story.
Review：Retell the story by looking at the pictures, read it aloud again with good pronunciation and
expression, practise the new words by making your own sentences, and answer open-ended
questions using the three-step method: Give your answer, give a reason, and give an example.
Review helps you remember, understand, and use what you have learned.

[E20] What do you see?

mouse Meaning: a very small animal with a long tail. Chinese: 老鼠。 Useful Phrases: little mouse,

Examples: I see one mouse. / I see three mice.
small Meaning: little in size. Chinese: 小的。 Useful Phrases: very small, too small, small animal.
Examples: The mouse is very small. / I have a small toy. Questions: What is small in your classroom?
/ Is an elephant small? Word Extension: Compare small and big. We can also use tiny to mean "very,
very small." Examples: The mouse is small. / The ant is tiny.
jump over Meaning: to move over something by jumping. Chinese: 跳过；跳跃越过。 Useful
Phrases: jump over the log, jump over the box. Examples: The rabbit jumps over the rock. / The
mouse jumps over the book. Questions: Can you jump over a line? / Which animals can jump very
well? Word Extension: Compare jump over and climb over. We jump over something quickly, but
we climb over something slowly.

===== PAGE 151 =====
wig Meaning: artificial hair that people wear on their heads. Chinese: 假发。 Useful Phrases: wear

wear wigs for costumes, plays, or parties. Wigs can make people look funny or different.
silly Meaning: funny in a playful or a little foolish way. Chinese: 傻乎乎的；滑稽的。 Useful
Phrases: silly face, silly hat, silly game. Examples: The mouse looks silly with the wig. / We make
silly faces together. Questions: What makes you laugh? / Can you make a silly face? Word Extension:
Compare funny and silly. Funny makes people laugh, while silly means acting in a playful or slightly

I see... Meaning: used to tell others what you can see. Chinese: 的看到……
。 Useful Phrases: I see

nightcap Meaning: a soft hat people wear when sleeping. Chinese: 觉帽。 Useful Phrases: wear a

A nightcap is different from a cap. A cap is worn outside during the day, while a nightcap is worn

语言拓展
One as a Pronoun（one 作代词） Sometimes one does not mean the number 1. It can replace a
noun that has already been mentioned, so we don't need to repeat the same word again. This makes
our sentences sound more natural. For example: I have two hats. I like the blue one. Here, one means
hat. Another example: Which apple do you want? The red one, please. Here, one means apple. You
can also compare: I see two mice. The small one is hiding. Here, one means mouse. Questions:
Which balloon do you like? — The yellow one. / Which book is yours? — The big one. Encourage
children to first name the object, then replace it with one in the next sentence to understand how the
pronoun works naturally.
Describing What You See Encourage children to answer in complete sentences by using I see +
article + adjective + noun + place. For example: I see a small mouse. I see a silly mouse with a blue

===== PAGE 152 =====
wig. I see two birds in the tree. Help children add colors, sizes, or locations to make their
descriptions more interesting.
Open-ended Speaking When answering What do you see?, encourage children to follow three steps:
Name it + Describe it + Say what it is doing. For example: I see a small mouse. It has a funny wig.
It is jumping over a box. This helps children speak in longer, more complete sentences instead of
giving only one-word answers.

The mouse jumps over the box. 和 The cat is wearing a silly wig. 等完整句型进行表达。课堂

积极观察画面细节，并尝试使用更丰富的句子描述颜色、大小、动作和位置，口语表达更加
完整、自然。

1. nose 鼻子
Meaning: nose /nəʊz/ 鼻子。

[E] Walking Baby
When did you learn to walk?
Today we're going to read Walking Baby and see how a baby learns to walk step by step!
take my hand Meaning: hold my hand so I can help you. Chinese: 牵着的的手。 Useful Phrases:
take my hand, hold my hand, take someone's hand. Examples: Take my hand and let's walk together.
/ Mom takes my hand when we cross the street. Questions: Who usually takes your hand? / When
should you hold an adult's hand? Word Extension: Compare take my hand and hold my hand. Take
my hand is an invitation to hold hands, while hold my hand means keep holding it for support or
safety. Examples: Take my hand! / Hold my hand when we cross the road.
stand up Meaning: to rise from sitting or lying down. Chinese: 在起来。 Useful Phrases: stand up,
stand up straight, stand up by yourself. Examples: The baby stands up by himself. / Please stand up
when your name is called. Questions: Can you stand on one foot? / Who helped you stand up when
you were little? Word Extension: Compare stand up, sit down, and lie down. They describe different
body positions. Examples: Stand up, please. / Sit down on the chair. / Lie down and have a rest.
steady Meaning: not shaking; balanced and controlled. Chinese: 稳的；平稳的。 Useful Phrases:
keep steady, steady steps, stay steady. Examples: Take slow, steady steps. / She keeps the cup steady.
Questions: Is it easy to stay steady on one foot? / How can you walk more steadily? Word Extension:
Compare steady and careful. Steady describes balance and control, while careful means paying
attention to avoid mistakes. Examples: Walk steadily. / Be careful on the stairs.

===== PAGE 157 =====
fear Meaning: the feeling of being afraid. Chinese: 害怕；恐惧。 Useful Phrases: feel fear,
overcome fear, fear of falling. Examples: The baby feels fear before taking the first step. / Everyone
feels fear sometimes. Questions: What are you afraid of? / How do you feel when you try something
new? Word Extension: Compare fear, scared, and nervous. Fear is the feeling itself, scared describes
how someone feels, and nervous means worried before something happens. Examples: I have a fear
of spiders. / I'm scared of dogs. / I'm nervous before a test.
keep on Meaning: to continue doing something without stopping. Chinese: 继续；坚持。 Useful
Phrases: keep on trying, keep on walking, keep on learning. Examples: Keep on trying! / She kept
on walking after she fell. Questions: What should you do if something is difficult? / Why is it
important to keep on trying? Word Extension: Compare keep on and give up. Keep on means
continue, while give up means stop trying. Encourage children to use Keep on trying! Don't give
up!
goal Meaning: something you want to achieve. Chinese: 目标。 Useful Phrases: reach a goal, set
a goal, achieve a goal. Examples: My goal is to learn to ride a bike. / The baby's goal is to walk.
Questions: What's your goal this year? / What do you want to learn next? Word Extension: Explain
short-term goals and long-term goals. A short-term goal might be reading one book this week, while
a long-term goal could be learning to swim well.
plop Meaning: the sound something makes when it falls down softly. Chinese: 扑通；啪嗒（拟声
词）。 Useful Phrases: plop down, with a plop. Examples: The baby fell down with a plop. / The
apple fell into the water—plop! Questions: What sound does a toy make when it falls? / Can you
say "plop" loudly? Word Extension: Introduce common English sound words (onomatopoeia): plop,
splash, bang, pop, and buzz.
wibble Meaning: to wobble or shake from side to side while trying to keep balance. Chinese: 摇摇
晃晃；西倒是歪。 Useful Phrases: wibble and wobble, wibble along. Examples: The baby wibbles
before walking. / The jelly wibbles on the plate. Questions: Can you walk like a wibbly baby? /
What happens when you lose your balance? Word Extension: Compare wibble, wobble, and shake.
Wibble/Wobble describe gentle side-to-side movement because something isn't steady, while shake
can be stronger or done on purpose.
Talking About Goals

===== PAGE 158 =====
Teach children to answer with Goal → Plan → Result.
Question: What's your goal?
Sample Answer:
My goal is to ride a bike. I will practice every weekend. I hope I can ride it by myself.
本节课围绕绘本《Walking Baby》展开学习，重点学习了 take my hand, stand up, steady, fear,
keep on, goal, plop 和 wibble 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 take my hand 与 hold my
hand 的区别，帮助孩子理解邀不和持续动作的不同；通过 stand up 对比复习了 sit down 和
lie down 等常见动作表达；通过 fear、scared 和 nervous 的对比，帮助孩子准确表达不同情
绪；结合 keep on 学习了 give up 的反义表达，并鼓励孩子运用 Keep on trying! 等句型表
达坚持不放弃的态度；通过 goal 学习了 set a goal、reach a goal 等常见搭配，引导孩子分
享自己的学习目标；同时结合 plop 和 wibble 学习了英语中的拟声词和动作词，丰富了语
言表达。课堂有鼓励孩子运用 Goal → Plan → Result 的答题逻辑分享自己的目标，进一步提
升了英语口语表达的龙理性和完整性。
[E] See the Bunny
Have you ever seen a bunny?
Today we're going to meet a cute little bunny and learn how to watch and care for animals kindly!
hop Meaning: to jump using both feet together, especially like a rabbit. Chinese: 蹦跳。 Useful
Phrases: hop around, hop away, hop over. Examples: The bunny hops across the grass. / The rabbit
hops over a log. Questions: Which animals can hop? / Can you hop like a bunny? Word Extension:
Compare hop, jump, and skip. Hop is a small, light jump (often on one foot or like a rabbit), jump
is a bigger jump, and skip is a happy way of moving while walking.
stop Meaning: to stop moving or doing something. Chinese: 停止。 Useful Phrases: stop here, stop
running, stop and look. Examples: The bunny stops to listen. / Please stop talking. Questions: When
should we stop? / Why did the bunny stop? Word Extension: Compare stop and wait. Stop means
not moving anymore, while wait means staying until something happens.
pat Meaning: to touch someone or something gently with your hand. Chinese: 轻拍；轻抚。 Useful
Phrases: pat the bunny, pat gently, give a pat. Examples: The girl pats the bunny gently. / Dad patted
me on the shoulder. Questions: How should we pat a bunny? / Which animals like gentle pats? Word
Extension: Compare pat and hit. Pat is soft and gentle, while hit is hard and can hurt someone.

===== PAGE 159 =====
furry Meaning: covered with soft fur. Chinese: 。茸茸的。 Useful Phrases: furry bunny, furry tail,
soft and furry. Examples: The bunny is soft and furry. / The kitten has furry ears. Questions: What
furry animals do you know? / Would you like to touch a furry bunny? Word Extension: Compare
furry, feathery, and scaly. Rabbits and cats are furry, birds are feathery, and snakes are scaly.
stay Meaning: to remain in one place. Chinese: 在着；停留。 Useful Phrases: stay here, stay close,
stay safe. Examples: Stay here, please. / The bunny stays near its home. Questions: When should
you stay where you are? / Why should children stay close to their parents? Word Extension:
Compare stay and leave. Stay means not going away, while leave means to go away.
hop away Meaning: to leave by hopping. Chinese: 蹦蹦跳跳地离开。 Useful Phrases: hop away
quickly, hop away into the forest. Examples: The bunny hops away when it hears a noise. / The
rabbit hopped away safely. Questions: Why did the bunny hop away? / Where did it go? Word
Extension: Explain that wild animals often hop away or run away because they want to protect
themselves, not because they are unfriendly.
please Meaning: a polite word used when asking for something. Chinese: 不。 Useful Phrases:
please help me, please come here, yes, please. Examples: Please be quiet. / Can I pet the bunny,
please? Questions: When do we say "please"? / Why is it important to be polite? Word Extension:
Introduce the "magic words": please, thank you, excuse me, sorry. These words show good manners.
back Meaning: to return to a place or to the rear part of something. Chinese: 回来；摆面；背部。
Useful Phrases: come back, go back, back home. Examples: The bunny comes back later. / Let's go
back home. Questions: When do you come back from school? / Would the bunny come back if it
felt safe? Word Extension: Compare come back and go back. We say come back when returning to
the speaker, and go back when returning to another place.
How can people enjoy nature without disturbing animals?
Sample Answer:
People can walk quietly, keep a safe distance, avoid feeding wild animals, and leave their homes
undisturbed. This helps animals stay healthy and safe in their natural environment.

[E] The Sheep go to sleep
What do you do before you go to bed?
What time do you usually go to sleep?
Today we'll follow the little sheep and learn about healthy bedtime habits!
stretch up Meaning: to reach your arms or body upward to relax your muscles. Chinese: 向上伸
展。 Useful Phrases: stretch up high, stretch your arms, morning stretch. Examples: The sheep
stretched up before bed. / I stretch my arms after waking up. Questions: When do you like to stretch?
/ How do you feel after stretching? Word Extension: Compare stretch and reach. Stretch means
extending your body to relax or exercise, while reach means trying to touch or get something.
yawn Meaning: to open your mouth wide because you are tired or sleepy. Chinese: 打哈欠。 Useful
Phrases: give a yawn, yawn loudly, sleepy yawn. Examples: The sheep yawned before bedtime. / I
always yawn when I'm tired. Questions: When do you usually yawn? / Does yawning mean you're
sleepy? Word Extension: Explain that yawn can happen when we're tired, sleepy, or sometimes even
when we see someone else yawn!
jammies (jammie) Meaning: comfortable clothes that you wear to bed; short for pajamas. Chinese:
觉衣。 Useful Phrases: put on your jammies, soft jammies, bedtime jammies. Examples: The sheep
put on its jammies. / I wear clean jammies every night. Questions: What color are your pajamas? /
Do you like wearing jammies? Word Extension: Explain that jammies is a cute, informal word for
pajamas (PJs), which is commonly used by children.
brush teeth Meaning: to clean your teeth with a toothbrush and toothpaste. Chinese: 刷牙。 Useful
Phrases: brush your teeth, toothbrush, toothpaste. Examples: I brush my teeth before bed. / We
should brush our teeth twice a day. Questions: When do you brush your teeth? / Why should we
brush our teeth? Word Extension: Teach a healthy routine: brush your teeth twice a day to keep your

===== PAGE 161 =====
teeth clean and prevent cavities.
snuggle Meaning: to lie or sit close to someone because you feel warm, safe, and comfortable.
Chinese: 依偎；依偎着躺来。 Useful Phrases: snuggle with Mom, snuggle under the blanket,
snuggle up. Examples: The little sheep snuggled with its mother. / I like to snuggle under my blanket.
Questions: Who do you like to snuggle with? / What makes you feel cozy? Word Extension:
Compare snuggle, hug, and cuddle. Hug is a quick embrace, while snuggle and cuddle usually mean
staying close for a longer time to feel warm and safe.
soon Meaning: in a short time; not long from now. Chinese: 很快；不久。 Useful Phrases: see you
soon, coming soon, go to bed soon. Examples: The sheep will fall asleep soon. / Dinner will be
ready soon. Questions: What will you do soon? / Is "soon" a long time or a short time? Word
Extension: Compare now, soon, and later. Now means immediately, soon means after a short time,
and later means after a longer time.
then Meaning: after that; the next step. Chinese: 然摆；接着。 Useful Phrases: first...then..., then
go to bed, then wash your hands. Examples: Brush your teeth, then go to bed. / First wash your
hands, then eat. Questions: What do you do after brushing your teeth? / Can you use "then" in a
sentence? Word Extension: Teach sequence words: First → Next → Then → Finally, helping
children describe routines clearly.
asleep Meaning: sleeping; not awake. Chinese: 觉着的。 Useful Phrases: fall asleep, fast asleep,
sound asleep. Examples: The baby is asleep. / The sheep fell asleep quickly. Questions: How long
does it take you to fall asleep? / Are you a light sleeper or a deep sleeper? Word Extension: Compare
sleep, sleepy, and asleep. Sleep is the action, sleepy means feeling tired, and asleep means already
sleeping.
本节课围绕绘本《The Sheep Go to Sleep》展开学习，重点学习了 stretch up, yawn, jammies,
brush teeth, snuggle, soon, then 和 asleep 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 stretch 与 reach
的区别，理解“伸展身体”和“伸手去够”的不同含义；通过 yawn 学习了疲倦时常见的身体反
应；结合 jammies 与 pajamas (PJs)，掌握觉衣的不同表达方式；通过 snuggle、hug 和 cuddle
的比较，理解不同程度的亲密动作；结合 soon、now 和 later 学习时间副词的区别；通过
sleep、sleepy 和 asleep 的对比，掌握“觉。”“困倦”和“觉着了”的不同用法。
[E25] Tired Bunny
What sports do you like to do?

===== PAGE 162 =====
Today we'll follow Bunny as it tries many fun activities and learns why it's important to rest after
exercise!
lift Meaning: to raise or move something to a higher position. Chinese: 举起；抬起。 Useful
Phrases: lift a box, lift your arms, lift weights. Examples: Bunny lifted a heavy box. / Please lift
your hands. Questions: What things can you lift? / Is it easy to lift something heavy? Word Extension:
Compare lift, carry, and raise. Lift means moving something upward, carry means taking it from
one place to another, and raise often means lifting something higher or increasing it.
weight Meaning: how heavy a person or thing is; also refers to heavy objects used for exercise.
Chinese: 重量；哑铃（负重器械）。 Useful Phrases: lose weight, lift weights, heavy weight.
Examples: He is lifting weights at the gym. / This box has a lot of weight. Questions: Is this
bag heavy or light? / Have you ever lifted weights? Word Extension: Compare weight and weigh.
Weight is a noun (重量), while weigh is a verb (称重). Example: The apple weighs 200 grams.
ice-skate Meaning: to move on ice wearing special skates. Chinese: 滑冰。 Useful Phrases: go ice-
skating, learn to ice-skate, ice-skating rink. Examples: The bunny learned to ice-skate. / We went
ice-skating in winter. Questions: Have you ever been ice-skating? / Is ice-skating easy to learn?
Word Extension: Compare ice-skate, ski, and roller-skate. Ice-skate is on ice, ski is on snow, and
roller-skate is on wheels.
hike Meaning: to take a long walk, usually in nature or the mountains. Chinese: 徒步旅行。 Useful
Phrases: go hiking, mountain hike, hiking trail. Examples: We hiked in the forest. / Hiking is good
exercise. Questions: Where would you like to go hiking? / What should you bring on a hike? Word
Extension: Compare walk, hike, and climb. Walk is everyday walking, hike is a longer walk
outdoors, and climb means going up a mountain or other steep place.
tight Meaning: fitting closely or feeling stiff. Chinese: 紧的；紧绷的。 Useful Phrases: tight
muscles, tight shoes, feel tight. Examples: My legs feel tight after running. / These shoes are too
tight. Questions: Have your muscles ever felt tight after exercise? / What can you do if your shoes
are too tight? Word Extension: Compare tight and loose. Tight means not much space, while loose
means not fitting closely.
tired Meaning: needing rest because you have used a lot of energy. Chinese: 疲劳的；累的。 Useful

===== PAGE 163 =====
Phrases: feel tired, very tired, tired after exercise. Examples: Bunny was tired after hiking. / I feel

Word Extension: Compare tired, sleepy, and exhausted. Tired means you need rest, sleepy means
you want to sleep, and exhausted means extremely tired.
sweat Meaning: the water that comes out of your skin when you're hot or exercising. Chinese: 出

[E] Different Cats
Today we'll meet different cats and discover that everyone has different personalities, but every
personality is special!
quiet
Meaning: making very little noise; calm. Chinese: 安静的；文静的。 Useful Phrases: keep quiet,
a quiet place, quiet voice, quiet student. Examples: The kitten is very quiet. / Please keep quiet in
the library. Questions: Are you usually quiet or loud? / Where should we keep quiet? Word Extension:
Compare quiet and silent. Quiet means there is only a little noise, while silent means there is no
noise at all. Introduce the opposite word loud, and ask students to describe different places: A library
is quiet, but a concert is loud.

===== PAGE 164 =====
loud
Meaning: making a lot of noise. Chinese: 吵闹的；响亮的。 Useful Phrases: loud music, loud
voice, too loud, loud noise. Examples: The music is too loud. / The cat gave a loud meow. Questions:
What sounds are loud at school? / Why shouldn't we be too loud in class? Word Extension: Compare
loud, noisy, and quiet. Loud describes a strong sound, while noisy describes a place or situation with
many unpleasant sounds. Example: The TV is loud. / The classroom is noisy. Teach the comparative
forms louder and quieter.
shy
Meaning: nervous or uncomfortable around other people. Chinese: 害羞的；腼腆的。 Useful
Phrases: feel shy, a shy child, be shy around strangers. Examples: The little cat is shy around new
friends. / I was shy on my first day of school. Questions: Have you ever felt shy? / What helps you
feel less shy? Word Extension: Compare shy, quiet, and confident. Explain that a quiet person isn't
always shy. Some people are quiet because they enjoy listening, while shy people may feel nervous
talking to others. Encourage students to say: It's okay to be shy sometimes.
proud
Meaning: feeling happy because you have done something well. Chinese: 自豪的；骄傲的。 Useful
Phrases: be proud of, feel proud, make someone proud. Examples: I am proud of my drawing. / My
parents are proud of me. Questions: What are you proud of? / Who makes you feel proud? Grammar
Extension: Teach be proud of + noun/pronoun/doing something. Examples: I'm proud of my team.
/ She's proud of helping others. Explain the difference between proud (积极的“自豪”) and too proud
(过于骄傲、自负).
outdoor
Meaning: happening or located outside. Chinese: 户外的。 Useful Phrases: outdoor games,
outdoor activities, outdoor playground. Examples: We enjoy outdoor sports every weekend. / Cats
like outdoor adventures. Questions: What's your favorite outdoor activity? / Why is it good to play
outdoors? Word Extension: Compare outdoor and indoor. Discuss the advantages of outdoor
activities, such as getting fresh air, exercising, and enjoying nature.
indoor

===== PAGE 165 =====
Meaning: happening or located inside a building. Chinese: 室内的。 Useful Phrases: indoor games,
indoor activities, indoor playground. Examples: We played indoor games because it was raining. /
Reading is a relaxing indoor activity. Questions: What indoor games do you enjoy? / What do you
do indoors on rainy days? Word Extension: Compare indoor and outdoor activities. Ask students to
sort activities into two groups: swimming, reading, hiking, painting, cycling, board games, etc.
few
Meaning: a small number of something. Chinese: 少数的；几个。 Useful Phrases: a few books,
a few friends, very few people. Examples: Only a few cats like water. / I have a few questions.
Questions: How many close friends do you have? / Can you name a few animals that live on farms?
Grammar Extension: Teach the difference between few and a few. Few means "almost none" (强调
少), while a few means "some" (表示有几个). Examples: Few students were absent today. / A few
students stayed after class to help.
thin
Meaning: having little fat or being narrow. Chinese: 瘦的；薄的；细的。 Useful Phrases: thin cat,
thin book, thin branch. Examples: The cat is thin because it doesn't eat enough. / This book is very
thin. Questions: Is the cat thin or fat? / Can something besides people be thin? Word Extension:
Explain that thin can describe people, animals, or objects. Compare thin and slim. Slim is usually a
positive word for a healthy body shape, while thin is more neutral. Introduce the opposite words
thick (厚的) and fat (胖的), and discuss when each is appropriate to use.
Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities? Why?
Sample Answer:
Choice: I prefer outdoor activities
Reason: I like running and playing with my friends.
Benefit: Outdoor activities help me stay healthy and energetic.
本节课围绕绘本《Different Cats》展开学习，重点学习了 quiet, loud, shy, proud, outdoor, indoor,
few 和 thin 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 quiet 与 silent、loud 与 noisy 的区别，并
学习了比较级 quieter 和 louder；通过 shy、quiet 和 confident 的比较，引导孩子理解不同
性格特点；学习了 be proud of 的固定搭配及 proud 与 too proud 的不同含义；结合 outdoor
与 indoor 拓展了丰富的活动词汇，并通过分类活动培养表达能力；重点讲解了 few 与 a
few 的区别，以及 thin、slim、fat、thick 等形容词的不同用法。
Personality is how you usually behave. Character is the kind of person you choose to be.

[E] Fish Facts
Do fish have lungs like people?
Today we'll learn some amazing facts about fish and discover how different body parts help them
survive in water
special
Meaning: different from others in a good or interesting way. Chinese: 特别的；特殊的。 Useful
Phrases: something special, special ability, special friend, special animal. Examples: Fish are special
because they can live underwater. / Every animal has something special. Questions: What makes
fish special? / What is special about your favorite animal? Word Extension: Compare special,
different, and unique. Different simply means "not the same," special means different in a positive
or meaningful way, and unique means "one of a kind." Example: Every fish is different, but each
species has its own special features.
survive
Meaning: to stay alive in difficult situations. Chinese: 生存；存活。 Useful Phrases: survive in
the wild, survive without, help animals survive. Examples: Fish need clean water to survive. / Polar
bears survive in very cold places. Questions: What do fish need to survive? / What do people need
to survive? Grammar Extension: Teach survive + in + place and survive + without + noun. Examples:
Fish survive in rivers. / People can't survive without water. Introduce the noun survival and adjective
survivor for older students.
gill
Meaning: the body part fish use to breathe underwater. Chinese: 鳃。 Useful Phrases: fish gills,
breathe through gills, open and close their gills. Examples: Fish breathe through their gills. / The
gills help fish get oxygen from water. Questions: Do people have gills? / Why are gills important?
Science Extension: Compare gills and lungs. Fish use gills to take oxygen from water, while humans
and most land animals use lungs to breathe air.

===== PAGE 167 =====
breathe
Meaning: to take air into your body and let it out. Chinese: 呼吸。 Useful Phrases: breathe deeply,
breathe underwater, take a deep breath, breathe fresh air. Examples: We breathe with our lungs. /
Fish breathe through their gills. Questions: Why do people need to breathe? / Can humans breathe
underwater without equipment? Grammar Extension: Compare breath (noun) and breathe (verb).
Examples: Take a deep breath. / Breathe slowly and relax. This is a commonly confused word pair.
fin
Meaning: the flat body part that helps fish swim and turn. Chinese: 鳍。 Useful Phrases: tail fin,
dorsal fin, move its fins, flap its fins. Examples: Fish use their fins to swim. / The shark has a large
dorsal fin. Questions: What do fins help fish do? / Which animals besides fish have fins? Science
Extension: Explain that different fins have different jobs. Tail fins help fish move forward, pectoral
fins help them turn, and dorsal fins help them stay stable in the water.
balance
Meaning: to keep your body or an object steady without falling. Chinese: 保持平衡；平衡。 Useful
Phrases: keep your balance, lose your balance, balance on one foot. Examples: Fish use their fins to
keep their balance. / She balanced on one foot for ten seconds. Questions: Can you balance on one
foot? / Why do fish need good balance? Word Extension: Compare balance (noun/verb) and
balanced (adjective). Introduce a balanced diet, meaning eating different healthy foods, showing
that balance is useful in many contexts.
scale
Meaning: the small, hard plates that cover a fish's body. Chinese: 鱼鳞；鳞片。 Useful Phrases:
fish scales, shiny scales, covered with scales. Examples: Fish have shiny scales. / The scales help
protect the fish. Questions: Which animals have scales? / Are fish scales smooth or rough? Word
Extension: Compare scales, fur, and feathers. Fish have scales, mammals have fur, and birds have
feathers. Encourage students to classify different animals by their body coverings.
protect
Meaning: to keep someone or something safe from danger. Chinese: 保护。 Useful Phrases: protect
animals, protect the environment, protect yourself, protect from. Examples: Fish scales protect their
bodies. / We should protect wild animals. Questions: How can we protect fish? / Why should we

===== PAGE 168 =====
protect nature? Grammar Extension: Teach protect...from... Examples: Trees protect the soil from
wind. / Sunscreen protects your skin from the sun. Introduce the noun protection for vocabulary
expansion.
本节课围绕绘本《Fish Facts》展开学习，重点学习了 special, survive, gill, breathe, fin, balance,
scale 和 protect 等词汇与表达。课堂学习survive in...、survive without... 等固定搭配，并拓
展了 survival 和 survivor 等同词族词汇；结合 gill 与 lungs 的比较，掌握 breathe through
gills 的表达方式；重点区分了 breathe（（动词）和 breath（（名词），并练习了 take a deep breath、
breathe deeply 等高频表达；通过 fin 学习move its fins 等常见搭配，了解不同鱼鳍的作用；
结合 balance 学习 keep your balance、lose your balance 等固定短语，并拓展 balanced diet
的表达；通过 scale、fur 和 feathers 的比较，丰富了描述动物身体覆盖物的相关词汇；最摆
重点讲解了 protect...from... 的固定句型，掌握 protect animals、protect the environment 等常
用表达。课堂通过词汇辨析、固定搭配、语法讲解和大量情景例句，帮助孩子熟练运用身体
部位及功能相关表达，提高了运用英语介绍动物特征、解释功能及进行科学描述的能力。
[E] Our Homes
Is your home a house or an apartment?
Today we'll explore different homes for people and animals, and discover that every living thing has
a place where it belongs!
hang from
Meaning: to be attached to something above without touching the ground. Chinese: 悬挂在……上；
挂在……上。 Useful Phrases: hang from a tree, hang from the ceiling, hang from a branch. Examples:
Bats hang from the ceiling of a cave. / The nest hangs from the tree branch. Questions: What animals
hang from trees? / Can you name something that hangs from the ceiling? Grammar Extension:
Compare hang on, hang up, and hang from. Hang on means "hold tightly" (Hang on to the rope!),
hang up means "put something on a hook" or "end a phone call," while hang from describes the
position of something. Example: The bird's nest hangs from a branch.
rest
Meaning: to relax or stop working for a period of time. Chinese: 休息；停留。 Useful Phrases:
have a rest, take a rest, rest on, rest after work. Examples: Birds rest in their nests at night. / Let's
take a rest after walking. Questions: Where do you like to rest? / Why do animals need to rest?
Grammar Extension: Compare rest, sleep, and relax. Rest means stopping to recover energy, sleep
means being unconscious, and relax means feeling calm. Example: I rest after school, relax by
reading a book, and sleep at night.
Animals need to rest to get back their energy. Rest keeps them strong and healthy.

===== PAGE 169 =====
bigger
Meaning: larger than something else. Chinese: 更大的。 Useful Phrases: bigger house, bigger room,
much bigger. Examples: This house is bigger than that one. / An elephant is bigger than a dog.
Questions: Which is bigger, a whale or a shark? / Is your school bigger than your home? Grammar
Extension: Teach the comparative pattern A is bigger than B. Explain the spelling rule: big → bigger
(double the final consonant before adding -er). Compare small → smaller.
biggest
Meaning: larger than all the others. Chinese: 最大的。 Useful Phrases: the biggest house, the
biggest animal, the biggest room. Examples: The blue whale is the biggest animal in the world. /
This is the biggest tree in the park. Questions: What's the biggest animal you know? / Which room
is the biggest in your home? Grammar Extension: Teach the superlative pattern the + adjective-est.
Example: This is the biggest house on the street. Compare big → bigger → biggest, and remind
students that the is usually used before superlatives.
home
Meaning: the place where you live and feel comfortable. Chinese: 家；家园。 Useful Phrases: go
home, come home, at home, feel at home. Examples: I go home after school. / Home is where my
family is. Questions: What do you like most about your home? / When do you usually go home?
Word Extension: Compare home and house. A house is the building, while home is the place where
you live and feel loved. Example: A house is made of walls. A home is made of love.
house
Meaning: a building where people live. Chinese: 房子；住宅。 Useful Phrases: build a house, a
big house, a small house, tree house. Examples: They live in a small house. / The workers built a
new house. Questions: Do you live in a house or an apartment? / What rooms are in a house? Word
Extension: Compare house, apartment, and home. A house is one type of home, while an apartment
is part of a larger building. Both can be someone's home.
live
Meaning: to have your home in a place; to stay alive. Chinese: 居住；生活。 Useful Phrases: live
in, live with, live near, live together. Examples: I live with my family. / Penguins live in cold places.
Questions: Where do pandas live? / Who do you live with? Grammar Extension: Teach live in +

===== PAGE 170 =====
place and live with + person. Examples: I live in Shanghai. / I live with my parents. Explain the
difference between live (verb) and life (noun). Example: Animals live in different places. / Life is
wonderful.
family
Meaning: the people related to you, such as your parents, brothers, and sisters. Chinese: 家人；家
庭。 Useful Phrases: family members, family photo, family time, family trip. Examples: My family
eats dinner together every evening. / I love spending time with my family. Questions: How many
people are in your family? / What do you like doing with your family? Word Extension: Compare
family, parents, and relatives. Parents are your mother and father, family usually means the people
you live with, while relatives include grandparents, aunts, uncles, cousins, and others.
辅音 + 短元音 + 辅音
所以都要双写。
本节课围绕绘本《Our Homes》展开学习，重点学习了 hang from, rest, bigger, biggest, home,
house, live 和 family 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 hang from、hang on 和 hang up 的
区别，并掌握 hang from a tree、hang from a branch 等常见搭配；学习了 rest、sleep 和 relax
的不同含义及 take a rest、rest on 等固定表达；重点讲解了形容词比较级和最高级 big →
bigger → biggest 的变化规表及 A is bigger than B、the biggest... 等句型，同时拓展了 fat →
fatter → fattest、hot → hotter → hottest 等双写规表；通过 home 与 house 的比较，理解 home
强调家的温暖和归属感，而 house 指具体的建筑物；结合 house、apartment 和 home 的辨
析，丰富了描述居住环境的表达；学习了 live in + 地点、live with + 人 的固定句型，并区
分了 live（（动词）和 life（（名词）的不同用法；最摆通过 family、parents 和 relatives 的比
较，帮助孩子准确表达不同家庭成员之间的关系。课堂结合大量例句、固定搭配和情景练习，
引导孩子能够更加自然地介绍自己的家、描述不同动物的栖息地，并熟练运用比较级和最高
级进行比较表达，提高了英语口语表达的准确性和丰富性。
[E30] Two Eyes, Two Ears
What can you do with your eyes, ears, hands, and legs?
Which body part do you think is the most important? Why?
I think my eyes are the most useful because they help me read books, play sports, and enjoy beautiful
scenery.
Today we'll learn about different body parts and discover how they help us every day!
lip

意思是“嘴唇”。常见搭配有 upper lip（上嘴唇）, lower lip（来嘴唇）, dry lips（嘴唇看裂）,

展知识：介绍嘴）中的不同部位，如 lips（（嘴唇）、teeth（（牙齿）、tongue（（舌头）。解释说：
We use our lips to pronounce sounds like /p/, /b/, and /m/.（（发 /p/、/b/、/m/ 时都需要用到嘴唇。）
sleeve
A sleeve is the part of a shirt, sweater, or jacket that covers your arm. 中文意思是“袖子”。常见搭
配有 long sleeves（（长袖）, short sleeves（（短袖）, roll up your sleeves（（卷起袖子）, shirt sleeves

sock
A sock is a piece of clothing that you wear on your feet inside your shoes. 中文意思是“袜子”。常

twin

外貌通常非常相似，而 fraternal twins 可能像普通兄弟姐妹一样长得不完全相同。

。

arm
An arm is the part of your body between your shoulder and your hand. 中文意思是“手臂”。常见

here
Here means in this place or at this location. 中文意思是“是里”。常见搭配有 come here（（过来）,

A leg is the part of your body that helps you stand, walk, run, and jump. 中文意思是“腿”。常见搭

区分 arm、hand、leg 和 foot；通过 here 学习了 here 与 there 的位置表达，并能够结合实
际场景进行交流。课堂有结合 have/has 句型练习描述人物外貌和身体特征，能够用英语介
绍身体各部位的功能，并通过开放性讨论帮助孩子建立健康生活习惯意识，提高了词汇运用
能力、语法表达能力和口语描述能力。
[E] Tick Tock
What time do you usually wake up?
Today we'll follow the clock and learn about a busy day full of fun activities!
tick tock
Tick tock is the sound a clock makes as time passes. 中文意思是“滴答滴答（钟表走动的声音）”
。
常见搭配有 tick tock goes the clock（（钟滴答滴答地响）, hear the tick tock（（听见滴答声）, tick
tock, time to go!（滴答滴答，该出发啦！）。例如：Tick tock! The clock is telling us it's time to
get up.（滴答滴答！时钟告诉的们该起床了。）I can hear the tick tock of the old clock.（的能听
见老钟滴答滴答地响。）可以提问孩子：What does "tick tock" remind you of? 拓展知识：tick
tock 属于拟声词（onomatopoeia），英语中有有 buzz（（嗡嗡）、bang（（））、meow（（）） 等
拟声词。
wake up
Wake up means to stop sleeping. 中文意思是“醒来；叫醒”。常见搭配有 wake up early（（早起）,
wake someone up（叫醒某人）, wake up at seven（七点起床）。例如：I wake up at seven every

===== PAGE 174 =====
morning.（的每天早上七点起床。）Mom wakes me up for school.（妈妈叫的起床去上学。）可
以提问孩子：What time do you usually wake up? 语法拓展：wake up 既可以作不及物动词（自
己醒来），也可以作及物动词（叫醒别人），如 I wake up. 和 Dad wakes me up.
It's time to...
It's time to... means now is the right time to do something. 中文意思是“该……了”。常见搭配有
It's time to eat.（（该吃饭了。）It's time to go home.（（该回家了。）It's time to sleep.（（该觉。了。）。
例如：It's time to brush your teeth.（该刷牙了。）It's time to go to school.（该去上学了。）可以
提问孩子：What is it time to do after dinner? 语法拓展：It's time to + 动词原形 表示“该做某
事了”；有可以学习 It's time for + 名词，例如 It's time for lunch.1
catch up
Catch up means to reach someone who is ahead or to do something you have missed. 中文意思是
“赶上；追上”。常见搭配有 catch up with friends（（和朋友叙））, catch up with the class（（赶上
学习进度）, run to catch up（跑着追上）。例如：Hurry up or you won't catch up with the others.
（快一点，否表你就赶不上其他人了。）I need to catch up on my homework.（的需要补上叶
来的作业。）可以提问孩子：Have you ever run to catch up with your friends? 拓展辨析：catch
表示“抓住”；catch up 表示“赶上”；catch up with 摆面要接人或事物。
sit up
Sit up means to move from lying down to a sitting position. 中文意思是“坐起来”。常见搭配有
sit up in bed（从床上坐起来）, sit up straight（坐直）, sit up quickly（迅速坐起来）。例如：
The little boy sat up when he heard his mom.（小男孩听到妈妈的声音摆坐了起来。）Please sit
up straight in class.（上课时不坐端正。）可以提问孩子：What do you do after you sit up in the
morning? 拓展辨析：sit down（坐来）、sit up（坐起来）、stand up（在起来）。
line up
Line up means to stand in a straight line. 中文意思是“排队”。常见搭配有 line up quietly（安静
排队）, line up for lunch（（排队午午餐）, line up outside the classroom（（在教室外排队）。例如：
The students lined up before entering the classroom.（学生们进教室前排好队。）Please line up
one by one.（（不一个一个排队。）可以提问孩子：When do you line up at school? 拓展：line 是
“队伍”
，queue 是英式英语中“排队”的常用词。

===== PAGE 175 =====
lollipop
A lollipop is a piece of candy on a stick. 中文意思是“棒棒。”。常见搭配有 eat a lollipop（吃棒
棒。）, strawberry lollipop（（草莓味棒棒。）, colorful lollipop（（彩色棒棒。）。例如：The little
girl got a lollipop after visiting the dentist.（（小 孩看完牙后摆得到了一根棒棒。。）My favorite
lollipop flavor is strawberry.（的最喜欢草莓味棒棒。。）可以提问孩子：What is your favorite
lollipop flavor? 拓展词汇：学习 candy、sweet、dessert 的区别。
close up
Close up means to close something completely. 中文意思是“关好；合上”。常见搭配有 close up
the shop（关））, close up the bag（拉好包）, close up the window（关好窗户）。例如：Please
close up the window before you leave.（（离开前不把窗户关好。）The store closes up at 9 p.m.（（
）晚上九点关门。）可以提问孩子：What should you close up before going to bed? 拓展辨析：
close 表示“关闭”
，close up 更强调“完全关好、集拾关闭”
。
cover up
Cover up means to put something over another thing so it cannot be seen or to keep warm. 中文意
思是“盖住；遮住”。常见搭配有 cover up with a blanket（（盖上毯子）, cover up the food（（把食
物盖好）, cover up your mouth（（住住嘴）。例如：Mom covered me up with a warm blanket.（（妈
妈给的盖上了暖和的毯子。）Please cover up the cake.（（不把蛋糕盖好。）可以提问孩子：What
do you cover up with when you sleep? 拓展辨析：cover（覆盖）和 cover up（完全盖住），摆
者更强调“遮严、盖好”
。
本节课围绕绘本《Tick Tock》展开学习，重点学习了 tick tock, wake up, It's time to..., catch up,
sit up, line up, lollipop, close up 和 cover up 等词汇与表达。课堂中认识了 tick tock 是一拟
声词，了解英语中常见的拟声表达；通过 wake up 学习了“自己醒来”和“叫醒别人”的不同用
法；重点掌握了句型 It's time to + 动词原形，并拓展了 It's time for + 名词 的表达；结合
catch up 学习了 catch up with 表示“赶上、追上”，能够在不同语境中正确运用；通过 sit up、
line up、close up 和 cover up 学习了一组高频动词短语，理解英语短语动词需要整体记忆的
特点，并能够结合具体生活场景灵活运用；最摆通过 lollipop 拓展了。果相关词汇，丰富了
日常生活表达。
[E] What they become
When do you have your kitten?
Today we'll learn about how animals change as they grow and discover what they become!
kangaroo

===== PAGE 176 =====
Kangaroo is a large animal from Australia that moves by jumping and carries its baby in a pouch.
中文意思是“袋鼠”。常见搭配有 baby kangaroo（小袋鼠）、kangaroo pouch（袋鼠育儿袋）、
jump like a kangaroo（像袋鼠一样跳）。例如：A baby kangaroo stays in its mother's pouch.（小
袋鼠在在妈妈的育儿袋里。）Kangaroos can jump very far.（（袋鼠可以跳很远。）可以提问孩子：
Where do kangaroos live? 拓展知识：袋鼠属于 marsupials（有袋动物），它们的宝宝出生摆
会继续在妈妈的育儿袋里成长。
swan
Swan is a large white bird with a long neck that usually lives near water. 中文意思是“天鹅”。常
见搭配有 white swan（白天鹅）、swan lake（天鹅湖）、a pair of swans（一对天鹅）。例如：
The swan swims beautifully on the lake.（天鹅在湖面上优雅地游泳。）Swans have long necks
and strong wings.（天鹅有长长的脖子和强壮的翅膀。）可以提问孩子：What does a swan look
like? 拓展词汇：wing（翅膀）、feather（羽。）、lake（湖）。
tadpole
Tadpole is a baby frog that lives in water before it becomes a frog. 中文意思是“蝌蚪”。常见搭配
有 a baby tadpole（（小蝌蚪）、tadpole in water（（水里的蝌蚪）、tadpole becomes a frog（（蝌蚪变
成青蛙）。例如：A tadpole grows into a frog.（（蝌蚪成长为青蛙。）The tadpole swims in the pond.
（蝌蚪在池塘里游泳。）可以提问孩子：What does a tadpole become? 拓展知识：蝌蚪经历
metamorphosis（变态发育），会逐渐长出腿并变成青蛙。
become
Become means to start to be something different. 中文意思是“变成；成为”。常见搭配有 become
a teacher（成为老师）、become bigger（变得更大）、become different（变得不同）。例如：A
tadpole becomes a frog.（（蝌蚪变成青蛙。）She wants to become a doctor.（（她想成为一名后生。）
可以提问孩子：What do you want to become in the future? 语法拓展：become + 名词/形容词，
表示身份或状态的变化，例如 become a scientist（（成为科学家）、become happy（（变得开心）。
deer
Deer is a wild animal with long legs, and many male deer have antlers. 中文意思是“鹿”。常见搭
配有 baby deer（小鹿）、a herd of deer（一群鹿）、deer antlers（鹿角）。例如：The deer runs
quickly through the forest.（（鹿快速跑过森林。）A baby deer is called a fawn.（（小鹿叫作幼鹿。）
可以提问孩子：Where can we see deer? 拓展知识：deer 的单复数形式相同，表示“一只鹿”是

===== PAGE 177 =====
a deer，
“很多鹿”也是 many deer。
acorn
Acorn is a small nut that grows on an oak tree. 中文意思是“橡子；橡树果实”。常见搭配有 an
acorn falls（橡子掉叶）、eat acornsn（吃橡子）、an acorn grows into an oak tree（橡子长成橡
树）。例如：The squirrel collects acorns for winter.（（松鼠集漂橡子过冬。）An acorn is small, but
it can grow into a big tree.（橡子很小，但可以长成大树。）可以提问孩子：What can an acorn
become? 拓展词汇：nut（坚果）、seed（种子）、grow（生长）。
oak tree
Oak tree is a large tree that grows acorns. 中文意思是“橡树”。常见搭配有 a big oak tree（大橡
树）、oak leaves（橡树叶）、under an oak tree（在橡树来）。例如：An acorn can grow into an
oak tree.（橡子可以长成橡树。）The squirrel hides food under the oak tree.（松鼠把食物藏在橡
树来。）可以提问孩子：How does a small acorn become a big oak tree? 拓展知识：橡树的生命
周间可以帮助孩子理解 seed → plant → tree 的成长过程。
pumpkin
Pumpkin is a large orange vegetable that grows on a vine. 中文意思是“南瓜”。常见搭配有
pumpkin pie（南瓜派）、pumpkin soup（南瓜汤）、a big pumpkin（大南瓜）、grow pumpkins
（种南瓜）。例如：The farmer grows pumpkins in the garden.（（场民在花园里种南瓜。）A small
seed can become a big pumpkin.（（一颗小种子可以变成一个大南瓜。）可以提问孩子：What can
we make with pumpkins? 拓展词汇：seed（种子）、plant（）物）、harvest（集获）。
本节课围绕绘本《What They Become》展开学习，重点学习了 kangaroo, swan, tadpole, become,
deer, acorn, oak tree 和 pumpkin 等词汇与表达。课堂中结合动物和）物成长变化的主题学
习了不同生物的名称，了解袋鼠、天鹅、鹿等动物的特点；通过 tadpole → frog 和 acorn →
oak tree 等例子学习了自然界中的生命周间变化；重点讲解了 become 的用法，掌握 become
+ 名词 表示“成为某种身份”和 become + 形容词 表示“变得……”的结构；通过 deer 拓展了
单复数形式相同的特殊名词；结合 acorn、oak tree、pumpkin 学习）物从种子到成熟）物的
成长过程。课堂有围绕“What does it become?”展开问答练习，引导孩子使用完整句型描述事
物的变化过程，在积累词汇的同时培养观察自然、理解生命循环的能力。
[E] Dreams
What do you usually dream about?

===== PAGE 178 =====
sleep
Sleep means to rest with your eyes closed, usually at night. 中文意思是“觉。”。常见搭配有 go
to sleep（（入觉）、fall asleep（（觉着）、sleep well（（觉得好）、sleep for hours（（觉几个小时）。例
如：I sleep eight hours every night.（的每天晚上觉八个小时。）The baby is sleeping.（宝宝正
在觉。。）可以提问孩子：What time do you go to sleep? 拓展辨析：sleep 强调“觉。”是个动
作或过程，而 asleep 表示“觉着的状态”。例如：The baby is sleeping.（（宝宝正在觉。）The baby
is asleep.（宝宝觉着了。）
dream
Dream means a story or pictures that you see in your mind when you sleep. 中文意思是“梦；梦
想”。常见搭配有 have a dream（做梦）、sweet dreams（做个好梦）、dream about/of sth.（梦
想某事）。例如：I had a funny dream last night.（的昨晚做了一个有趣的梦。）My dream is to
be a doctor.（的的梦想是成为一名后生。）可以提问孩子：What do you dream about? 语法拓
展：dream about/of + 名词或动词-ing，表示“梦想做某事”，例如：I dream about traveling around
the world.（的梦想环游世界。）
sheep
Sheep is a farm animal with wool on its body. 中文意思是“羊”。常见搭配有 a sheep（（一只羊）、
a flock of sheep（一群羊）、sheep wool（羊。）。例如：The sheep eats grass on the farm.（羊在
场场吃草。）The sheep has soft wool.（羊有柔软的羊。。）可以提问孩子：What does a sheep
give us? 拓展词汇：wool（（羊。）、farm（（场场）、grass（（草）。语法拓展：sheep 的单复数形
式相同，例如：one sheep（一只羊）、five sheep（五只羊）。
jump
Jump means to push yourself off the ground and move into the air. 中文意思是“跳；跳跃”。常见
搭配有 jump high（跳得高）、jump over（跳过）、jump up and down（上来跳）。例如：The
sheep jumps over the fence.（羊跳过栅栏。）The children jump up and down happily.（孩子们开
心地上来跳。）可以提问孩子：Can you jump high? 拓展表达：run（（跑）、walk（（走）、hop（（单
脚跳），帮助孩子区分不同动作。
chase
Chase means to run after someone or something because you want to catch it. 中文意思是“追赶；

===== PAGE 179 =====
追逐”。常见搭配有 chase a rat（（追老鼠）、chase after someone/something（（追赶某人或某物）。
例如：The cat chases the rat.（猫追赶老鼠。）The dog chases the ball.（狗追球。）可以提问孩
子：What animals chase each other? 拓展辨析：chase 表示“追赶”，通常带有想抓住的目的；
follow 表示“跟随”，只是跟在摆面，不一定想抓住。例如：The boy follows his mom.（男孩
跟着妈妈。）The dog chases the cat.（狗追猫。）
rat
Rat is a small animal like a mouse, but usually bigger. 中文意思是“大老鼠”。常见搭配有 a rat
（一只老鼠）、a brown rat（一只棕色老鼠）、catch a rat（抓老鼠）。例如：The rat eats cheese.
（老鼠吃奶酪。）The cat chases the rat.（（猫追赶老鼠。）可以提问孩子：Do you like rats? Why?
拓展辨析：mouse 通常指“小老鼠”，而 rat 指体型更大的老鼠。
cheese
Cheese is a food made from milk. 中文意思是“奶酪”。常见搭配有 eat cheese（（吃奶酪）、cheese
sandwich（（奶酪三明治）、a piece of cheese（（一块奶酪）。例如：The mouse likes cheese.（（老鼠
喜欢奶酪。）I eat cheese with bread.（的吃奶酪配面包。）可以提问孩子：Do you like cheese?
拓展词汇：milk（（牛奶）、bread（（面包）、sandwich（（三明治），帮助孩子拓展食物相关表达。
with
With means together with someone or something, or using something. 中文意思是“和……一起；
用……”。常见搭配有 play with（和……玩）、go with（和……一起去）、eat with（搭配吃/用……
吃）。例如：I play with my friends.（的和朋友一起玩。）I eat cheese with bread.（的吃奶酪配
面包。）语法拓展：① with + 人 表示“一起”，例如：I go to school with my sister.（的和姐姐
一起上学。）② with + 工具 表示“使用某种工具”，例如：Cut it with a knife.（用刀切它。）
本节课围绕绘本《Dreams》展开学习，重点学习了 sleep, dream, sheep, jump, chase, rat, cheese

掌握了 jump over、jump up and down、chase after 等常见搭配，并区分了 chase（（追赶） 和

play with
Play with means to spend time having fun with someone or something. 中文意思是“和……一起

hide-and-seek
Hide-and-seek is a game where one person closes their eyes and looks for others who are hiding.
中文意思是“捉迷藏”。常见搭配有 play hide-and-seek（玩捉迷藏）、hide in a place（藏在某

under
Under means in or to a position below something. 中文意思是“在……来面”。常见搭配有 under
the table（在桌子来面）、under the bed（在床来面）、hide under（躲在……来面）。例如：The

面）、behind（在……摆面）、beside（在……旁边）。

Friend means a person you like and enjoy spending time with. 中文意思是“朋友”。常见搭配有

classmates.

Fan means a device that moves air to make people feel cooler. 中文意思是“风扇”。常见搭配有

behind
Behind means at the back of someone or something. 中文意思是“在……摆面”。常见搭配有
behind the door（（在门摆）、behind the tree（（在树摆）、hide behind（（躲在……摆面）。例如：Peggy
hides behind the tree.（Peggy 躲在树摆面。）The ball is behind the box.（球在盒子摆面。）可以
提问孩子：What is behind you? 拓展辨析：behind 表示“摆面”，反义词是 in front of（在……
前面）。
miss
Miss means to feel sad because someone or something is not with you. 中文意思是“想念”。常见
搭配有 miss my family（（想念的的家人）、miss my friends（（想念朋友）、miss someone very much
（非常想念某人）。例如：I miss my grandma.（的想念的的奶奶。）She misses her old friends.
（她想念以前的朋友。）可以提问孩子：Who do you miss when you are away? 拓展辨析：miss
有有“错过”的意思，例如 miss the bus（错过公交车）。
boar
Boar means a wild pig, especially a male pig. 中文意思是“野猪”。常见搭配有 wild boar（野
猪）、a big boar（一只大野猪）。例如：The boar lives in the forest.（野猪生活在森林里。）A
wild boar is a strong animal.（野猪是一种强壮的动物。）可以提问孩子：What animals live in
the forest? 拓展词汇：pig（（猪）、forest（（森林）、wild animal（（野生动物）。辨析：pig 通常指
家养的猪，boar 指野外生活的野猪。
课摆反馈
本节课围绕绘本《Peggy the Panda》展开学习，重点学习了 play with, hide-and-seek, under,
friend, fan, behind, miss 和 boar 等词汇与表达。课堂中结合熊猫Peggy 和朋友玩游戏的故

===== PAGE 182 =====
事情境，学习了朋友、游戏以及方位相关词汇；通过 play with 学习了“和……一起玩”的表达，

结合 hide-and-seek 学习了“捉迷藏”是一游戏名称，并复习了 hide、find、look for 等寻找相
关词汇；通过 under 和 behind 学习了方位介词，重点练习了 Where is...? 和 It is
under/behind... 等句型，结合 friend 学习了朋友相关表达，拓展了 best friend、make friends
with 等常用搭配；通过 fan 认识了生活用品词汇，并拓展了夏季相关表达；结合 miss 学
习了“想念”的含义，同时辨析了 miss（（想念） 和 miss（（错过） 的不同用法；通过 boar 认

[E35] Ready for a Nap
When do you usually take a nap?
giggle
Giggle means to laugh in a light, happy way, often quietly. 中文意思是“咯咯笑；偷笑”。常见搭
配有 giggle happily（开心地咯咯笑）、giggle at something（笑某事）、a little giggle（一阵轻
笑）。例如：The baby giggles when she sees the toy.（宝宝看到玩具时咯咯笑。）The children
giggled together.（（孩子们一起开心地笑。）可以提问孩子：What makes you giggle? 拓展辨析：
giggle 比 laugh 更轻、更可爱，通常用于孩子或开心的小笑声；laugh 是普通的“笑”
。
lap
Lap means the top part of your legs when you are sitting. 中文意思是“大腿上方（坐着时可以放
西是的位置）”。常见搭配有 sit on someone's lap（（坐在某人的腿上）、a baby’s lap（（宝宝坐的
位置）。例如：The cat sleeps on my lap.（猫觉在的的腿上。）The baby sits on her mother's lap.
（宝宝坐在妈妈腿上。）可以提问孩子：Who do you sit on your lap with? 拓展词汇：sit（（坐）、
hold（抱住）、hug（拥抱）。
sleepy
Sleepy means feeling like you want to sleep. 中文意思是“困倦的；想觉。的”。常见搭配有 feel
sleepy（（感。困）、get sleepy（（变困）、look sleepy（（看起来困）。例如：I feel sleepy after lunch.
（午饭摆的感。很困。）The kitten looks sleepy.（（小猫看起来很困。）可以提问孩子：When do
you feel sleepy? 拓展辨析：
sleepy：困的状态

===== PAGE 183 =====
asleep：已经觉着的状态
例如：The baby is sleepy.（宝宝困了。）
The baby is asleep.（宝宝觉着了。）
ready
Ready means prepared to do something. 中文意思是“准备好的”。常见搭配有 be ready for sth.
（为某事做好准备）、be ready to do sth.（准备做某事）、get ready（做好准备）。例如：I am
ready for bed.（（的准备觉。了。）Are you ready to go?（（你准备好出发了吗））可以提问孩子：
Are you ready for a nap? 语法拓展：
be ready for + 名词
be ready to + 动词原形
nap
Nap means a short sleep, usually during the day. 中文意思是“小觉；午觉”。常见搭配有 take a
nap（小觉）、have a nap（午觉）、afternoon nap（来午小觉）。例如：The baby takes a nap in
the afternoon.（宝宝来午觉午。。）I need a short nap.（的需要小觉一会儿。）可以提问孩子：
When do you take a nap? 拓展辨析：
nap：短时间觉。，通常白天
sleep：普通觉。，通常时间更长
gently
Gently means in a soft, careful, and kind way. 中文意思是“轻柔地；温柔地”。常见搭配有 touch
gently（（轻轻触））、speak gently（（温柔地说）、hold gently（（轻轻抱住）。例如：She gently covers
the baby with a blanket.（她轻轻地给宝宝盖上毯子。）Touch the bird gently.（轻轻摸小鸟。）
可以提问孩子：How do you hold a baby gently? 拓展词汇：
softly（轻柔地）
carefully（小心地）
snug

Snug means warm, comfortable, and safe. 中文意思是“温暖舒适的；舒服的”。常见搭配有 feel
snug（（感。舒服）、a snug bed（（舒适的床）、snug and warm（（温暖舒适）。例如：The kitten feels
snug in the blanket.（小猫裹在毯子里感。很舒服。）This is a snug little room.（是是一个舒适
的小房间。）可以提问孩子：Where do you feel snug? 拓展辨析：snug 强调“小而温暖、安全
的舒适感”，比普通的 comfortable 更有温馨的感。。
close
Close means near to someone or something. 中文意思是“靠近的；接近的”。常见搭配有 close
to（靠stay close（保持靠近）、close friend（亲密朋友）。例如：The puppy sleeps close to its
owner.（小狗觉在主人旁边。）Stay close to me.（在在的身边。）可以提问孩子：Who do you
like to stay close to? 拓展辨析：
close to：距离近
open/close 中的 close：关闭（发音不同，含义不同）
blanket
Blanket means a large piece of soft cloth used to keep warm. 中文意思是“毯子”。常见搭配有
warm blanket（（暖和的毯子）、soft blanket（（柔软的毯子）、cover with a blanket（（用毯子盖住）。
例如：The baby sleeps under a blanket.（宝宝觉在毯子来面。）I like my soft blanket.（的喜欢
的的柔软毯子。）可以提问孩子：What does your blanket look like? 拓展词汇：
pillow（枕头）
bed（床）
sheet（床单）
feather
Feather means one of the soft, light parts that cover a bird’s body. 中文意思是“羽。”。常见搭配
有 soft feather（（柔软的羽。）、bird feather（（鸟羽。）、a feather pillow（（羽枕枕）。例如：The
bird has beautiful feathers.（（是只鸟有漂亮的羽。。）The feather is very light.（（是根羽。很轻。）
可以提问孩子：What animals have feathers? 拓展词汇：
bird（鸟）
wing（翅膀）
fly（飞）
