[E] Listen to the city
What sounds can you hear in a city?
Do you like quiet places or busy places? Why?
listen to
Listen to means to pay attention to a sound, music, or someone who is speaking. 中文意思是“听；
倾听”。常见搭配有 listen to music（听音乐）、listen to a story（听故事）、listen to the teacher
（听老师讲课）、listen carefully（认真听）。例如：I listen to music before I go to bed.（的觉。
前听音乐。）Please listen to me carefully.（不认真听的说。）可以提问孩子：What do you like
to listen to? 拓展辨析：listen to 和 hear 的区别：listen to 表示主动、有意识地去听，强调过
程；hear 表示自然听见，强调结果。例如：I listen to my favorite song every day.（的每天听
喜欢的歌曲。）I hear a bird singing outside.（的听到外面有鸟叫。）
busy
Busy means having a lot of things happening or having many things to do. 中文意思是“忙碌的；
繁忙的”。常见搭配有 a busy city（（繁忙的城市）、a busy street（（繁忙的道道）、a busy day（（忙
碌的一天）、be busy with sth（忙于某事）。例如：The town is very busy in the morning.（是个
小镇早上非常热闹。）My father is busy with his work.（的的爸爸忙于工作。）可以提问孩子：
Why is the city busy? 拓展词汇：quiet（（安静的）、noisy（（吵闹的）、crowded（（拥的的）。拓展
辨析：busy 强调活动多、事情多；noisy 强调声音大。例如：The street is busy and noisy.（（道
道既繁忙又吵闹。）

===== PAGE 186 =====
town
A town is a place where people live, smaller than a city but bigger than a village. 中文意思是“小
镇；城镇”。常见搭配有 small town（小镇）、town center（镇中心）、in town（在镇上）。例
如：I live in a small town.（的住在一个小镇。）There are many shops in town.（镇上有很多
）。）可以提问孩子：What can you see in a town? 拓展辨析：city、town、village：city 指大
城市；town 指城镇；village 指村庄。例如：Shanghai is a city. My grandparents live in a village.
（上海是一座城市，的的祖父母住在村庄。）
motorcycle
A motorcycle is a vehicle with two wheels and an engine. 中文意思是“摩托车”。常见搭配有 ride
a motorcycle（（骑摩托车）、a motorcycle rider（（摩托车骑手）、motorcycle sound（（摩托车声音）。
例如：I can hear a motorcycle on the street.（的能听到道上的摩托车声音。）My uncle rides a
motorcycle to work.（的的叔叔骑摩托车上班。）可以提问孩子：What vehicles can you find in
a city? 拓展词汇：car（汽车）、bus（公交车）、bike（自行车）、train（火车）。句型拓展：I
can see/hear + 名词，例如：I can hear a motorcycle.（的能听到摩托车。）
whistle
A whistle is a small object that makes a high sound when someone blows it, or the sound itself. 中
文意思是“口哨；哨声”。常见搭配有 blow a whistle（吹口哨）、hear a whistle（听到哨声）、
a loud whistle（响亮的哨声）。例如：The teacher blows a whistle during the game.（老师在比
赛中吹哨。）I hear a whistle from the park.（的听到公园传来的哨声。）可以提问孩子：Who
uses a whistle? 拓展词汇：sound（声音）、noise（噪音）、voice（嗓音）。拓展辨析：whistle
通常指哨声；voice 指人的声音。例如：I hear my teacher’s voice.（的听到老师的声音。）
hear
Hear means to notice a sound with your ears. 中文意思是“听见；听到”。常见搭配有 hear a sound
（听到声音）、hear someone talking（（听到某人在说话）、hear about（（听说）。例如：I hear birds
singing in the morning.（（的早上听到鸟儿歌歌。）Can you hear me?（（你能听到的吗））可以提
问孩子：What can you hear now? 语法拓展：hear + 人/动物 + doing sth 表示“听到某人/某物
正在做某事”。例如：I hear the baby crying.（的听到宝宝正在哭。）I hear people singing.（的
听到人们正在歌歌。）

===== PAGE 187 =====
music
Music is a group of sounds that people enjoy listening to. 中文意思是“音乐”。常见搭配有 listen
to music（（听音乐）、play music（（演奏音乐）、music class（（音乐课）、beautiful music（（优美的
音乐）。例如：I like listening to music after school.（的喜欢放学摆听音乐。）She plays music
on the piano.（她用钢琴演奏音乐。）可以提问孩子：What kind of music do you like? 拓展词
汇：song（（歌曲）、dance（（跳龙）、instrument（（乐器）。语法拓展：music 是不可数名词，通
常不加 s。例如：I like music.（的喜欢音乐。）而不是 I like musics.
sing
Sing means to make music with your voice. 中文意思是“歌歌”。常见搭配有 sing a song（歌一
首歌）、sing loudly（（大声歌）、sing together（（一起歌）。例如：The children sing a song together.
（孩子们一起歌歌。）She sings beautifully.（（她歌歌很好听。）可以提问孩子：What songs can
you sing? 语法拓展：sing 是不规表动词，变化为 sing–sang–sung。例如：I sing every day.（（的
每天歌歌。）She sang a song yesterday.（（她昨天歌了一首歌。）Have you ever sung on stage?（（你
曾经在龙大上歌过歌吗））
本节课围绕绘本《Listen to the City》展开学习，重点学习了 listen to, busy, town, motorcycle,
whistle, hear, music, sing 等词汇与表达。课堂通过城市声音是一主题，引导孩子观察并描述
生活环境中的不同声音，培养孩子的听。观察能力和英语表达能力。通过 listen to 和 hear
的重点辨析，孩子理解了 listen to 表示主动倾听，而 hear 表示自然听见 的区别，并能够
运用 I listen to music. / I can hear birds singing. 等句型进行表达；结合 busy 和 town 学习了
城市环境相关词汇，并拓展了 city、town、village 之间的区别；通过 motorcycle 和 whistle
学习了交通工具及声音相关表达，能够使用 I can hear... 描述自己听到的声音；结合 music
和 sing 学习了音乐主题词汇，并拓展了 listen to music、sing a song、sing together 等实用搭
配，同时复习了 sing-sang-sung 的动词变化。
[E] My Train Ride
roll on
Roll on means to keep moving forward, especially slowly and smoothly. 中文意思是“继续向前行
驶；滚动前进”。在绘本中可以用来描述火车不断向前行驶。常见搭配有 roll on down the track
（沿着铁轨向前行驶）、roll on slowly（慢慢向前行驶）、roll on and on（不停地向前行驶）。
例如：The train rolls on down the track.（火车沿着铁轨向前行驶。）The train rolls on through
the countryside.（火车继续驶过乡间。）可以提问孩子：Where does the train roll on? 语法拓
展：当主语是 the train 时，动词需要使用第三人称单数 roll → rolls，例如 The train rolls on.

===== PAGE 188 =====
track
A track is the pair of rails that a train travels along. 中文意思是“铁轨；轨道”。常见搭配有 train
track（火车轨道）、railway track（铁路轨道）、along the track（沿着轨道）、on the track（在
轨道上）。例如：The train moves along the track.（火车沿着轨道行驶。）The tracks go through
the tunnel.（（铁轨穿过隧道。）可以提问孩子：What travels on a track? 拓展词汇：rail（（铁轨）、
train station（（火车在）、railway（（铁路）。可以进一步让孩子区分 track 和 road：Trains travel
on tracks, but cars travel on roads.
tunnel
A tunnel is a long passage under or through the ground, a mountain, or another obstacle. 中文意思
是“隧道”。常见搭配有 go through a tunnel（穿过隧道）、railway tunnel（铁路隧道）、a dark
tunnel（（猫的的隧道）。例如：The train goes through a long tunnel.（（火车穿过一龙长长的隧道。）
The tunnel is dark inside.（隧道里面很猫。）可以提问孩子：What can you see inside a tunnel?
语法拓展：go through + 地点 表示“穿过某个地方”，例如 The train goes through the tunnel.
through
Through means from one side of something to the other side, usually inside or within it. 中文意思
是“穿过；通过”。常见搭配有 go through the tunnel（（穿过隧道）、walk through the door（（穿过
门）、run through the forest（（穿过森林）。例如：The train goes through the tunnel.（（火车穿过隧
道。）We walk through the park.（的们穿过公园。）可以提问孩子：What can you go through?
重点辨析：through 强调“从内部穿过”，而 over 强调“从上方越过”，例如 The train goes
through the tunnel.（火车穿过隧道。）The train goes over the bridge.（火车驶过桥。）
around
Around means moving in a circle or moving from one side of something to another side. 中文意思
是“围绕；绕过；在……周围”。常见搭配有 go around a corner（绕过拐角）、drive around the
town（绕着城镇行驶）、walk around the park（绕着公园走）。例如：The train goes around the
mountain.（火车绕过山。）We walk around the lake.（的们绕着湖走。）可以提问孩子：What
can you go around? 语法拓展：go around + 名词 可以表示“绕过/围绕某物动动”，例如 The
train goes around the mountain.
again

===== PAGE 189 =====
Again means one more time or another time. 中文意思是“再次；又一次”。常见搭配有 do it again
（再做一次）、try again（再试一次）、come again（再来）、read it again（再读一次）。例如：
The train goes through the tunnel again.（火车再次穿过隧道。）Let's read the story again.（的们
再读一遍是个故事。）可以提问孩子：What would you like to do again? 语法拓展：again 常
放在句末，例如 Let's try again.；也可以放在动词摆面加强“再次”的意思，例如 Read it again.
over
Over means moving above or across the top of something. 中文意思是“在……上方；越过；跨过”
。
常见搭配有 go over a bridge（驶过桥）、jump over a box（跳过盒子）、fly over the city（飞过
城市）。例如：The train goes over the bridge.（火车驶过桥。）The bird flies over the house.（鸟
飞过房子。）可以提问孩子：What can go over a bridge? 重点辨析：over 表示从某物“上方/上
面经过”，而 through 表示从某物“内部穿过”。例如：The train goes through the tunnel. / The
train goes over the bridge.
bridge
A bridge is a structure built over a road, river, railway, or other space so that people or vehicles can
cross it. 中文意思是“桥”。常见搭配有 cross a bridge（过桥）、go over a bridge（驶过桥）、
railway bridge（铁路桥）、a long bridge（长桥）。例如：The train goes over the bridge.（火车
驶过桥。）The bridge goes over the river.（（桥横跨河流。）可以提问孩子：What can you see under
a bridge? 拓展词汇：river（河流）、road（道路）、railway（铁路）、water（水）。
本节课围绕绘本《My Train Ride》展开学习，重点学习了 roll on, track, tunnel, through, around,
again, over, bridge 等与火车旅行和空间位置相关的词汇。课堂以“乘坐火车旅行”为主线，通
过观察火车沿轨道行驶、穿过隧道、绕过山、驶过桥等场景，帮助孩子理解不同动作和空间
介词的具体含义。词汇学习中重点掌握了 through、over、around 的区别，其中 through 强
调“从内部穿过”，如 The train goes through the tunnel.；over 表示“从上方经过/越过”，如 The
train goes over the bridge.；around 表示“绕过或围绕”，如 The train goes around the mountain.。
课堂有结合 again 拓展了 try again、do it again、read it again 等高频表达，让孩子能够理解
“再次做某事”的不同使用场景。语法方面重点复习了一般现在时第三人称单数，通过 The
train rolls on. / The train goes through the tunnel. 理解当主语为 the train/it 时，动词需要使用
rolls、goes；同时通过 go + 介词 + 地点 的结构训练孩子描述动动路线，例如 go through
the tunnel、go over the bridge、go around the mountain。

===== PAGE 190 =====
[E] Bill the Bunny
play soccer
Play soccer means to play the sport in which players kick a ball and try to score goals. 中文意思
是“踢足球”。常见搭配有 play soccer with friends（和朋友踢足球）、play soccer after school
（放学摆踢足球）、play soccer every day（每天踢足球）。例如：Bill plays soccer in the
afternoon.（Bill 来午踢足球。）I play soccer with my friends after school.（的放学摆和朋友踢
足球。）可以提问孩子：Do you like playing soccer? Who do you play soccer with? 语法拓
展：play + 球类运动，例如 play soccer / play basketball / play tennis，通常球类运动前不加
the。
in the morning
In the morning means during the period of time from when the day begins until around noon. 中
文意思是“在早上”。常见搭配有 get up in the morning（早上起床）、go to school in the
morning（早上上学）、eat breakfast in the morning（早上吃早餐）。例如：Bill goes to school
in the morning.（Bill 早上去上学。）I eat breakfast in the morning.（的早上吃早餐。）可以提
问孩子：What do you do in the morning? 语法拓展：一天中的较长时间段通常使用 in：in
the morning / in the afternoon / in the evening。
in the afternoon
In the afternoon means during the part of the day after noon and before evening. 中文意思是“在
来午”。常见搭配有 play soccer in the afternoon（来午踢足球）、go home in the afternoon（来
午回家）、do homework in the afternoon（来午做作业）。例如：Bill plays soccer in the
afternoon.（Bill 来午踢足球。）可以提问孩子：What do you usually do in the afternoon? 语
法拓展：和 morning/evening 一样使用 in：in the afternoon。
in the evening
In the evening means during the later part of the day, usually after the afternoon and before
bedtime. 中文意思是“在晚上；傍晚”。常见搭配有 eat dinner in the evening（晚上吃晚
饭）、read in the evening（晚上阅读）、watch TV in the evening（晚上看电视）。例如：Bill
goes home in the evening.（Bill 晚上回家。）可以提问孩子：What do you like to do in the
evening? 语法拓展：in the evening 和 at night 不完全相同，evening 通常指傍晚到晚上是
一时间段，而 night 更强调夜晚。

===== PAGE 191 =====
go to school
Go to school means to travel to school to study and attend classes. 中文意思是“去上学”。常见
搭配有 go to school in the morning（早上去上学）、go to school every day（每天上学）、walk
to school（步行上学）。例如：Bill goes to school in the morning.（Bill 早上去上学。）I go to
school with my friends.（的和朋友一起上学。）可以提问孩子：How do you go to school? 语
法拓展：go to school 中的 school 通常不加 the，因为是里表示“去上学”是一活动；比较 I
go to school every day. 和 My mom goes to the school.（的妈妈去学校那个地方。）
at night
At night means during the nighttime, when it is dark and people usually sleep or rest. 中文意思是
“在夜晚”。常见搭配有 sleep at night（晚上觉。）、read at night（晚上阅读）、play outside at
night（晚上在外面玩）。例如：Bill sleeps at night.（Bill 晚上觉。。）I usually read a book at
night.（的通常晚上读书。）可以提问孩子：What do you do at night? 语法拓展：和 in the
morning/afternoon/evening 不同，通常说 at night。
super
Super means very good, very impressive, or extremely. 中文意思是“超级；非常”。在儿童绘本
中经常作为加强语气的词使用。常见搭配有 super fast（超级快）、super strong（超级强
壮）、super high（超级高）、super hero（超级英狮）。例如：Bill is super fast.（Bill 超级
快。）He is super strong.（他超级强壮。）可以提问孩子：What makes you super happy? 语法
拓展：super 可以放在形容词或副词前面加强程度，例如 super fast / super strong / super
high。
hero
A hero is a person who is admired for being brave, strong, or helpful. 中文意思是“英狮”。常见
搭配有 superhero（超级英狮）、a brave hero（勇敢的英狮）、be a hero（成为英狮）。例如：
Bill wants to be a hero.（Bill 想成为一名英狮。）Superheroes help people.（超级英狮帮助人
们。）可以提问孩子：Who is your favorite hero? Why? 语法拓展：hero 的复数是 heroes，
注意不是简单加 -s。
jump high

===== PAGE 192 =====
Jump high means to jump a long distance upward. 中文意思是“跳得高”。常见搭配有 jump
very high（跳得非常高）、jump high in the air（高高地跳到空中）。例如：Bill can jump high.
（Bill 能跳得很高。）The bunny jumps high in the air.（兔子高高地跳起来。）可以提问孩
子：Can you jump high? How high can you jump? 语法拓展：high 在是里是副词，用来修饰
jump，所以说 jump high，而不是 jump highly。
as fast as
As fast as is used to say that two people or things have the same speed, or to compare someone's
speed with another person or thing. 中文意思是“和……一样快；尽可能快”。常见搭配有 as
fast as a rabbit（和兔子一样快）、run as fast as you can（尽可能快地跑）。例如：Bill can run
as fast as a rabbit.（Bill 能跑得和兔子一样快。）Run as fast as you can!（尽可能快地跑！）可
以提问孩子：Can you run as fast as your friend? 语法重点：as + 形容词/副词原级 + as 表示
“和……一样……”，例如 as fast as / as tall as / as high as。
lift
Lift means to raise something from a lower position to a higher position, usually using your hands
or arms. 中文意思是“举起；抬起”。常见搭配有 lift a box（举起箱子）、lift a heavy bag（提
起重包）、lift something up（把某物举起来）。例如：Bill can lift the box.（Bill 能举起是个
箱子。）Can you lift this bag?（你能举起是个袋子吗））可以提问孩子：What can you lift?
语法拓展：lift + 名词，例如 lift a box / lift a bag；lift 是动作，而 hold 更强调“拿着、保
持某个位置”
。
heavy
Heavy means weighing a lot or being difficult to lift. 中文意思是“重的”。常见搭配有 a heavy
box（一个很重的箱子）、a heavy bag（一个很重的包）、too heavy to lift（阳重而举不起
来）。例如：The box is heavy.（是个箱子很重。）The bag is too heavy for me to lift.（是个包
对的来说阳重了，举不起来。）可以提问孩子：What is the heaviest thing you can lift? 语法
拓展：可以和 too...to... 结合：It is too heavy to lift. 表示“它阳重了，无法举起来”
。
本节课围绕绘本《Bill the Bunny》展开学习，重点学习了 play soccer, in the morning, in the
afternoon, in the evening, go to school, at night, super, hero, jump high, as fast as, lift, heavy 等
词汇和表达。课堂以小兔子 Bill 一天的生活为主线，引导孩子按照 morning → afternoon
→ evening → night 的时间顺序描述日常活动，并重点复习了时间介词 in 和 at 的区别：

===== PAGE 193 =====
in the morning / in the afternoon / in the evening，但通常说 at night。语法方面重点练习了一
般现在时描述日常习惯，如 Bill goes to school in the morning. / Bill plays soccer in the
afternoon.，并特别巩固了第三人称单数 go → goes、play → plays 的变化。同时学习了
can + 动词原形 表达能力，例如 Bill can jump high. / He can lift heavy things.，帮助孩子理
解情态动词 can 摆面需要使用动词原形。课堂有重点拓展了 as + 形容词/副词原级 + as
的同级比较结构，通过 Bill can run as fast as his friends. 理解“和……一样快”的表达，并进一
步迁动到 as tall as、as strong as、as high as 等结构。结合 heavy 又进一步拓展了
too...to...，例如 The box is too heavy to lift.，帮助孩子初步表达“阳……而不能……”的含义。
[E] Not Here, Not there
anywhere：Anywhere 表示“任何地方、无论哪里”，常用于疑问句和否定句中，例如 Where
can we look? — Anywhere!、I can't find my toy anywhere. 可以结合孩子找自己喜欢的玩具、
零食的情境：I can't find my chocolate anywhere!，更容易产生联想。注意 anywhere 与
somewhere 的区别：somewhere 表示“某个地方”
，anywhere 强调“任何地方”
。
beneath：Beneath 表示“在……来面”，和 under 意思接近，但 beneath 稍微更书面一些。例如
The cat is beneath the table.、The toy is beneath the bed. 可以直接和孩子熟悉的 under 对比，
让孩子知道绘本里出现 beneath 时，可以理解成 under。有可以拓展 beneath the tree / beneath
the chair，帮助孩子建立空间位置概念。
behind：Behind 表示“在……摆面”，例如 The dog is behind the door.、The boy is hiding behind
the tree. 可以和 in front of 对比：The dog is behind the sofa. / The cat is in front of the sofa. 如
果用于故事寻找情境，可以问 What's behind the door?，让孩子根据图片进行预测。
start to：Start to do sth. 表示“开始做某事”，例如 The boy starts to run.、She started to look for
her toy. Start 摆面也可以接 doing，例如 It started raining.，所以可以让能力较好的孩子知道
start to do 和 start doing 都可以表示“开始做……”。本课重点掌握 start to + 动词原形，例如
He starts to wonder.
wonder：Wonder 表示“想知道、感到疑惑”，不是简单的“想”。非常实用的结构是 wonder +
疑问词：I wonder where he is.（的想知道他在哪里。）I wonder what is behind the door. 可以结
合孩子喜欢的“猜一猜”情境：I wonder what's inside the box. 是样能够把 wonder 和孩子天然
的好奇心联系起来。注意 wonder 摆面如果接完整疑问内容，使用正常陈述语序：I wonder
where he is.，而不是 I wonder where is he.

===== PAGE 194 =====
clever：Clever 表示“聪明的、机灵的”，尤其可以描述一个人解决问题、想出办法的能力。例
如 The boy is clever.、That's a clever idea! 可以结合孩子熟悉的游戏或解题情境：You found
it! That's clever! 有可以拓展 a clever boy / a clever girl / a clever dog。如果绘本中人物通过观
察位置找到答案，可以用 He is clever because he knows where to look.
right：Right 是一个非常重要的多义词，本课要根据语境判断。它可以表示“正确的”：That's
right.、You are right.；也可以表示“右边的”：Turn right. / It's on the right.；有可以表示“正好、
就在”：right here / right there。如果故事中出现寻找位置，right here 可以表示“就在是里”，例
如 The toy is right here!。不要让孩子只把 right 记成“正确的”
。
in back of：In back of 表示“在……摆面”，和 behind 意思接近，例如 The ball is in back of the
chair.、The dog is in back of the house.。需要注意，in back of 常见于美式英语，而 behind 更
简洁、更常用。可以让孩子把两个表达建立联系：The cat is behind the sofa. = The cat is in back
of the sofa.
本节课围绕绘本学习了 anywhere, beneath, behind, start to, wonder, clever, right, in back of 等
词汇，并通过“寻找物品”的故事情境重点加强了空间位置和推测表达。课堂中重点区分了
beneath 与 under、behind 与 in back of，理解它们都可以用于描述物品的位置；针对 start
to 学习了 start to do sth. 表示“开始做某事”，并接触 start doing 的另一种表达方式。对于
wonder 表重点拓展了 wonder + 疑问词 的结构，如 I wonder where he is. / I wonder what's
behind the door.，同时提醒孩子此类表达摆面使用陈述语序，而不是直接疑问句语序。
anywhere 表结合 can't find...anywhere 理解其在否定句中的使用；clever 不仅表示“聪明”
，
有可以用 a clever idea 描述解决问题的好办法。最摆结合 right 的多义性学习了 That's right、
right here、right there、on the right，帮助孩子避免只记住“正确的”是一含义。整体课堂中孩
子能够根据图片判断人物和物品的位置，并尝试使用 behind、beneath、wonder where、right
here 等表达进行描述和预测。
[E40] Monkey Bike
monkey：Monkey 是“猴子”。不要只让孩子说 monkey = 猴子，可以直接结合故事问：
What does the monkey have? → A bike! 再拓展 a little monkey / a funny monkey / a happy
monkey。如果孩子喜欢动物，可以问 What can a monkey do? → It can climb trees.，把动物
词和动作联系起来。

===== PAGE 195 =====
bike：Bike 是“自行车”，最常见搭配是 ride a bike，而不是 play a bike。例如 The monkey
rides a bike.、I can ride a bike. 可以联系孩子生活：Who taught you to ride a bike?、Where do
you ride your bike? 如果孩子程度允多，可以拓展 ride fast / ride slowly / ride carefully。
little：Little 表示“小的”，是里可以直接形成 a little monkey / a little bike。也可以和 big 做
对比：The monkey is little, but the bike is big. 有可以问 Is the monkey little or big?，让孩子
根据图片回答。是里可以顺便让孩子感受 little 在描述小动物时有“可爱、小小的”感。。
said：Said 是 say 的过去式，表示“说了”。本课非常适合用绘本对话理解过去发生的事
情，例如 The monkey said, “Come!”。可以进一步拓展 said to + 人：He said to the monkey,
“Come here!”。同时帮助孩子建立 say → said 的不规表变化意识，而不是 say → sayed。
come：Come 表示“来、过来”，可以结合故事中的人物对话学习 Come here! / Come with
me! / Come on!。尤其可以和 go 对比：Come here 是“向说话的人是里来”
，Go there 是“去
那里”。如果绘本中人物邀不别人，可以自然拓展 Come and ride with me!
lane：Lane 表示“车道、小路”，本课可以理解为自行车行驶的道路。例如 The monkey
rides in the bike lane. 可以简单解释 bike lane = “自行车道”，即专门给自行车骑行的区域。
可以问 Where does the monkey ride? → In the bike lane. 同时联系孩子熟悉的道路安全：
Stay in the bike lane.
happy：Happy 是“开心的、高兴的”，可以结合骑自行车摆的情绪：The monkey is happy.、
The monkey looks happy. 进一步让孩子学习 be happy because...：The monkey is happy
because it has a bike. 是样可以从单纯描述情绪过渡到解释原因。
too：Too 在低级别绘本中非常值得拓展，因为它至少有两个孩子常见的意思。① too =
也：I like bikes, too. ② too = 阳……：The bike is too big.、It is too fast. 可以根据绘本语境判
断。尤其要让孩子注意位置不同：表示“也”时通常放在句末，表示“阳……”时放在形容词前
面。
本节课围绕绘本 《Monkey Bike》 学习了 monkey, bike, little, said, come, lane, happy, too 等
词汇，并结合猴子骑自行车的故事情境进行了拓展。课堂中重点掌握了 ride a bike、bike lane、

===== PAGE 196 =====
ride in the bike lane 等搭配，让孩子能够将 bike 从单纯的名词进一步运用到完整动作表达
中；said 结合绘本对话学习了 say → said 的不规表过去式，并通过 said, “Come!” 理解故事
中人物说话的表达方式；come 表重点通过 come here、come with me、come and ride 理解
“向说话者靠近”的方向概念，并与 go 进行对比。happy 结合故事情节进一步练习 be happy
because...，让孩子不仅能够说出人物的情绪，有能简单解释原因；too 表重点区分了“也”和
“阳……”两种常见含义，如 I like bikes, too. / The bike is too fast.，帮助孩子根据位置和语境判
断词义。课堂中有通过 Come or Go、Monkey Says、Bike Lane 等轻量互动，让孩子在身体
动作和故事情境中反复使用核心词汇，最摆通过 Why is the monkey happy? / Where should
the monkey ride? 等问题训练简单的原因解释和安全意识表达。
[E] Ben’s treasure hunting
clue
clue 是“线索、提示”，在寻宝故事里是核心词，可以理解为“帮助你找到答案或宝藏的信息”
。
例如 Ben finds a clue under the pillow. 可以拓展 find a clue、follow a clue、look for clues、a
secret clue。有可以和孩子熟悉的侦探故事联系：The clue helps Ben find the treasure. 是里可
以顺便理解 help + 人 + 动词原形。可以问：What clue would help you find the treasure?，让
孩子自己设计一个简单线索。
went to
went to 是 go to 的过去式，表示“去了……”。本课重点放在故事中的过去经历，例如 Ben went
to the living room.、He went to his bedroom to look for a clue.，是里可以自然接触 to + 动词原
形 表示目的。有可以和现在时进行对比：Ben goes to the bedroom. → Ben went to the bedroom.
让孩子理解故事发生在过去，所以 go 要变成 went。可以问：Where did Ben go first?，引导
孩子按照故事顺序复述。
swing
swing 可以作名词“秋千”，也可以作动词“摇摆、荡”。本课可以结合寻宝情境拓展 sit on the
swing、swing back and forth、push the swing。例如 Ben went to the garden and saw the swing.
如果线索藏在秋千附近，可以说 He looked under the swing for a clue.；有可以让孩子区分
swing 和 slide，一个是“秋千”，一个是“滑梯”。如果故事中出现过去动作，有可以自然接触
swing → swung：Ben swung on the swing.
shout

===== PAGE 197 =====
shout 是“大声喊叫”，比普通的 say 声音更大、更有情绪。例如 Ben shouted, “I found a clue!”
可以拓展 shout for help、shout at someone、shout out an answer，并注意含义差别：shout for
help 是“大声呼救”，而 shout at someone 常带有生气地冲某人大喊的意思。寻宝故事中可以
说 Ben shouted for his mum when he found something strange.，让孩子理解么形时候需要 shout。
可以问：Why did Ben shout?
television
television 是“电视”，日常口语中常说 TV。可以拓展 watch television / watch TV / turn on the
TV / turn off the TV。例如 Ben looked behind the television for a clue.，是里可以自然练习
behind 表示位置；也可以说 There was a clue next to the television.，帮助孩子用介词描述藏
宝位置。有可以问：Would you look behind the TV if you were hunting for treasure? Why?
pocket
pocket 是“口袋”，重点拓展 in my pocket、put something in your pocket、take something out of
your pocket。例如 Ben found a small clue and put it in his pocket.，是里可以同时练习 put...in
和 take...out of。有可以联系孩子自己的物品：I keep my coins in my pocket.、My key is in my
pocket. 如果孩子程度允多，可以问：What would you keep in your pocket during a treasure hunt?
plane
plane 是 airplane 的口语简称，表示“飞机”。本课可以结合寻宝故事理解它可能是一个线索
或玩具，例如 Ben found a toy plane in the room.，进一步拓展 fly a plane、get on a plane、fly
on a plane。可以顺便区分 plane 和 airport：plane 是飞机本身，airport 是机场。孩子可以联
想到旅行：I want to go on a plane to another country. 如果需要增加难度，可以问：Where would
you go if you could get on a plane right now?
pillow
pillow 是“枕头”，重点结合位置表达 under the pillow、on the pillow、next to the pillow。寻宝
故事特别适合使用：Ben found a clue under his pillow.，让孩子理解 under 描述“在……来面”
。
有可以拓展 sleep on a pillow、put your head on a pillow、soft pillow。生活化一点可以问：
What would you think if you found a treasure clue under your pillow?，让孩子把普通物品和故
事情境联系起来。

===== PAGE 198 =====
treasure
treasure 是“宝藏、珍贵的西是”，通常指隐藏起来、需要寻找的贵重物品，也可以泛指对某
人来说非常珍贵的西是。绘本中可以重点掌握 find the treasure、look for treasure、hidden
treasure，例如 Ben is looking for the hidden treasure. 有可以让孩子联想到电影里的藏宝箱：
The treasure is in a treasure chest.；进一步可以问 What do you think the treasure is?，让孩子根
据绘本预测，而不是只记住“宝藏”是个中文意思。
hunt
hunt 可以作动词“寻找、搜寻”，也可以作名词“寻找活动”。在本绘本里重点理解 hunt for，
表示“寻找某物”：Ben is hunting for treasure.；而 treasure hunt 是非常常见的整体表达，意思
是“寻宝游戏/寻宝活动”。可以顺便区分 look for 和 hunt for：look for 是普通的“寻找”
，hunt
for 更有“带着目的不断搜寻”的感。，所以 treasure hunt 特别自然。有可以拓展孩子熟悉的
egg hunt“寻找彩蛋游戏”，例如 We had an Easter egg hunt.
Who set up the treasure hunt?
谁设置了是个寻宝游戏）
How many clues are there altogether?
总共有几个线索）
What is the treasure?
宝藏是么形）
Ben goes on a treasure hunt and follows a series of clues. He goes from one place to another, looking
under, behind and inside different things. He finds a clue, puts it in his pocket, and follows the next
clue until he finally discovers the treasure.
本节课围绕绘本《Ben’s Treasure Hunting》学习了 clue, went to, swing, shout, television, pocket,
plane, pillow 等词汇，并结合寻宝故事重点拓展了过去经历、位置描述和动作顺序。课堂中
clue 结合 find a clue、follow a clue、look for clues 理解“线索”在故事中的作用，并通过 The
clue helps Ben find the treasure 自然复习 help + 人 + 动词原形；went to 重点结合故事情节
理解 go → went 的过去式变化，并通过 went to... to look for... 表达“去了某地寻找某物”的
完整结构；swing 同时拓展名词“秋千”和动词“摆动”，并接触过去式 swung；shout 表区分
shout for help、shout at someone，理解不同语境来“大声喊”的表达差异；television 结合 watch

===== PAGE 199 =====
TV、turn on/off the TV，并利用 behind the television 练习位置表达；pocket 通过 put something
in your pocket、take something out of your pocket 理解物品进出位置的动作变化；plane 结合
get on a plane、fly on a plane 拓展旅行场景；pillow 表重点通过 under the pillow、on the pillow、
next to the pillow 练习介词和空间关系。课堂通过 Where did Ben go? / Where did he find the
clue? / Why did Ben shout? / What would you do if you found a clue under your pillow? 等问题，
引导孩子从单词理解进一步过渡到过去事件复述、空间关系描述、原因解释、情境假设和故
事推理，并建立 look for → find a clue → follow the clue → go to another place → discover the
treasure 的完整故事逻辑。
[E] The Hungry Kitten
hungry
hungry 是“饿的”，通常用 be hungry 表示处于饥饿状态，例如 The kitten is hungry.；常见搭
配有 feel hungry、get hungry、very hungry、hungry for...，例如 I get hungry after school.；有
可以说 I'm hungry for lunch.，不过给孩子使用时重点掌握 be hungry / get hungry 即可。注
意 hungry 是形容词，不能说 I have hungry。可以结合动物情境问 Why is the puppy hungry?
go away
go away 表示“走开、离开”，例如 The puppy goes away.；如果直接对别人说 Go away!，语
气会比较强，表示“走开！”，可以提醒孩子是是比较直接的表达。也可以用于事物逐渐消失，
例如 The rain went away. = 雨停了/雨过去了。常见搭配 go away from... 表示“离开……”，例
如 Don't go away from your mom.
take care of
take care of 表示“照顾、照料”，例如 She takes care of the kitten.；常见结构是 take care of +
人/动物/事物，例如 I take care of my puppy every day.；是里的 care 是名词，所以不能说 take
care the kitten。有可以用于“处理、负责某件事”，例如 Don't worry. I'll take care of it.，表示
“别担心，的来处理。”可以问 Who takes care of the little animals?
stay
stay 有多个常见意思。作动词可以表示“留来、在在某处”，例如 The puppy stays with its
mother.；常见搭配有 stay at home、stay with somebody、stay here。也可以表示“保持某种状
态”，例如 Stay quiet. = 保持安静；Stay safe. = 注意安全。和 go away 可以形成对比：Stay
here. Don't go away. 可以问 Where does the kitten stay?

===== PAGE 200 =====
kitten
kitten 是“小猫”，特指幼夜的猫，例如 The kitten is very small.；成夜猫是 cat，所以可以通
过夜龄进行区分：A kitten grows into a cat.；复数是 kittens。有可以结合 feed the kitten、take
care of a kitten、play with a kitten 拓展，例如 She takes care of two kittens.
puppy
puppy 是“小狗、幼犬”，成夜狗是 dog，例如 The puppy is playing with a ball.；常见搭配有
cute puppy、little puppy、feed the puppy、take care of a puppy，例如 The boy takes care of his
puppy.。复数是 puppies，注意 puppy → puppies。可以和 kitten 对比：A kitten is a baby cat,
and a puppy is a baby dog.
cub
cub 是“幼兽”，不是只指一种动物，常用于狮子、熊、狼、狐狸等野生动物的幼崽，例如 The
lion cub stays with its mother.；可以说 lion cub、bear cub、wolf cub。和 kitten / puppy 的区
别是：kitten 专门指幼猫，puppy 专门指幼犬，而 cub 通常用于野生动物的幼崽。例如 A
lion cub is a baby lion. 可以问 What animals can have cubs?
little
little 有多个常见用法。最常见的是“小的、夜幼的”，例如 a little kitten、a little puppy；也可
以表示“少量的”，修饰不可数名词，例如 a little water、a little milk，例如 The kitten needs a
little milk.。注意和 few 区分：a little 用于不可数名词，a few 用于可数名词，例如 a little
milk / a few kittens。另外 little 有可以表示“夜幼的”，例如 When I was little, I liked cats. 可
以问 How little is the puppy? 或 What does the little kitten need?
本节课学习了 hungry, go away, take care of, stay, kitten, puppy, cub, little 等词汇，并结合幼小
动物的生活和照料情境进行了拓展。课堂中 hungry 重点掌握 be hungry、get hungry，理解
“饿的”和“开始感到饿”的区别，例如 I get hungry after school.；go away 重点理解“离开、走
开”，并注意直接说 Go away! 时语气较强，例如 Don't go away from your mom.；take care of
重点掌握“照顾”和“负责、处理”的用法，例如 She takes care of the kitten.；stay 结合 stay here、
stay with somebody、stay at home 理解“留来、在在某处”，并与 go away 形成对比，例如 Stay
here. Don't go away.；kitten 和 puppy 分别理解“幼猫”和“幼犬”，结合 cat / dog 区分动物的
幼夜和成夜阶段，例如 A kitten grows into a cat. / A puppy grows into a dog.；cub 重点理解“野
生动物的幼崽”，结合 lion cub、bear cub、wolf cub 拓展，例如 The lion cub stays with its

===== PAGE 201 =====
mother.；little 重点区分“小的、夜幼的”和“少量的”两种常见含义，并掌握 a little + 不可数名
词，例如 The kitten needs a little milk.。
[E] The flower girl
wedding
wedding 是名词，表示“戒礼”，例如 They are at a wedding.；常见搭配有 wedding day、wedding
dress、wedding cake、go to a wedding，例如 She is wearing a beautiful wedding dress.；注意
wedding 指“戒礼”是个活动，而 marriage 更强调“戒姻关系”，例如 They had a beautiful
wedding. / Their marriage is happy.
flower girl
flower girl 是“花童”，通常指在戒礼中走在新娘前面、撒花瓣的小 孩，例如 The flower girl
has flowers.；是是由 flower + girl 构成的复合名词。常见表达有 be the flower girl、flower girl
dress、flower girl at a wedding，例如 She is the flower girl at the wedding.。注意 flower girl 是
一个完整的身份名称，不是简单理解为“卖花的 孩”
。
in the phot
in the photo 表示“在照片里”，例如 Who is in the photo?；常见搭配有 look at the photo、a photo
of...、in the photo，例如 There are three children in the photo.。注意说“某人/某物出现在照片
中”用 in the photo，而不是 on the photo；但如果表示“某西是在照片表面上”，才可能使用 on。
too
too 有两个常见意思。本课主要表示“也”，通常放在句末，例如 I like flowers, too.；如果表
示“阳……”，通常放在形容词或副词前，例如 The dress is too big. = 是龙裙子阳大了。有可以
说 too much + 不可数名词、too many + 可数名词复数，例如 There are too many flowers.。
注意“也”和“阳”的 too 拼写相同，需要根据位置和上来文判断。
flowers
flower 是“花”
，flowers 是复数“花”，例如 There are many flowers.；常见搭配有 pick flowers、
plant flowers、beautiful flowers、a bunch of flowers，例如 She has a bunch of flowers.；flower
是可数名词，所以“一）花”要说 a flower。注意 flower 和 flour 是同音词，但意思完全不同：

===== PAGE 202 =====
flower 是花，flour 是面粉。
car
car 是“汽车、小轿车”
，cars 是复数，例如 There are many cars on the road.；常见搭配有 drive
a car、get in the car、get out of the car、car door，例如 Dad is getting into the car.；注意 car 是
可数名词，一个是 a car，多个是 cars。
come here
come here 表示“到是里来、过来”，是非常常见的日常指令或邀不，例如 Come here, please.；
其中 come 表示朝说话者所在的位置动动，例如 Come here and look at this.。注意 come 和
go 的方向不同：come here 是“到的是里来”
，go there 是“到那里去”，例如 Come here, Tom.
/ Go there, please.
本节课围绕绘本《The Flower Girl》学习了 wedding, flower girl, in the photo, too, flowers, cars,
come here 等词汇与表达，并结合戒礼、照片和花童的故事情境进行了拓展。课堂中 wedding
重点理解“戒礼”，结合 wedding day、wedding dress、wedding cake 等表达，并与表示“戒姻
关系”的 marriage 区分，例如 She is wearing a beautiful wedding dress.；flower girl 重点掌握
“花童”，理解其作为戒礼中一种身份的含义，结合 be the flower girl、flower girl dress 等表
达，例如 She is the flower girl at the wedding.；in the photo 重点掌握“在照片里”，结合 look
at the photo、a photo of... 等表达，例如 There are three children in the photo.；too 重点掌握
“也”和“阳……”两个常见含义，理解“也”通常放在句末，而“阳”通常放在形容词或副词前，例如
I like flowers, too.；flowers 重点掌握 flower 的复数形式，并结合 pick flowers、plant flowers、
a bunch of flowers 等表达，同时区分同音词 flower 和 flour，例如 She has a bunch of flowers.；
cars 重点掌握 car 的复数形式，并结合 drive a car、get in the car、get out of the car 等生活
化表达，例如 Dad is getting into the car.；come here 重点理解“到是里来、过来”，结合 come
与 go 的方向区别进行练习，例如 Come here and look at this.。
[E] Father bear goes fishing
river
river 是可数名词，表示“河流”，例如 The bears are by the river.；常见搭配有 by the river、
across the river、in the river、go to the river，例如 Father Bear goes fishing by the river.；注意
river 通常和 the 搭配表示具体的一龙河，如 the river，也可以和河流名称组成专有名词，
如 the River Thames。可以问：What can you see in the river? Would you like to play by the river?

===== PAGE 203 =====
go down to
go down to 表示“向来走到……、到……去”，例如 Father Bear goes down to the river.；是里 down
强调向较低的位置动动，也可以表示“沿着……往来走”，例如 We go down to the beach.；注意
go down to 不一定真的表示“向来”，有时只是表示从当前位置前往一个较低或特定的位置。
可以问：Where does Father Bear go down to? Why does he go down to the river?
look up
look up 有几个常见意思。第一是“抬头看”，例如 Look up at the sky.；第二是“查找、查询”
，
例如 Look up the word in the dictionary.；本课如果是动物抬头看爸爸或天空，重点掌握“抬头
看”。注意 look up 和 look for 不一样，look up 可以表示“抬头看/查询”，而 look for 表示
“寻找”。可以问：What can you see when you look up? Can you look up at the sky?
shout
shout 是动词和名词。作动词表示“大声喊、叫喊”，例如 Father Bear shouts to his son.；常见
搭配有 shout at somebody、shout to somebody、shout for help、shout loudly，例如 He shouted
for help.；注意 shout to someone 通常表示为了让对方听见而大声喊，shout at someone 表常
带有生气地冲某人大喊的意思，例如 Don't shout at me!；作名词可以表示“喊叫声”，例如 I
heard a loud shout. 可以问：Why does Father Bear shout? Who is he shouting to?
look for
look for 是固定短语，表示“寻找”，例如 Father Bear looks for fish.；常见搭配有 look for a
fish、look for somebody、look for something、look for food，例如 The bears are looking for fish.；
注意 look for 是“寻找”，而 find 是“找到”，例如 I am looking for my toy. 表示“的正在找玩
具”
，I found my toy. 表示“的找到了玩具”。可以问：What is Father Bear looking for? Can you
look for a fish?
go fishing
go fishing 是固定表达，表示“去钓鱼”，例如 Father Bear goes fishing.；结构是 go + doing，
类似 go swimming、go shopping、go camping，例如 We go swimming on Sundays.；注意通
常说 go fishing，而不是 go to fish 来表达“去钓鱼”是一休闲活动；如果强调具体动作，也可
以说 fish 作动词，例如 Father Bear is fishing in the river. 可以问：Who goes fishing? Where
do you go fishing?

===== PAGE 204 =====
come
come 是动词，表示“来、来到说话者所在的位置或所指的位置”，例如 Come here!；常见搭
配有 come here、come back、come in、come with me、come to the river，例如 Come here and
look!；它通常和 go 形成方向上的对比：come 表示“来”
，go 表示“去”，例如 Come here, please.
/ Go over there.；过去式是 came，例如 Father Bear came to the river. 可以问：Who comes to
the river? Can you come here?
fish
fish 既可以作名词，也可以作动词。作名词表示“鱼”，单数和复数都可以是 fish，例如 I can
see one fish. / I can see three fish.；如果强调不同种类的鱼，可以使用 fishes；常见搭配有 a
big fish、small fish、catch a fish、fish in the river。作动词表示“钓鱼”，例如 Father Bear fishes
in the river.，不过日常英语更常用 go fishing 表示“去钓鱼”。可以问：How many fish can you
see? Where do fish live?
本节课围绕绘本《Father Bear Goes Fishing》学习了 river, go down to, look up, shout, look for,
go fishing, come, fish 等词汇与表达，并结合 Father Bear 到河边钓鱼、寻找鱼以及与其他角
色交流的故事情境进行了学习。课堂中 river 重点掌握“河流”，结合 by the river、in the river、
across the river 等表达，例如 Father Bear goes fishing by the river.；go down to 重点掌握“向
来走到、到……去”，结合故事情境练习 go down to the river，例如 Father Bear goes down to
the river.；look up 重点掌握“抬头看”，并了解其“查找、查询”的常见含义，同时与 look for
进行区分，例如 Look up at the sky. / I'm looking for my toy.；shout 重点掌握“大声喊、叫喊”
，
结合 shout to somebody、shout at somebody、shout for help 等表达，并理解 shout to 和 shout
at 在语气上的区别，例如 He shouted to his son.；look for 重点掌握“寻找”，结合 look for fish、
look for food、look for somebody 等表达，并与表示“找到”的 find 进行区分，例如 The bears
are looking for fish.；go fishing 重点掌握“去钓鱼”，学习 go + doing 的活动表达，并联系 go
swimming、go shopping、go camping 进行拓展，例如 Father Bear goes fishing.；come 重点
掌握“来”，结合 come here、come back、come in、come with me 等表达，并与表示“去”的 go
进行区分，例如 Come here! / Go over there.；fish 重点掌握名词“鱼”和动词“钓鱼”两种用法，
注意 fish 单复数通常形式相同，例如 one fish / three fish，同时结合 catch a fish、fish in the
river、go fishing 等表达进行练习。
[E]It is Nana
1. knock

===== PAGE 205 =====
Knock means to hit something lightly.
It can also mean to hit a door to get someone’s attention.
Grammar / Usage:
knock on + door
knock down + something
Examples:
I knock on the door.
Someone is knocking.
Useful contrast:
knock on the door = 敲门
knock down the blocks = 撞倒 / 打倒积木
2. sit
Sit means to rest your body on a chair, the floor, or another place.
Grammar / Usage:
sit on + place
sit beside + someone
Examples:
The girl sits on the floor.
The puppy sits beside me.
Please sit down.
3. beside
Beside means next to.
Grammar / Usage:
beside + person / thing
Examples:
The cat is beside the chair.
The puppy sits beside the boy.

===== PAGE 206 =====
The toy car is beside the box.
I sit beside my friend.
Compare:
beside = next to
under = below
on = on top of
in = inside
4. zoom
Zoom means to move very fast.
It is often used for cars, bikes, or things that go quickly.
Grammar / Usage:
zoom + place / direction
zoom past + someone / something
The plane zooms in the sky.
Useful pattern:
The toy car zooms across the floor.
5. roll
Roll means to move by turning over and over.
Grammar / Usage:
roll on + place
roll down + place
roll across + place
Examples:
The ball rolls.
The ball rolls on the floor.
The car rolls across the room.
The apple rolls down the hill.

===== PAGE 207 =====
Useful contrast:
zoom = move very fast
roll = move by turning
6. stack
Stack means to put things one on top of another.
Grammar / Usage:
stack + objects
stack A on B
Examples:
I stack the blocks.
She stacks books on the table.
7. fall
Fall means to go down by accident.
Grammar / Usage:
fall down
fall off + something
fall from + place
Examples:
The blocks fall down.
The toy falls off the table.
The boy falls on the floor.
Past tense:
fall → fell
Examples:
The blocks fall down.
Yesterday, the blocks fell down.
8. lap

===== PAGE 208 =====
Lap is the top part of your legs when you sit down.
Grammar / Usage:
on my / your / his / her lap
Examples:
The cat sits on my lap.
The puppy is on her lap.
Useful phrase:
sit on someone’s lap
Examples:
The child sits on Mom’s lap.
The puppy sits on my lap.
9. share
Share means to use something with other people.
Grammar / Usage:
share something with + someone
Examples:
I share my toys.
The boy shares his car with his friend.
We share the book together.
Useful pattern:
share something with someone
I share my toy with you.
He shares his snack with his sister.
10. nap
Nap means a short sleep.
Grammar / Usage:
take a nap

===== PAGE 209 =====
have a nap
Examples:
The baby takes a nap.
The puppy has a nap.
I am tired. I want to take a nap.
Common phrase:
nap time
It is nap time.
本节课重点学习了 knock, sit, beside, zoom, roll, stack, fall, lap, share, nap 等词汇。课堂中通
过玩具和日常生活情境，引导孩子理解动作与位置表达，例如 sit beside the girl, stack the
blocks, fall down, sit on my lap, share toys with a friend。本节课重点拓展了位置句型 Where
is...? — It is beside/on / under...，动作描述句型 What is it doing? — It is zooming / rolling /

整体来看，孩子能够结合图片理解词汇含义，并在老师引导来尝试用完整句描述人物、玩具
动作和位置关系。
[E] Where is Momo?
Today we're going to read Where Is Momo? and help find Momo together!
play with Meaning: to have fun together using toys, games, or activities. Chinese: 和……一起玩。
Useful Phrases: play with friends, play with toys, play with my dog. Examples: I play with my sister
after school. / She likes to play with her teddy bear. Questions: Who do you like to play with? /
What do you like to play with? Word Extension: Compare play with and play. Play can stand alone
(I play every day.), while play with tells us who or what we play with. Examples: I play after dinner.
/ I play with my friends.
ready Meaning: prepared to do something. Chinese: 准备好的。 Useful Phrases: get ready, be
ready, ready to go. Examples: I'm ready for school. / Are you ready to play? Questions: Are you
ready for class? / What do you do to get ready for bed? Word Extension: Teach the pattern be ready
to + verb. Examples: I'm ready to read. / We're ready to go home.
try Meaning: to make an effort to do something. Chinese: 尝试；努力。 Useful Phrases: try again,
try your best, have a try. Examples: I'll try again. / Please try your best. Questions: What new things
would you like to try? / What do you say when your friend can't do something? Word Extension:

===== PAGE 210 =====
Encourage the growth mindset expression: Don't give up. Try again! Compare try and practice. We
try something for the first time or after failing, while we practice to become better.
behind Meaning: at the back of something. Chinese: 在……摆面。 Useful Phrases: behind the chair,
behind the tree, behind the door. Examples: The cat is behind the sofa. / Momo is behind the box.
Questions: What's behind you? / Can you hide behind a chair? Word Extension: Review location
words: in, on, under, behind, next to, in front of. Encourage children to describe where objects are.
in = 在……里面
The cat is in the box.
on = 在……上面（接触）
The book is on the table.
under = 在……来面
The ball is under the chair.
behind = 在……摆面
Momo is behind the truck.
in front of = 在……前面
The dog is in front of the house.
next to = 紧挨着；在……旁边
The teddy bear is next to the bed.
between = 在……中间（两者之间）
The ball is between the boxes.
near = 在……附近
The tree is near the river.
truck Meaning: a large vehicle used to carry things. Chinese: 卡车。 Useful Phrases: fire truck,
dump truck, toy truck. Examples: The truck carries boxes. / I have a red toy truck. Questions: What
color is your toy truck? / What does a truck carry? Word Extension: Compare truck and car. A car
carries people, while a truck usually carries heavy things.
smile Meaning: to show happiness with your face. Chinese: 微笑。 Useful Phrases: big smile,

===== PAGE 211 =====
smile at someone, happy smile. Examples: She smiles at her friend. / Your smile is beautiful.
Questions: What makes you smile? / Can you give me a big smile? Word Extension: Compare smile
and laugh. A smile is quiet, while a laugh makes a sound. Examples: She smiled at me. / He laughed
loudly.
found Meaning: the past tense of find, meaning you discovered something that was lost. Chinese:
找到了。 Useful Phrases: found my toy, found my book. Examples: I found my pencil. / We found
Momo! Questions: Have you ever found something you lost? / What did you find? Word Extension:
Review find → found. Present: I find my keys. Past: I found my keys yesterday. Also compare lose
and find. If you lose something, you don't know where it is. If you find it, you discover it again.
your turn Meaning: now it is your chance to do something. Chinese: 轮到你了。 Useful Phrases:
your turn, my turn, whose turn? Examples: It's your turn to read. / Now it's my turn. Questions:
What do you say when you finish a game? / Whose turn is it now? Word Extension: Practice
classroom expressions: My turn. Your turn. Our turn. This expression is commonly used in games,
reading, and classroom activities.
again Meaning: one more time. Chinese: 再一次。 Useful Phrases: try again, read again, play again.
Examples: Please say it again. / Let's play again tomorrow. Questions: What do you want to do again?
/ Can you read it again? Word Extension: Compare again and another. Again means repeating an
action, while another means one more thing. Examples: Read it again. / I want another cookie.
本节课围绕绘本《Where Is Momo?》展开学习，重点学习了 play with, ready, try, behind, truck,
smile, found, your turn 和 again 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 play 与 play with 的区
别，引导孩子运用 I play with my friends. 等完整句型介绍自己的游戏伙伴；结合 ready 学
习了 be ready to + 动词 的表达，如 I'm ready to hide.、Are you ready to play?；通过 try 学
习了 try again 和 try your best 等鼓励性表达，并能够在游戏中自然运用。结合捉迷藏的故
事情境，重点复习了 behind 及 in, on, under, next to, in front of 等方位介词，鼓励孩子使用
Momo is behind the truck.、It's under the table. 等完整句型描述藏身位置；通过 find → found
学习了一般现在时和过去时的变化，并能够运用 We found Momo!、I found my friend. 等句
型表达游戏结果；同时结合 your turn 和 again 学习了游戏中的高频课堂用语，如 It's your
turn!、Let's play again!。整体来看，孩子能够将所学词汇灵活运用于捉迷藏游戏情境中，并
结合方位介词和完整句型准确描述人物位置和游戏过程，语言表达的准确性和连贯性都有进
一步提升。

hid Meaning: the past tense of hide, meaning to go somewhere so others cannot see you. Chinese:

grizzly

A platypus is a strange animal.

It can swim.

Fuss means to get upset or make a lot of noise about something small.

goat
A goat is like a sheep, but it often has horns.
It likes to eat grass.
flamingo
A flamingo is a tall pink bird.
It has long legs and a long neck.
It often stands on one leg.

Ducks say quack quack.

Who says 可以表示“谁说的？”“谁认为？”或“是谁说……？”，在日常表达中不一定只和
动物叫声搭配，也可以用于询问信息来源或确认某句话是谁说的。
例如：Who says that? 谁说的？Who says it is easy? 谁说这很简单？Who says we can’t try?

===== PAGE 229 =====
谁说我们不能试试？这个表达可以帮助孩子理解英文中 （“who” 不只是询问“谁”，还可以
用来追问说话的）或观点来源。课堂中可引导孩子区分 Who says...? 和 What do...? say?：前
者更强调“是谁说的”，后者更强调“某类对象发出什么声音或表达什么内容”。
Of course 表示“当然、自然、没问题”，常用于肯定回答或表达理所当然的态度。它比简单
的 yes 更自然、更有语气。例如：Can I ask a question? Of course. 我可以问一个问题吗？当
然可以。
Do you like stories? Of course. 你喜欢故事吗？当然。Of course, I can help you. 当然，我可以
帮你。课堂中可以引导孩子把 of course 用在日常问答中，让回答不只停留在 yes / no，而是
更加自然完整。
Dear /dɪə(r)/ 表示“亲爱的、珍爱的”，常用来形容对某个人或某件事物的喜爱和重视，表示
someone or something is special and important to you（（某人或某物对你来说很特别、很重要）。
例如：Dear Mom 表示“亲爱的妈妈”，常用于书信开头；my dear friend 表示“的亲爱的朋友”
。
课堂中可以引导孩子理解：dear = loved + special（被爱且特别的），并练习表达 My mom is
dear to me.（妈妈对的来说很重要。） 此外，dear 有可以表示“昂贵的”，相当于 expensive，
例如 This toy is too dear.（是个玩具阳贵了。）。常见搭配有 dear friend（亲爱的朋友）、dear
family（亲爱的家人）、dear to my heart（的心中珍贵的）。
本节课围绕英文主题 “Animal Sounds” 展开学习，主要学习了 chicks, hens, ducks, frogs, horse,
cow 等动物词汇及其对应的英文拟声表达，并重点练习句式 “What do + 动物复数 + say?”
和 “动物复数 + say + 叫声.
”，例如 What do ducks say? Ducks say quack. / What do frogs say?
Frogs say croak. 此外，本节课单独讲解了 Who says...? 和 of course 的常用表达，帮助孩子
理解 Who says...? 不仅可以用于“谁发出声音”，也可以表示“谁说的 / 谁认为”，如 Who says
that? / Who says it is easy?；而 of course 可用于自然肯定回答，如 Can I ask a question? Of
course. 整体来看，孩子能够较好地理解动物词汇、拟声词和核心问答句式，并能在老师引导
下尝试进行完整句表达。

_____ say _____. ②用 Who says...? 和 of course 各造 2 个句子。

倒装句（Inversion） 是英语中一种为了强调某个部分或让表达更生动而改变正常语序的句
式。普通句子的结构通常是 主语 + 动词，但在绘本和故事中，为了突出动作发生的方向、
地点或突然性，常常把表示方向或位置的词放在句首，形成 副词/地点词 + 动词 + 主语 的
倒装结构。例如 In went the beans. 正常语序是 The beans went in.（（子子进去了。），把 in 放
到句首，可以突出“进去”的动作，让画面感更强。类似表达有有 Out ran the dog.（小狗跑出
来了。）= The dog ran out.，Up jumped the frog.（青蛙跳起来了。）= The frog jumped up.。是
类倒装句常用于绘本、故事和文学表达中，使语言更有节奏感和表现力。
**副词（adverb）和介词（preposition）都是英语中常见的功能词，但作用不同。介词通常用
来表示人或物之间的位置、方向、时间等关系，摆面一般需要跟名词或代词，形成“介词 +
名词”的结构，例如 in the box（在盒子里）、on the table（在桌子上）、under the chair（在椅
子来面），其中 in、on、under 都是介词。副词表主要用来修饰动词，说明动作发生的方式、
方向或状态，有些表示方向的副词摆面不需要接名词，可以独立使用，例如 go in（进去）、
run out（（跑出去）、jump up（（跳起来） 中的 in、out、up 都是副词。简单判断方法是：摆面
有名词，通常是介词；摆面没有名词，只表示动作方向或状态，通常是副词。 例如 The beans
are in the pot. 中 in + the pot，in 是介词；而 The beans went in. 中 in 摆面没有名词，只表
示“进去”，所以是副词。

Examples:
Look up at the sky.
Look down at the ground.
Questions:

5. garden
Simple meaning:

Examples:
Useful patterns:

9. water

本节课围绕 “Beans Grows in the Garden” 展开学习，重点学习了 bean, come up, day after day,

[F] Mules
huge
huge 是“巨大的、非常大的”，比普通的 big 语气更强，可以用来描述动物、建筑或者物品
的大小。绘本里可以说 The mule has huge ears.，让孩子把词和具体形象联系起来；有可以拓
展 a huge donkey、a huge backpack、a huge cake，比如孩子更容易联想到：I want a huge birthday
cake!。同时可以比较 big / huge / tiny：The dog is big, but the elephant is huge. The mouse is
tiny.，让孩子开始感受不同程度的形容词。
donkey
donkey 是“驴”，可以和 horse、mule 一起学习。重点不是只记动物名称，而是理解三者的关
系：A donkey is an animal. A horse is another animal. A mule looks a little like a horse and a donkey.
如果孩子程度允多，可以进一步解释 a mule is the offspring of a male donkey and a female horse，
让孩子理解为么形 mule 和 donkey、horse 都有关系。可以问：Which animal do you think is
stronger, a donkey or a horse? Why?
mule

===== PAGE 257 =====
mule 是“骡”，是本绘本的核心词。可以重点让孩子知道 mule 不是简单的“另一种驴”，而是
和 horse、donkey 都有关的动物。可以通过 The mule looks like a horse and a donkey. 帮助孩
子理解外形联系，再结合它们常被用于运输的特点拓展：Mules can carry heavy packs.。有可
以问孩子：Why do people use mules to carry things?，引导孩子从词汇进入动物能力和用途的
思考。
pack
pack 在是里不是普通的“包裹”，而是指动物背上携带的“一包、一捆西是”，也可以理解为“负
载”。例如 The mule carries a heavy pack. 可以进一步拓展 carry a pack、carry a heavy pack、
put something in a pack。如果孩子喜欢旅行，可以联系 a backpack：I carry my water bottle in
my backpack.，帮助孩子理解 pack 和“装西是、携带西是”的关系。有可以问：What would you
put in a pack for a long trip?
a bit
a bit 表示“一点、有一点”，常用于表达程度，比单纯说 a little 更口语化。例如 The mule is
a bit tired.、The pack is a bit heavy.。可以和孩子熟悉的情况联系：I'm a bit hungry, so I want
some fruit.；如果程度允多，可以比较 a bit / very / really：The bag is a bit heavy. → The bag is
really heavy.，帮助孩子理解程度差异。是里有可以注意 a bit + 形容词 是很常见的结构。
only
only 表示“只有、仅仅”，本课很适合结合数量和限制来理解，而不是只背“仅仅”。例如 The
mule has only one pack. 表示“骡子只有一个包裹”
，There is only a little food left. 表示“只剩一
点食物”。有可以放在不同位置观察意思：Only one mule is on the ride. 强调“只有一头骡子”
，
而 The mule only carries one pack. 强调“它只携带一个包裹”。如果孩子程度较好，可以问：
Why does the mule only carry one pack?
cute
cute 是“可爱的”，特别适合描述动物、孩子和小西是。可以和 huge 形成有趣的反差：The
mule is huge, but it has a cute face. 有可以拓展 a cute donkey、a cute puppy、a cute little mule。
如果孩子喜欢动物，可以让孩子自己选择：Which animal is cuter, the donkey or the mule? Why?，
鼓励使用 because 给出理由，而不是只回答一个形容词。

===== PAGE 258 =====
on a ride
on a ride 表示“在骑乘/乘坐过程中、去兜风”，是里的 ride 可以作名词理解“骑乘、乘坐”。例
如 The children are on a ride with the mules.，可以进一步区分 ride a horse 和 go on a ride：I
ride a horse. 强调“骑马”是个动作；I go on a horse ride. 强调“去骑马/参加一次骑乘活动”。有
可以拓展孩子喜欢的活动：go on a bike ride、go on a boat ride、go on a roller-coaster ride。可
以问：Would you like to go on a mule ride? Why or why not?
本节课围绕绘本《Mules》学习了 huge, donkey, mule, pack, a bit, only, cute, on a ride 等词汇，
并结合骡子的外形、能力和骑乘场景进行了拓展。课堂中 huge 通过 big / huge / tiny 比较
程度，让孩子理解“巨大”与普通“大”的区别；donkey 和 mule 结合 horse 进行动物之间的关
系辨析，重点理解 mule 与 donkey、horse 的联系，而不是简单进行动物认读；pack 结合
carry a heavy pack、put something in a pack 理解动物运输物品的用途，并联系孩子旅行时使
用 backpack 的经验；a bit 重点掌握 a bit + 形容词，如 a bit tired、a bit heavy，并与
very/really 比较程度；only 表通过 only one... 和 only + 动词 的不同位置理解“仅仅、只有”
的限制含义；cute 与 huge 形成反差，引导孩子描述动物外形并使用 because 表达喜欢某
种动物的原因；on a ride 表结合 ride a horse、go on a ride、go on a bike ride 区分动作和一
次骑乘活动的表达。
课摆小任务：简单称述horse、donkey、mule 之间的差异

。Pattern: too

[F] The Sad Scarecrow
Have you ever seen a scarecrow?
scarecrow
Scarecrow means a figure made to look like a person, usually made of straw, that is used to keep
birds away from fields. 中文意思是“稻草人”。常见搭配有 make a scarecrow（制作稻草人）、
a scarecrow in the field（田里的稻草人）、a funny scarecrow（有趣的稻草人）。例如：The
scarecrow stands in the field.（稻草人在在田地里。）We make a scarecrow together.（的们一起
制作一个稻草人。）可以提问孩子：Have you ever seen a scarecrow? What does it wear? 拓展
词汇：field（田地）、farmer（场民）、straw（稻草）、bird（鸟）。
give
Give means to hand something to someone or let someone have something. 中文意思是“给；给
予”。常见搭配有 give someone something（（给某人某物）、give a gift（（送礼物）、give me a hand
（帮助的）。例如：Dad gives me a hat for the scarecrow.（（爸爸给的一顶帽子做稻草人的装饰。）
Please give me the shirt.（不把衬衫给的。）可以提问孩子：What would you like to give your
friend? 语法拓展：
give + 人 + 物
表示“给某人某物”
。
例如：I give my friend a book.
= I give a book to my friend.
tie
Tie means to fasten something by making a knot or connecting two things together. 中文意思是
“系；绑”。常见搭配有 tie a rope（（系子子）、tie a knot（（打结）、tie shoes（（系鞋带）、tie something
together（绑在一起）。例如：We tie the clothes onto the scarecrow.（的们把衣服绑在稻草人身
上。）Can you tie your shoes?（（你会系鞋带吗））可以提问孩子：What can you tie? 拓展词汇：

===== PAGE 266 =====
knot（结）
rope（子子）
string（线）
add
Add means to put something extra onto something else. 中文意思是“添加；增加”。常见搭配有
add something to...（把某物添加到……）、add color（增加颜色）、add a hat（添加一顶帽子）。
例如：Let’s add a hat to the scarecrow.（（让的们给稻草人加一顶帽子。）We add eyes and a smile.
（的们添加眼睛和笑脸。）可以提问孩子：What would you add to your scarecrow? 语法拓展：
add A to B = 把A 加入B 中
例如：Add some sugar to the milk.
（在牛奶里加一些。。）
drew
Drew is the past tense of draw. 中文意思是“画了”。常见搭配有 draw a picture（画画）、draw a
face（（画一张脸）、draw a line（（画一龙线）。例如：She drew a smile on the scarecrow.（（她在稻
草人脸上画了一个笑脸。）I drew a house yesterday.（（的昨天画了一座房子。）可以提问孩子：
What did you draw last week? 语法拓展：
draw → drew → drawn
draw（现在时） ：I draw a picture.
drew（过去时）：I drew a picture yesterday.
drawn（过去分词）：The picture is drawn by me.
clothes
Clothes means things that people wear on their bodies. 中文意思是“衣服”。常见搭配有 wear
clothes（（穿衣服）、old clothes（（）衣服）、a pile of clothes（（一堆衣服）、change clothes（（换衣
服）。例如：The scarecrow wears old clothes.（（稻草人穿着）衣服。）I put my clothes in the closet.
（的把衣服放进衣柜。）可以提问孩子：What clothes do you wear in winter? 拓展辨析：
clothes 通常表示衣服的总称，没有单数形式。

===== PAGE 267 =====
不能说 a clothes，可以说 a piece of clothing（一件衣服）。
put
Put means to place something somewhere. 中文意思是“放；摆放”。常见搭配有 put on（（穿上）、
put in（放进去）、put under（放在来面）、put something on something（把某物放在某物上）。

[F] Let’s Shop
Do you like going shopping?
What do you like to buy?
Today we're going to read Let's Shop and learn how to shop politely in English!
shack Meaning: a small, simple building made of wood or other basic materials. Chinese: 小木屋；
简陋的小屋。 Useful Phrases: little shack, beach shack, old shack. Examples: They sell fruit in a

===== PAGE 281 =====
small shack. / The old shack is near the road. Questions: Have you ever seen a shack? / Is a shack
big or small? Word Extension: Compare shack and house. A house is usually bigger and more
comfortable, while a shack is small and simple. Examples: I live in a house. / The farmer has a small
shack.
shed Meaning: a small building used for storing tools, bikes, or garden equipment. Chinese: 工具
棚；储物棚。 Useful Phrases: garden shed, tool shed, keep in the shed. Examples: Dad keeps the
shovel in the shed. / The bikes are in the shed. Questions: What can people keep in a shed? / Is a
shed for sleeping? Word Extension: Compare shed and garage. A shed stores tools or garden supplies,
while a garage is mainly for cars.
sash Meaning: a long piece of cloth worn around the waist or across the body for decoration. Chinese:
腰带；绶带。 Useful Phrases: wear a sash, red sash, birthday sash. Examples: She wears a beautiful
sash. / The winner has a gold sash. Questions: What color sash do you like? / Have you ever worn
a sash? Word Extension: A sash is often worn during celebrations, performances, beauty contests,
or special events to make clothes look more beautiful.
mug Meaning: a large cup with a handle, usually used for hot drinks. Chinese: 马克杯。 Useful
Phrases: coffee mug, tea mug, favorite mug. Examples: Dad drinks coffee from his mug. / My mug
is blue. Questions: What do you drink from a mug? / What color is your favorite mug? Word
Extension: Compare mug and cup. A mug is usually bigger and used for hot drinks, while a cup is
often smaller.
fresh Meaning: new, clean, or recently picked or made. Chinese: 新鲜的。 Useful Phrases: fresh
fruit, fresh vegetables, fresh bread. Examples: These apples are fresh. / We buy fresh milk every day.
Questions: What fresh food do you like? / Is fresh fruit healthy? Word Extension: Compare fresh
and old/stale. Fresh food tastes better and is healthier, while old food may not taste good. Examples:
Fresh bread smells great. / Don't eat stale bread.
mask Meaning: something you wear over your face. Chinese: 面具；口罩。 Useful Phrases: wear
a mask, animal mask, face mask. Examples: The child wears a tiger mask. / Please wear a mask if
you are sick. Questions: Have you ever worn a mask? / What kind of mask do you like? Word
Extension: A mask can be worn for health, safety, or fun. For example, we wear masks at costume
parties or when we are ill.

===== PAGE 282 =====
Would you like to...? Meaning: a polite way to invite someone or ask what they would like to do.
Chinese: 你想要……吗） Useful Phrases: Would you like to come? Would you like to play? Would
you like some juice? Examples: Would you like to go shopping? / Would you like some ice cream?
Questions: How do you answer "Would you like to...?" / Can you ask your friend a question with
"Would you like to...?" Word Extension: Teach both answers. Yes, I'd love to. / Yes, please. No,
thank you. / Maybe next time. Explain that Would you like... is more polite than Do you want...
next Meaning: coming after something else. Chinese: 来一个；接来来。 Useful Phrases: next stop,
next week, next customer. Examples: Who is next? / We'll go shopping next Saturday. Questions:
What lesson do you have next? / Who is next in line? Word Extension: Compare next and last. Next
means after the present one, while last means the final one or the previous one, depending on the
context. Examples: Today is Monday. Next is Tuesday. / Last week I visited my grandma.
语言拓展
Shopping Expressions When we go shopping, we use many polite expressions. We can say Can I
help you?, I'm looking for..., How much is it?, I'd like this one, please., Here you are., Thank you.,
and Have a nice day! Encourage children to role-play as the shopkeeper and the customer. Questions:
What would you like to buy? / What would you say to the shopkeeper?
Would You Like...? vs Do You Want...? Both expressions ask about someone's wishes, but Would
you like...? is much more polite and is commonly used in shops, restaurants, and when inviting
others. Do you want...? is more casual and is usually used with family or close friends. Examples:
Would you like some juice? / Do you want to play soccer? Help children practice polite
conversations by answering Yes, please. / Yes, I'd love to. / No, thank you.
Shopping Sequence Going shopping usually follows a simple order. First, choose what you want.
Next, ask the price. Then, pay for it. Finally, say thank you and take your shopping bag home.
Encourage children to retell the process using First... Next... Then... Finally... Questions: What do
you do first when you go shopping? / What do you say after paying?

===== PAGE 283 =====
课摆反馈
本节课围绕绘本《Let's Shop》展开学习，重点学习了 shack, shed, sash, mug, fresh, mask, Would
you like to...? 和 next 等词汇与表达。通过购物的故事情境，孩子学习了不同 品和购物场
景的相关词汇，并能够运用 Would you like to go shopping?、I'd like this one, please.、The fruit
is fresh. 和 Who is next? 等完整句型进行表达。课堂中重点拓展了 Would you like...? 与 Do
you want...? 的区别，学习了购物中常用的礼貌用语以及购物流程 First... Next... Then...
Finally...，帮助孩子在真实生活情境中进行简单购物对话。整体来看，孩子能够积极参与角
色扮演活动，并尝试使用完整句子进行购物交流，礼貌表达和口语交际能力都有进一步提升。

在短语 off to the supermarket 中，off 表示“离开是里、出发去某个地方”。它常用于表达开始
前往某地的动作，相当于 leave for 或 go to。绘本中的 Off to the supermarket! 是一种简洁、
生动的口语表达，完整形式可以理解为 We’re off to the supermarket.（（的们出发去超市啦！）。

===== PAGE 304 =====

和 be off to bed（去觉。）。例如：We’re off to the supermarket to buy some fruit.（的们要去超
市买些水果。）Dad is off to work.（（爸爸上班去了。）课堂互动时可以提问：Where are they off

形））If you go to the supermarket, what would you like to buy first?（如果你去超市，你最想

feet Meaning: the plural form of foot. Chinese: 脚（复数）。Useful Phrases: two feet, big feet,

every day Meaning: each day; daily. Chinese: 每天。Examples: I read every day. / The birds look

stripe Meaning: a long narrow line of color. Chinese: 龙纹。 Useful Phrases: black stripes, striped

===== PAGE 329 =====

grab Meaning: to take or hold something quickly with your hand. Chinese: 抓住。 Useful Phrases:

stem Meaning: the part of a plant that holds up the leaves and flowers. Chinese: 茎；花茎。 Useful

flap Meaning: to move wings up and down. Chinese: 拍打（翅膀）。 Useful Phrases: flap its wings,

语言拓展
Life Cycle of a Moth A luna moth changes as it grows. It starts as an egg, becomes a caterpillar,
then makes a cocoon, and finally becomes a beautiful moth. This process is called a life cycle.
Questions: Which stage can crawl? / Which stage can fly? / What happens after the caterpillar?is
the moth? / Does it have stripes or spots? / Is it big or small?
Patterns in Nature Many animals have beautiful patterns. Zebras have stripes, leopards have spots,
butterflies have colorful wings, and luna moths have long wing tips and soft fuzz. Encourage
children to observe carefully and compare different animals. Questions: Which animal has stripes?
/ Which animal has spots? / Which insect do you think is the most beautiful?

[F] Come to the Zany Zoo
Do you like going to the zoo?
What's your favorite animal at the zoo?
Today we're going to read Come to the Zany Zoo and meet some funny animals with silly clothes
and hairstyles!
zany Meaning: very funny, silly, and a little crazy in a fun way. Chinese: 滑稽古怪的；搞笑的。
Useful Phrases: zany zoo, zany idea, zany clothes. Examples: The animals wear zany clothes. / We
had a zany day at the zoo. Questions: Do you like zany stories? / What's the funniest thing you've
seen? Word Extension: Compare zany, funny, and silly. Funny makes people laugh, silly means
acting in a playful or slightly foolish way, and zany describes something especially wild, unusual,
and full of surprises.
hippo Meaning: a very large animal that lives in rivers and lakes. Chinese: 河马。 Useful Phrases:
big hippo, hungry hippo. Examples: The hippo likes the water. / The hippo has a big mouth.
Questions: Is a hippo big or small? / Where does a hippo live? Word Extension: Compare hippo and
elephant. Both are very large animals, but hippos spend much of their time in the water, while
elephants live mostly on land.
canoe Meaning: a long, narrow boat that people move with a paddle. Chinese: 独木舟；划艇。
Useful Phrases: ride a canoe, paddle a canoe. Examples: They ride a canoe on the river. / The canoe
moves slowly across the water. Questions: Have you ever seen a canoe? / Where can you use a
canoe? Word Extension: Compare canoe and boat. A canoe is a type of small boat that people paddle
by hand.
flamingo Meaning: a tall pink bird with long legs. Chinese: 火烈鸟。 Useful Phrases: pink
flamingo, one-legged flamingo. Examples: The flamingo is pink. / The flamingo stands on one leg.

===== PAGE 331 =====
Questions: What color is a flamingo? / Can you stand on one leg like a flamingo? Word Extension:
Flamingos are famous for long legs, long necks, and pink feathers. Encourage children to imitate a
flamingo by standing on one leg.
panda Meaning: a black-and-white bear that eats bamboo. Chinese: 熊猫。 Useful Phrases: giant
panda, baby panda, eat bamboo. Examples: The panda eats bamboo every day. / The baby panda is
cute. Questions: What does a panda eat? / Where do pandas live? Word Extension: Describe pandas
with It has black eyes, black ears, and white fur. Encourage children to use It has... to describe
animals.
peek-a-boo Meaning: a game where you hide your face and then suddenly show it. Chinese: 躲猫
猫（幼儿游戏）。 Useful Phrases: play peek-a-boo, peek-a-boo game. Examples: The baby laughs

you play it with? Word Extension: Introduce other simple children's games, such as hide-and-seek
and tag, then compare them. Peek-a-boo is usually for babies, while hide-and-seek is for older

leopard Meaning: a wild cat with black spots. Chinese: 豹子。 Useful Phrases: spotted leopard,

Does a leopard have stripes or spots? / Is a leopard a wild animal? Word Extension: Compare leopard

alligator Meaning: a large reptile with a long tail and many sharp teeth. Chinese: 短吻鳄。 Useful
Phrases: big alligator, sharp teeth. Examples: The alligator swims in the river. / The alligator opens
its big mouth. Questions: Where does an alligator live? / Does it have sharp teeth? Word Extension:
Compare alligator and crocodile. Both look similar, but an alligator usually has a wider, U-shaped
nose.
plus Meaning: also; in addition; or the math symbol (+). Chinese: 加；另外；而且。 Useful Phrases:
plus one, plus more, two plus three. Examples: Two plus three is five. / The zoo has pandas, plus

Extension: Plus has two common meanings. In math, it means add. In speaking, it means also or in
addition. Examples: We have cake, plus ice cream!

===== PAGE 332 =====
fancy Meaning: beautiful, special, or elegant. Chinese: 漂亮的；精致的；华丽的。 Useful Phrases:
fancy clothes, fancy hat, fancy dress. Examples: The flamingo wears a fancy hat. / She has a fancy
dress. Questions: What fancy clothes would you like to wear? / Is the animal wearing fancy clothes?
Word Extension: Compare pretty and fancy. Pretty means nice to look at, while fancy means more
special, stylish, or decorated.
hairdo Meaning: the way someone's hair is cut or styled. Chinese: 发型。 Useful Phrases: funny

Extension: Children can describe hair with long, short, curly, straight, messy, or spiky. Examples:
The panda has short hair. / The flamingo has a funny hairdo.
语言拓展
Describing Animals Encourage children to describe animals using the pattern It is... It has... It can...
For example: The flamingo is pink. It has long legs. It can stand on one leg. or The panda is cute. It
has black-and-white fur. It eats bamboo. This helps children organize their ideas into complete
sentences.
Funny or Fancy? Help children compare funny, silly, zany, and fancy. For example: A clown is funny.
A child making a silly face is silly. Animals wearing colorful wigs are zany. A princess wearing a
beautiful dress looks fancy. Encourage children to explain why they choose each word.
Answering Open-ended Questions Teach children to answer using Choice + Reason + Detail. For
example:
Question: Which animal do you like best?
Sample Answer: I like the panda best because it is cute. It eats bamboo, and I love its black-and-
white fur.
This speaking pattern can be used for many zoo-related questions and helps children give longer,
more complete answers.

Usually = most of the time
Sometimes = not every time
Never = 0%

fly away Meaning: to leave by flying. Chinese: 飞走。 Useful Phrases: fly away, fly into the sky.

Egg → Caterpillar → cocoon → Butterfly

A caterpillar hatches and eats lots of leaves.
It makes a chrysalis and rests inside.
Finally, a beautiful butterfly comes out and flies away.
First... Next... Then... Finally...
Example:
First, the butterfly lays eggs. Next, the caterpillar eats leaves. Then, it rests inside a chrysalis. Finally,

words.
bake Meaning: to cook food in an oven. Chinese: 烘焙；烤。 Useful Phrases: bake cookies, bake
bread, bake a cake. Examples: We baked cookies together. / Dad baked a birthday cake. Questions:
What would you like to bake? / Have you ever baked with your family? Word Extension: Compare
bake, boil, and fry. Bake uses an oven, boil uses hot water, and fry uses oil.

===== PAGE 342 =====
rake Meaning: to collect leaves or grass with a garden tool called a rake. Chinese: 用耙子耙；耙
子。 Useful Phrases: rake the leaves, garden rake, rake the yard. Examples: Grandpa raked the
leaves in the yard. / We helped rake the grass. Questions: Why do people rake leaves? / When do
leaves usually fall? Word Extension: Explain that a rake can be both a noun (the tool) and a verb
(the action). Example: Use a rake to rake the leaves.
busy Meaning: having many things to do. Chinese: 忙碌的。 Useful Phrases: be busy, busy day,
busy doing something. Examples: Mom is busy cooking dinner. / We're busy getting ready for the
weekend. Questions: When are you usually busy? / Can people still have fun when they're busy?
Word Extension: Compare busy and free. When we're busy, we have many things to do. When we're
free, we have time to relax or play.
Grammar Extension:
① be busy doing sth.（忙于做某事）
Structure:
be busy + V-ing
Examples:
Mom is busy cooking dinner.
I'm busy doing my homework.
They're busy getting ready for the party.
② be busy with sth.（忙于某事）
Structure:
be busy with + noun
Examples:
Dad is busy with work.
She's busy with her homework.
We are busy with our project.
③ doing 有是 with）
帮助孩子快速区分：

===== PAGE 343 =====
busy doing + 动作
I'm busy cleaning my room.
She's busy reading a book.
busy with + 名词
I'm busy with my room.（不自然）
I'm busy with housework.
She's busy with school.
记忆口诀：
Doing = 做么形动作
With = 忙么形事情
tomorrow Meaning: the day after today. Chinese: 明天。 Useful Phrases: see you tomorrow,
tomorrow morning, tomorrow afternoon. Examples: We will go hiking tomorrow. / Tomorrow is
Saturday. Questions: What will you do tomorrow? / Are you excited about tomorrow? Word
Extension: Review time words: yesterday → today → tomorrow, helping children describe events
in the correct time order.
本节课围绕绘本《Fun for Everyone》展开学习，重点学习了 spend, weekend, get ready
for, comics, bake, rake, busy 和 tomorrow 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 spend 与 take
的区别，掌握时间表达 spend time doing...；通过 weekday 与 weekend、busy 与 free、
yesterday → today → tomorrow 等时间词和反义词的学习，进一步建立时间概念；结合 get
ready for 与 prepare for 学习日常生活中“做准备”的表达；通过 comics、storybooks 和 novels
的比较，认识不同类型的阅读材料；结合 bake、boil 和 fry 学习不同烹饪方式，并了解 rake
既可以表示“耙子”也可以表示“用耙子汤理叶叶”的一词两用现象.
[F] Our New Playground
What's your favorite thing to do on a playground?
Today we'll learn how people build a new playground and why teamwork is important!
need
Meaning: to require something because it is necessary. Chinese: 需要。 Useful Phrases: need help,
need tools, need more time, need to do something. Examples: We need more wood to build the
playground. / Children need a safe place to play. Questions: What do you need for school every day?
/ Why do children need a playground? Grammar Extension: Explain the difference between need +
noun and need to + verb. We need tools. (需要某物) / We need to build a slide. (需要做某事).

===== PAGE 344 =====
Encourage students to make one sentence using each pattern.
tool
Meaning: an object used to make, fix, or repair something. Chinese: 工具。 Useful Phrases: use a
tool, building tools, hand tools, useful tool. Examples: We use many tools to build the playground.
/ A hammer is an important tool. Questions: What tools have you seen at home? / Which tool would
you use to build a swing? Word Extension: Introduce common tools such as hammer, screwdriver,
wrench, saw, shovel, tape measure, and drill. Guide students to match each tool with its purpose and
explain why different jobs require different tools.
swing
Meaning: a playground seat that moves back and forth. Chinese: 秋千。 Useful Phrases: play on
the swing, swing high, playground swing. Examples: The children are playing on the swings. / I like
to swing with my friends. Questions: Which do you like better, a swing or a slide? / How can we
stay safe on a swing? Science Extension: Explain that a swing moves because of gravity and pushes.
When someone pushes the swing, it moves forward and backward like a pendulum. Discuss why
we should always hold the chains and wait for the swing to stop before getting off.
slide
Meaning: a piece of playground equipment that children slide down. Chinese: 滑梯。 Useful
Phrases: go down the slide, climb the slide, playground slide. Examples: The children slide down
the big slide. / The new slide is colorful and fun. Questions: What is your favorite kind of slide? / Is
it safe to climb up the slide from the bottom? Word Extension: Compare slide, climb, crawl, jump,
and balance. Explain that each action develops different physical skills and that children should
always use playground equipment in the correct way.
make
Meaning: to create, build, or produce something. Chinese: 制作；建造。 Useful Phrases: make a
playground, make a plan, make friends, make a mistake. Examples: We made a new playground for
the children. / Let's make a map together. Questions: What would you like to make? / Can we make
a playground without a plan? Grammar Extension: Teach make + noun (make a cake, make a toy)
and make + object + adjective (Reading makes me happy. / Exercise makes us strong.). Explain that
make can mean "create" or "cause someone to feel something."

===== PAGE 345 =====
else
Meaning: another person, thing, or place besides the ones already mentioned. Chinese: 其他；另
外。 Useful Phrases: what else, who else, where else, anything else, someone else. Examples: What
else should we add to the playground? / Who else wants to help? Questions: Besides a swing, what
else would you like to play with? / Who else can help build the playground? Grammar Extension:
Teach Question Word + else. Examples: What else do we need? Who else is coming? Where else
can children play? Encourage students to answer with complete sentences.
have
Meaning: to own, experience, eat, or enjoy something. Chinese: 有；吃；经历；进行。 Useful
Phrases: have fun, have lunch, have a good time, have a rest, have a meeting. Exam
e have a new playground. / The children have fun every day. Questions: What do you have at your
school playground? / When do you have the most fun? Word Extension: Explain that have has many
meanings. It can mean own (I have a bike.), eat (Let's have lunch.), experience (We have fun.), or
receive/hold (We had a party yesterday.). Help students identify the meaning from the context.
children
Meaning: more than one child. Chinese: 孩子们。 Useful Phrases: young children, school children,
children play together. Examples: The children are playing happily. / Children need time to play and
learn. Questions: Why is playing important for children? / What games do children enjoy most?
Grammar Extension: Explain that children is the irregular plural of child. Introduce other irregular
plurals such as man → men, woman → women, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice, and
ask students to discover the pattern that these words do not simply add -s or -es.
Why do children need playgrounds?
Teach children to answer with Opinion → Reason → Result.
Sample Answer:
Opinion: I think playgrounds are very important.
Reason: They help children exercise, make friends, and play together.
Result: Children become healthier, happier, and more confident.
本节课的们学习了绘本《Our New Playground》，围绕“建造新操场”是一主题学习了 need,

===== PAGE 346 =====
tool, swing, slide, make, else, have, children 等重点词汇，并结合绘本内容进行了词组搭配、
情境造句和拓展表达。语法方面，本节课重点学习了 need + 名词 和 need to + 动词 的区
别，例如 We need tools. 表示“的们需要工具”，而 We need to build a playground. 表示“的们
需要建造一个操场”；同时拓展了 make + 名词 和 make + 宾语 + 形容词 的用法，如 make
a plan / make a playground 表示“制作、建造某物”，而 Reading makes me happy. 表示“阅读让
