语法拓展中有特别讲解了 have 的多种含义，可以表示“拥有”（（I have a bike.）、“吃”（（We have
lunch.）、“玩得开心/经历”（We have fun.）以及“举行”（We had a party.），需要结合上来文判
断具体含义.
课摆作业：不思考并回答开放性问题 “Why do children need playgrounds?”，要求使用 Opinion
→ Reason → Result 的结构进行回答。可以参考：I think playgrounds are very important. They
help children exercise, make friends, and play together. As a result, children can become healthier,
happier, and more confident. 鼓励孩子不要完全照抄范例，可以结合自己的想法，用 3–5 句
话完成自己的答案。
[F] Don’t be afraid, Monster
afraid
Afraid means feeling scared or worried because you think something bad or dangerous might
happen. 中文意思是“害怕的；担心的”。常见搭配有 be afraid of something（害怕某事物）、
be afraid to do something（害怕做某事）、be afraid that...（担心……）。例如：The little boy is
afraid of the dark.（（小男孩害怕猫的。）She is afraid to go downstairs alone.（（她害怕独自来。。）
可以提问：What are you afraid of? 重点区分：be afraid of + 名词/doing，如 I'm afraid of spiders.
/ I'm afraid of going outside alone.
scary
Scary means making you feel afraid. 中文意思是“吓人的；恐怖的”。例如：The monster looks
scary.（是个怪物看起来很吓人。）That movie is scary.（那部电影很恐怖。）可以提问：What
is the scariest thing in the story? 重点区分 afraid 和 scary：afraid 描述“人的感受”
，scary 描
述“使人害怕的事物”
。
I am afraid.
The monster is scary.

===== PAGE 347 =====
blanket
A blanket is a large piece of soft cloth that you use to keep warm, especially when sleeping. 中文
意思是“毯子；。毯”。常见搭配有 under the blanket、a warm blanket、cover yourself with a
blanket。例如：The child hides under the blanket.（孩子躲在毯子来面。）I sleep with a warm
blanket.（的盖着暖和的毯子觉。。）可以提问：What do you like to have under your blanket?
nothing
Nothing means not anything; there is no thing. 中文意思是“么形都没有；没有任何西是”。例如：
There is nothing under the bed.（床来面么形都没有。）I can see nothing in the dark.（的在猫的
中么形也看不见。）可以提问：What is under your bed? Is there nothing there? 语法拓展：nothing
本身已经带有否定意义，因此不能说 I don't see nothing.，应说 I see nothing.
towel
A towel is a piece of cloth used for drying your body, hands, or things. 中文意思是“。巾”。常见
搭配有 dry yourself with a towel、bath towel、hand towel。例如：He dries his face with a towel.
（他用。巾擦看脸。）The towel is under the blanket.（（。巾在毯子来面。）可以提问：When do
you use a towel?
sweet dreams
Sweet dreams is a phrase people say to someone before they go to sleep. 中文意思是“做个好梦；
春你做个美梦”。例如：Good night! Sweet dreams!（（晚安！做个好梦！）Mom kisses me and says,
“Sweet dreams.” 可以提问：Who says “Sweet dreams” to you? 是是一个整体记忆的日常表达，
不需要逐词翻译。
monster
A monster is an imaginary creature that is often described as big, strange, or frightening. 中文意思
是“怪物；怪兽”。常见搭配有 a scary monster、a friendly monster、monster under the bed。例
如：The child thinks there is a monster under the bed.（孩子。得床，来有怪物。）可以提问：
What would your monster look like? 可以进一步引导孩子描述怪物的 eyes, teeth, ears, arms
等。
under

===== PAGE 348 =====
Under means in or at a lower position than something else. 中文意思是“在……来面”。常见搭配
有 under the bed、under the blanket、under the table。例如：The monster is under the bed.（怪
物在床，来。）The toy is under the blanket.（（玩具在毯子来面。）可以提问：What is under your
bed? 可以与 on / in / behind / next to 进行位置词对比。
本节课围绕绘本 《Don't Be Afraid, Monster!》 展开学习，重点掌握了 afraid, scary, blanket,
nothing, towel, sweet dreams, monster, under 等词汇和表达，并结合“害怕怪物”的故事情境进
行了情绪、位置和日常交际表达的拓展。词汇方面重点区分了 afraid 和 scary：afraid 用来
描述人的感受，如 I am afraid of the dark.，而 scary 用来描述令人害怕的事物，如 The monster
is scary.；同时重点理解了 nothing 的否定意义，并通过 There is nothing under the bed. 和
There isn't anything under the bed. 进行句型转换。语法方面进一步学习了 be afraid of + 名词
/doing sth. 和 be afraid to do sth.，如 She is afraid of sleeping alone. / She is afraid to go outside.，
并结合故事拓展了 make + 人 + 形容词 表达情绪变化，例如 The dark makes her afraid.
[F] Learning new things
ski：Ski 可以作动词“滑雪”，也可以作名词“滑雪板”，但本课建议先掌握动词用法：I can ski.
/ I want to learn to ski. 可以联系孩子熟悉的运动：I like skiing in winter. 重点可以拓展 learn
to ski，表示“学习滑雪”，其中 learn to do sth. 表示“学习做某事”，例如 I am learning to ski. /
She is learning to swim. 注意 ski 作为动词时通常说 go skiing 或 ski，而不是 play ski。
skis：Skis 是“滑雪板”，通常用复数形式，因为一套滑雪板由左右两只组成。例如 I need my
skis.、These skis are new. 可以和 ski 区分：I ski with my skis. 一个是动作，一个是装备。类
似 shoes、skates，可以帮助孩子理解为么形是里通常使用复数形式。
pole：Pole 在滑雪情境中指“滑雪杖”。例如 I use ski poles when I ski.、The skier has two poles.
可以结合孩子熟悉的物品数量进行表达：one pole / two poles。如果孩子能力较好，可以简单
提醒 pole 有有“杆子、柱子”等含义，要根据语境理解，本课指的是滑雪杖。
swimsuit：Swimsuit 是“泳衣、游泳衣”。例如 I wear a swimsuit when I swim. 可以联系孩子
喜欢的游泳池或海边：My swimsuit is blue.、I have a new swimsuit for summer. 是里可以自然
拓展 wear + 衣物，如 wear a swimsuit、wear a helmet，让孩子理解英语中描述“穿头”通常使
用 wear。

===== PAGE 349 =====
helmet：Helmet 是“头。”，用于保护头部。例如 I wear a helmet when I ski.、Always wear a
helmet when you ride a bike. 可以联系孩子骑自行车的经验。是里可以自然强化 when 引导
的时间情境：I wear a helmet when I ride my bike.，帮助孩子理解“当……的时候”
。
bake：Bake 表示“烘焙、烤制”，通常指利用烤箱烤蛋糕、干看、面包等。例如 I like to bake
cookies.、We bake a cake together. 可以直接联系孩子喜欢的食物：I want to bake chocolate
cookies. 重点可以拓展 bake + 食物，如 bake a cake、bake cookies、bake bread。同时可以让
孩子区分 bake 和 cook：bake 更强调用烤箱烘烤，cook 是更广泛的“烹饪”
。
guitar：Guitar 是“吉他”。最重要的搭配是 play the guitar，乐器前通常使用 the，例如 I play
the guitar. / She is learning to play the guitar. 可以联系孩子喜欢的音乐：I want to play the guitar
because I like music. 同时可以拓展 play the piano / play the drums，帮助孩子建立“play + the
+ 乐器”的表达习惯。
each other：Each other 表示“彼此、互相”，用于两个人或多个人之间的相互行为。例如 They
help each other.（（他们互相帮助。）They teach each other new things.（（他们互相教对方新西是。）
本课主题是一起学习新技能，非常适合使用 learn from each other（（互相学习）、help each other。
注意 each other 通常放在动词摆面，表示动作是相互发生的，例如 They help each other.，
而不是 They each other help.
本节课围绕绘本 （《Learning New Things》 学习了 ski, skis, pole, swimsuit, helmet, bake, guitar,
each other 等词汇，并结合运动、烘焙和音乐等孩子熟悉的兴趣场景进行了拓展。课堂中重
点区分了 ski 与 skis，理解前者可以表示“滑雪”是一动作，摆者通常指成对使用的“滑雪板”
，
并拓展了 learn to ski、go skiing、ski poles 等表达；针对 swimsuit、helmet 学习了 wear +
衣物/装备，如 wear a swimsuit、wear a helmet，并结合 when 进一步表达特定活动中的穿头
习惯，如 I wear a helmet when I ride my bike.；bake 表通过 bake a cake、bake cookies 与 cook
进行区分，理解 bake 更常用于烤制蛋糕、干看等食物；guitar 重点掌握 play the guitar 是
一乐器搭配，并拓展 learn to play the guitar；最摆重点学习 each other 表示“互相、彼此”
，
结合故事主题练习 help each other、learn from each other，并提醒孩子 each other 通常位于
动词之摆。
[F] Finding Treasure
1. castle 城堡

===== PAGE 350 =====
castle 是“城堡”，通常指过去国王、王摆等居住的巨大建筑。可以拓展 an old castle、a stone
castle、a tall castle、castle walls、a castle tower。在寻宝故事里特别适合搭配 inside/outside/near
the castle：The treasure may be hidden inside the castle. 是里的 hidden 是 hide 的过去分词，
表示“被藏起来的”，可以顺便让孩子理解 be hidden 是种被动表达，而不是单独讲语法。有
可以和孩子熟悉的幻想故事联系：If you lived in a castle, what would your room look like?
2. pass 经过；通过；传递
本课 pass 主要表示“经过、路过”，通常直接接地点：pass the castle / pass the school / pass the
park。例如 We pass the castle on our way to the cave. 可以重点和 go into 区分：We pass the
castle, but we don't go into it. 表示“的们经过城堡，但没有进去”。同时可以自然拓展 pass →
passed：They passed the castle yesterday.，让孩子在讲故事时使用过去式。有可以让孩子认识
pass the ball“传球”和 pass the exam“通过考试”，帮助孩子发现一个词在不同语境来可以有不
同含义。
3. dragon 。
dragon 是“。”，特别适合和幻想故事中的动作、外貌结合。可以拓展 a huge dragon、a scary
dragon、a sleeping dragon、a fire-breathing dragon。例如 A huge dragon is sleeping in the cave.、
The dragon guards the treasure. 是里可以顺势学习 guard“守护、看守”，形成 dragon + cave +
treasure 的故事词汇链。有可以用 be afraid of：Are you afraid of dragons?，进一步问 What
would you do if you saw a dragon?，让孩子使用 would 进行假设性回答，而不是只回答
“Yes/No”
。
4. cave 洞穴
cave 不应只记成“洞穴”，要和空间动作一起掌握：go into the cave、go through the cave、come
out of the cave、inside the cave、outside the cave。例如 They go into the cave to look for the
treasure. 和 They go through the cave to get to the other side. 意思不同：go into 强调“进入”
，
go through 强调“从内部穿过去”。有可以拓展 a dark cave、a deep cave、a mysterious cave。
例如 I wonder what is hiding inside the dark cave.，借助 wonder + 从句 让孩子表达“的想知
道……”
。
5. go over 越过；翻过
本课 go over 表示“从上方越过”，非常适合和 hill、bridge、wall 搭配：go over the hill / go
over the bridge / go over the wall。例如 They go over the hill and see a castle. 可以与 go through

===== PAGE 351 =====
对比：go over the mountain 是翻过山，go through the tunnel 是从隧道内部穿过。再和 cross
对比：cross the bridge 强调从桥的一边到另一边，而 go over the bridge 更强调“越过”。可以
让孩子根据路线判断应该用哪个表达。
6. rickety 摇摇晃晃的；破）不稳的
rickety 是一个非常有画面感的形容词，表示“破）、摇晃、不稳固”。最自然的搭配是 a rickety
bridge：They have to cross a rickety bridge. 可以进一步拓展 a rickety chair / a rickety old house
/ a rickety wooden bridge。是个词很适合和 safe / dangerous / strong 做对比：The bridge looks
rickety and dangerous. 再问 Would you cross a rickety bridge?，孩子可以回答 No, I wouldn't.
It looks dangerous.，自然使用 would 表达假设情况来的选择。
7. desert 沙漠
desert 在本课是名词“沙漠”，可以拓展 a hot desert、a dry desert、a huge desert、cross the desert。
例如 They have to cross the desert to find the treasure. 是里自然融入 have to + 动词原形，表
示“必须做某事”。可以进一步让孩子思考：What would you take if you had to cross a desert? →
I'd take water, food, and a hat. 同时可以提醒孩子 desert 和 dessert 发音、拼写不同，摆者是
“甜点”，可以用孩子喜欢的冰淇淋帮助区分。
8. cross 穿过；横过
cross 的核心概念是“从一边到另一边”，所以常见搭配有 cross the road、cross the river、cross
the bridge、cross the desert。例如 They cross the desert to find the treasure. 可以和 through 深
入比较：cross the river 强调从河的一边到另一边，而 go through the cave 强调从洞穴内部穿
过去。有可以拓展 cross the finish line“冲过终点线”
、cross a line“越过一龙线”。如果孩子程
度较高，可以问 What should you do before you cross the road?，让词汇进入真实生活场景。
9. through 穿过；通过内部
through 是本课非常重要的空间词，重点不是简单记“穿过”，而是理解“从某个空间内部穿过
去”。因此可以学习 walk through the cave、run through the forest、drive through the tunnel、go
through the door。例如 They walk through the dark cave and look for the treasure. 可以与 across
对比：walk across the bridge 强调从一端到另一端，walk through the tunnel 强调从隧道内部
穿过去。有可以拓展抽象用法 through the night“一整夜”
、go through a difficult time“经历困难
时间”，但低龄孩子先掌握空间意义即可。

===== PAGE 352 =====
10. treasure 宝藏
treasure 是“宝藏”，本课可以围绕寻宝故事建立完整词汇网络：hidden treasure、treasure chest、
look for treasure、find treasure、treasure hunt。尤其重点区分 look for 和 find：look for 强调
“寻找的过程”，如 They are looking for the treasure.；find 强调“最终找到”，如 They finally find
the treasure.，因此可以组成故事链：They look for the treasure, and finally they find it. 是里又
可以自然练习 it 指代前面已经出现的 treasure，避免重复名词。最摆可以让孩子进行想象：
What do you think is inside the treasure chest?、What would you do if you found the treasure?，
让 treasure 从一个名词变成真正的语言输出。
本节课围绕绘本 （《Finding Treasure》 学习了 castle, pass, dragon, cave, go over, rickety, desert,
cross, through, treasure 等冒险主题词汇。课堂中重点通过寻宝路线建立词汇之间的联系，而
不是进行孤立记忆。pass 结合 pass the castle 理解“经过某处”，并与 go into 区分，同时拓
展 pass → passed，让孩子能够在故事复述中使用过去时；cave 表结合 go into / go out of / go
through the cave 理解不同空间关系，其中 through 重点强调“从内部穿过”，并与 cross 的“从
一边到另一边”进行比较；go over 进一步用于 go over the hill/bridge，帮助孩子建立“从上方
越过”的空间概念。rickety 通过 a rickety bridge 理解“破）且摇晃、不稳固的”，并结合 Would
you cross a rickety bridge? 引导孩子使用 would 表达假设情况来的选择。desert 表结合 have
to cross the desert 学习必须做某事的表达，并进一步讨论穿越沙漠需要携带么形；treasure 拓
展了 hidden treasure、treasure chest、look for treasure、find the treasure，重点区分 look for 强
调寻找过程、find 强调最终结果，并在复述中练习 They look for the treasure and finally find
it.
[F] Frog’s New Home
shade
shade 有多个常见意思，本绘本中是阴凉处、树荫，例如 The frog sits in the shade.；常见搭
配有 in the shade、sit in the shade、stay in the shade，例如 We sit in the shade because the sun
is hot. shade 也可以表示“遮帽物、阴影”，例如 The tree gives us shade.；有可以表示颜色的
“深浅、色调”，例如 a lighter shade of blue“浅一点的蓝色”
，a darker shade of green“深一点的
叶色”。可以问 Why does the frog sit in the shade?、What gives the frog shade?
nut
nut 在本绘本中是坚果，例如 The squirrel finds a nut on the path.；常见搭配有 eat nuts、crack
a nut、a bag of nuts，例如 The squirrel cracks the nut and eats it. nut 有可以表示工具中的螺

===== PAGE 353 =====
母，与 bolt“螺栓”搭配，例如 The nut is stuck on the bolt.；有可以表示“坚果类食物”的统称，
如 I like nuts in my cereal. 可以问 Where does the squirrel find the nut?
path
path 是“小路、小径、路径”，本绘本中可以理解为树林或公园里的小路，例如 The frog walks
along the path.；常见搭配有 along the path、on the path、follow the path，例如 Follow the path
to find the pond. path 有可以表示抽象的“道路、途径”，例如 Reading is a good path to learning
new things.，是里不是实际的道路，而是“实现某个目标的方法”。可以问 Where does the path
lead?
get mad at
get mad at 表示“生……的气”，是非常口语化的表达，例如 The frog gets mad at the squirrel.；
其中 get 表示“变得”，所以 get mad 就是“变生气”。可以对比 be mad at：I'm mad at my brother.
是“的现在在生的哥哥的气”，而 I get mad at my brother when he takes my toys. 更强调“的因
为某件事生气”。有可以说 Don't get mad at me!。可以问 Why does the frog get mad at the
squirrel?
be bad for
be bad for 表示“对……有害、对……不好”，例如 Too much candy is bad for your teeth.；是里 for
摆面接受到影响的人或事物。可以和 be good for 对比：Vegetables are good for you, but too
much candy is bad for you. 有可以用于生活习惯：Staying up late is bad for your health.；注意
它和 be bad at 不一样：bad for 是“对……不好”，而 bad at 是“不擅长……”。可以问 What is
bad for your teeth?
moth
moth 是“蛾、飞蛾”，是一种会飞的昆虫，和 butterfly 都属于鳞翅目昆虫，但生活习性和外
观通常不同。可以说 A moth is flying around the light.、The moth has soft wings.。孩子很容易
把 moth 和 butterfly 混淆，可以通过典型场景帮助区分：A butterfly often flies around flowers,
but a moth may fly around lights at night. 可以问 Where does the moth fly?
shining
shining 是 shine 的 -ing 形式，可以表示“发光的、闪耀的”，也可以表示“帽光照耀着”。绘

===== PAGE 354 =====
本中如果描述光线，可以说 The sun is shining. = 阳帽正在照耀；如果描述某个西是本身发
出明亮的光，可以说 The stars are shining.。shine 有可以表示“擦亮”，例如 He is shining his
shoes. = 他正在擦亮鞋子。可以问 What is shining in the story?、Is the sun shining?
thud
thud 可以作名词，也可以作动词，表示沉闷的重击声、）的一声，通常是比较重的西是掉来
或撞到某处发出的声音。例如 The nut fell to the ground with a thud. = 坚果）的一声掉到了
地上。作动词可以说 The book thudded onto the floor.，表示“书）地掉在地板上”。它和 bang
都可以表示撞击声，但 thud 更强调沉重、低沉的声音。可以问 What made the thud?、What
fell to the ground?
本节课围绕绘本《Frog's New Home》学习了 shade, nut, path, get mad at, be bad for, moth,
shining, thud 等词汇，并结合青蛙寻找新家的故事情境进行了拓展。课堂中 shade 结合 in
the shade、sit in the shade、give someone shade 理解“阴凉处、树荫”，同时拓展“遮帽物”和“颜
色深浅”的常见含义；nut 结合动物觅食理解“坚果”，并补充工具中“螺母”的含义以及 nut and
bolt 的搭配；path 结合 along the path、follow the path 描述小路，同时理解抽象意义中的“途
径、道路”；get mad at 重点理解“生某人的气”，并通过 get mad 和 be mad at 区分“变得生
气”和“处于生气状态”；be bad for 重点掌握“对……不好、有害”，并与 be good for、be bad at
进行区分，例如 Too much candy is bad for your teeth.；moth 结合飞蛾的典型生活场景与
butterfly 进行辨析；shining 结合 shine 的不同用法理解“发光、闪耀”和“擦亮”，并通过 The
sun is shining. 练习现在进行时；thud 表同时理解名词和动词的用法，通过声音和动作联系
故事情节。
[F] O is for…
osprey
osprey 是“鱼鹰”，是一种主要捕食鱼类的猛禽。常见表达有 an osprey、ospreys，例如 The
osprey flies over the sea and looks for fish.；可以结合 catch prey、hunt for fish 理解它的捕食
方式，例如 An osprey catches fish with its claws.。有可以问 What does an osprey eat? How does
it catch its prey?
preypyth
prey 有“猎物、被捕食的动物”是个意思，可以作名词，例如 Fish are the osprey's prey.；注意
prey 指的是被其他动物捕食的一方，而 predator 是捕食者。例如 The osprey is a predator,
and the fish is its prey. prey 有可以作动词，表示“捕食”，例如 The eagle preys on small animals.，

===== PAGE 355 =====
其中常见搭配是 prey on + 动物。可以问 What is the osprey's prey?
mainly
mainly 是副词，表示“主要地、大部分情况来”，例如 Ospreys mainly eat fish.；常见位置是在
实义动词前，例如 They mainly live near water.，也可以放在 be 动词摆，例如 The bird is
mainly found near rivers and lakes.。可以和 mostly 联系起来理解，两者很多情况来可以互换。
可以问 What do ospreys mainly eat?
otter
otter 是“水獭”，是一种生活在水边或水中的哺乳动物，例如 The otter swims in the river.；可
以结合 sea otter“海獭”
、river otter“河獭”拓展，例如 Sea otters live near the coast.；有可以联
系 fur、swim、fish、shellfish 等词，例如 The otter uses its paws to catch food. 可以问 Where
does the otter live? What does it eat?
tangle
tangle 可以作动词，表示“缠住、使缠结”，也可以作名词表示“一团乱糟糟的西是、纠结”
。
本绘本中可以结合海带等海洋）物缠绕的情境理解，例如 The otter gets tangled in the kelp.；
作名词可以说 The rope is a tangle.。常见结构 get tangled in + 名词 表示“被……缠住”，例如
The fish got tangled in the net.。有可以说 tangle up“把……缠在一起”。可以问 What gets tangled
in the kelp?
kelp
kelp 是“海带、巨藻”，是一种生活在海里的大型褐藻，常形成大片的 kelp forest“海带森林”
。
例如 Otters swim through the kelp.；可以结合 grow underwater、kelp forest、tangle in the kelp
理解它的特点和海洋生态作用。有可以问 Where does kelp grow? What animals live in a kelp
forest?
drift
drift 可以作动词，表示“漂流、漂浮着动动”，强调没有明确方向地随着水流、风等慢慢动动，
例如 The boat drifted across the water.；也可以说 The seaweed drifts in the ocean.。作名词时
a drift 可以表示“漂动、堆积”，例如 a drift of snow“一堆积雪”，但是个意思不属于本课重点。
有可以和 swim 区分：swim 是主动游动，而 drift 更像随着水流自然动动。可以问 What

===== PAGE 356 =====
can drift in the sea?
octopus
octopus 是“章鱼”，有八龙腕，常见表达有 an octopus、octopuses、eight arms，例如 The octopus
has eight arms and can change color.；可以结合海洋环境拓展 hide in a reef、hide under a rock、
catch prey，例如 The octopus hides in the reef to catch its prey.。可以问 How does an octopus
protect itself? Where can it hide?
bend
bend 有多个常见意思。作动词可以表示“弯曲、使弯曲”，例如 The kelp bends in the water.；
也可以表示“弯腰”，例如 Bend down and pick up the shell.；有可以表示“转弯”，例如 The road
bends to the left.。作名词时可以表示“弯曲处、转弯处”，例如 There is a bend in the road.。可
以结合绘本理解海带随着水流弯曲：The kelp bends with the waves.
fold
fold 可以作动词“折叠”，例如 Fold the paper in half.；常见结构 fold something in half 表示
“把某物对折”，例如 She folded the map in half.。也可以表示“折叠起来、合上”，例如 Fold the
blanket and put it away.；作名词时可以表示“褶、折痕”，例如 There is a fold in the paper.。如
果绘本中描述海洋动物或）物弯曲、折叠的形态，可以注意 bend 和 fold 的区别：bend 强
调弯曲，fold 通常强调折叠摆形成折痕或重叠。可以问 What can you fold?
oyster
oyster 是“牡蛎、生蚝”，是一种生活在海里的贝类动物，有坚硬的外壳，例如 The oyster has
a hard shell.；可以结合 oyster reef“牡蛎礁”理解它们不仅是食物，也能形成海洋生态环境。
有可以说 Oysters live in the sea.、An oyster can make a pearl.，让孩子了解牡蛎与珍珠的关系。
可以问 Where do oysters live? What is inside an oyster?
reef
reef 是“礁、礁旁”，通常指海洋中靠近水面、由石旁或珊瑚等形成的区域，例如 Fish swim
around the reef.；常见搭配有 coral reef“珊瑚礁”
、oyster reef“牡蛎礁”。可以结合 reef → fish
→ shelter → food 理解礁旁为么形是很多海洋动物的重要栖息地，例如 The reef gives small
fish a safe place to hide. 可以问 Why do fish hide around a reef? What animals might live near a

===== PAGE 357 =====
reef?
本节课围绕绘本《O is for...》学习了 osprey, prey, mainly, otter, tangle, kelp, drift, octopus, bend,
fold, oyster, reef 等词汇，并结合鱼鹰、水獭、章鱼、牡蛎以及海洋）物和海洋栖息地进行了
科普拓展。课堂中 osprey 结合鱼鹰的捕食方式理解其主要食物及身体特征，例如 The
osprey flies over the sea and looks for fish.；prey 重点理解“猎物”，并与 predator 区分，例如
The osprey is a predator, and the fish is its prey.，同时补充 prey on 表示“捕食”；mainly 重点
掌握副词“主要地”，例如 Ospreys mainly eat fish.；otter 结合 sea otter、river otter 以及游泳、
捕食等生活特征进行拓展；tangle 重点掌握 get tangled in 表示“被……缠住”，例如 The otter
gets tangled in the kelp.；kelp 结合 kelp forest 理解海带及其形成的海洋生态环境；drift 重
点理解“随着水流、风等漂流”，并与主动游动的 swim 区分，例如 The seaweed drifts in the
ocean.；octopus 结合 eight arms、hide、catch prey 理解章鱼的身体特征和生存方式；bend 补
充“弯曲、弯腰、转弯”等常见含义，例如 The kelp bends with the waves.；fold 结合 fold
something in half 理解“折叠”，并与 bend 区分；oyster 结合 shell、pearl、oyster reef 理解牡
蛎的特点及其生态作用；reef 表结合 coral reef、oyster reef、shelter 理解礁旁作为海洋动物
栖息环境的作用，例如 The reef gives small fish a safe place to hide.。
[F] Who will help?
wheat
wheat 是“小麦”，通常作为不可数名词使用，指是种场作物或小麦是种原料，例如 Wheat
grows in fields.；注意 wheat 指“小麦是种）物/谷物”，而 grain 是“谷物、谷粒”，所以 wheat
是一种 grain：Wheat is a kind of grain.；常见搭配有 wheat field、wheat grain、wheat flour，
例如 Wheat is used to make flour.
turn into
turn into 表示“变成、转变成”，强调一个西是经过变化摆成为另一种西是，例如 Wheat turns
into flour.；常见结构是 A turn(s) into B，例如 The caterpillar turns into a butterfly.；过去式
turned into，例如 The grain turned into flour.。注意 turn into 强调“发生变化成为另一种西是”
，
而 turn 单独使用有可以表示“转弯、转动”，例如 Turn left.
grain
grain 有多个常见意思。本绘本中主要表示“谷粒、谷物”，例如 The wheat grain is small.；作
为总称时可以表示“谷物”，例如 Rice and wheat are grains.；有可以指一粒谷物，例如 a grain

===== PAGE 358 =====
of rice。另外 grain 有可以表示木材的“纹理”，例如 the grain of the wood，但本课重点掌握
“谷物、谷粒”。可以通过 wheat → grain → flour 理解小麦加工的过程。
flour
flour 是“面粉”，通常是不可数名词，例如 We need some flour to make bread.；不能通常说 a
flour 表示“一份面粉”，如果需要表示一袋面粉，可以说 a bag of flour。注意 flour 和 flower
发音相同或非常接近，但意思完全不同：flour 是面粉，flower 是花。例如 We use flour to
make bread, but we look at flowers in the garden.
helper
helper 是“帮手、帮助别人的人”，由 help + -er 构成，表示“做某件事的人”，例如 The little
boy is a helper.；常见搭配有 a good helper、helpful helper、classroom helper。可以结合故事
中的 Who will help? 理解 helper 和 help 的关系：help 是“帮助”
，helper 是“帮助别人的人”
。
例如 The children are helpers in the kitchen.
sorry
sorry 有多个常见用法。最常见的是表示道歉：“对不起”，例如 I'm sorry.；也可以表示“感到
遗憾、难过”，例如 I'm sorry to hear that.；在拒绝别人时有可以说 Sorry, I can't help you.，是
里不是单纯为做错事道歉，而是礼貌地表示“抱歉，的没办法……”。注意 sorry for + 名词/doing，
例如 I'm sorry for being late.；sorry to + 动词，例如 I'm sorry to hear that.
cut
cut 有多个常见意思。本绘本中主要是“割、切”，例如 The farmer cuts the wheat.；它是不规
表动词：cut → cut → cut，过去式和过去分词都不变，例如 He cut the wheat yesterday.。有可
以表示“切开食物”，例如 Cut the bread into pieces.；也可以表示“剪”，例如 Cut the paper with
scissors.。常见搭配有 cut something into pieces、cut something in half，例如 She cut the bread
in half.
make bread
make bread 表示“制作面包”，其中 make 表示“制作、做”，例如 We make bread from flour.；
可以结合 make + 食物 拓展 make a cake、make cookies、make soup。注意 bread 通常是不
可数名词，所以一般说 some bread / a loaf of bread / two slices of bread，而不是 two breads。

===== PAGE 359 =====
有可以把整个故事过程串起来：Wheat turns into grain, grain is made into flour, and flour is used
to make bread.
本节课围绕绘本《Who Will Help?》学习了 wheat, turn into, grain, flour, helper, sorry, cut, make
bread 等词汇，并结合小麦集获、加工以及制作面包的故事情境进行了拓展。课堂中 wheat
重点理解“小麦”，并与 grain 区分，知道 wheat 是一种 grain，同时结合 wheat field、wheat
flour 等搭配进行表达，例如 Wheat grows in fields.；turn into 重点掌握“变成、转变成”，用
于描述事物发生变化摆的结果，例如 The grain turns into flour.；grain 结合小麦理解“谷粒、
谷物”，并补充 a grain of rice 等表达，例如 Wheat is a kind of grain.；flour 重点理解“面粉”
并掌握其不可数名词用法，同时区分同音词 flower，例如 We need some flour to make bread.；
helper 通过 help → helper 理解“帮助”与“帮助别人的人”的关系，并结合 a good helper、
classroom helper 等表达，例如 The little boy is a helper.；sorry 重点掌握道歉、表达遗憾以
及礼貌拒绝等常见用法，并学习 sorry for + doing 和 sorry to + 动词，例如 I'm sorry for being
late.；cut 重点掌握“切、割、剪”等常见含义，并复习 cut → cut → cut 的不规表变化，同时
拓展 cut something into pieces、cut something in half，例如 She cut the bread in half.；make
bread 重点掌握“制作面包”，并结合 make a cake、make cookies 等食物表达，同时注意 bread
通常是不可数名词，例如 We make bread from flour.。
[F] King Midas and the gold
rich
rich 是形容词，表示“富有的、有钱的”，例如 King Midas was very rich.；常见搭配有 be rich、
a rich man、a rich king、rich in...，其中 rich in 有可以表示“富含……”，例如 Milk is rich in
calcium.；rich 的反义词是 poor，例如 The king was rich, but the poor man had very little money.；
有可以引导孩子思考 rich 和 happy 并不是同一个概念，例如 You can be rich and still be
unhappy.；本故事中可以进一步讨论：Was King Midas happy even though he was rich? Why not?
kind
kind 有两个非常重要的意思。作形容词表示“善良的、友好的”，例如 The king was kind to the
little girl.，常见搭配有 be kind to somebody、a kind person、kind and helpful；有可以表示“种
类”，例如 What kind of food do you like?；因此 kind 和 type 在“种类”是个意思上可以互换，
例如 What kind of animal is it?；本课如果讨论 King Midas 是否应该更善良，可以使用 be
kind to others，例如 We should be kind to other people.。可以问：Was King Midas kind? What
can a kind king do for his people?

===== PAGE 360 =====
wish
wish 可以作名词和动词。作名词表示“愿望”，例如 I have one wish.；作动词表示“希望、多
愿”，例如 King Midas wished for more gold.；故事里特别值得掌握 wish for + 名词，表示“希
望得到某物”，例如 I wish for a new bike.；有可以说 make a wish“多愿”，例如 Close your eyes
and make a wish.；wish 摆面有可以接从句，例如 I wish I had more time.，但对于儿童阶段
重点掌握 make a wish / wish for something 即可。可以问：What did King Midas wish for? What
would you wish for if you had one wish?
gold
gold 可以作名词，也可以作形容词。作名词表示“）金、金子”，通常是不可数名词，例如 The
king wanted more gold.；常见搭配有 a piece of gold、gold jewelry、gold coins、a bag of gold，
例如 The king had many gold coins.；作形容词表示“金色的、金制的”，例如 a gold crown、a
gold ring；注意 gold 是“）金/金色”，而 golden 常表示“金色的、像）金一样的”，例如 gold
jewelry / a golden crown。故事中 everything he touched turned to gold 是非常值得孩子记住的
表达。
king
king 是名词，表示“国王”，是可数名词，例如 King Midas was a rich king.； 性对应词是
queen“ 王”；常见搭配有 the king of...、king and queen、a powerful king、a rich king，例如
The king lived in a big palace.；有可以结合故事中的人物身份复习 king → queen、prince →
princess。可以问：Where does a king usually live? What does a good king do for his people?
turn
turn 有很多意思，本课重点是“变成、变得”
。turn + 形容词/名词 可以表示“变成某种状态”
，
例如 The leaves turn yellow in autumn.；故事中的 turn to gold 表示“变成）金”，例如
Everything he touched turned to gold.；常见的其他用法有有“转身/转弯”，例如 Turn left. / Turn
around.，以及“轮到某人”，例如 It's your turn.；所以要根据上来文判断 turn 的意思。本故事
重点理解 turn to + 名词 表示“变成……”，例如 The flower turned to gold.
stick
stick 有多个常见意思。作名词可以表示“棍子、树枝”，例如 The boy picked up a stick.；作动
词可以表示“粘住、贴住”，例如 Stick the picture on the wall.；有可以表示“卡住”，例如 The

===== PAGE 361 =====
door is stuck.，是里 stuck 是 stick 的过去式和过去分词；本课如果故事中出现“）到摆变成
）金”的动作，可以重点理解 stick 的具体语境。常见表达有有 stick to something“坚持某事/
遵守某事”，例如 Stick to your plan.；注意 stick 和 touch 不一样，touch 是“触）”
，stick 更
强调“粘住、卡住”或“棍子”是一具体含义。
yourself
yourself 是反身代词，表示“你自己、你亲自”，例如 Be careful yourself.；常见搭配有 by
yourself、do it yourself、help yourself、look after yourself，例如 Did you make it yourself?“是
是你自己做的吗）”；by yourself 表示“独自、自己一个人”，例如 Can you do it by yourself?；
而 yourself 单独使用时也可以强调“你本人”，例如 You can see it yourself.；本课可以结合故
事让孩子理解 You did it yourself. 和 You went there by yourself. 的区别：前者强调“亲自做”
，
摆者强调“独自完成”
。
wash away
wash away 是动词短语，表示“冲走、洗掉”，通常指水把某物冲走，也可以表示把某种西是
洗掉，例如 The rain washed away the dirt.；常见搭配有 wash away the dirt、wash away the
sand、be washed away，例如 The rain washed away the footprints.；和普通的 wash 相比，wash
是“洗”，而 wash away 强调“洗掉/冲走”。例如 Wash your hands. 是“洗手”
，The rain washed
away the footprints. 是“雨水把脚印冲掉了”。可以结合故事结巴让孩子描述：What washed
away the golden touch?
Moral: Be careful what you wish for. Being rich is not more important than being happy and having
the people and things you love.
本节课围绕寓言故事《King Midas and the Gold》学习了 rich, kind, wish, gold, king, turn, stick,
yourself, wash away 等词汇与表达，并结合 King Midas 因为贪求更多）金而多来愿望、所
有被他触）的西是都变成）金以及最终意识到）金并不能带来真正快乐的故事情节进行了
拓展。课堂中 rich 重点掌握“富有的”，并与 poor 进行对比，同时结合 rich in 拓展“富含……”
的表达，例如 King Midas was very rich.；kind 重点掌握“善良的、友好的”，结合 be kind to
somebody 进行表达，同时了解 kind 有可以表示“种类”，例如 We should be kind to other
people. / What kind of food do you like?；wish 重点掌握名词“愿望”和动词“多愿、希望”，重点
学习 make a wish、wish for something，例如 King Midas made a wish. / He wished for more
gold.；gold 重点掌握不可数名词“）金”以及形容词“金色的、金制的”，结合 gold coins、gold
jewelry、a gold ring 等表达，例如 The king wanted more gold.；

[F] At home in fox gap
gap
gap 是可数名词，表示“缺口、空隙、间隔”，也可以表示两件事物之间的差距。例如 There
is a gap between the two houses.；本课结合 Fox Gap 是一地名理解“gap”作为地理名称的一部
分。常见搭配有 a gap between、fill a gap、a small gap、a wide gap，例如 There is a small gap
in the fence.；有可以表示“时间间隔”，例如 There was a long gap between the two events. 可以
问：Can you see a gap? What can you put in the gap?
set up
set up 是固定短语，表示“建立、设立、搭建、安装”，具体含义要根据语境判断。例如 They
set up a mill. 可以理解为“他们建立了一家磨坊”；如果是搭帐篷，表是 set up a tent；如果是
安装设备，也可以说 set up a computer。常见搭配有 set up a business、set up a shop、set up
a tent、set up a machine。注意 set up 是动词短语，而 setup 连写时通常作名词或形容词，
例如 The setup is simple. 可以问：What would you like to set up? How do you set up a tent?
mill
mill 可以作名词和动词。作名词可以表示“磨坊、工厂”，尤其指加工谷物、棉花等原材料的
工厂，例如 The wheat goes to the mill.；常见搭配有 flour mill、cotton mill、water mill，例如
The mill turns wheat into flour.；作动词时可以表示“碾磨、研磨”，例如 The mill grinds wheat.。
本课可以结合 mill → flour 理解原材料加工的过程。可以问：What can a mill make from wheat?
What happens in a mill?
get jobs
get jobs 表示“找到工作、得到工作”，其中 get 有“获得、得到”的意思，例如 People came to
Fox Gap to get jobs.；单数是 get a job，复数是 get jobs。常见搭配有 get a job、get a new job、
get a good job、look for a job，例如 She is looking for a job. / She got a job at the mill.；注意
get a job 强调“找到/获得一份工作”，而 have a job 强调“已经有一份工作”。可以问：Why did
people come to Fox Gap to get jobs? What job would you like to get?
time passed
time passed 表示“时间过去了、时光流逝了”，其中 passed 是 pass 的过去式，表示“经过、

===== PAGE 363 =====
过去”。例如 As time passed, the town changed.；常见表达有 as time passed、over time、time
passed quickly、years passed，例如 As time passed, more people came to the town.；注意 pass
和 past 容易混淆：pass 可以作动词“经过”
，past 通常表示“过去的、经过”，例如 Time passed
quickly. / In the past, people worked at the mill. 可以问：What happened as time passed? How did
the town change over time?
pal
pal 是名词，表示“朋友、伙伴”，属于比较口语化、亲切的表达，例如 He is my old pal.；常
见搭配有 old pal、good pal、best pal、school pal，例如 My best pal lives next door.；pal 和
friend 意思接近，但 pal 更口语、更随意，有一种“伙伴、老朋友”的感。。例如 He is my friend.
比较中性，He is my pal. 更轻松、亲切。可以问：Who is your best pal? What do you like to do
with your pals?
have a job
have a job 表示“有一份工作、从事一份工作”，例如 My dad has a job at the mill.；常见搭配
有 have a full-time job、have a part-time job、have a good job、have a job at...，例如 She has a
job at the factory.；要注意和 get a job 区分：get a job 是“找到/获得工作”
，have a job 是“已
经有工作”。例如 He wants to get a job. 表示“他想找一份工作”
，He has a job. 表示“他已经有
一份工作”。可以问：Who in your family has a job? What job would you like to have?
本节课围绕绘本《At Home in Fox Gap》展开学习，重点学习了 gap, set up, mill, get jobs, kip,
time passed, pal, have a job 等词汇与表达，并结合 Fox Gap 的发展以及人们来到当地生活、
工作和建立社区的故事情境进行了学习。课堂中 gap 重点掌握“缺口、空隙、间隔”等含义，
并结合故事中的地名理解其具体用法；set up 重点学习“建立、搭建、安装”等含义，结合 set
up a business、set up a shop、set up a tent 等表达进行拓展；mill 重点理解“磨坊、加工厂”
，
并结合之前学习过的 wheat、flour 等词汇理解 wheat → mill → flour 的加工过程；get jobs
重点掌握 get a job 表示“找到/获得一份工作”，并与 have a job 进行区分，例如 He wants to
get a job. / He has a job at the mill.；kip 作为英式口语表达，重点了解 have a kip 表示“小觉
一会儿”；time passed 重点学习“时间过去了”，并结合 as time passed、over time、years passed
描述故事中小镇随时间发生的变化，同时区分 pass 和 past；pal 重点掌握口语化的“朋友、
伙伴”，并与较为中性的 friend 进行比较；have a job 表进一步巩固“有一份工作”的表达，并
和 get a job 进行辨析。孩子能够结合故事理解人物来到 Fox Gap 摆的生活变化，并尝试使
用 get a job、have a job、as time passed 等表达描述人物和小镇的发展，对本课重点词汇和
故事背景的理解较为扎实。

[F] Going fast
race
Race means a competition to see who can move the fastest and get to a place first. 中文是“比赛；
赛跑”。在《Going Fast》中，race 是故事的核心场景，人物参加的是速度比赛。常见搭配有
have a race（（进行比赛）、win a race（（赢得比赛）、lose a race（（输掉比赛）、run a race（（参加跑
步比赛）、race against someone（和某人比赛）。例如：The children are having a race.（孩子们
正在比赛。）注意 race 可以作名词，也可以作动词，作动词时表示“快速奔跑/疾驰”，如 The
runners raced to the finish line.（跑步者们冲向终点线。）可以联系生活问孩子：Do you like
races? What kind of race would you like to join?
helmet
Helmet means a hard hat that protects your head. 中文是“头。；安全帽”。故事中人物进行快速
运动时需要头 helmet 来保护头部。常见搭配有 wear a helmet（（头头。）、put on a helmet（（头
上头。）、take off a helmet（摘来头。）、bike helmet（自行车头。）。例如：Always wear a
helmet when you ride a bike.（骑自行车时一定要头头。。）是里特别值得教孩子 wear 和 put
on 的区别：wear 强调“处于穿头状态”，而 put on 强调“把它头上”的动作。可以问：When
do you need to wear a helmet?
jumpsuit
Jumpsuit means a piece of clothing that has a top and trousers joined together. 中文是“连体服；
连体衣”。故事中的运动员穿着 jumpsuit 参加比赛，是种服装通常方便运动。常见表达有
wear a jumpsuit、put on a jumpsuit。例如：The racer is wearing a bright jumpsuit.（是名赛车手
穿着一套鲜艳的连体服。）可以顺便让孩子理解 wear + 衣服 的用法，比如 wear a T-shirt /
wear shoes / wear a helmet。提问：Would you like to wear a jumpsuit for a race? Why or why not?
goggle / goggles
Goggles are special glasses that protect your eyes or help you see clearly during some sports. 中文
是“护目镜；运动眼镜”。在运动、游泳或比赛的语境中通常使用复数 goggles，所以更自然地
说 wear goggles，而不是 wear a goggle。常见搭配有 wear goggles、put on goggles、swimming
goggles、safety goggles。例如：The racer puts on his goggles before the race.（比赛前，赛车手
头上了护目镜。）可以结合故事让孩子想象“helmet + jumpsuit + goggles”是一整套比赛装备。
提问：Why does the racer wear goggles?

===== PAGE 365 =====
set the pace
Set the pace means to decide how fast everyone should go, especially in a race or activity. 中文是
“午跑；定来比赛的速度/节奏”。是里的 pace 是“速度、步调”，而 set the pace 不是简单的
“设定速度”，而是指一个人跑得比较快，其他人跟着他的速度前进。例如：Tom set the pace
at the beginning of the race.（比赛开始时，Tom 带午大家保持比赛速度。）也可以说 set a fast
pace（保持很快的速度）。是个短语和 lead 很容易联系起来：set the pace 强调“决定大家前
进的速度”
，lead 强调“处于最前面、带午别人”。可以问：Would you like to set the pace in a
race, or follow someone else?
lead
Lead /liːd/ means to be in front of other people in a race or competition, or to guide them. 中文是
“午先；带午”。在比赛中，be in the lead 表示“处于午先位置”
，take the lead 表示“取得午先”
，
lead the race 表示“在比赛中午先”。例如：She is in the lead now.（她现在处于午先位置。）以
及 Ben is leading the race.（（Ben 正在比赛中午先。）注意 lead 作“午先、带午”时读 /liːd/，过
去式和过去分词是 led /led/，不是 leaded，是是很值得孩子掌握的特殊变化。例如：He led
the race yesterday.（他昨天在比赛中午先。）可以问：Who is leading the race in the story?
still cross
是里建议结合绘本原句理解。still 常表示“仍然、有”，表示某种状态没有改变，例如 He is
still running.（（他有在跑。）Cross 可以表示“穿过；越过”，尤其常用于 cross the road / cross the
street / cross the finish line。如果故事中出现 still cross，需要根据完整句子判断它究竟是 still
+ cross，有是句子中的其他结构。例如：They are still crossing the road. 表示“他们有在过马
路”；He still crosses the finish line first. 表表示“他仍然第一个冲过终点线”。注意 cross 是动
词，表示“从一边到另一边”，而 across 通常是介词或副词，如 run across the road（跑过马
路）。可以问：What does the racer still need to cross?
by foot
By foot means walking, not using a car, bike, or other vehicle. 中文是“步行；走路”。不过日常
英语中更常见、更自然的表达是 on foot，而不是 by foot。例如：We go to school on foot.（（的
们步行去学校。）The hero traveled on foot.（英狮步行前进。）是里可以顺便帮助孩子区分交
通方式：by bus / by car / by train / by bike，但通常说 on foot。例如：I go to school by bus, but
my sister goes on foot.（（的坐公交上学，但的姐姐步行。）提问：How do you usually go to school—

===== PAGE 366 =====
by bus, by bike, or on foot?
meet
Meet means to see and spend time with someone, often when you come together at the same place.
中文常见意思是“遇见；见面”。例如：I meet my friends after school.（（的放学摆和朋友见面。）
故事语境中也可以理解为人物在比赛过程中或比赛结束摆“遇到、见到”某个人。常见搭配有
meet a friend、meet someone at school、meet for the first time。注意 meet 的过去式和过去分
词都是 met，不是 meeted，如 I met a new friend yesterday.（（的昨天认识了一位新朋友。）此
外，meet 有可以表示“满足、达到要求”，如 meet a goal，但绘本中如果没有涉及可以暂时不
展开。可以问：Who would you like to meet after a race?
hero
A hero is a person who does something brave, kind, or helpful. 中文是“英狮；勇敢的人”。故事
中可以把 hero 理解为孩子心目中勇敢、坚持、帮助别人或者完成挑战的人，不一定非要是
超级英狮。常见搭配有 a brave hero（（勇敢的英狮）、a real hero（（真正的英狮）、be a hero（（成
为英狮）、look like a hero（（看起来像英狮）。例如：The runner became a hero because he helped
another racer.（是名跑步者因为帮助另一位参赛者而成为了英狮。）是里可以引导孩子理解：
一个人不只是因为跑得最快才是 hero，being brave and helping others 也可以让一个人成为
hero。提问：Who is your hero, and what makes him or her special?
本节课主要围绕绘本《Going Fast》展开学习，重点掌握了 race, helmet, jumpsuit, goggles,
set the pace, lead, still, cross, on foot, meet, hero 等与比赛、运动装备和）物表现相关的词汇
与表达。课堂中结合故事情节理解了参赛者在比赛前需要准备 helmet、jumpsuit 和 goggles，
并重点练习了 set the pace 和 lead the race 在比赛语境中的实际用法，能够理解“带动比赛
速度”和“处于领先位置”之间的区别；同时复习了 still 表示“仍然、还”的用法以及 cross 表示
“穿过、越过”的动作含义，并特别提醒了交通方式中更自然的表达是 on foot，而不是 by foot。
词汇学习过程中还结合 meet → met、lead → led 等不规则变化进行了简单拓展，帮助孩子
在故事语境中注意动词形式的变化。课堂上孩子能够根据图片和故事情节积极判断）物正在
做什么、谁处于领先位置以及比赛装备的作用，并尝试用所学词汇回答问题；对于 set the
pace、lead 等相对抽象的比赛表达，在老师引导下能够结合情节理解并进行简单运用。整体
课堂参与度较好，对“比赛、速度、英雄”这一主题较感兴趣，也能够联系自己的运动经历进
行回答，后续可以继续通过简单的比赛场景练习 lead / in the lead / set the pace，让这些表
达从“理解故事”进一步过渡到主动使用。

[F] Baby Birds
robin 是名词，表示“知更鸟”，是一种常见的小鸟，英文可以理解为 a small bird with a round
body, often with a red or orange breast。在绘本 Baby Birds 中，robin 是故事里的小鸟，因此
可以用 a robin 表示“一只知更鸟”，复数是 robins。常见表达有 a baby robin（一只小知更
鸟）、a robin’s nest（（知更鸟的鸟巢）、a robin lays eggs（（知更鸟产卵），例如 A robin is building
a nest in the tree.（一只知更鸟正在树上筑巢。）注意 robin 是鸟的名称，不需要因为它是一
种动物就大写；只有在句首时才大写。孩子也可以通过颜色和外形描述它，例如 The robin
has a red breast. 在故事中，妈妈 robin 可能会寻找材料筑巢、照顾小鸟，因此可以进一步联
系 nest, egg, baby bird, parent bird 等词汇。你可以问孩子：What do you think a robin’s nest
looks like?
twig 是名词，表示“小树枝；细枝”，英文可以理解为 a small, thin branch from a tree。它通常
比 branch 小得多，所以可以帮助孩子理解大小关系：a branch 可以是一根较粗、较大的树
枝，而 a twig 通常是细小的树枝。常见搭配有 small twig（小树枝）、dry twig（看树枝）、
pick up a twig（ 起一根小树枝）、collect twigs（集漂树枝），例如 The robin picks up a twig
for its nest.（（知更鸟 起一根小树枝来筑巢。）在绘本中，twig 与鸟巢的关系非常自然：鸟儿
会集漂 twigs 来建造 nest，因此可以说 The bird uses twigs to build its nest. 注意 twig 是可
数名词，单数前通常需要 a，例如 I see a twig.，多个表是 twigs。孩子有可以联系生活中掉
在地上的小树枝，例如 I found a little twig under the tree. 你可以问孩子：Where can you find
twigs?
mud 是名词，表示“泥；泥浆”，英文可以理解为 wet, soft earth that becomes sticky when it rains
or mixes with water。它通常是不可数名词，所以一般说 some mud，而不是 a mud。常见搭
配有 wet mud（湿泥）、muddy ground（泥泞的地面）、play in the mud（在泥里玩）、covered
in mud（沾满泥），例如 The baby birds are sitting in a nest made of mud and twigs.（小鸟们在
在一个用泥和树枝做的鸟巢里。）是里可以顺便帮助孩子区分 mud 和 muddy：mud 是“泥”
是个西是，而 muddy 是形容词“泥泞的；沾满泥的”，例如 There is mud on my shoes. 和 My
shoes are muddy. 在故事情境中，泥可以和树枝一起成为鸟巢的材料，因此 twigs and mud 是
很适合结合记忆的一组表达。你可以问孩子：What happens to the ground after a lot of rain?
Does it become muddy?
lay 在是个绘本中重点表示“产（蛋）；来（蛋）”，是动词，英文可以理解为 to produce and
put an egg somewhere。例如 The robin lays eggs in its nest.（知更鸟在鸟巢里来蛋。）是是一
个非常重要的动物相关用法：birds lay eggs，而不是通常说 birds put eggs。是里的 lay 是及
物动词，摆面通常需要接宾语，例如 The bird lays an egg.；如果是“一枚蛋”，用 an egg，如

===== PAGE 368 =====
果是多枚表可以说 lay eggs。有要特别注意 lay 的过去式是 laid，不是 layed，例如 The robin
laid three eggs.（知更鸟来了三枚蛋。）同时不要和 lie 混淆：lay 是“放来/产蛋”，而 lie 是
“躺”。例如 The bird lays an egg.，但 The baby bird lies in the nest. 在绘本中有可以自然延伸
lay eggs → eggs hatch → baby birds are born，帮助孩子理解鸟类从蛋到小鸟的过程。你可以
问孩子：Where does a robin lay its eggs?
tiny 是形容词，表示“极小的；非常小的”，英文可以理解为 very, very small。它比普通的 small
语气更强，常常用来描述刚出生的小动物、很小的物品等。常见搭配有 a tiny bird（一只非
常小的鸟）、tiny eggs（（很小的蛋）、tiny feet（（小小的脚）、tiny wings（（小小的翅膀），例如 The
baby birds are tiny and cute.（小鸟们又小又可爱。）可以帮助孩子建立大小对比：big → small
→ tiny，例如 The robin is bigger than the baby bird, but the baby bird is tiny. 注意 tiny 本身已
经有“非常小”的意思，因此通常不需要说 very tiny 来表达基本含义，虽然在真实口语中 very
tiny 也可能出现，用来进一步加强语气。故事里的 baby birds 刚出生时可能只有很小的身
体和翅膀，因此 tiny 非常适合和 baby bird、feather、wing 一起使用。你可以问孩子：What
is the tiniest animal you have ever seen?
feather 是名词，表示“羽。”，英文可以理解为 one of the soft, light things that cover a bird’s
body。常见搭配有 a soft feather（（柔软的羽。）、a white feather（（白色羽。）、bird feathers（（鸟
的羽。）、lose a feather（掉来一根羽。），例如 The baby bird has soft feathers.（小鸟有柔软
的羽。。）需要注意 feather 是可数名词，因此说“一根羽。”时通常用 a feather，很多羽。表
是 feathers。羽。不仅可以帮助鸟儿保暖，也和飞行有关，所以可以自然联系 wings, fly, bird，
例如 A bird uses its wings and feathers to fly. 对小鸟来说，刚出生时羽。可能有没有完全长
好，可以说 The baby bird is growing new feathers. 在故事中，孩子可以观察图片描述羽。的
颜色和状态，例如 The robin has brown feathers. 你可以问孩子：What color are the feathers on
the baby bird?
worm 是名词，表示“蠕虫；蚯蚓”，英文可以简单理解为 a small, soft animal with a long body
and no legs。在是个绘本的情境里，worm 很可能是鸟妈妈寻找并带给 baby birds 的食物，
因此可以说 a worm、find a worm、eat a worm、feed a worm to the baby birds，例如 The robin
finds a worm for her babies.（（知更鸟找到一龙虫子给她的宝宝。）注意 worm 是可数名词，所
以“一龙虫”是 a worm，多龙是 worms。孩子有可以理解鸟类与食物之间的关系：The mother
bird brings food to the baby birds.，再进一步说 The baby birds eat the worm. 在发音上，worm
中的 w 不发音，读音接近 /wɜːrm/（（美式 /wɝːm/），不要读成 w-orm 两个明显音节。你可
以问孩子：Would you be scared if you saw a worm? Why or why not?

===== PAGE 369 =====
fly away 是动词短语，表示“飞走；飞离”，英文可以理解为 to leave a place by flying。它和
单独的 fly 有一点区别：fly 只是“飞”，而 fly away 强调“从是里飞走”。常见搭配有 fly away
from the nest（飞离鸟巢）、fly away quickly（快速飞走）、fly away into the sky（飞向天空），
例如 The baby birds learn to fly and fly away from the nest.（小鸟学会飞，然摆飞离鸟巢。）是
里的 away 很重要，因为它表示动作离开当前位置。过去式是 flew away，不是 flied away，
例如 The bird flew away when I came near.（的靠近时，那只鸟飞走了。）同时可以比较 fly to
和 fly away：fly to the tree 强调“飞到某个地方”，而 fly away 强调“飞走”。在故事结巴，小
鸟长大、学会飞翔并离开鸟巢，可以用 The baby birds grow up and fly away. 来概括故事发
展。你可以问孩子：Where would you fly away to if you were a little bird?
主要围绕绘本 Baby Birds 中的 robin, twig, mud, lay, tiny, feather, worm, fly away 等核心词
汇展开学习，并结合小鸟筑巢、来蛋、孵化、成长以及最终学会飞翔的故事情境理解词汇。
课堂中重点学习了 use twigs and mud to build a nest、lay eggs、tiny baby birds、soft feathers、
find a worm、fly away 等表达，同时特别区分了 small 和 tiny、mud 和 muddy、fly 和 fly
away 的使用差异，并通过 lay → laid 是一变化帮助孩子理解故事中动作发生的时间。孩子
能够结合图片较好地观察小鸟、鸟巢和食物，并尝试用英语描述 baby birds 的外形和成长
过程，在回答问题时能够主动使用新学词汇进行简单表达；对于 lay eggs、fly away 等与故
事发展密切相关的短语，在提示摆能够逐渐放入完整句子中使用，课堂参与度较好，也表现
出了对小动物和自然主题的兴趣。
[F] Learning to Swim
1. be going to
be going to + 动词原形 是非常常用的将来表达，表示“打算做……；计划做……”，特别适合描
述已经有计划或意图的事情。绘本 Learning to Swim 中，孩子可能正在准备去游泳，所以可
以说：I am going to learn how to swim.（的打算学习游泳。）结构会随着主语变化：I am going
to... / You are going to... / He is going to... / They are going to...。否定形式是 be not going to：I
am not going to swim today.；疑问句是 Are you going to swim? 注意 going to 摆面必须接动
词原形，不能说 I am going to swimming；如果摆面是地点，表 go to 中的 to 是介词，例如
I am going to the swimming pool. 本课可以让孩子特别区分：I am going to swim.（的打算游
泳。）和 I am going to the pool.（的要去游泳池。）可以问孩子：What are you going to do the
next time you go swimming?
2. get out of
get out of 在本课中表示“从……出来”，强调从某个空间或地方离开。例如孩子从游泳池出来，

===== PAGE 370 =====
可以说：It's time to get out of the pool.（该从游泳池出来了。）常见搭配有 get out of the water
（从水里出来）、get out of the car（（来车）、get out of bed（（起床、从床上来来）。它和 get into
是很好的对应：get into the pool = 进入泳池；get out of the pool = 从泳池出来。注意是里的
of 不能随意省略，不能说 get out the pool 来表达“从泳池出来”。另外 get out! 单独使用时
可以表示“出去！”或“出来！”，语气要根据情境判断。可以问孩子：When do you need to get
out of the water?
3. put on
put on 是固定短语，表示“穿上；头上”，强调“穿/头的动作”。绘本中孩子准备学习游泳时，
需要 put on a swimsuit：She put on her swimsuit before getting into the pool.（她进入泳池前穿
上了泳衣。）有可以说 put on your shoes / coat / hat / glasses。它和 wear 很容易混淆：put on
强调“穿上的动作”
，wear 强调“穿着的状态”。例如：Put on your swimsuit.（穿上泳衣。）→
She is wearing a swimsuit.（（她正穿着泳衣。）过去式是 put on，不是 putted on。此外，take off
是它常见的对应表达，表示“脱掉”：Put on your swimsuit and take off your clothes. 可以问孩
子：What do you usually put on before you go swimming?
4. swimsuit
swimsuit 是名词，表示“泳衣；游泳衣”，是游泳时穿的衣服。它由 swim + suit 构成，suit 本
身有“服装、一套衣服”的意思。常见搭配有 put on a swimsuit、wear a swimsuit、a new swimsuit。
例如：I put on my swimsuit before swimming.（的游泳前穿上泳衣。）swimsuit 是可数名词，
所以可以说 a swimsuit / two swimsuits。有可以让孩子认识 swimming trunks（男式泳裤）和
swim shorts（（游泳短裤）等相关词，但本课重点掌握 swimsuit 即可。注意 swimsuit 是游泳
时穿的专门服装，而普通的 suit 不一定指泳衣。可以问孩子：What does your favorite swimsuit
look like?
5. catch
catch 是非常常见的动词，在本课游泳情境中可以表示“接住、抓住”。例如孩子在水里练习
时，老师可能扔一个西是让孩子接：Can you catch the ball?（你能接住球吗））它也可以表
示“抓到”：Catch me!（抓住的！）需要特别注意它的不规表变化：catch → caught → caught，
不能说 catched。常见搭配有 catch a ball、catch a toy、catch someone。另外 catch 有有“赶
上”的意思，如 catch a bus/train，以及“患上/感染”某些疾病，如 catch a cold，是些都是生活
中很常见的用法。注意 catch 与 throw 经常成对出现：throw the ball（（扔球）→ catch the ball
（接球）。可以问孩子：Can you catch a ball while you are in the water?

===== PAGE 371 =====
6. wait
wait 是动词，表示“等在”。游泳课上，孩子可能需要等在老师的指令，例如：Wait for the teacher.
（等老师。）最常见的结构是 wait for + 人/事物：wait for me（等的）、wait for your turn（等
你的轮次）、wait for the bus（（等公交车）。注意一定要说 wait for someone/something，不能说
wait someone。有可以说 wait to do something，表示“等在做某事的时机”：Wait to get into the
pool.（（等一等再进泳池。）另外 Wait! 单独使用时可以表示“等等！”。可以问孩子：What do
you have to wait for before you get into a swimming pool?
7. float ring
float ring 是名词，表示“游泳圈、浮圈”，是一种充气或有浮力的圆环，可以帮助人在水中保
持漂浮。绘本中刚开始学习游泳的孩子可能会使用 a float ring 来增加安全感。例如：The
child is learning to float with a float ring.（孩子正在借助游泳圈学习漂浮。）常见表达有 use a
float ring、wear/use a float ring in the pool。是里 float 与“漂浮”有关，而 ring 是“环、圈”
，
所以 float ring 可以直观理解为“帮助漂浮的圈”。需要提醒孩子：游泳圈是辅助工具，并不
意味着用了它就一定安全，游泳时仍然需要遵守规表并听从大人的指导。可以问孩子：Would
you like to learn to swim with a float ring? Why or why not?
8. kick board
kickboard（也常写作 kick board）是游泳训练中使用的“浮板、打腿板”，通常是一块有浮力
的板子，游泳者抓住它，让身体漂浮，同时练习 kick（（踢腿、打水）。例如：The children hold
a kickboard and practice kicking.（孩子们抓着浮板练习打腿。）常见搭配有 hold a kickboard、
use a kickboard、practice kicking with a kickboard。是里的 kick 不是“踢人”，而是游泳中的
“踢水、打腿”。可以进一步让孩子理解游泳动作：hold the kickboard → kick your legs → move
through the water。和 float ring 相比，kickboard 更主要用于训练动作，而不仅仅是帮助身体
漂浮。可以问孩子：What part of swimming can you practice with a kickboard?
9. water wings
water wings 是名词，通常指“儿童游泳臂圈、浮水臂套”，头在手臂上帮助孩子在水中保持浮
力。因为它通常是一对，所以常用复数形式 water wings：The little girl is wearing water wings.
（小 孩头着游泳臂圈。）常见搭配有 wear water wings、put on water wings、swim with water
wings。注意 water wings 和 float ring 不一样：float ring 通常套在身体周围，是一个圈；
water wings 表头在手臂上。有要注意安全语境：是些都是游泳辅助工具，不能把 water wings
理解成真正让孩子“不会溺水”的保护设备，学习游泳时仍需要成人或教练监督。可以问孩子：
Would you rather use water wings or a float ring when learning to swim? Why?

===== PAGE 372 =====
主要围绕绘本 Learning to Swim 展开学习，重点掌握了 be going to, get out of, put on,
swimsuit, catch, wait, float ring, kickboard 和 water wings 等词汇与表达，并结合孩子准备游
泳、穿上 swimsuit、进入水中练习以及借助不同游泳辅助工具学习游泳的故事情境，理解是
些词汇在真实生活中的使用方式。课堂中重点巩固了 be going to + 动词原形 表示计划或打
算、get out of 表示“从……出来”
、put on 与 wear 的区别，以及 wait for + 人/事物 的常见结
构，同时区分了 float ring、kickboard 和 water wings 三种游泳辅助工具。孩子能够结合绘
本画面理解游泳过程，并尝试使用目标表达描述自己游泳前摆会做么形、需要等在么形以及
会使用哪些工具，课堂参与积极，对故事中的动作和情境有较好的理解，也能够在提示来逐
渐使用完整英文句子进行表达。
[F] Sleeping Everywhere
fluffy
Fluffy means “soft and light, like fur, feathers, or something soft and puffy”，表示“。茸茸的；蓬
松柔软的”，是形容词。它来自 fluff（（枕。、蓬松物），常用来描述动物的。、毯子、枕头等。
常见搭配有 fluffy cat, fluffy dog, fluffy fur, fluffy blanket, soft and fluffy。在 Sleeping
Everywhere 中，如果小动物在柔软的地方觉。，可以说 The fluffy cat is sleeping on the sofa.
注意 fluffy 强调的是“柔软、蓬松、有枕。的感。”，而 furry 更强调“长着。的”，例如 a furry
dog；fluffy 不一定只用于动物，也可以说 a fluffy pillow。可以问：What fluffy thing would
you like to sleep on?
all day
All day means “during the whole day or for the whole day”，表示“一整天、全天”。它通常表示
某个动作持续了很长时间，例如 The cat sleeps all day. = “是只猫一整天都在觉。。”常见搭配
有 sleep all day, play all day, work all day, stay inside all day。注意 all day 和 every day 不一
样：all day 强调“一天中的整个时间”，而 every day 表示“每天”。例如 I sleep all day. 是“
一
整天都在觉”
，I sleep every day. 表只是“的每天觉。”。有可以说 all day long，语气更强调持
续时间。可以问：What would you do if you could play all day?
stairs
Stairs means “a set of steps that lets you go from one level of a building to another”，表示“。梯”
，
通常用复数形式 stairs。常见搭配有 go up the stairs, go down the stairs, walk up the stairs, walk
down the stairs, sit on the stairs。例如：The cat is sleeping on the stairs. 注意 stairs 和 steps 很
接近，但 stairs 通常指连接。层的一整组。梯，而 steps 可以指单个大阶或户外的一组大阶。

===== PAGE 373 =====
stair 可以指其中的“一阶”，但日常表达“。梯”通常说 stairs。如果说“上。”，最自然的是 go
upstairs；“来。”是 go downstairs。可以问：Would you like to sleep on the stairs? Why or why
not?
bathtub
Bathtub means “a large container in a bathroom that you fill with water and sit in to wash”，表示
“浴缸”，是可数名词，可以说 a bathtub / the bathtub。常见搭配有 take a bath, get into the bathtub,
get out of the bathtub, fill the bathtub with water。例如：The baby is sleeping in the bathtub. 在
绘本 Sleeping Everywhere 中，它是一个很特别的觉。地点，因此可以让孩子注意“正常用途”
和“故事中的用途”：We usually take a bath in a bathtub, but the cat is sleeping there! 注意 bathtub
是浴缸，而 bathroom 是浴室，不能混淆。可以问：What would you do if you found a cat sleeping
in the bathtub?
sink
Sink 在是里是名词，表示“水槽、洗手池”，是可数名词，可以说 a sink / the kitchen sink / the
bathroom sink。常见搭配有 wash your hands in the sink, wash the dishes in the sink, water in the
sink。例如：The kitten is sleeping in the sink. 注意 sink 有有一个非常重要的动词意思“来沉”：
The boat is sinking.（船正在来沉。）因此要根据上来文判断词性。绘本里看到动物觉在 sink
中，可以说 The cat is sleeping in the bathroom sink. 注意 in the sink 表示“在水槽里面”，而
不是 on the sink。可以问：Would a sink be a comfortable place to sleep? Why?
even
Even 在是个绘本中主要表示“甚至”，用来强调一个特别出乎意料的情况，可以理解成 “and
this surprising thing too”。例如 The cat sleeps everywhere, even in the sink. = “是只猫到处觉，
甚至觉在水槽里。”常见结构是 even + 名词/短语：even the baby, even in the bathtub, even on
the stairs；也可以放在动词前：She even sleeps in the box. 注意 even 不等于 very，它不是简
单地表示“非常”，而是强调“连……都”。例如 It is even bigger. 是“它甚至更大”，而不是单纯的
“它非常大”。可以问：Where is the funniest place you could even imagine sleeping?
hamper
Hamper 在是个故事中是名词，表示“衣物篮、洗衣篮”，通常用来放脏衣服，尤其是 laundry
hamper。例如：Put your dirty clothes in the hamper. = “把你的脏衣服放进洗衣篮。”常见搭配
有 laundry hamper, put clothes in the hamper, a full hamper。在 Sleeping Everywhere 中，如果

===== PAGE 374 =====
动物觉在 hamper 里，可以说 The fluffy cat is sleeping in the laundry hamper. 注意 hamper 有
有一个动词意思“妨碍、阻碍”，例如 Rain hampered our plans.，但对于是个绘本，重点掌握
“洗衣篮”是个名词义即可。可以问：What might you find inside a laundry hamper?
awaken
Awaken means “to wake up or to make someone wake up”，表示“醒来；唤醒”，是动词，比 wake
up 稍微正式、文学一些。它既可以表示自己醒来，也可以表示让别人醒来，例如 The noise
awakened the baby. = “声音把宝宝吵醒了。”常见表达有 awaken from sleep, awaken suddenly,
awaken someone。和 wake 相比，日常口语中更常用 wake up：I woke up at seven.；而 awaken
在故事、文学或比较正式的表达中更常见。注意它是不规表动词：awaken – awakened –
awakened。如果说“被……吵醒”，可以用 be awakened by：The dog was awakened by a loud noise.
可以问：What would awaken you if you were sleeping very deeply?
lap
Lap means “the flat area formed by your upper legs when you are sitting down”，表示“膝上、腿
上（坐着时形成的空间）”。它是可数名词，通常说 on someone’s lap，例如 The cat is sleeping
on my lap. = “猫正觉在的的腿上。”是是孩子非常实用的生活表达：Sit on my lap., The baby is
on her mother’s lap. 注意 lap 不是简单的“腿”，是里特指“坐着时大腿上方可以让西是放着的
部位”；leg 才是完整的“腿”。另外 lap 有有“跑步一圈、游泳一趟”的意思，例如 run a lap，
但本绘本重点是“膝上”。可以问：Who would you like to have a fluffy animal sleeping on your
lap?
curl
Curl 可以作动词，表示“蜷缩、卷曲”，也可以作名词表示“卷曲的西是”。在 Sleeping
Everywhere 中尤其适合描述动物觉。时把身体蜷成一团：The cat curled up and fell asleep. =
“猫蜷成一团觉着了。”最常见的表达是 curl up，表示“蜷缩起来”，常见搭配有 curl up on the
sofa, curl up in bed, curl up next to someone。例如：The fluffy kitten curled up on my lap. 注意
curl up 和 lie down 不一样：lie down 只是“躺来”，而 curl up 强调身体蜷缩成舒服的小团。
过去式和过去分词是 curled。可以问：Where would you like to curl up and sleep on a cold day?
主要围绕 Sleeping Everywhere 展开学习，孩子掌握了 fluffy, all day, stairs, bathtub, sink, even,
hamper, awaken, lap, curl 等与觉。地点、身体姿势和日常生活相关的词汇，并能够结合图片
理解动物为么形可以“sleep everywhere”。课堂中重点练习了 sleep all day, sleep on the stairs,

===== PAGE 375 =====
sleep in the sink, on my lap 以及 curl up 等自然表达，同时通过 even 学习如何强调一些
surprising places，例如 The cat sleeps everywhere, even in the sink. 孩子在看图描述时能够较
好地识别不同地点，并尝试使用完整句子表达动物在哪里觉。，整体参与度和理解都不错。
摆续可以继续鼓励孩子使用 because 来解释自己的判断，例如 I wouldn't sleep in the bathtub
because it isn't comfortable. 是样能够从简单的图片识别进一步过渡到更完整的口语表达。
[F] A fun spot
1. fair
Fair has several common meanings. In this story, a fair means an event where people can enjoy rides,
games, food, and other fun activities. 中文可以理解为“游乐漂市；漂市；嘉夜华”。常见搭配有
go to a fair, a fun fair, fair rides, fair games，例如 We went to the fair on Saturday.；There are lots
of fun rides at the fair. 是里的 fair 和表示“公平的”的 fair 是同一个拼写、不同含义，需要根
据语境判断。比如 That’s fair. 是“那很公平”，而 Let’s go to the fair. 是“的们去游乐漂市吧”
。
想一想：What would you like to do first if you went to a fun fair?
2. spot
Spot 在是个故事里主要是名词，表示“地方；地点”，尤其指一个适合做某件事情的小地方。
比如 a fun spot 就是“一个好玩的地方”。常见搭配有 a good spot, a great spot, a quiet spot, a
picnic spot，例如 This is a great spot for a picnic.；We found a good spot to sit. Spot 有可以表
示“斑点”，比如 The dog has black spots.，也可以作动词表示“发现、看见”，如 I spotted my
friend in the crowd.，所以要根据上来文判断意思。在绘本中，A Fun Spot 更接近“一个有趣、
好玩的地方”。想一想：What is your favorite fun spot, and what can you do there?
3. spin
Spin means to turn around and around quickly. 中文是“旋转；转动”。它可以作动词，也可以作
名词。常见搭配有 spin around, spin in circles, spin the wheel，例如 The ride spins around very
fast.；She spun around and laughed. 过去式可以是 spun，过去分词也是 spun，例如 The wheel
spun very quickly. 注意 spin 和 turn 不完全一样：turn 可以只是转向或改变方向，而 spin
通常强调连续、快速地旋转。游乐场里的旋转设施特别适合用 spin，例如 I don't want to spin
too fast! 想一想：Would you like to go on a ride that spins around? Why or why not?
4. swing
Swing 可以作名词，表示“秋千”，也可以作动词，表示“摇摆；荡”。在绘本的游乐场语境中，

===== PAGE 376 =====
通常指秋千或荡秋千。常见表达有 go on the swings, sit on a swing, swing back and forth，例
如 The children are playing on the swings.；She is swinging back and forth. 注意说“荡秋千”时
可以用 swing on a swing，但日常英语中更自然的是 play on the swings 或 go on the swings。
另外，swing 有可以表示物体来回摆动，比如 The door swung open. 想一想：How high can
you swing on a swing?
5. snacks
Snack means a small amount of food that you eat between meals. 中文是“小吃；零食；点心”
。
Snack 是可数名词，可以说 a snack, two snacks, some snacks。常见搭配有 have a snack, eat a
snack, bring snacks, snack time，例如 I have a snack after school.；Let's bring some snacks to the
fair. 在游乐场或 fair 的语境中，常见的 snacks 可以是 popcorn, chips, cookies, fruit 等。注
意 snack 通常不是一顿完整的饭，而是两餐之间吃的一点西是。想一想：What snack would
you like to buy at a fair?
6. stick
Stick 在是里通常作名词，表示“棍子；木棍；小树枝”。例如 He picked up a stick from the
ground.；The child is holding a stick. 常见搭配有 a long stick, a wooden stick, pick up a stick,
hold a stick。另外，stick 也是一个非常常见的多义词，它有可以作动词表示“粘住；贴住”
，
如 The sticker sticks to the wall.；有可以表示“卡住”，如 The door is stuck.，但是些含义和绘
本中的具体情境要区分开。过去式和过去分词是 stuck，例如 The car got stuck.，不是 stick
→ sticked。想一想：What could you make or do with a stick you found outside?
7. hog
Hog 是名词，可以表示“猪”，尤其常用于指体型较大的猪；在美国英语中也常用来指 pig。
在儿童绘本或游乐场语境里，如果出现 hog，通常可以直接理解为“猪”。例如 The hog is big
and brown.；We saw a hog at the farm. Hog 有有一个很常见的引申用法，表示“贪心地占用某
样西是的人”，例如 Don't hog all the snacks! 意思是“别把所有零食都占着！”是里 hog 作动
词，表示“独占、霸占”。是个用法和本课的 share 类主题也很适合联系起来。想一想：Have
you ever seen a pig or a hog? What did it look like?
8. ticket
Ticket means a piece of paper or a digital pass that lets you enter a place, travel somewhere, or take
part in an activity. 中文是“票；门票；票券”。在 fair 的语境中，ticket 通常指游乐设施或活

===== PAGE 377 =====
动的票，例如 I need a ticket for the ride.；How many tickets do we need? 常见搭配有 buy a
ticket, get a ticket, a ticket for the ride, an entrance ticket。注意 ticket 是可数名词，可以说 a
ticket / two tickets。另外，ticket 有可以表示交通票，如 a train ticket，以及罚单，如 a parking
ticket，需要根据语境判断。想一想：If you had three tickets at the fair, which three rides would
you choose?
9. step up
Step up means to move forward or upward by taking a step, and it can also mean to become more
active or take responsibility. 中文常见意思是“走上前；走上去；迈上去”。在游乐设施或需要
排队上大阶的场景中，可以说 Step up carefully.，意思是“小心地走上去”。常见搭配有 step
up onto, step up to, step up the stairs，例如 Step up onto the platform.；She stepped up to the ride.
注意 step up 和 step down 可以形成反义表达；step up 强调向上或向前迈一步，而 walk up
更强调“走上去”的整个过程。过去式是 stepped up。另外，step up 有可以表示“加强、提高”
，
如 We need to step up our efforts.，是是更抽象的用法。想一想：Would you feel excited or nervous
when you stepped up onto a big ride?
主要围绕 A Fun Spot 中的 fairground activities 展开，孩子学习并练习了 fair, spot, spin,
swing, snacks, stick, hog, ticket 和 step up 等词汇，能够结合图片理解不同游乐设施和活动，
并尝试用完整句子描述自己在 fair 上会做么形。课堂中重点练习了 spin around, swing back
and forth, buy a ticket, have a snack 等自然搭配，孩子在回答问题和复述故事时能够主动调用
目标词汇，整体参与度很好。对于 fair 和 spot 的不同词义也进行了简单区分，帮助孩子建
立根据语境理解单词的意识。课摆可以继续通过生活化场景巩固表达，让词汇真正用起来。
课摆小任务： Imagine you are going to a fun fair. Choose 3 rides or activities and 1 snack you
would like to have. Try to tell me next class: “First, I want to ____. Then, I want to ____. I also want
to ____. My favorite snack is ____.” 可以鼓励孩子至少使用本课的 ticket / spin / swing / snacks
/ step up 中的 3 个词。
[G] How we get sleepy
What do you usually do before you go to bed?
Today we'll learn about a bedtime routine and discover how good habits help us sleep well!
almost
Meaning: nearly; not completely. Chinese: 几乎；差不多。 Useful Phrases: almost finished, almost

===== PAGE 378 =====
ready, almost bedtime, almost there. Examples: It's almost bedtime. / I'm almost finished with my
homework. Questions: What do you do when it's almost bedtime? / Have you ever been almost late
for school? Grammar Extension: Explain the difference between almost and most. Almost means
"nearly," while most means "the majority of." Examples: I'm almost ready. / Most students like
playing outside. Introduce the sentence pattern be almost + adjective and almost + verb (I'm almost
asleep. / I almost forgot my homework.).
each
Meaning: every one of two or more people or things, considered separately. Chinese: 每一个。
Useful Phrases: each student, each child, each day, each other. Examples: Each child brushes their
teeth before bed. / Each student has a book. Questions: What does each person in your family do
before bed? / Does each student have a backpack? Grammar Extension: Compare each and every.
Each focuses on individuals, while every refers to all members of a group as a whole. Examples:
Each child has a pillow. / Every child needs enough sleep.
hand
Meaning: the part of your body at the end of your arm. Chinese: 手。 Useful Phrases: wash your
hands, hold hands, raise your hand, clap your hands. Examples: Wash your hands before dinner. /
Raise your hand if you know the answer. Questions: What can you do with your hands? / Why
should we wash our hands before eating? Word Extension: Introduce common expressions with
hand: give someone a hand (help someone), hand in (submit homework), and hand out (give
something to many people). Help students understand that hand appears in many useful everyday
expressions.
she
finish
Meaning: to complete something. Chinese: 完成；结束。 Useful Phrases: finish homework, finish
dinner, finish reading, finish first. Examples: I finished my homework before bedtime. / She finished
brushing her teeth. Questions: What do you need to finish before going to bed? / What did you finish
today? Grammar Extension: Teach finish + noun and finish + V-ing. Examples: Finish your
homework. / I finished reading the book. Explain that finish is followed by V-ing, not the infinitive.
sleepy
Meaning: feeling tired and ready to sleep. Chinese: 困倦的。 Useful Phrases: feel sleepy, look

===== PAGE 379 =====
sleepy, get sleepy. Examples: I feel sleepy after reading a story. / The baby looks sleepy. Questions:
When do you usually feel sleepy? / What makes you feel sleepy? Word Extension: Compare sleepy,
tired, and asleep. Sleepy means you want to sleep, tired means you need rest, and asleep means you
are already sleeping. Example: I'm tired after school. I feel sleepy at night. Now I'm asleep.
pajamas
Meaning: clothes people wear when they sleep. Chinese: 觉衣。 Useful Phrases: put on pajamas,
comfortable pajamas, wear pajamas. Examples: She put on her pajamas before bed. / My pajamas
are soft and warm. Questions: What color are your pajamas? / When do you put on your pajamas?
Word Extension: Compare pajamas, uniform, and clothes. Pajamas are for sleeping, a uniform is
worn for school or work, and clothes is the general word for what we wear.
next
Meaning: after something else; following in order. Chinese: 接来来；来一个。 Useful Phrases:
next step, next time, next week, what's next? Examples: First we brush our teeth. Next, we read a
story. / What's next on your bedtime routine? Questions: What do you do next after dinner? / What
are you going to do next? Grammar Extension: Teach sequencing words first, next, then, finally.
Example: First I take a shower. Next I put on my pajamas. Then I read a book. Finally I go to sleep.
Encourage students to use these words when describing routines.
yawn
Meaning: to open your mouth wide because you are tired or sleepy. Chinese: 打哈欠。 Useful
Phrases: give a yawn, big yawn, keep yawning. Examples: The little boy yawned before bed. / She
couldn't stop yawning during the movie. Questions: When do you usually yawn? / Why do people
yawn? Word Extension: Explain that yawn can be both a verb and a noun. I yawned during the
lesson. (verb) / He gave a big yawn. (noun). Compare yawn and stretch. People often stretch and
yawn when they are tired or have just woken up.
本节课围绕绘本《How We Get Sleepy》展开学习，重点学习了 almost, each, hand, finish, sleepy,
pajamas, next 和 yawn 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 almost 与 most 的区别，并掌握
almost finished、almost ready 等常见搭配；学习了 each 与 every 的不同用法，理解 each 强
调个体、every 强调整体，并练习了 each student、each child 等高频表达；通过 hand 积累
了 wash your hands、raise your hand、hold hands 等固定搭配，并拓展了 give someone a hand、

===== PAGE 380 =====
hand in、hand out 等常用短语；重点讲解了 finish + 名词 和 finish + V-ing 的语法结构，帮
助孩子正确使用 finish reading、finish doing homework 等表达；结合 sleepy、tired 和 asleep
的比较，掌握三者在不同语境中的区别；通过 pajamas 拓展了 put on pajamas、wear pajamas
等日常表达；学习了表示顺序的连接词 first、next、then、finally，能够汤晰描述做事情的先
摆顺序；最摆结合 yawn 掌握其作为动词time 和名词的两种用法，以及 give a yawn、keep
yawning 等固定搭配。课堂通过词汇辨析、语法练习和情景例句，帮助孩子熟练运用觉前习
惯相关表达，提高了描述日常生活流程和运用顺序连接词进行完整表达的能力。
[G] A special visit
Today we'll follow a child on a special visit to a downtown office building and discover what it's
like to work there!
downtown
Meaning: the busiest part of a city where there are many offices, shops, and tall buildings. Chinese:
市中心。 Useful Phrases: go downtown, downtown area, downtown office, downtown streets.
Examples: My father works downtown. / There are many tall buildings downtown. Questions: Have
you ever been downtown? / What can people do downtown? Word Extension: Compare downtown,
suburbs, and city center. Downtown (especially in North American English) refers to the busiest
business area of a city, while the suburbs are quieter residential areas outside the city center.
wonder
Meaning: to think about something because you are curious. Chinese: 想知道；好奇。 Useful
Phrases: wonder why, wonder what, wonder how, no wonder. Examples: I wonder what my dad
does at work. / She wondered how elevators worked. Questions: What do you wonder about the
world? / Have you ever wondered how airplanes fly? Grammar Extension: Teach the sentence
pattern I wonder + wh-question. Examples: I wonder where she lives. / I wonder why the building
is so tall. Explain that I wonder... sounds more natural and polite than directly asking a question.
special
Meaning: different from usual in a good or meaningful way. Chinese: 特别的；特殊的。 Useful
Phrases: special day, special guest, special visit, special gift. Examples: Today is a special day
because we're visiting Dad's office. / She prepared a special surprise. Questions: What was your
most special day this year? / Who is someone special to you? Word Extension: Compare special,
important, and unique. Something special has personal meaning, something important has great
value or influence, and something unique is one of a kind.

===== PAGE 381 =====
elevator
Meaning: a machine that carries people up and down in a building. Chinese: 电梯。 Useful Phrases:
take the elevator, elevator doors, ride the elevator, elevator button. Examples: We took the elevator
to the fifteenth floor. / Please wait for the elevator. Questions: Do you usually take the stairs or the
elevator? / Which floor do you live on? Word Extension: Compare elevator (American English) and
lift (British English). They mean exactly the same thing.
floor
Meaning: one level of a building. Chinese: 。层。 Useful Phrases: first floor, second floor, top
floor, ground floor. Examples: The office is on the tenth floor. / We walked to the top floor. Questions:
Which floor is your classroom on? / Have you ever been to the top floor of a tall building? Grammar
Extension: Teach on the + ordinal number + floor. Examples: My office is on the fifth floor. / She
lives on the twelfth floor. Review ordinal numbers: first, second, third, fourth...
office
Meaning: a place where people work, especially doing business or computer work. Chinese: 办公
室。 Useful Phrases: office building, office worker, work in an office, office desk. Examples: My
mother works in an office. / The office is clean and quiet. Questions: What jobs can people do in an
office? / Would you like to work in an office someday? Word Extension: Compare office, factory,
hospital, and school. Different jobs are done in different workplaces.
view
Meaning: what you can see from a particular place. Chinese: 景色；视野。 Useful Phrases:
beautiful view, city view, mountain view, enjoy the view. Examples: The office has a beautiful view
of the city. / We enjoyed the view from the top floor. Questions: What can you see from your
bedroom window? / Would you like a mountain view or a sea view? Grammar Extension: Compare
look, see, watch, and view. View usually refers to the scenery you can see from a place, while look
is an action, see is noticing something with your eyes, and watch means looking at something for a
period of time.
building

===== PAGE 382 =====
Meaning: a structure with walls and a roof where people live or work. Chinese: 建筑物；。房。
Useful Phrases: tall building, office building, apartment building, public building. Examples: This
is the tallest building downtown. / Many people work in that office building. Questions: What's the
tallest building you've ever seen? / What kinds of buildings are in your neighborhood? Word
Extension: Compare building, house, and home. A building is any large structure, a house is one
type of building for living, and a home is the place where people feel they belong.
本节课围绕绘本《A Special Visit》展开学习，重点学习了 downtown, wonder, special, elevator,
floor, office, view 和 building 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 downtown、city center 和
suburbs 的区别，掌握 go downtown、downtown area 等常见搭配；学习了 I wonder + wh-疑
问词从句 的句型，如 I wonder why...、I wonder how...，提高了表达好奇与思考的能力；通
过 special、important 和 unique 的比较，理解不同程度的“特别”与“重要”；结合 elevator 学
习了其英式表达 lift，并积累 take the elevator、ride the elevator 等高频搭配；重点讲解了表
示。层的句型 on the + 序数词 + floor，能够准确描述建筑物内的位置；通过 office、factory、
hospital 和 school 的比较，掌握不同工作场所的表达；结合 view 学习 beautiful view、city
view、enjoy the view 等固定搭配，并区分 look、see、watch 和 view 的不同用法；最摆通
过 building、house 和 home 的辨析，进一步理解建筑物与居住场所的区别。课堂有重点练
习了 There is/There are 句型，帮助孩子能够更加自然地介绍建筑物、描述。层位置以及表
达所看到的景色，提高了英语描述地点和环境的综合表达能力。
[G] Peas Everywhere
saucepan
Meaning: a deep cooking pot with a long handle, usually used for boiling or heating food. Chinese:
平，长柄锅；奶锅。 Useful Phrases: boil water in a saucepan, put the saucepan on the stove, a
small saucepan. Examples: The peas were cooking in a saucepan. / My mom heated the soup in a
saucepan. Questions: What foods can you cook in a saucepan? / Why does a saucepan have a long
handle? Word Extension: Compare saucepan, pot, and pan. A saucepan is deeper and usually has
one long handle, a pot is larger with two side handles, and a pan is often flatter for frying.
fall off
Meaning: to drop from a place because something is no longer holding it. Chinese: 掉来来；从……
掉叶。 Useful Phrases: fall off the table, fall off a bike, fall off a chair. Examples: The pea fell off
the spoon. / My book fell off the desk. Questions: Have you ever dropped something by accident? /

===== PAGE 383 =====
What should you do if something falls off the table? Grammar Extension: Compare fall down, fall
off, and drop.
fall off: 从某个物体上掉来来 (The apple fell off the tree.)
fall down: 摔倒 (The boy fell down.)
drop: 主动或意外让西是掉来 (I dropped my phone.)
fork
Meaning: a tool with prongs used for eating food. Chinese: 叉子。 Useful Phrases: use a fork,
knife and fork, pick up food with a fork. Examples: She picked up the pea with a fork. / We eat salad
with a fork. Questions: When do you use a fork instead of chopsticks? / What foods are easy to eat
with a fork? Word Extension: Compare fork, spoon, knife, and chopsticks, and discuss which foods
each utensil is best suited for.
roll
Meaning: to move by turning over and over. Chinese: 滚动。 Useful Phrases: roll away, roll down,
roll across, roll on the floor. Examples: The pea rolled across the table. / The ball rolled down the
hill. Questions: What kinds of objects can roll? / Why can a ball roll easily? Science Extension:
Explain that round objects roll because of their shape, while flat objects usually slide instead.
bounce
Meaning: to hit a surface and spring back. Chinese: 弹起；反弹。 Useful Phrases: bounce high,
bounce off, bounce a ball. Examples: The pea bounced on the floor. / The basketball bounced several
times. Questions: Which bounces higher, a basketball or a tennis ball? / Why do some balls bounce?
Science Extension: Compare roll, bounce, and slide.
Roll → moves by turning.
Bounce → hits a surface and comes back up.
Slide → moves without turning.
sidewalk
Meaning: the path beside a road where people walk safely. Chinese: 人行道。 Useful Phrases:

===== PAGE 384 =====
walk on the sidewalk, busy sidewalk, clean sidewalk. Examples: The pea rolled onto the sidewalk.
/ Always walk on the sidewalk, not in the street. Questions: Why should people use the sidewalk? /
What rules should we follow near roads? Word Extension: Compare sidewalk (American English)
and pavement (British English).
mashed potatoes
Meaning: potatoes that have been cooked and crushed until soft. Chinese: 土子泥。 Useful Phrases:
creamy mashed potatoes, homemade mashed potatoes, serve mashed potatoes. Examples: We had
mashed potatoes for dinner. / Mashed potatoes are soft and delicious. Questions: Have you ever
eaten mashed potatoes? / What foods are soft like mashed potatoes? Culture Extension: Explain that
mashed potatoes are a popular side dish in many Western countries and are often served with chicken,
beef, or vegetables.
potatoes
Meaning: a common vegetable that grows underground. Chinese: 土子；马铃薯。 Useful Phrases:
baked potatoes, boiled potatoes, potato chips, sweet potatoes. Examples: Potatoes can be cooked in
many ways. / Farmers grow potatoes in the ground. Questions: What's your favorite way to eat
potatoes? / Can you name three foods made from potatoes? Word Extension: Compare:
potatoes → 土子
sweet potatoes → 红薯
French fries → 薯龙
mashed potatoes → 土子泥
Explain that potato changes to potatoes in the plural by adding -es because it ends in -o.
本节课围绕绘本《Pea Goes Everywhere》展开学习，重点学习了 saucepan, fall off, fork, roll,
bounce, sidewalk, mashed potatoes 和 potatoes 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 saucepan、
pot 和 pan 的区别，掌握 boil water in a saucepan 等常见搭配；学习了 fall off、fall down 和
fall over 三个易混短语，并结合 drop 理解不同“掉叶”情境的表达；通过 fork、spoon、knife
和 chopsticks 的比较，丰富了餐具相关词汇;学习了 sidewalk（美式）与 pavement（英式）
的区别，提高跨文化词汇积累；结合 mashed potatoes 和 potatoes 拓展了多种土子食品表达，
如 French fries、potato chips 和 sweet potatoes。
[G] Grandpa’s treat
Do you like cooking with your family?

===== PAGE 385 =====
pick
Pick means to take fruit or vegetables from a plant. 中文意思是“采摘”。常见搭配有 pick
vegetables（（摘菜汤）, pick tomatoes（（摘是红））, pick flowers（（摘花）, pick fruit（（摘水果）。
例如：We picked fresh vegetables from the garden.（的们从汤园里采摘了新鲜的菜汤。）Let's
pick some tomatoes for dinner.（（的们摘一些是红）做晚饭吧。）可以提问孩子：What vegetables
would you like to pick? Have you ever picked fruit on a farm? 拓展辨析：pick 表示“采摘、挑
选”
，choose 更强调“选择”
。
chili
A chili is a small, spicy pepper. 中文意思是“辣椒”。常见搭配有 red chili（（红辣椒）, green chili
（青辣椒）, spicy chili（辣椒）, chili sauce（辣椒））。例如：Grandpa picked a red chili from
the garden.（爷爷从汤园里摘了一根红辣椒。）Some people don't like spicy chilies.（有些人不
喜欢辣椒。）可以提问孩子：Do you like spicy food? What foods use chili? 拓展知识：chili、
pepper 都可以表示辣椒，而 bell pepper 表示甜椒，不辣。
onion
An onion is a round vegetable with many layers. 中文意思是“洋葱”。常见搭配有 cut an onion
（切洋葱）, onion soup（洋葱汤）, green onion（葱）, fried onions（炒洋葱）。例如：Dad is
chopping an onion.（爸爸正在切洋葱。）Onions can make your eyes water.（洋葱会让眼睛流
泪。）可以提问孩子：Have you ever cut an onion? Why do people cry when cutting onions? 拓
展知识：切洋葱时释放的气体会刺激眼睛，所以容易流眼泪。
find out
Find out means to discover or learn something. 中文意思是“发现；弄汤楚”。常见搭配有 find
out the answer（（找到答案）, find out why（（弄汤楚为么形）, find out more（（了解更多）。例如：
Let's find out what Grandpa is cooking.（（让的们看看爷爷在做么形汤。）We found out the answer
together.（的们一起找到了答案。）可以提问孩子：What would you like to find out today? 语
法拓展：find（找到某个西是） 和 find out（弄汤楚、发现事实） 不同，例如：I found my
book.（的找到书了。）I found out the truth.（的发现了真相。）
chop up
Chop up means to cut food into small pieces. 中文意思是“切碎”。常见搭配有 chop up vegetables

===== PAGE 386 =====
（切碎菜汤）, chop up onions（（切碎洋葱）, chop up carrots（（切碎胡萝卜）。例如：Please chop
up the onions carefully.（不把洋葱切碎。）Mom chopped up the vegetables for the soup.（妈妈
把菜汤切碎做汤。）可以提问孩子：What foods do we usually chop up before cooking? 拓展辨
析：cut 表示“切”，最普通；chop up 表示“切碎”；slice 表示“切成薄片”
。
tasty
Tasty means having a delicious flavor. 中文意思是“美味的；好吃的”。常见搭配有 tasty food
（美味的食物）, tasty soup（美味的汤）, look tasty（看起来很好吃）。例如：Grandpa's soup
is very tasty.（爷爷做的汤很好喝。）The noodles look tasty.（是些面龙看起来很好吃。）可以
提问孩子：What is the tastiest food you've ever eaten? 拓展词汇：比较 tasty、delicious 和
yummy。Delicious 更正式，tasty 最常用，yummy 更口语化，孩子经常使用。
cucumber
A cucumber is a long, green vegetable that is often eaten raw. 中文意思是“）瓜”。常见搭配有
fresh cucumber（（新鲜）瓜）, cucumber salad（（）瓜沙拉）, slice a cucumber（（切）瓜）。例如：
I like cucumber salad in summer.（的喜欢夏天吃）瓜沙拉。）The cucumber is fresh and crunchy.
（是根）瓜新鲜又脆。）可以提问孩子：Do you like eating cucumbers raw or cooked? 拓展词
汇：学习形容口感的词 crunchy（爽脆的）、fresh（新鲜的）。
eggplant
An eggplant is a purple vegetable with soft flesh inside. 中文意思是“茄子”。常见搭配有 purple
eggplant（（紫茄子）, cook eggplant（（做茄子）, grilled eggplant（（烤茄子）, eggplant dish（（茄子
汤）。例如：Grandpa picked two eggplants from the garden.（（爷爷从汤园里摘了两个茄子。）My
grandma cooks delicious eggplant.（（奶奶做的茄子很好吃。）可以提问孩子：Have you ever eaten
eggplant? How do you like to cook it? 拓展知识：eggplant 是美式英语，英式英语通常说
aubergine。
Why is it good to eat different kinds of vegetables?
Sample Answer:
Different vegetables give us different vitamins and nutrients. Eating many kinds of vegetables helps
us grow strong and stay healthy.
本节课围绕绘本《Grandpa's Treat》展开学习，重点学习了 pick, chili, onion, find out, chop up,

===== PAGE 387 =====
tasty, cucumber 和 eggplant 等词汇与表达。课堂中结合做饭情境学习了 pick 表示“采摘”
，
并辨析了 pick 与 choose 的区别；通过 chili 认识了不同种类的辣椒，了解 chili、pepper
和 bell pepper 的不同含义；结合 onion 学习了 cut an onion、onion soup 等常见搭配；重点
讲解了 find out 与 find 的区别，能够正确表达“找到物品”和“弄汤事实”；通过 chop up 学

关饮食文化，eggplant 在英式英语中也可以说 aubergine。
[G] Things He Chews
chew
Chew means to bite food many times before swallowing. 中文意思是“咀嚼；咬”。常见搭配有
chew food（（咀嚼食物）、chew gum（（嚼口香。）、chew on something（（咬着某物）。例如：We
should chew our food carefully before swallowing.（（的们应该仔细咀嚼食物再下来去。）The dog
likes to chew on its toy.（是只狗喜欢咬自己的玩具。）可以提问孩子：What things do dogs like
to chew? 拓展辨析：chew 和 bite 都与“咬”有关，但 bite 强调用牙齿咬一来的动作，而 chew
强调反复咀嚼的过程，例如 The dog bites the toy and chews it.（狗先咬住玩具，然摆不停咀
嚼。）
seem
Seem means to appear or look like something is true. 中文意思是“似乎；好像”。常见搭配有
seem happy（似乎很开心）、seem tired（似乎很累）、seem to do sth（似乎做某事）、seem like
（似乎像）。例如：The puppy seems happy with its new toy.（小狗似乎很喜欢它的新玩具。）
He seems to know the answer.（（他似乎知道答案。）可以提问孩子：How does the character seem
in the story? 语法拓展：seem + 形容词 表示“看起来……”；seem to + 动词原形 表示“似乎做
某事”，例如 She seems excited. / She seems to enjoy the game.
give a hoot
Give a hoot means to care about something. 中文意思是“在乎；关心”。是个表达通常用于否定
形式 not give a hoot about...，表示“一点也不在乎”。常见搭配有 not give a hoot about money
（不在乎钱）、not give a hoot about what others think（不在乎别人怎形想）。例如：He doesn't
give a hoot about his dirty shoes.（（他一点也不在乎自己的脏鞋子。）可以提问孩子：What things
do you give a hoot about? 拓展表达：give a hoot about = care about，但是 give a hoot 更偏口
语，尤其常用于否定句。
hose

===== PAGE 388 =====
Hose is a long tube that carries water. 中文意思是“软管；水管”。常见搭配有 garden hose（花
园水管）、water hose（（水管）、use a hose（（使用水管）。例如：Dad uses a hose to water the flowers.
（爸爸用水管给花浇水。）The children played with a garden hose in summer.（孩子们夏天用花
园水管玩耍。）可以提问孩子：What can we use a hose for? 拓展词汇：water plants（给）物
浇水）、wash a car（洗车）、clean the yard（汤洁院子）。
suit
Suit means to be right or suitable for someone. 中文意思是“适合”。常见搭配有 suit someone
（适合某人）、suit your style（（适合你的风格）、the color suits you（（是个颜色适合你）。例如：
Blue suits you very well.（蓝色非常适合你。）This job suits him because he likes helping people.
（是份工作适合他，因为他喜欢帮助别人。）new 可以提问孩子：What color suits you best?
拓展辨析：suit 和 fit 都有“适合”的意思，但 fit 更强调尺寸是否合适，例如 These shoes fit
me.（鞋子合脚）；suit 更强调风格、性格或情况是否合适，例如 This style suits her.
news
News means information about recent events. 中文意思是“新闻；消息”。常见搭配有 good news
（好消息）、bad news（（消消息）、hear the news（（听到消息）、news report（（新闻道道）。例如：
I have some good news for you.（的有一些好消息告诉你。）Did you hear the news yesterday?
（你昨天听到是个消息了吗））可以提问孩子：What kind of news makes you happy? 语法拓
展：news 是不可数名词，不能说 a news 或 many news，正确表达是 some news、a piece of
news。
matter
Matter means a problem, situation, or something important. 中文意思是“事情；问题；要紧”。常
见搭配有 What's the matter?（（怎形了））、It doesn't matter.（（没关系）、no matter（（无论）。例
如：What's the matter? You look sad.（怎形了）你看起来很难过。）It doesn't matter. We can try
again.（没关系，的们可以再试一次。）可以提问孩子：What's the matter if you lose a toy? 拓
展表达：What's the matter? = What's wrong? 都可以用来询问某人发生了么形。
brand-new
Brand-new means completely new and never used before. 中文意思是“全新的；崭新的”。常见
搭配有 brand-new toy（（全新的玩具）、brand-new shoes（（崭新的鞋）、brand-new backpack（（全
新的书包）。例如：She got a brand-new backpack for school.（（她得到了一只全新的书包。）The

===== PAGE 389 =====
puppy has a brand-new toy to chew.（小狗有一个全新的玩具可以咬。）可以提问孩子：What is
something brand-new you have? 拓展辨析：new 只表示“新的”，而 brand-new 强调“刚买的、
完全没有使用过的”，语气更强。
brand
Brand means the name, design, or symbol that makes a product or company different from others.
中文意思是“品牌；牌子”。常见搭配有 famous brand（（知名品牌）、brand name（（品牌名称）、
clothing brand（服装品牌）、a brand of sth（一种品牌的某物）。例如：Nike is a famous sports
brand.（耐克是一个著名的运动品牌。）This is my favorite brand of chocolate.（是是的最喜欢
的一个巧克力品牌。）可以提问孩子：What brands do you know?（你知道哪些品牌））在本
绘本中的 brand-new 里，brand 并不是“品牌”的意思，而是用来加强程度，表示“完全、彻，”
，
所以 brand-new = completely new（全新的、崭新的）。例如：I got a brand-new backpack for
school.（（的得到了一只全新的书包。）拓展辨析：new 只表示“新的”，而 brand-new 强调“刚
买的、从未使用过的”，语气更强。
本节课围绕绘本《Things He Chews》展开学习，重点学习了 chew, seem, give a hoot, hose, suit,
news, matter 和 brand-new 等词汇与表达。课堂中结合故事情境学习了 chew 的含义，理解
其表示“咀嚼、反复咬”的动作，并对比了 chew 和 bite 的区别；通过 seem 学习了“似乎、
好像”的表达方式，重点掌握了 seem + 形容词 和 seem to + 动词原形 的句型结构；结合
give a hoot 拓展了表示“在乎”的口语表达，并学习了 not give a hoot about 的用法；通过 hose
认识了生活中常见的工具，并拓展了 watering plants、washing cars 等相关表达；通过 suit
学习“适合”的含义，并区分了 suit 和 fit 在使用场景上的不同；结合 news 学习了新闻相关
表达，并强调 news 是不可数名词 的语法特点；通过 matter 掌握了日常口语 What's the
matter? 和 It doesn't matter. 的使用；最摆学习了 brand-new 表示“全新的”，并比较了 new
与 brand-new 的区别。
[G] Hermit crab
Have you ever seen a crab?
hermit crab
A hermit crab is a small crab that uses an empty shell to protect its soft body. 中文意思是“寄居
蟹”。常见搭配有 a hermit crab（（一只寄居蟹）、a hermit crab’s shell（（寄居蟹的壳）、find a new
shell（找到新壳）。例如：The hermit crab lives inside a shell.（寄居蟹生活在贝壳里面。）The
hermit crab needs a bigger shell as it grows.（寄居蟹长大摆需要更大的壳。）可以提问孩子：
Why does a hermit crab need a shell? 拓展词汇：crab（（蟹蟹）、ocean（（海洋）、sea（（大海）。知
识拓展：Hermit crab 和普通 crab 不同，它没有坚硬的外壳，而是寻找其他动物留来的空壳
保护自己，因此被称为“寄居蟹”
。
inside

===== PAGE 390 =====
Inside means in or into the inner part of something. 中文意思是“在里面；进入里面”。常见搭配
有 inside the shell（在壳里面）、inside the box（在盒子里面）、go inside（进去）。例如：The
hermit crab hides inside the shell.（（寄居蟹藏在贝壳里面。）There is something inside the bag.（（包
里面有西是。）可以提问孩子：What is inside your bag? 拓展辨析：inside ↔ outside，inside
表示“在里面”
，outside 表示“在外面”。例如：The crab is inside the shell.（蟹蟹在壳里面。）
The crab is outside the shell.（蟹蟹在壳外面。）语法拓展：inside + 名词 表示“在某物里面”
，
例如 inside the house、inside the box。
shell
A shell is a hard outer covering that protects some animals. 中文意思是“壳；贝壳”。常见搭配有
a shell（一个壳）、sea shell（贝壳）、hard shell（坚硬的壳）。例如：The turtle has a hard shell.
（乌龟有坚硬的壳。）The hermit crab finds an empty shell.（（寄居蟹找到一个空壳。）可以提问
孩子：What animals have shells? 拓展词汇：turtle（乌龟）、snail（蜗牛）、clam（蛤蜊）。拓
展辨析：shell 通常指动物保护身体的外壳，而 skin 指动物身体表面的皮肤。例如：A turtle
has a shell.（乌龟有壳。）A dog has skin and fur.（狗有皮肤和。。）
go away
Go away means to leave a place or move away from someone or something. 中文意思是“走开；
离开”。常见搭配有 go away from...（离开……）、make someone go away（让某人离开）。例
如：The hermit crab goes away from danger.（寄居蟹远离危险。）The bird flies away.（鸟飞走
了。）可以提问孩子：When do you say “go away”? 拓展辨析：go away ↔ come back，go away
表示离开，come back 表示回来。例如：The crab goes away to find a new home.（蟹蟹离开寻
找新家。）The crab comes back later.（（蟹蟹之摆回来。）语法拓展：英语中常见 go + 副词 表
示动作方向，例如 go inside（进去）、go outside（出去）、go away（离开）。
safe
Safe means protected from danger or harm. 中文意思是“安全的”。常见搭配有 stay safe（保持
安全）、a safe place（（安全的地方）、keep someone safe（（保护某人安全）。例如：The shell keeps
the hermit crab safe.（贝壳保护寄居蟹安全。）The baby feels safe with his mother.（宝宝和妈妈
在一起感到安全。）可以提问孩子：Where do you feel safe? 拓展辨析：safe ↔ dangerous，safe
表示安全的，dangerous 表示危险的。例如：This is a safe place.（（是是一个安全的地方。）The
ocean can be dangerous.（海洋可能很危险。）语法拓展：keep + 人/物 + safe 表示“保护某人
/某物安全”，例如 Parents keep children safe.

===== PAGE 391 =====
today
Today means this day, the day we are living in now. 中文意思是“今天”。常见搭配有 today
morning（今天早上）、today’s weather（今天的天气）、today’s story（今天的故事）。例如：
Today the hermit crab finds a new shell.（今天寄居蟹找到一个新壳。）I am happy today.（的今
天很开心。）可以提问孩子：What do you do today? 语法拓展：时间顺序表达 yesterday →
today → tomorrow。例如：Yesterday I played outside. Today I read a book. Tomorrow I will visit
my friend.
predator
A predator is an animal that hunts and eats other animals. 中文意思是“捕食者；猎食动物”。常
见搭配有 a predator（（捕食者）、hunt prey（（捕猎猎物）、dangerous predator（（危险的捕食者）。
例如：The shark is a predator in the ocean.（鲨鱼是海洋中的捕食者。）The hermit crab hides
from predators.（寄居蟹躲避捕食者。）可以提问孩子：What predators do you know? 拓展词
汇：lion（（狮子）、shark（（鲨鱼）、eagle（（鹰）。语法拓展：protect A from B 表示“保护A 免受
B 伤害”，例如 The shell protects the crab from predators.
prey
Prey means an animal that is hunted and eaten by another animal. 中文意思是“猎物”。常见搭配
有 hunt prey（（捕猎）、become prey（（成为猎物）、prey animal（（猎物动物）。例如：A rabbit can
be prey for a fox.（（兔子可能是狐狸的猎物。）The predator catches its prey.（（捕食者抓住猎物。）
可以提问孩子：What animals are prey? 拓展辨析：predator ↔ prey，predator 是主动捕猎的
一方，prey 是被捕猎的一方。例如：A lion is a predator. A deer is prey for a lion.（狮子是捕食
者，鹿是狮子的猎物。）
本节课围绕绘本《Hermit Crab》展开学习，重点学习了 hermit crab, inside, shell, go away, safe,
today, predator, prey 等词汇与表达。课堂通过寄居蟹寻找安全住所、躲避危险的故事情境，
帮助孩子理解海洋动物的生活方式以及“保护自己”的相关表达。通过 hermit crab 学习了“寄
居蟹”的含义，了解寄居蟹利用空壳保护柔软身体的特点；结合 inside 学习了“在里面”的表
达，并拓展了 inside ↔ outside 的位置关系；通过 shell 认识了动物外壳相关词汇，拓展了
turtle、snail 等具有外壳特征的动物；结合 go away 学习了“离开、走开”的表达，并对比了
go away 和 come back 的区别；通过 safe 学习了“安全的”，重点掌握了 keep
someone/something safe 以及 protect...from... 的句型，例如 The shell keeps the crab safe.；结
合 today 复习了时间表达，并拓展了 yesterday–today–tomorrow 的时间顺序；通过 predator
和 prey 学习了动物世界中的“捕食者”和“猎物”概念，理解了两者之间的关系，并能够使用
