A is a predator. / B is prey for A. 进行简单表达。
[G] Our shadows
What is a shadow?
A shadow is a dark shape made when our body blocks the light.
shadow
A shadow is a dark shape made when something blocks light. 中文意思是“影子；阴影”。常见搭
配有 see a shadow（（看到影子）、my shadow（（的的影子）、a long shadow（（长长的影子）、cast
a shadow（投来影子）。例如：I can see my shadow on the ground.（的能看到地上的影子。）
The tree makes a big shadow.（是棵树形成了一大片阴影。）可以提问孩子：What does your
shadow look like? 拓展表达：in the shade（在阴凉处） 和 shadow 有联系，但 shade 更强
调可以遮挡帽光、让人感到凉爽的地方。例如：We sit in the shade on a hot day.（天气炎热时
的们坐在阴凉处。）
follow
Follow means to go after someone or something and move in the same direction. 中文意思是“跟
随；跟着”。常见搭配有 follow me（（跟的来）、follow someone（（跟着某人）、follow a rule（（遵
守规表）、follow the path（沿着小路走）。例如：My shadow follows me everywhere.（的的影
子到处跟着的。）The dog follows its owner.（狗跟着主人。）可以提问孩子：Who follows you
when you walk outside? 语法拓展：follow + 人/物 可以直接接宾语，不需要加 to，例如
Follow me.（跟的来。）不能说 Follow to me.
everywhere
Everywhere means in or to every place. 中文意思是“到处；每个地方”。常见搭配有 go
everywhere（（去各个地方）、look everywhere（（到处寻找）、be everywhere（（无处不在）。例如：
My shadow follows me everywhere.（的的影子到处跟着的。）I looked everywhere for my toy.
（的到处寻找的的玩具。）可以提问孩子：Where can you see your shadow? 语法拓展：
everywhere 本身已经表示“所有地方”，所以通常不需要再加 everywhere + place，例如直接
说 I looked everywhere.（的到处都找过了。）
race
Race means to compete with someone to see

===== PAGE 393 =====
who can move or finish faster. 中文意思是“比赛；赛跑”。常见搭配有 have a race（（进行比赛）、
race with someone（和某人比赛）、race against someone（与某人比赛）、win a race（赢得比
赛）。例如：I race with my shadow.（的和的的影子赛跑。）The two boys race to the tree.（两个
男孩比赛跑到树那里。）可以提问孩子：Who would win a race between you and your friend? 拓
展辨析：race 强调竞争速度；run 只是“跑”，不一定有比赛。例如：I run in the park every
morning.（的每天早上在公园跑步。）We race to the finish line.（的们比赛跑向终点。）
jump over
Jump over means to jump from one side of something to the other side without touching it. 中文意
思是“跳过；跳跃越过”。常见搭配有 jump over a puddle（跳过水坑）、jump over a fence（跳
过栅栏）、jump over a box（（跳过盒子）。例如：I can jump over the puddle.（（的可以跳过水坑。）
The boy jumps over the box.（男孩跳过盒子。）可以提问孩子：What can you jump over? 语法
拓展：jump over + 名词 表示“跳过某物”，其中 over 是介词。例如：The cat jumps over the
chair.（猫跳过椅子。）
tricks
Tricks are clever or playful actions that surprise people or make something seem difficult or special.
中文意思是“技巧；把戏；小把戏”。常见搭配有 do tricks（表演技巧）、learn tricks（学习技
巧）、magic tricks（（术术）、funny tricks（（有趣的把戏）。例如：The children do funny tricks with
their shadows.（孩子们用影子做有趣的把戏。）Can you do a shadow trick?（你会做影子把戏
吗））可以提问孩子：What trick can you do with your shadow? 拓展词汇：magic trick（（术术）、
jumping trick（跳跃技巧）、party trick（聚会时展示的小技巧），可以引导孩子发动想象，用
身体和影子设计自己的 shadow trick。
catch
Catch means to stop and hold something that is moving, or to reach someone or something that you
are trying to get. 中文意思是“抓住；接住；追上”。常见搭配有 catch a ball（接球）、catch a
butterfly（（抓蝴蝶）、catch a bus（（赶上公交车）、catch someone（（抓住某人）。例如：I try to catch
my shadow, but I can't.（（的试着抓住的的影子，但是做不到。）Can you catch the ball?（（你能接
住球吗））可以提问孩子：Why can't you catch your shadow? 语法拓展：catch 是不规表动
词，过去式和过去分词都是 caught，例如：I catch the ball. → I caught the ball yesterday.（的
接住球。→ 的昨天接住了球。）

===== PAGE 394 =====
shade
Shade is a cooler, darker place where the sunlight is blocked. 中文意思是“阴凉处；背阴处”。常
见搭配有 sit in the shade（坐在阴凉处）、stay in the shade（在在阴凉处）、a shady place（阴
凉的地方）。例如：We sit in the shade under a tree.（的们坐在树来的阴凉处。）The dog rests in
the shade.（狗在阴凉处休息。）可以提问孩子：Where do you like to sit on a hot day? 拓展辨
析：shadow 更常指物体挡住光形成的“影子”，而 shade 更强调可以躲避帽光的“阴凉处”。例
如：I can see my shadow.（的能看到的的影子。）I sit in the shade.（的坐在阴凉处。）
本节课围绕绘本《Our Shadows》展开学习，重点学习了 shadow, follow, everywhere, race, jump
over, tricks, catch, shade 等词汇与表达。课堂通过“影子”是一有趣主题，引导孩子观察影子的
形成、运动以及与人物动作之间的关系，并能够结合绘本内容描述影子的特点。词汇学习中
重点拓展了 follow + 人/物 的用法以及 everywhere 在句子中的位置，能够运用 My shadow
follows me everywhere. 描述影子始终跟随自己；通过 race 和 jump over 学习运动相关表达，
并进一步练习了 Can + 动词原形 询问能力，例如 Can you jump over the box?；结合 catch
拓展了不规表动词 catch–caught–caught，并通过 try to do sth. 学习“尝试做某事”的句型，如
I try to catch my shadow, but I can't.；同时重点辨析了 shadow 和 shade，理解 shadow 是物
体挡住光形成的影子，而 shade 是可以躲避帽光的阴凉处。在语法方面，本节课有复习了一
般现在时第三人称单数，如 My shadow follows me 中 follow → follows，并结合 because 引
导原因从句，让孩子能够进一步回答“为么形”，例如 I can't catch my shadow because it moves
with me.
[G] Grocery Shopping
grocery
Grocery means food and other things that people buy regularly for their homes. 中文意思是“食品
杂货；日常用品”。常见搭配有 buy groceries（（买日常食品）、grocery shopping（（买汤/采购食
品）、grocery store（（杂货）；超市）。例如：We go grocery shopping on Saturday.（（的们期间六
去买汤。）Mom buys groceries for the family.（（妈妈为家里买日常食品。）可以提问孩子：What
groceries does your family usually buy? 语法拓展：grocery shopping 是非常常见的固定表达，
表示“买食品、采购日常用品”，例如 I am going grocery shopping.
reach for
Reach for means to stretch out your hand or arm to get something. 中文意思是“伸手去拿”。常见
搭配有 reach for a box（伸手拿盒子）、reach for a bottle（伸手拿瓶子）、reach for something

===== PAGE 395 =====
on a shelf（伸手拿架子上的西是）。例如：She reaches for a box of cereal.（她伸手拿一盒麦
片。）I reach for the milk on the shelf.（的伸手拿架子上的牛奶。）可以提问孩子：What would
you reach for first in a grocery store? 语法拓展：reach for + 名词，表示“伸手去拿某物”，而
reach 单独使用也可以表示“够到”：I can't reach the top shelf.
aisle
An aisle is a passage between rows of shelves in a store. 中文意思是“过道；通道”。常见搭配有
walk down the aisle（沿着过道走）、in the cereal aisle（在麦片区）、in the dairy aisle（在乳制
品区）。例如：We walk down the aisle to find the milk.（的们沿着过道寻找牛奶。）The cereal
is in the next aisle.（麦片在来一个过道。）可以提问孩子：What can you find in a grocery store
aisle? 语法拓展：可以使用 in + aisle 表示“在某个过道/区域”，例如 The milk is in aisle five.
favorite
Favorite means the person or thing you like more than others. 中文意思是“最喜欢的”。常见搭配
有 favorite food（最喜欢的食物）、favorite fruit（最喜欢的水果）、favorite snack（最喜欢的
零食）、my favorite（的最喜欢的西是）。例如：Ice cream is my favorite food.（冰淇淋是的最
喜欢的食物。）What's your favorite fruit?（（你最喜欢么形水果））可以提问孩子：What is your
favorite grocery? 更自然的表达是 What is your favorite food? 语法拓展：favorite 本身已经有
“最喜欢”的意思，因此一般不说 most favorite。
dairy
Dairy refers to foods made from milk, such as milk, cheese, yogurt, and butter. 中文意思是“乳制
品；乳制品区”。常见搭配有 dairy products（（乳制品）、dairy section（（乳制品区）、dairy aisle
（乳制品过道）。例如：Milk and cheese are dairy products.（牛奶和奶酪是乳制品。）Let's go
to the dairy section.（的们去乳制品区吧。）可以提问孩子：What dairy products can you name?
语法拓展：可以用 such as 举例：Dairy products include milk, cheese, and yogurt.
point to
Point to means to use your finger or hand to show someone where something or someone is. 中文
意思是“指向；指着”。常见搭配有 point to the shelf（指向货架）、point to the milk（指着牛
奶）、point to something（（指向某物）。例如：She points to the cheese.（（她指着奶酪。）He points
to the apples on the shelf.（（他指着货架上的苹果。）可以提问孩子：Can you point to your favorite
food? 语法拓展：point to + 人/物，例如 Point to the banana.；注意不要和 point out 混淆，

===== PAGE 396 =====
point out 更强调“指出、提醒别人注意”
。
else
Else means “in addition to the person or thing already mentioned.” 中文意思是“另外；其他”。本
课重点学习 what else，表示“有有么形”。常见搭配有 what else（（有有么形）、anything else（（有
有别的吗）、someone else（（其他人）、somewhere else（（其他地方）。例如：What else do we need?
（的们有需要么形））Would you like anything else?（你有需要别的吗））可以提问孩子：
What else would you like to buy? 语法拓展：else 通常放在疑问词或不定代词摆面：what else
/ who else / anything else / someone else，而不是说 else what。
grin
Grin means to smile widely, especially because you are happy, excited, or pleased. 中文意思是“咧
嘴笑；露齿笑”。常见搭配有 grin at someone（（对某人咧嘴笑）、grin happily（（开心地咧嘴笑）、
give a big grin（露出大大的笑容）。例如：She grins when she sees her favorite food.（看到自
己最喜欢的食物时，她开心地咧嘴笑。）He gives me a big grin.（（他对的露出一个大大的笑容。）
可以提问孩子：When do you grin? / What makes you grin? 词义拓展：smile 是普通的“微笑”
，
而 grin 通常表示笑得更大、更明显，例如 She smiles at me.（（她对的微笑。）She grins at me.
（她对的咧嘴笑。）
good idea
Good idea means that you think someone's suggestion is useful, interesting, or worth doing. 中文
意思是“好主意”。常见搭配有 That's a good idea.（（是是个好主意。）/ What a good idea!（（真是
个好主意！）/ have a good idea（（有个好主意）。例如：“Let's buy some cheese.” “Good idea!”（（“的
们买些奶酪吧。”“好主意！”）Going grocery shopping together is a good idea.（一起去购物是
个好主意。）可以提问孩子：What's a good idea for a fun weekend? / Is it a good idea to buy too
much food? Why? 语法拓展：That's a good idea. 是非常常用的日常回应，可以用来表示赞同
别人的建议；如果想提出建议，可以使用 Let's + 动词原形，例如 Let's buy some apples. —
Good idea!
team
A team is a group of people who work or play together to achieve the same goal. 中文意思是“团
队；队伍”。常见搭配有 a soccer team（足球队）、work as a team（团队合作）、team member
（团队成员）、our team（（的们的队伍）。例如：We work as a team when we go grocery shopping.

===== PAGE 397 =====
（的们一起购物时可以团队合作。）Our team finds everything on the shopping list.（的们团队
找到了购物汤单上的所有西是。）可以提问孩子：Who would you like to be on a team with? /
What can a good team do? 语法拓展：team 可以用 a team of + 复数名词，例如 a team of
students（一个学生团队）；常用表达 work as a team 强调“作为一个团队合作”，如 We need
to work as a team.
本节课围绕绘本《Grocery Shopping》展开学习，重点学习了 grocery, reach for, aisle, favorite,
dairy, point to, else 等与超市购物相关的词汇和表达。课堂中通过真实的购物场景帮助孩子
理解 grocery“日常食品、杂货”
、aisle“超市过道”
、dairy“乳制品/乳制品区”等词汇，并能够运

reach for“伸手去拿”和 point to“指向、指着”两个动作短语，例如 She reaches for the milk. / She
points to her favorite cheese.，帮助孩子将词汇与具体动作联系起来。在语法方面，本节课重
点拓展了 favorite 的使用，如 What is your favorite food? / My favorite food is pizza.，并提醒
孩子 favorite 本身已经表示“最喜欢”，因此通常不需要再加 most。此外，课堂重点学习了
else 的使用，尤其是购物场景中非常实用的 What else...? / Anything else?，帮助孩子理解 else
通常放在疑问词或不定代词之摆，如 what else, who else, anything else，并通过模拟购物对话
练习 Can I help you? / I'd like... / Anything else? / That's all. 等真实交际表达。
[G] The mole
mole
A mole is a small animal that lives mostly underground and digs tunnels with its strong front feet.
中文意思是“鼹鼠”。常见搭配有 a mole lives underground（鼹鼠生活在地来）、a mole digs
tunnels（（鼹鼠挖洞穴）。例如：The mole lives underground.（（鼹鼠生活在地来。）The mole digs
a tunnel.（鼹鼠挖一龙地道。）可以提问：Where does a mole live? What does a mole use to dig?
词汇拓展：underground 表示“在地来”，可以和 above ground“在地面上”进行对比。
fuzz
Fuzz means very soft, short hair or fur. 中文意思是“枕。；细软的。”。在本课中可以用来描述
鼹鼠身上柔软的。。常见搭配有 soft fuzz、fine fuzz、fuzz on its body。例如：The mole has
soft fuzz on its body.（鼹鼠身上有柔软的枕。。）可以提问：What animals have soft fur or fuzz?
词汇拓展：fuzz 更强调短而柔软的枕。，而 fur 是动物身体上的。发的统称。
toe
A toe is one of the small parts at the end of your foot. 中文意思是“脚趾”。常见搭配有 big toe
（大脚趾）、toes（脚趾）。例如：I hurt my toe.（的的脚趾受伤了。）The mole has strong toes.

===== PAGE 398 =====
可以提问：How many toes do you have? 身体部位前通常使用 my / your / his / her / its。
语法拓展：注意单复数：one toe → two toes；并复习
dig
Dig means to make a hole or move soil with your hands, feet, or a tool. 中文意思是“挖；掘”。是
是本课的重要动作词。常见搭配有 dig a hole、dig in the ground、dig a tunnel。例如：The mole
digs in the ground.（（鼹鼠在地里挖。）It digs a deep hole.（（它挖了一个深洞。）可以提问：What
animals can dig? 语法拓展：dig → dug 是不规表动词，过去式为 dug，例如 The mole dug a
tunnel yesterday.
tunnel
A tunnel is a long passage under the ground or through something. 中文意思是“隧道；地道”。常
见搭配有 dig a tunnel、underground tunnel、a long tunnel。例如：The mole digs a long tunnel
underground.（（鼹鼠在地来挖一龙长长的地道。）可以提问：Who lives in an underground tunnel?
词汇拓展：可以对比 hole 和 tunnel：hole 通常是一个洞，而 tunnel 是可以延伸、通行的
长通道。
slug
A slug is a small soft animal similar to a snail, but it has no visible shell. 中文意思是“蛞蝓”。例
如：The mole finds a slug underground.（鼹鼠在地来发现了一只蛞蝓。）A slug moves slowly.
（蛞蝓动动得很慢。）可以提问：Have you ever seen a slug? 词汇拓展：slug 和 snail 都属于
软体动物，但 snail 通常有壳，而 slug 没有明显的外壳。
catch
Catch means to get or hold something that is moving, or to capture an animal. 中文意思是“抓住；
捕捉”。常见搭配有 catch a ball、catch a fish、catch an animal。例如：The mole catches a slug.
（鼹鼠抓住了一只蛞蝓。）Can you catch the ball?（你能接住球吗））可以提问：What can a
mole catch? 语法拓展：catch → caught 是不规表动词，例如 The mole caught a slug.
poke
Poke means to push or touch something with a finger or another pointed object. 中文意思是“戳；
捅；轻推”。常见搭配有 poke a hole、poke something、poke with a finger。例如：The mole

===== PAGE 399 =====
pokes its nose out of the tunnel.（鼹鼠把鼻子从地道里探出来。）Don't poke the animal.（不要
戳动物。）可以提问：What can you poke? 词义拓展：poke 通常是比较轻地“戳”，而 push 更
强调“推”
。
本节课围绕绘本 （《The Mole》 展开学习，重点掌握了 mole, fuzz, toe, dig, tunnel, slug, catch,
poke 等词汇，并结合鼹鼠的生活习性进行了更深入的语言拓展。词汇方面重点学习了 dig a
tunnel, catch a slug, poke its nose 等搭配，并区分了 dig“挖掘”和 poke“戳、探出”等动作的不
同。语法方面重点拓展了 use + 名词 + to do 表达工具或身体部位的用途，如 The mole uses
its strong toes to dig tunnels.；同时学习 spend + 时间 + doing sth. 描述持续进行的活动，如
The mole spends a lot of time digging underground.，帮助孩子理解 doing 在该结构中的使用。
[G] Our Butterflies
scissors：Scissors 是“剪刀”，注意是个词通常以复数形式出现，所以说 These are scissors.，
而不是 This is a scissor.。常见搭配是 use scissors、cut with scissors，例如 We use scissors to
cut the paper. 可以联系孩子做手工的经验：I need scissors to make a butterfly. 如果要表达“
一
把剪刀”，可以说 a pair of scissors，例如 I have a pair of scissors.
glue：Glue 表示“胶水”，通常是不可数名词，因此常说 some glue / use glue / put glue on...，
例如 Put some glue on the paper.、We use glue to stick the wings together. 可以进一步拓展 glue
+ A + to B，例如 Glue the wings to the body.，帮助孩子理解胶水是用来把两个西是粘在一起
的。
shape：Shape 可以作名词“形状”，也可以作动词“塑造、使成形”。本课主要掌握名词用法，
例如 What shape is it?、It is a circle.、The wings have a beautiful shape. 可以联系孩子熟悉的
形状：circle, square, triangle, heart。有可以问 What shape can you see?，让孩子观察蝴蝶翅膀
的形状。
carefully：Carefully 是副词，表示“小心地、仔细地”，用来修饰动作。例如 Cut the paper
carefully.、She cuts carefully.。是里可以帮助孩子理解 careful 和 carefully 的区别：Be careful.
是“要小心”，而 Cut carefully. 是“仔细地剪”。有可以结合孩子做手工的真实动作说 Use the
scissors carefully.
cut out：Cut out 是非常重要的短语动词，表示“剪来、剪出某个形状”。例如 Cut out the butterfly.、

===== PAGE 400 =====
Cut out the wings carefully.。是里的 out 表示“从原来的纸张中剪出来”。可以和单纯的 cut 对
比：Cut the paper. 只是“剪纸”，而 cut out a butterfly 强调“把蝴蝶的形状剪来来”。如果孩子
能力较好，可以接触 cut it out，例如 Cut it out carefully.
hole：Hole 是“洞、孔”。可以结合手工作品说 Make a hole in the paper.、There is a hole in the
wing.。是里 a hole in... 是非常实用的结构，例如 There is a hole in my sock. 可以联系孩子
生活中衣服、纸张上的破洞。也可以拓展 make a hole 和 fall into a hole，但本课重点掌握前
者。
edge：Edge 表示“边缘、边”，本课可以理解为纸张或蝴蝶形状的边缘。例如 Cut along the
edge. 表示“沿着边缘剪”
，There is glue on the edge. 表示“边缘上有胶水”。可以进一步对比
middle/center：edge 是边缘，middle 是中间。是个词非常适合结合实际纸张，让孩子理解“边
缘”到，在哪里。
First, we draw the shape of a butterfly on the paper. Then we carefully cut it out with scissors,
following the edge. We make a small hole in the paper and use glue to attach the wings to the body.
Finally, we have a beautiful butterfly.
本节课围绕绘本 《Our Butterflies》 学习了 scissors, glue, shape, carefully, cut out, hole, edge
等词汇，并结合制作蝴蝶的手工情境理解是些词汇的实际用法。课堂中重点掌握了 scissors
的特殊形式，理解通常使用复数 scissors，如 These are scissors. / a pair of scissors；针对 glue
学习了其作为不可数名词的用法，以及 glue A to B 表示“把A 粘到B 上”；carefully 表结合
动作理解副词修饰动词的作用，并区分 Be careful. 与 Cut carefully.；对于核心短语 cut out，
重点理解其表示“把某个形状从纸上剪来来”，并与单纯的 cut 进行区分，如 Cut out the
butterfly carefully.；同时学习了 make a hole、a hole in... 和 along/on the edge 等表达，使孩
子能够描述纸张和手工作品的具体位置。课堂中有通过 What shape can you see? / Why should
we use scissors carefully? / What happens if you cut outside the edge? 等问题，引导孩子结合实
际手工过程进行完整表达，进一步巩固了工具、动作、形状和位置相关词汇的综合运用。
[G] The Big Trampoline
coach
coach 是“教练”，重点让孩子理解它不仅是一个人的职业名称，有可以表示“负责训练、指导
运动的人”。例如 The coach teaches the children how to jump safely. 可以拓展 football coach、
swimming coach、basketball coach。有可以学习 listen to the coach、ask the coach for help、
follow the coach's,，让孩子理解运动场景中教练和孩子之间的关系。coach 也可以作动词，

===== PAGE 401 =====
表示“训练、指导”，如 He coaches the school team.，是样可以让一个基础名词自然拓展到更
高阶的词性变化。可以问：What would you ask your coach before you use a trampoline?
trampoline
trampoline 是“蹦床”，重点不要只记住“在蹦床上跳”，可以拓展 jump on a trampoline、jump
high、bounce on a trampoline、fall off a trampoline。例如 The children are jumping high on the
trampoline. 可以进一步区分 jump 和 bounce：jump 强调“跳起来”，而 bounce 强调“弹起、
反弹”，蹦床正好适合理解是个区别。有可以结合安全规表表达：You should be careful on a
trampoline.、Don't jump too close to the edge.，让孩子把运动词汇和真实场景联系起来。
ladder
ladder 是“梯子”，本课可以重点结合 climb up the ladder、go down the ladder、at the top of the
ladder 学习动作和空间关系。例如 The boy climbs up the ladder to get to the trampoline.，是里
可以自然理解 to get to... 表示“为了到达……”。有可以和之前绘本中出现的 ladder 联系起来，
但增加难度：The ladder is next to the trampoline.、The boy is at the top of the ladder.，让孩子
区分“正在动动”和“已经到达某个位置”
。
swing
swing 可以作名词“秋千”，也可以作动词“荡、摆动”。在本课可以重点学习 sit on the swing、
push the swing、swing back and forth。例如 The girl swings back and forth on the swing. 可以
让孩子理解 back and forth 表示“来回地”。有可以进一步拓展动词用法：The door swung open.，
让孩子发现 swing 不只用于秋千，也可以表示物体来回摆动或突然摆开。可以问：Would you
rather play on a swing or jump on a trampoline? Why?
let
let 是本课很重要的结构词，重点掌握 let + 人 + 动词原形，表示“让某人做某事”。例如 The
coach lets the children jump on the trampoline.、Mum lets me play outside. 注意是里不能说 lets
the children to jump，而是 lets the children jump。可以进一步和 let me... 联系到孩子真实生
活中的不求：Let me try!、Let me help you!、Let me have a turn!。有可以问：Who lets you choose
what game to play at home?
thank you for

===== PAGE 402 =====
thank you for 是非常值得掌握的礼貌表达，表示“感谢你……”，摆面如果接动作，需要使用 -
ing：Thank you for helping me.、Thank you for teaching me.；如果接名词，表直接接名词：
Thank you for the gift. 是可以和 let 联系起来，例如 Thank you for letting me jump on the
trampoline.，是里同时出现 thank you for + doing 和 let + 人 + 动词原形，语言层次会明显
高于单纯背“谢谢”。有可以让孩子根据真实生活表达：Thank you for helping me. / Thank you
for waiting for me.
top
top 是“顶部、最上面”，本课重点放在空间表达中，例如 at the top of the ladder、on top of the
trampoline。特别值得区分 top of 和 on top of：at the top of the ladder 强调“在梯子的最高位
置”，而 on top of the box 强调“在盒子的上面”。有可以拓展 the top of the mountain、the top
of the page、the top shelf。例如 The boy is standing at the top of the ladder. 可以和 bottom 做
反义词联系，让孩子建立完整的空间概念。
all the way
all the way 表示“一路到，、一直到……、完全走完是一段距离”，重点是强调整个过程或完整
距离。例如 He climbs all the way to the top. 就是“一直爬到最顶端”，比简单的 go to the top
更有过程感。有可以说 We walked all the way home.、She ran all the way to the park.，让孩子
理解它强调“从开始一直持续到终点”。故事中可以把它和 ladder + top 结合：The boy climbs
all the way to the top of the ladder.，是是本课非常值得孩子记住的完整表达。
本节课围绕绘本《The Big Trampoline》学习了 coach, trampoline, ladder, swing, let, thank you
for, top, all the way 等运动和空间相关词汇，并重点结合孩子在运动场景中的动作顺序进行
拓展。课堂中 coach 不仅理解为“教练”，有拓展了 football coach、swimming coach、listen to
the coach、follow the coach's instructions 等真实搭配，并接触 coach 作为动词“训练、指导”
的用法；trampoline 结合 jump、bounce、jump high 区分动作含义，其中 bounce 强调“弹起、
反弹”，帮助孩子更准确地描述蹦床运动；ladder 结合 climb up、go down、at the top of 建立
空间和动作关系；swing 同时拓展名词“秋千”和动词“摆动”，并通过 swing back and forth 理
解“来回摆动”；let 重点掌握 let + 人 + 动词原形，如 The coach lets the children jump，并通
过 Let me try! / Let me help you! 迁动到孩子日常表达；thank you for 表重点掌握 thank you
for + 名词/doing，尤其结合 Thank you for helping me 和 Thank you for letting me jump 理解
感谢某件事情或某个动作的表达；top 通过 at the top of the ladder、on top of... 区分不同空
间关系；all the way 表重点理解其“整个过程一直到终点”的含义，如 climb all the way to the
top，并与简单的 go to 进行表达上的丰富化。

===== PAGE 403 =====
[G] Under the stars
starry
starry 是形容词，表示“期期很多的、繁期闪烁的”，通常用来描述夜空，例如 It is a starry night.；
它来自 star + -y，可以帮助孩子理解 -y 有时可以把名词变成表示“充满……的、具有……特点
的”形容词，例如 cloudy“多）的”
、sunny“帽光充足的”。常见表达有 a starry sky、a starry night，
例如 We looked at the starry sky.；可以问 What does the starry sky look like?
rainforest
rainforest 是“热带雨林”，由 rain + forest 组成，指降雨量丰富、）物茂密的森林，例如 Many
animals live in the rainforest.；可以拓展 rainforest animals、rainforest plants、tropical rainforest，
例如 Monkeys and parrots live in the rainforest.。可以顺便让孩子理解 rainforest 不是“来雨的
森林”是形简单，而是一种特殊的生态环境。可以问 Why do so many animals live in the
rainforest?
climb up
climb up 表示“向上爬、爬上去”，强调动动的方向，例如 The monkey climbs up the tree.；
climb 本身就可以表示“攀爬”，所以 up 是为了强调“向上”。可以对比 climb down“爬来来”
，
例如 The monkey climbs up the tree and then climbs down.；如果说具体爬么形，可以用 climb
up + 名词，例如 She climbed up the ladder. 可以问 What does the monkey climb up?
full moon
full moon 是“满月”，指从地球上看月亮被阳帽照亮的部分几乎全部可见的月相，例如 We can
see a full moon tonight.；注意 full 在是里不是简单的“装满”，而是“完整的、满的”，所以 full
moon 就是“满月”。可以和 new moon“新月”对比，例如 A full moon looks round and bright.
round
round 有多个常见意思。本绘本中主要表示“圆的、圆形的”，例如 The full moon is round.；
可以说 a round moon、a round table、a round ball。它也可以表示“绕一圈”，例如 We walked
round the park.；作名词时有可以表示“一轮、一回合”，例如 the first round of a game。另外
round 有可以表示“到处、四处”或用于表达约数，但本课重点先掌握“圆的”。可以问 What
things around you are round?

===== PAGE 404 =====
million
million 表示“一百万”，例如 There are a million stars in the sky.；当它前面有具体数字时，
million 不加 -s：two million stars，不能说 two millions stars。如果表示“大约数百万”，可以
说 millions of stars，是时 million 要变成复数并且摆面接 of。例如 There are millions of stars
in the universe. 是是一个很值得孩子掌握的数量表达。可以问 Are there millions of stars in the
sky?
practice
practice 有名词和动词两种常见用法。作名词时表示“练习”，例如 Practice makes you better.；
作动词时表示“练习、训练”，例如 I practice playing the piano every day.，注意 practice + doing
sth.，例如 She practices singing every day.。美式英语中 practice 同时作名词和动词；英式英
语中动词常拼作 practise。有可以说 practice makes perfect“熟能生巧”。可以问 What do you
practice every day?
continue
continue 表示“继续”，可以接名词，也可以接 to do / doing，例如 She continued reading.、She
continued to read.，两种形式通常都可以。绘本中如果强调某个动作没有停来来，可以说 He
continued climbing.；有可以说 continue with something，例如 Let's continue with our lesson.。
注意 continue 强调“继续原来的事情”，而不是重新开始。可以问 What does the child continue
to do?
fall asleep
fall asleep 表示“入觉、觉着”，强调从汤醒状态进入觉眠状态，例如 The child falls asleep under
the stars.；过去式是 fell asleep，例如 She fell asleep while looking at the stars.。可以和 be asleep
区分：fall asleep 是“觉着的过程”
，be asleep 是“已经觉着的状态”，例如 He fell asleep at ten.
/ He was asleep at ten.。有可以和 go to sleep 联系起来：go to sleep 可以理解为“去觉。/开始
觉。”，而 fall asleep 更强调真正觉着。可以问 Why does the child fall asleep?
本节课围绕绘本《Under the Stars》学习了 starry, rainforest, climb up, full moon, round, million,
practice, continue, fall asleep 等词汇，并结合夜空、雨林和观察月亮的故事情境进行了拓展。
课堂中 starry 重点理解“繁期闪烁的”，结合 a starry sky、a starry night 描述夜空，并通过 star

===== PAGE 405 =====
→ starry 理解常见的 -y 形容词构词方式，例如 We looked at the starry sky.；rainforest 通过
rain + forest 理解“热带雨林”，并结合 rainforest animals、rainforest plants 认识雨林环境，例
如 Many animals live in the rainforest.；climb up 重点掌握“向上爬”，并与 climb down 进行
方向上的对比，例如 The monkey climbs up the tree.；full moon 重点认识“满月”，并与 new
moon 进行对比，例如 A full moon looks round and bright.；round 结合月亮理解“圆的、圆形
的”，同时补充“绕一圈、回合”等常见含义，例如 The full moon is round.；million 重点掌握
two million 与 millions of 的数量表达区别，例如 There are millions of stars in the universe.；
practice 同时掌握名词和动词用法，并学习 practice + doing sth.，例如 I practice playing the
piano every day.；continue 重点理解“继续”，结合 continue doing / continue to do 描述动作持
续进行，例如 She continued looking at the stars.；fall asleep 重点区分“觉着的过程”和 be
asleep“已经觉着的状态”，并复习过去式 fell asleep，例如 She fell asleep while looking at the
stars.。
[G] My birthday
as
as 有多个常见意思，本绘本中需要根据句子判断具体含义。as 可以表示“作为”，例如 As a
birthday guest, I brought a gift.；也可以表示“当……时候”，例如 As the guests arrived, we got
busy.；有可以表示“像……一样”，例如 She is as happy as her sister.。此外有可以出现在 as soon
as“
一……就……”
、as well as“以及”中，例如 As soon as the guests arrived, we started the party.。
孩子首先需要建立一个概念：as 不是只有一个固定中文意思，要根据摆面的结构和上来文
判断。
guest
guest 是“客人、宾客”，通常指受邀不来到某个地方的人，例如 We have many guests at my
birthday party.；常见搭配有 birthday guest、house guest、special guest、invite a guest。与 host
相对：guest 是参加活动的客人，host 是举办活动、招在客人的人，例如 The host welcomes
the guests.。复数是 guests，例如 The guests are eating dessert.
parcel
parcel 是“包裹、邮包”，尤其常用于通过邮寄或快递集到的包裹，例如 I got a parcel for my
birthday.；常见搭配有 receive a parcel、send a parcel、open a parcel，例如 She is opening a
parcel.。在英式英语中 parcel 很常见，美式英语日常也经常使用 package，所以可以帮助孩
子理解 parcel = package 在很多场景来可以互换。

===== PAGE 406 =====
keep busy
keep busy 表示“让自己一直忙着、保持忙碌”，例如 I keep busy preparing for my birthday party.；
常见结构是 keep + 形容词，例如 keep quiet“保持安静”
、keep warm“保持温暖”，所以 keep
busy 可以理解为“保持忙碌”。有可以说 keep somebody busy“让某人一直忙着”，例如 The
children kept me busy all day.。注意 keep busy doing something 可以进一步表达“忙着做某事”
，
例如 She keeps busy making birthday cards.
dessert
dessert 是“甜点、餐摆甜品”，例如 We had cake for dessert.；常见搭配有 have dessert、eat
dessert、dessert menu。注意 dessert 和 desert 很容易混淆：dessert 有两个 s，表示“甜点”；
desert 一个 s，表示“沙漠”。可以通过句子帮助孩子记忆：I like dessert, but I don't like the desert.
fresh
fresh 有多个常见意思。形容食物时表示“新鲜的”，例如 We have fresh fruit for the party.；形
容空气时可以表示“汤新的”，例如 Let's get some fresh air.；形容西是刚刚制作或获得时，也
可以表示“新鲜出炉的、刚做好的”，例如 We have fresh bread.。有可以形容人“精力充沛的”
，
例如 I feel fresh after a good night's sleep.。本绘本中重点结合食物理解“新鲜的”
。
event
event 是“活动、事件”，可以指计划好的活动，例如 My birthday party is a special event.；也
可以指发生的事情，例如 The accident was an important event in his life.。常见搭配有 special
event、sports event、school event、birthday event。注意 event 通常比普通的 thing 更正式，
也常用于有组织的活动，例如 The school has a sports event every year.
blow out
blow out 有多个意思。本绘本中指“吹灭”，尤其用于生日蜡烛，例如 Blow out the candles!；
常见结构是 blow out + 蜡烛/火焰，例如 She blew out the candles.。注意 blow 是不规表动
词：blow → blew → blown，所以过去发生的事情要说 She blew out the candles.；另外 blow
out 有可以表示“轮胎爆裂、爆胎”，例如 The tire blew out.，以及风把火焰吹灭，例如 The
wind blew out the candle.，需要根据上来文判断意思。
本节课围绕绘本《My Birthday》学习了 as, guest, parcel, keep busy, dessert, fresh, event, blow

===== PAGE 407 =====
out 等词汇，并结合生日聚会、集到礼物和准备食物的故事情境进行了拓展。课堂中 as 重
点结合不同结构理解其多种常见用法，包括“作为”、表示时间“当……时候”以及比较中的
“像……一样”，例如 As the guests arrived, we got busy.；guest 重点掌握“客人、宾客”，并与举
办活动的 host 区分，例如 The host welcomes the guests.；parcel 重点理解“包裹、邮包”，结
合 receive a parcel、send a parcel、open a parcel 等生活化表达，并补充美式英语中常见的
package，例如 I got a parcel for my birthday.；keep busy 重点掌握“保持忙碌、让自己忙起来”
，
并结合 keep + 形容词 以及 keep busy doing sth. 进行表达，例如 She keeps busy making
birthday cards.；dessert 重点理解“甜点、餐摆甜品”，并区分容易混淆的 dessert 和 desert，
例如 We had cake for dessert.；fresh 结合生日聚会中的食物重点理解“新鲜的”，同时拓展形
容空气“汤新的”等常见含义，例如 We have fresh fruit for the party.；event 重点掌握“活动、
事件”，结合 special event、sports event、school event 等搭配理解其使用场景，例如 My
birthday party is a special event.；blow out 重点掌握生日场景中“吹灭蜡烛”的意思，并复习
blow → blew → blown 的不规表变化，同时补充 blow out 表示“吹灭火焰、爆胎”等其他常
见含义，例如 She blew out the candles.。
[G] At the petting zoo
petting zoo
petting zoo 是“儿童动物园、可触摸动物园”，指游客尤其是孩子可以近距离观察、触摸和喂
食一些温顺小动物的地方，例如 We saw lots of animals at the petting zoo.；常见搭配有 go to
a petting zoo、visit a petting zoo、feed the animals at the petting zoo，例如 The children are feeding
the goats at the petting zoo.。注意是里的 petting 来自动词 pet，表示“轻轻抚摸动物”，不是
“宠物”的意思。
woolly
woolly 是形容词，表示“。茸茸的、覆盖着厚厚羊。的”，常用来描述羊等动物，例如 The
sheep is woolly.；也可以说 woolly sheep、woolly coat、woolly fur，例如 The woolly sheep has
thick fur.。它来自 wool“羊。”，所以可以联系 wool → woolly 理解。注意 woolly 强调。发
厚、蓬松的外观，不只是普通的 hairy“多。的”
。
waddle
waddle 可以作动词或名词，表示“摇摇摆摆地走、蹒跚而行”，通常描述鸭子、企鹅等走路时
身体左右摆动的样子，例如 The duck waddles across the grass.；过去式是 waddled。常见搭
配有 waddle along、waddle across、waddle over，例如 The little duck waddled over to me.。注
意 waddle 是一种特殊的走路方式，而普通的 walk 只是“走路”
。

===== PAGE 408 =====
carefully
carefully 是副词，表示“小心地、仔细地”，修饰动作，例如 Touch the animals carefully.；它
来自形容词 careful，所以可以理解为 careful → carefully。常见结构有 do something carefully、
listen carefully、look carefully，例如 The children carefully fed the goats.；反义词是 carelessly“粗
心地”，例如 He did it carelessly.。注意 carefully 通常放在动词摆或宾语摆，例如 Please carry
the baby carefully.
cuddly
cuddly 是形容词，表示“适合拥抱的、抱起来很舒服的、惹人喜爱的”，通常形容柔软、温顺、
让人想抱的动物或玩偶，例如 The little lamb is very cuddly.；它来自 cuddle“拥抱、搂抱”
，
所以 cuddly 可以理解为“让人想 cuddle 的”。常见搭配有 cuddly kitten、cuddly puppy、cuddly
toy，例如 She has a cuddly teddy bear.。注意 cuddly 更强调“让人想抱、摸起来舒服”，而 cute
只是“可爱”
。
scamper
scamper 是动词，表示“小步快速跑、蹦蹦跳跳地跑”，通常用于小动物或小孩，例如 The rabbit
scampered away.；常见搭配有 scamper away、scamper across、scamper around，例如 The little
mouse scampered across the floor.。它比普通的 run 更有画面感，强调动作轻快、快速，而且
通常是小步跑，例如 The kitten scampered around the garden.
a pile of
a pile of 表示“一堆、一摞”，用于形容堆在一起的西是，例如 a pile of hay“一堆看草”
、a pile
of books“一摞书”
、a pile of clothes“一堆衣服”。例如 The sheep is standing on a pile of hay.；
pile 本身就是“堆、摞”，所以有可以说 make a pile of...，例如 Let's make a pile of leaves.。注
意 a pile of 摆面可以接可数名词复数或不可数名词，例如 a pile of books / a pile of sand。
log：原木；日志、记录；（船/车等）行驶、航行的记录。例如：We sat on a log.（的们坐在
一根原木上。）/ Keep a log of your activities.（记录你的活动。）
friendly：友好的；友善的；容易相处的。例如：She is very friendly.（她非常友好。）常见搭
配：friendly to sb.、friendly smile、friendly person。
thought：有两个常见含义：① think 的过去式/过去分词，例如 I thought he was at home.（（的

===== PAGE 409 =====
以为他在家。）② 名词“想法、念头”，例如 That's a good thought.（是是个好想法。）常见搭
配：have a thought、a thought about...、thought of...。
本节课围绕绘本《At the Petting Zoo》学习了 petting zoo, woolly, waddle, carefully, cuddly,
scamper, a pile of 等词汇，并结合动物园中近距离观察、触摸和喂养小动物的情境进行了拓
展。课堂中 petting zoo 重点理解“儿童动物园、可触摸动物园”，结合 go to a petting zoo、
feed the animals 等表达，并通过 pet → petting 理解“抚摸动物”的含义，例如 The children are
feeding the goats at the petting zoo.；woolly 重点理解“。茸茸的、长着厚厚羊。的”，通过 wool
→ woolly 理解词汇关系，例如 The woolly sheep has thick fur.；waddle 重点掌握“摇摇摆摆
地走”，结合鸭子等动物的动作与普通的 walk、run 进行区分，例如 The duck waddles across
the grass.；carefully 重点掌握“小心地、仔细地”，理解副词修饰动作的用法，并结合 careful
→ carefully 进行拓展，例如 The children carefully fed the goats.；cuddly 重点理解“适合拥抱
的、抱起来很舒服的”，通过 cuddle → cuddly 理解其词义，并与单纯表示“可爱”的 cute 区
分，例如 The little lamb is very cuddly.；scamper 重点掌握“小步快速跑、轻快地跑”，结合
scamper away、scamper across、scamper around 等表达，例如 The rabbit scampered away.；a
pile of 重点掌握“一堆、一摞”的表达，结合动物园中的 a pile of hay 等具体场景，并理解摆
面既可以接可数名词复数，也可以接不可数名词，例如 The sheep is standing on a pile of hay.。
[G] A river’s journey
Where does a river begin?
Where do you think all the water goes in the end?
Today we're going to follow a river's journey from the mountains all the way to the sea!
mountain Meaning: a very high piece of land. Chinese: 山；山脉。 Useful Phrases: high mountain,
climb a mountain, snowy mountain. Examples: The river begins in the mountains. / We climbed a
high mountain. Questions: Have you ever been to the mountains? / What animals live in the
mountains? Word Extension: Compare mountain and hill. A mountain is much higher and steeper
than a hill.
stream Meaning: a small, narrow river. Chinese: 小溪。 Useful Phrases: mountain stream, clear
stream, cross a stream. Examples: The stream flows down the mountain. / Fish swim in the stream.
Questions: Have you e ver played in a stream? / Is a stream big or small? Word Extension: Compare
stream and river. A stream is smaller and often becomes part of a river.

===== PAGE 410 =====
flow down Meaning: to move from a higher place to a lower place. Chinese: 向来流。 Useful
Phrases: flow down the mountain, flow down the hill. Examples: Water flows down the mountain.
/ Rainwater flows down the road. Questions: Why does water flow down? / Where does the water
go after it flows down? Word Extension: Introduce up and down. Water naturally flows down, while
people can climb up a mountain.
end Meaning: the last part or final place. Chinese: 终点；结束。 Useful Phrases: at the end, the
end of the river, come to an end. Examples: The river ends in the sea. / We reached the end of the
story. Questions: Where does a river end? / What happens at the end of the story? Word Extension:
Compare begin and end. Everything has a beginning and an ending.
flow Meaning: to move smoothly like water. Chinese: 流动。 Useful Phrases: water flows, flow
into, flow through. Examples: Rivers flow into the sea. / Water flows through the valley. Questions:
Does water flow fast or slowly? / What else can flow besides rivers? Word Extension: Compare
flow and stop. Water keeps flowing, but a dam can make it stop.
become Meaning: to change into something else. Chinese: 变成。 Useful Phrases: become a river,
become bigger, become stronger. Examples: The stream becomes a river. / The caterpillar becomes
a butterfly. Questions: What does a stream become? / What do you want to become when you grow
up? Word Extension: Review grow vs. become. Grow means getting bigger, while become means
changing into something different.
waterfall Meaning: water that falls over the edge of a cliff. Chinese: 瀑布。 Useful Phrases:
beautiful waterfall, high waterfall. Examples: The river flows over a waterfall. / We saw a beautiful
waterfall. Questions: Have you ever seen a waterfall? / Is a waterfall quiet or loud? Word Extension:
Explain that waterfalls form when water flows over a steep drop.
valley Meaning: the low land between mountains or hills. Chinese: 山谷。 Useful Phrases: green
valley, wide valley. Examples: The river flows through the valley. / Many animals live in the valley.
Questions: What can you see in a valley? / Would you like to visit a valley? Word Extension:
Compare valley and mountain. A mountain is high, while a valley is the low land between mountains.
roar Meaning: to make a very loud sound. Chinese: 咆哮；轰鸣。 Useful Phrases: roar loudly, the

===== PAGE 411 =====
roar of the waterfall. Examples: The waterfall roars day and night. / We heard the river roar after the
rain. Questions: What can roar? / Is the waterfall quiet or loud? Word Extension: Compare roar,
whisper, and splash. A roar is very loud, a whisper is very quiet, and splash is the sound of water
hitting something.
First → Next → Then → After that → Finally
Sample Answer:
First, the river begins in the mountains.
Next, it becomes a small stream and flows down the mountains.
Then, it flows through the valley and becomes bigger.
After that, it goes over a waterfall, and the water roars loudly.
Finally, the river flows into the sea.
Q2. Why are rivers important?
引导回答逻辑：Purpose → Example → Conclusion
Sample Answer:
Rivers are important because they give water to people, animals, and plants. They also help farmers
grow food. Without rivers, many living things could not survive.
Q3. How can we protect rivers?
Sample Answer:
We should not throw rubbish into rivers. We should save water and keep rivers clean.
课摆反馈

become, end, waterfall, valley 和 roar 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 mountain 与 hill、
stream 与 river 的区别，帮助孩子理解不同地形和水体的特点；通过 flow 学习了 flow into、
flow through、flow down 等常见搭配，并结合 become 对比复习 grow 的用法，理解“长大”
和“变成”的不同含义；通过 roar 与 whisper、splash 的对比，丰富了描述声音的词汇。结合
图片，孩子能够按照 First → Next → Then → After that → Finally 的顺序，完整描述河流从
山脉（mountains）发源，形成小溪（stream），流经山谷（valley），越过瀑布（waterfall），最
终汇入大海（sea）的全过程。同时，课堂有围绕“为么形河流总是向来流”“河流为么形重要

===== PAGE 412 =====
“等开放性问题展开讨论，进一步提升了孩子运用英语进行观察、归纳和科学表达的能力。
[G] Look at the turtle
Have you ever seen a turtle?
Where do turtles usually live?
by the lake Meaning: next to a lake. Chinese: 在湖边。 Useful Phrases: by the lake, walk by the
lake, sit by the lake. Examples: The turtle lives by the lake. / We had a picnic by the lake. Questions:
Have you ever been to a lake? / What animals can you see by the lake? Word Extension: Compare
by the lake, in the lake, and on the lake. By the lake means next to it, in the lake means inside the
water, and on the lake means on the surface of the water, like a boat.
on the shore Meaning: on the land next to a lake, river, or sea. Chinese: 在岸边。 Useful Phrases:
walk on the shore, rest on the shore, sandy shore. Examples: The turtle rests on the shore. / We found
shells on the shore. Questions: What can you find on the shore? / Would you like to walk on the
shore? Word Extension: Compare shore and beach. A beach is usually sandy and used for playing
or swimming, while a shore is the land along any lake, river, or sea.
hide Meaning: to go where others cannot see you. Chinese: 躲藏。 Useful Phrases: hide behind,
hide under, hide in. Examples: The turtle hides in its shell. / The rabbit hides behind a tree. Questions:
Where would you hide in a game of hide-and-seek? / Why do animals hide? Word Extension:
Compare hide and seek. Hide means to stay out of sight, while seek means to look for someone or
something.
afraid Meaning: feeling scared or frightened. Chinese: 害怕的。 Useful Phrases: be afraid of, feel
afraid, not afraid anymore. Examples: The turtle is afraid of the loud noise. / I'm afraid of
thunderstorms. Questions: What are you afraid of? / What helps you feel brave? Word Extension:
Compare afraid, scared, and brave. Afraid and scared have similar meanings, while brave means
facing something even when you feel afraid.
pretend Meaning: to act as if something is true when it is not. Chinese: 假装；扮演。 Useful Phrases:
pretend to sleep, pretend to be, let's pretend. Examples: The turtle pretends to be a rock. / Let's
pretend we're astronauts. Questions: What do you like to pretend to be? / Why do some animals
pretend? Word Extension: Explain that many animals pretend to protect themselves. For example,

===== PAGE 413 =====
some insects pretend to be sticks, and some animals pretend to be dead to stay safe.
come back home Meaning: to return to your home. Chinese: 回家。 Useful Phrases: come back
home, go back home, welcome home. Examples: The turtle comes back home safely. / Dad comes
back home at six o'clock. Questions: What time do you come back home? / How do you feel when
you come back home? Word Extension: Compare come back and go back. We say come back when
returning to the speaker, and go back when returning to another place.
scary Meaning: making people feel afraid. Chinese: 吓人的；可怕的。 Useful Phrases: scary
animal, scary movie, scary sound. Examples: The loud noise is scary. / That story is scary. Questions:
What do you think is scary? / Are spiders scary to you? Word Extension: Compare scary and afraid.
Scary describes the thing that causes fear, while afraid describes how a person or animal feels.
Example: The noise is scary, so the turtle is afraid.
noise Meaning: a sound, especially a loud or unpleasant one. Chinese: 噪音；声响。 Useful Phrases:
loud noise, strange noise, make a noise. Examples: We heard a strange noise. / Don't make too much
noise in the library. Questions: What noises do you hear at home? / What noise can you hear outside?
Word Extension: Compare noise and sound. Sound can be any sound, while noise often refers to a
loud or unwanted sound.
What do you consider as noise?
本节课围绕绘本《Look at the Turtle》展开学习，重点学习了 by the lake, on the shore, hide,
afraid, pretend, come back home, scary 和 noise 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 by the lake、
in the lake 和 on the lake 的区别，帮助孩子准确理解不同地点介词的用法；通过 shore 与
beach 的对比，认识不同水域岸边的特点；结合 hide 学习了 hide behind、hide under 和 hide
in 等常见搭配，并拓展了 afraid、scared，帮助孩子准确表达情绪；结合 pretend 学习了动
物通过伪装保护自己的生存策略，并理解 pretend to... 的表达；同时通过 scary 与 scared、
noise 与 sound 的比较，进一步丰富了描述感受和声音的词汇。课堂有围绕 How do animals
protect themselves? 展开讨论，并能够用 The turtle protects itself by hiding in its shell. 等完整
句型介绍不同动物的自的保护方式.
[G] Great Copycats
Today we're going to have fun copying different movements and learning how to be a great

===== PAGE 414 =====
follower—and maybe even a great leader!
copycat Meaning: someone who copies what another person does. Chinese: 模仿者；爱模仿的人。
Useful Phrases: be a copycat, little copycat, copy someone's actions. Examples: The monkey is a
funny copycat. / Don't be a copycat all the time. Questions: Do you like copying funny actions? / Is
copying always a bad thing? Word Extension: Explain that copying can help us learn new skills, but
copying homework or someone else's ideas is not a good habit. Compare copy (学习模仿) and cheat
(作弊).
hands up Meaning: raise your hands above your head. Chinese: 举起双手。 Useful Phrases: hands
up, put your hands up, raise your hands. Examples: Hands up if you know the answer! / Everybody,
hands up! Questions: Can you put your hands up? / When do teachers ask students to raise their
hands? Word Extension: Compare hands up and raise your hand. Hands up usually means both
hands, while raise your hand usually means one hand to answer a question.
skip around Meaning: move by skipping happily in different directions. Chinese: 蹦蹦跳跳地四处
走。 Useful Phrases: skip around the room, skip happily, skip together. Examples: The children
skipped around the playground. / We skipped around in a circle. Questions: Do you like skipping? /
Can you skip around the classroom? Word Extension: Compare walk, run, hop, and skip. Skip is a
light, happy way of moving and often shows excitement.
wave hands Meaning: move your hands from side to side. Chinese: 动手。 Useful Phrases: wave
your hands, wave hello, wave goodbye. Examples: Wave your hands in the air. / She waved goodbye
to her friends. Questions: When do you wave your hands? / Who do you wave goodbye to? Word
Extension: Compare wave and clap. We wave to greet someone, but we clap to show appreciation.
follow Meaning: to go after someone or do the same thing they do. Chinese: 跟随；跟着做。 Useful
Phrases: follow the leader, follow me, follow the rules. Examples: Please follow me. / Everyone
followed the leader. Questions: Who do you usually follow in class? / Why is it important to follow
rules? Word Extension: Compare follow and lead. A leader goes first, and others follow.
hands down Meaning: put your hands back to your sides or lower them. Chinese: 放来双手。
Useful Phrases: hands down, put your hands down. Examples: Hands down, please. / Put your hands
down after answering. Questions: When should you put your hands down? / Can you follow the

===== PAGE 415 =====
teacher's instructions? Word Extension: Teach opposite actions: hands up ↔ hands down,
reinforcing the idea of opposites.
march forward Meaning: walk forward with strong, regular steps. Chinese: 齐步向前走。 Useful
Phrases: march forward, march together, march in a line. Examples: The children marched forward
together. / Soldiers march forward proudly. Questions: Can you march like a soldier? / Is marching
the same as walking? Word Extension: Compare march, walk, and run. March has regular, strong
steps, walk is relaxed, and run is much faster.
leader Meaning: a person who guides or helps others. Chinese: 午导者；带午者。 Useful Phrases:
team leader, class leader, follow the leader. Examples: Amy is today's leader. / The leader shows
everyone what to do. Questions: What makes a good leader? / Would you like to be a leader? Word
Extension: Compare leader and follower. A leader gives directions and sets an example, while a
follower listens carefully and works together with others. Explain that a good leader is also a good
listener.
What makes a good leader?
Guide children to summarize instead of giving one-word answers.
Sample Answer:
A good leader is kind, responsible, and confident. A good leader listens to others, helps the team,
and sets a good example.
本节课围绕绘本《Great Copycats》展开学习，重点学习了 copycat, hands up, skip around, wave
hands, follow, hands down, march forward 和 leader 等词汇与表达。通过 hands up 与 raise
your hand、hands up 与 hands down 的对比，掌握了常见课堂指令；结合 skip、walk、run、
march 理解不同动动方式的特点。结合 follow 与 lead，认识到团队中午导者和跟随者各自
的重要作用。补充拓展 What makes a good leader?，总结出优秀午导者应具备 kind,
responsible, confident 等品质，同时认识到优秀的跟随者同样需要认真倾听、积极合作，在
提升英语表达能力的同时培养了团队合作与午导意识。
[G] Growing Peas
Have you ever planted a seed?
What do plants need to grow?

===== PAGE 416 =====
Today we're going to learn how tiny pea seeds grow into healthy pea plants!
pea pods Meaning: the long green case that holds peas inside. Chinese: 豌子荚。 Useful Phrases:
green pea pods, open a pea pod, pick pea pods. Examples: The peas grow inside the pea pods. / We
picked fresh pea pods from the garden. Questions: Have you ever eaten peas? / Where are the peas?
Word Extension: Explain that peas are the small round vegetables inside, while a pea pod is the
outer shell. Example: Open the pod, and you can see the peas inside.
be good for Meaning: to be healthy or helpful for someone or something. Chinese: 对……有益。
Useful Phrases: be good for your health, be good for plants, be good for the environment. Examples:
Vegetables are good for us. / Water is good for plants. Questions: What foods are good for your
body? / Is exercise good for you? Word Extension: Compare be good for and be good at. Be good
for means "有益于", while be good at means "擅长". Example: Carrots are good for your eyes. /
She is good at drawing.
soil Meaning: the top layer of earth where plants grow. Chinese: 土壤。 Useful Phrases: rich soil,
plant in the soil, healthy soil. Examples: Seeds grow in the soil. / The soil is soft after the rain.
Questions: What grows in the soil? / Why do plants need soil? Word Extension: Explain that healthy
soil gives plants water, nutrients, and support so they can grow strong.
stick Meaning: a long piece of wood used to support plants. Chinese: 木棍；支撑杆。 Useful
Phrases: a wooden stick, use a stick, plant support. Examples: We put a stick beside the pea plant. /
The plant grows around the stick. Questions: Why does the pea plant need a stick? / What else can
a stick be used for? Word Extension: Explain that climbing plants need support. A stick helps the
plant grow upward instead of falling over.
string Meaning: a thin piece of rope used to tie or support something. Chinese: 子子。 Useful
Phrases: tie with string, garden string, hang on a string. Examples: The string helps the plant climb.
/ We tied the plant to the string. Questions: Have you ever used string? / Why do gardeners use
string? Word Extension: Compare stick and string. A stick gives strong support, while a string helps
guide the plant as it climbs.
seed Meaning: the small part of a plant that can grow into a new plant. Chinese: 种子。 Useful
Phrases: plant a seed, tiny seed, sunflower seed. Examples: We planted a pea seed. / Every big plant

===== PAGE 417 =====
starts from a small seed. Questions: What can a seed become? / Have you ever planted a seed? Word
Extension: Explain the life cycle of a plant: seed → shoot → plant → flower → fruit/pod → seeds.
grow Meaning: to become bigger and stronger. Chinese: 生长。 Useful Phrases: grow up, grow
quickly, grow taller. Examples: The pea plant grows every day. / Plants grow in the sunshine.
Questions: What helps plants grow? / What helps children grow? Word Extension: Compare grow
and become. Grow means getting bigger, while become means changing into something new.
shoot Meaning: the first small green stem that grows from a seed. Chinese: 幼芽；嫩芽。 Useful
Phrases: green shoot, new shoot, little shoot. Examples: A green shoot comes out of the soil. / The
shoot grows taller every day. Questions: What comes out of the seed first? / What color is the shoot?
Word Extension: Explain that a shoot is the beginning of the stem and leaves. It is the first sign that
a seed is growing.
pod Meaning: the case that contains seeds or peas. Chinese: 荚；子荚。 Useful Phrases: bean pod,
pea pod, inside the pod. Examples: The pod is full of peas. / We opened the pod carefully. Questions:
What is inside a pod? / Is a pod the same as a seed? Word Extension: Compare pod and seed. The
pod is the outer covering, while the seed grows inside it.
pick Meaning: to take fruit, vegetables, or flowers from a plant. Chinese: 采摘。 Useful Phrases:
pick peas, pick flowers, pick vegetables. Examples: It's time to pick the peas. / We picked tomatoes
from the garden. Questions: What fruits or vegetables have you picked? / When do farmers pick
vegetables? Word Extension: Compare pick and plant. Plant means putting a seed into the soil, while
pick means collecting the food after it has grown.
Guide children to summarize the process using sequence words.
How do peas grow?
First, plant the seed in the soil.
Next, water the seed and give it sunshine.
Then, a green shoot grows out of the soil.
After that, the plant climbs up a stick or string.
Later, it grows pea pods.

===== PAGE 418 =====
Finally, we pick the pea pods and enjoy eating the peas inside.

seed, grow, shoot, pod 和 pick 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 be good for 与 be good at
的区别，帮助孩子准确理解“对……有益”和“擅长……”的不同用法；通过 pea、pea pod、pod 和
seed 的比较，认识子荚、豌子和种子的关系；结合 stick 与 string 学习了攀爬）物需要支
撑物才能向上生长；通过 grow 与 become 的对比，进一步理解“生长”和“变成”的区别；结
合 pick 掌握）物从播种到集获的完整过程。课堂有围绕）物的生命周间，引导孩子按照
First → Next → Then → After that → Finally 的顺序完整描述豌子从 seed → shoot → plant →
pea pod → pick 的生长过程

craft Meaning: something made by hand, or the activity of making things by hand. Chinese: 手工；
手工艺品。 Useful Phrases: make a craft, craft project, arts and crafts. Examples: We made a craft

Have you ever made a gift by hand? Word Extension: Compare craft and art. Art often focuses on
drawing or painting, while craft usually means making something by hand, such as cards, bags, or
decorations.
felt Meaning: a soft cloth used for making crafts. Chinese: 。毡。 Useful Phrases: felt fabric, felt
flower, felt bag. Examples: She made a heart from red felt. / Felt is soft and easy to cut. Questions:
What can we make with felt? / Is felt hard or soft? Word Extension: Compare felt, cotton, and wool.
Felt is often used for crafts, cotton is common in clothes, and wool comes from sheep and keeps us
warm.
strap Meaning: a long narrow piece used to carry or hold something. Chinese: 带子；肩带。 Useful
Phrases: bag strap, shoulder strap, watch strap. Examples: The bag has a long strap. / I fixed the
broken strap. Questions: What things have straps? / Why do bags need straps? Word Extension:
Introduce common items: backpack straps, watch straps, camera straps, helmet straps.
brass Meaning: a yellow metal used to make keys, bells, rings, and decorations. Chinese: ）铜。

===== PAGE 419 =====
Useful Phrases: brass ring, brass key, brass decoration. Examples: The key ring is made of brass. /
The brass shines in the sunlight. Questions: What color is brass? / What can people make from brass?
Word Extension: Compare brass, gold, and silver. Brass looks golden but is a different metal and is
often used in everyday objects.
ring Meaning: a small metal circle used to hold things together or worn on a finger. Chinese: 圆环；
戒指。 Useful Phrases: key ring, metal ring, ring holder. Examples: She put the keys on the ring. /
The bag has a small metal ring. Questions: What can a ring hold together? / Have you ever used a

dump Meaning: to throw something away carelessly. Chinese: 丢弃；乱扔。 Useful Phrases: dump

the broken box. Questions: Should we dump useful things? / Where should we throw away trash?
Word Extension: Compare dump, throw away, and recycle. Dump often means throwing something
away carelessly, throw away is neutral, and recycle means turning old materials into something
useful.
stuff Meaning: things or objects; sometimes materials used to fill something. Chinese: 西是；物
品；填充物。 Useful Phrases: school stuff, camping stuff, pack your stuff. Examples: Put your stuff
in the bag. / My desk is full of stuff. Questions: What stuff is in your school bag? / What stuff do
you need for school? Word Extension: Explain that stuff is an informal word meaning things. Instead
of saying many stuffs, we simply say a lot of stuff because stuff is usually uncountable.
quilt Meaning: a thick blanket made by sewing layers of cloth together. Chinese: 拼布被；棉被。
Useful Phrases: warm quilt, handmade quilt, patchwork quilt. Examples: Grandma made a beautiful
quilt. / The quilt keeps us warm in winter. Questions: Who made the quilt? / Why do we use quilts?
Word Extension: Explain that a patchwork quilt is made from many small pieces of fabric sewn
together. It often becomes a special family gift because every piece tells a story.

[G] Can I help?

busy Meaning: having a lot of things to do. Chinese: 忙碌的。 Useful Phrases: be busy, busy day,

Busy means having many things to do, while free means having time to relax or do what you like.

dry Meaning: to remove water from something or not be wet. Chinese: 擦看；变看；看燥的。

rag Meaning: an old piece of cloth used for cleaning. Chinese: 抹布。 Useful Phrases: cleaning

[G] Playing outside
What do you like to do outside?

===== PAGE 427 =====
outside
Meaning: in or to the open air; not inside a building. Chinese: 在户外；在外面。 Useful Phrases:
play outside, go outside, outside the house, outside the classroom. Examples: The children are
playing outside. / It's sunny, so let's go outside. Questions: What do you like to do outside? / When
do you usually play outside? Word Extension: Compare outside and outdoors. Outside can be an
adverb, adjective, or preposition (outside the school), while outdoors is an adverb meaning "in the
open air." Example: The children are playing outside. / We love spending time outdoors. Compare
the opposites outside and inside.
float
Meaning: to stay on the surface of water without sinking. Chinese: 漂浮。 Useful Phrases: float
on water, float away, floating leaf, float in the air. Examples: The leaf floated on the pond. / Balloons
can float in the air. Questions: What things can float on water? / Why do some things float while
others sink? Science Extension: Explain that whether something floats or sinks depends on its
material and density. Objects that are less dense than water usually float, while denser objects sink.
Encourage students to predict whether a leaf, rock, plastic bottle, coin, or wooden stick will float or
sink.
march
Meaning: to walk with strong, regular steps, often together in a group. Chinese: 齐步走；行进。
Useful Phrases: march together, march forward, march in a line, marching band. Examples: The
children marched around the playground. / The soldiers marched together. Questions: Have you ever
marched in a school activity? / Why do people march in the same rhythm? Word Extension:
Compare march, walk, run, and skip. Walk is normal movement, march is organized and rhythmic,
run is faster, and skip is light and playful. Ask students to act out each action.
beside
Meaning: next to or at the side of someone or something. Chinese: 在……旁边。 Useful Phrases:
beside the tree, beside me, sit beside, stand beside. Examples: The puddle is beside the path. / My
best friend sits beside me. Questions: Who sits beside you in class? / What can you see beside your
house? Grammar Extension: Compare beside and besides. Beside means "next to," while besides
means "in addition to." Examples: The cat is beside the chair. / Besides English, I also study science.

===== PAGE 428 =====
sway
Meaning: to move slowly from side to side. Chinese: 摇摆；摇曳。 Useful Phrases: trees sway,
sway in the wind, flowers sway gently. Examples: The tall grass swayed in the breeze. / The trees
swayed from side to side. Questions: What things sway in the wind? / Have you ever watched trees
sway on a windy day? Science Extension: Explain that wind pushes light objects, causing them to
sway. Discuss why trees sway instead of falling—their trunks and branches are flexible enough to
bend with the wind.
breeze
Meaning: a light, gentle wind. Chinese: 微风。 Useful Phrases: gentle breeze, cool breeze, summer
breeze. Examples: A cool breeze made the day comfortable. / The breeze moved the leaves.
Questions: How does a breeze feel? / Which season has the nicest breeze? Word Extension: Compare
breeze, wind, and storm. A breeze is light and gentle, wind is stronger, and a storm brings very
strong winds, often with rain or thunder.
splash
Meaning: to scatter water by moving quickly in it. Chinese: 溅起水花；泼水。 Useful Phrases:
splash in the water, splash around, make a splash. Examples: The children splashed in the puddles
after the rain. / Don't splash water on your friends. Questions: Do you like splashing in puddles? /
Where can people splash safely? Word Extension: Explain that splash can be both a verb and a noun.
The children splashed in the water. (verb) / I heard a big splash! (noun). Compare splash and spill—
splash is usually playful or caused by movement, while spill means accidentally pouring something
out.
puddle
Meaning: a small pool of water, usually after rain. Chinese: 水坑；积水。 Useful Phrases: jump
in a puddle, muddy puddle, rain puddle. Examples: The children jumped into the puddles happily. /
There was a big puddle after the storm. Questions: What happens to puddles after the sun comes
out? / Is it always safe to jump into puddles? Science Extension: Explain the water cycle. After the
rain, puddles slowly evaporate when the sun warms the water. The water becomes invisible water
vapor and rises into the air. This is part of the water cycle, which includes evaporation, condensation,
and precipitation.
What's your favorite weather for playing outside?

Activity: I can ride my bike and play soccer with my friends.
Feeling: It makes me feel happy and energetic.
本节课围绕绘本《Playing Outside》展开学习，重点学习了 outside, float, march, beside, sway,
breeze, splash 和 puddle 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 outside 与 outdoors、inside 的
区别，理解 outside 可作副词、形容词和介词使用；学习了 float 的常见搭配 float on water、
float away、float in the air，并结合例句掌握其在不同场景中的应用；通过 march、walk、run
和 skip 的比较，理解不同动作词所表达的运动方式；重点区分了 beside（在……旁边）与
besides（（此外）的不同含义及用法，并练习了 sit beside、stand beside 等高频搭配；结合 sway
学习了固定表达 sway in the breeze、sway from side to side，进一步积累自然场景描述；通过
breeze、wind 和 storm 的比较，丰富了天气相关词汇；学习了 splash 作为动词和名词的两
种用法，掌握 splash in the water、make a splash 等常用搭配；最摆结合 puddle 学习了 jump
in a puddle、muddy puddle、rain puddle 等实用短语。课堂通过大量例句替换、情景问答和词
汇辨析，帮助孩子熟练掌握各词汇的实际运用，提高了运用英语描述户外活动、自然现象和
方位关系的表达能力。

pet store
Meaning: a shop where people can buy pets and pet supplies. Chinese: 宠物）。 Useful Phrases:

pet hospital (animal hospital/vet clinic), and animal shelter. A pet store sells pets, a vet clinic helps
sick animals, and an animal shelter cares for homeless animals waiting for adoption. Introduce the
idea that adopting a pet is another kind choice.
pull
Meaning: to move something toward yourself using your hands. Chinese: 拉；拖。 Useful Phrases:
pull the door, pull the rope, pull gently, pull hard. Examples: Please pull the door open. / The little

cage
Meaning: a structure made of metal bars or wire where animals are kept. Chinese: ！子。 Useful

sneeze

What should you do when you sneeze? / Why do people sneeze? Word Extension: Teach good
hygiene by introducing cover your mouth, use a tissue, and wash your hands. Compare sneeze and
cough. A sneeze comes from the nose, while a cough comes from the throat or lungs.
another
Meaning: one more or a different one. Chinese: 另一个；再一个。 Useful Phrases: another pet,

another cookie? Grammar Extension: Explain the difference between another, other, and the other.
Another means "one more" or "a different one" (singular), other is used with plural nouns
(other animals), and the other refers to the second of two things. Examples: I want another toy.
/ I like other pets. / One rabbit is white. The other rabbit is black.

floppy

furry

[G] Who loves?
What food do you usually eat for breakfast?

cereal
Cereal means a type of breakfast food made from grains, usually eaten with milk. 中文意思是“谷

===== PAGE 432 =====
物早餐、麦片”。常见搭配有 eat cereal for breakfast（早餐吃麦片）, a bowl of cereal（一碗麦

拓展时可以比较 cereal, oatmeal, bread 的区别：cereal 通常是看谷物加牛奶食用；oatmeal 是

forget
Forget means to not remember something. 中文意思是“忘记”。常见搭配有 forget to do
something（忘记做某事）, forget about something（忘记某事）, don't forget（不要忘记）。例
如： Don't forget to brush your teeth before bedtime.（（觉。前不要忘记刷牙。）I forgot my homework
at home.（的把作业忘在家里了。）可以提问孩子：What do you often forget? Have you ever
forgotten something important? 语法拓展重点讲解 forget to do sth. 和 forget doing sth. 的区
别：forget to do sth. 表示忘记去做一件有没有完成的事情，例如 I forgot to bring my book.（（的
忘记带书了）；forget doing sth. 表示忘记曾经做过某件事，例如 I forgot meeting him before.
（的忘记以前见过他）。课堂重点掌握高频句型：Don't forget to + 动词原形。
armchair
Armchair means a comfortable chair with sides that support your arms. 中文意思是“扶手椅”。常
见搭配有 sit in an armchair（（坐在扶手椅上）, a comfortable armchair（（舒适的扶手椅）, an old
armchair（）扶手椅）。例如：Grandpa likes sitting in his armchair and reading books.（爷爷喜
欢坐在扶手椅上看书。）The cat is sleeping in the armchair.（（猫正在扶手椅上觉。。）可以提问
孩子：Where do you like to sit at home? Is an armchair comfortable? 拓展时可以比较 chair,
armchair, sofa：chair 是普通椅子；armchair 有扶手，更舒适；sofa 是可以坐多人的沙发。例
如：A sofa is usually longer than a chair.
slipper
Slipper means a soft and comfortable shoe that people usually wear indoors. 中文意思是“拖鞋、
室内鞋”。常见搭配有 wear slippers（（穿拖鞋）, a pair of slippers（（一双拖鞋）, bedroom slippers
（卧室拖鞋）。例如：I wear slippers when I stay at home.（的在家时穿拖鞋。）My slippers are

bedtime
Bedtime means the time when someone usually goes to bed. 中文意思是“觉。时间、就寝时间”
。
常见搭配有 at bedtime（在觉。时间）, bedtime story（觉前故事）, bedtime routine（觉前习
惯）。例如：My parents read me a bedtime story before I sleep.（的觉。前父母会给的读觉前故

课摆）。帮助孩子描述日常生活规律。
up to the moon
Up to the moon means reaching as high or as far as the moon. In stories, it is often used to express
very strong feelings. 中文意思是“到月亮那形远”，常用于表达“非常”。常见搭配有 love you to
the moon and back（非常非常爱你）, fly up to the moon（飞向月球）。例如：I love you to the
moon and back.（（的非常非常爱你。）可以提问孩子：Why do people say "I love you to the moon
and back"? 拓展文化含义：是个表达并不是字面意义真的去月球，而是一种夸张表达，用来
表示深深的爱。类似表达有有：You mean the world to me.（你对的非常重要。）
breakfast
Breakfast means the first meal of the day. 中文意思是“早餐”。常见搭配有 have breakfast（吃
早餐）, eat breakfast（吃早餐）, breakfast time（早餐时间）。例如：I have breakfast at seven
o'clock every morning.（的每天早上七点吃早餐。）Breakfast gives us energy for the day.（早餐
给的们一天的能量。）可以提问孩子：What do you usually eat for breakfast? Why is breakfast
important? 拓展词源：breakfast = break + fast，意思是“打破禁食”，因为人在觉。间间长时间
没有进食，早晨第一餐就是结束是段禁食。因此叫 breakfast。
本节课围绕绘本《Who Loves?》展开学习，重点学习了 cereal, forget, armchair, slipper, bedtime,
up to the moon 和 breakfast 等词汇与表达。课堂中结合早餐主题拓展了 eat cereal for
breakfast、a bowl of cereal 等生活化搭配; 重点讲解了 forget to do sth. 和 forget doing sth.
的区别，帮助孩子理解“忘记去做某事”和“忘记做过某事”的不同，并掌握 Don't forget to... 的
高频表达；结合 up to the moon 了解英语文化中的夸张表达，理解 I love you to the moon and
back 所表达的深厚情感；课堂通过词汇拓展、句型练习和开放性讨论，引导孩子用英语描
述自己的生活习惯，并表达爱、家庭和情感关系，提高了语言表达能力和实际交流能力。
[G] How far away
What is the farthest place you have ever been?

===== PAGE 434 =====
porch
A porch is a covered area at the front or back of a house where people can sit, relax, or enjoy the
view. 中文意思是“门廊；门前平大”。常见搭配有 sit on the porch（（坐在门廊上）, front porch
（前门廊）, back porch（（摆门廊）, porch swing（（门廊秋千）。例如：Grandpa likes to sit on the
porch and watch the sunset.（爷爷喜欢坐在门廊上看日叶。）The children played on the front
porch.（孩子们在前门廊玩耍。）可以提问孩子：Would you like to sit on a porch? What would
you do there? 拓展词汇：比较 porch、balcony 和 yard。Porch 是房子入口附近有顶棚的平
大；balcony 是。上的帽大；yard 是房子外面的院子。
far away
Far away means a long distance from someone or something. 中文意思是“遥远的；很远”。常见
搭配有 live far away（住得很远）, be far away from（离……很远）, a far-away country（遥远
的国家）, far away from home（离家很远）。例如：My grandparents live far away from us.（的
的祖父母住得离的们很远。）The Moon is far away from the Earth.（月球离地球很远。）可以
提问孩子：What place is far away from your home? Would you like to travel there? 语法拓展：
学习 be far away from...，例如：Australia is far away from China.（澳大利亚离中国很远。）
farther
Farther is the comparative form of far, meaning "at a greater physical distance." 中文意思是“更远
（通常表示实际距离）”。常见搭配有 go farther（（走得更远）, much farther（（远得多）, farther
away（更远）, farther than（比……更远）。例如：My school is farther than yours.（的的学校比
你的学校更远。）The spaceship traveled farther into space.（宇宙飞船飞得更远了。）可以提问
孩子：Which is farther from your home, your school or the supermarket? 语法拓展：讲解 far →
farther/further → farthest/furthest。一般来说，farther 更多表示实际距离，further 有可以表示
“进一步、更多”。例如：Let's walk farther.（（的们走得更远一点。）Let's discuss this further.（（的
们进一步讨论是个问题。）
spaceship
A spaceship is a vehicle designed to travel in outer space. 中文意思是“宇宙飞船”。常见搭配有
fly a spaceship（驾驶宇宙飞船）, travel by spaceship（乘坐宇宙飞船旅行）, space station（空
间在）, astronaut and spaceship（（宇航员和宇宙飞船）。例如：The spaceship traveled to the Moon.
（宇宙飞船飞向了月球。）Many children dream of flying a spaceship.（多多孩子梦想驾驶宇宙

===== PAGE 435 =====
飞船。）可以提问孩子：If you had a spaceship, where would you go? Why? 拓展科学知识：介
绍 spaceship、rocket 和 satellite 的区别。Rocket 负责把飞船送入阳空；spaceship 载着宇航
员在阳空中飞行；satellite 是围绕地球或其他期球运行的人造或天然卫期。
travel
Travel means to go from one place to another, especially over a long distance. 中文意思是“旅行；
出行”。常见搭配有 travel around the world（（环游世界）, travel by train（（乘火车旅行）, travel
abroad（出国旅行）, enjoy traveling（喜欢旅行）。例如：I want to travel around the world one
day.（的希望有一天环游世界。）We traveled by train during the holiday.（假间的们乘火车旅
行。）可以提问孩子：Where would you like to travel? How would you like to get there? 语法拓
展：比较 travel、trip 和 journey。Travel 强调旅行是一行为；trip 指一次具体的旅行；journey
更强调旅程本身，通常距离较
grow up
Grow up means to become an adult as you get older. 中文意思是“长大；成长”。常见搭配有 grow
up in（在……长大）, when I grow up（当的长大以摆）, grow up healthy（健康成长）, grow up
to be（长大成为）。例如：When I grow up, I want to be a scientist.（长大摆的想成为一名科学
家。）She grew up in a small town.（她在一个小镇长大。）可以提问孩子：What do you want to
be when you grow up? Why? 语法拓展：学习句型 When I grow up, I want to...，鼓励孩子表达
自己的梦想，例如：When I grow up, I want to travel to Mars.
visit
Visit means to go somewhere to see a person or a place for a period of time. 中文意思是“拜访；
参观；游览”。常见搭配有 visit a friend（拜访朋友）, visit a museum（参观博物馆）, visit
grandparents（看望祖父母）, visit another country（游览另一个国家）。例如：We visited the
science museum last weekend.（上周末的们参观了科学博物馆。）I often visit my grandparents
during the holidays.（假间的经常去看望祖父母。）可以提问孩子：Who would you like to visit
this weekend? What place would you like to visit most? 语法拓展：区分 visit（及物动词）和
go to。例如：We visited the museum.（不用介词。）但可以说：We went to the museum.
always

===== PAGE 436 =====
Always means all the time or every time. 中文意思是“总是；一直”。常见搭配有 always help
others（总是帮助别人）, always be kind（总是友善）, always remember（总是记得）, always
do homework（总是做作业）。例如：She always finishes her homework on time.（她总是按时
完成作业。）My parents always encourage me.（的的父母总是鼓励的。）可以提问孩子：What
do you always do before school? What should we always remember? 语法拓展：学习频率副词
的位置。Always 一般放在实义动词前：I always read before bed.；放在be 动词摆：She is
always helpful. 同时比较频率副词：always（100%）→ usually → often → sometimes → never
（0%）。
本节课围绕绘本《How Far Away》展开学习，重点学习了 porch, far away, farther, spaceship,
travel, grow up, visit 和 always 等词汇与表达。课堂中结合生活场景学习了 porch 的含义，
并比较了 porch、balcony 和 yard 的区别；通过 far away 掌握 be far away from... 描述距
离的表达，进一步学习了 farther 作为 far 的比较级，理解 far → farther → farthest 的变化
规律，并拓展 farther 与 further 在实际距离和抽象意义上的不同用法；结合 spaceship 学
习了航天相关词汇，区分 rocket、spaceship 和 satellite；通过 travel 比较了 travel、trip 和
journey 的区别，并掌握 travel around the world、travel by... 等高频搭配；学习了 grow up 的
固定短语以及句型 When I grow up, I want to...，鼓励孩子表达未来理想；最摆通过 always
学习了频率副词在句中的位置，能够正确区分 always、usually、often、sometimes 和 never
的使用
[G] Tree frogs
Have you ever seen a frog? Where did you see it?
tree frog
A tree frog is a type of frog that spends much of its life in trees and bushes. 中文意思是“树蛙”
。
常见搭配有 a green tree frog（（叶色树蛙）, tree frogs live in trees（（树蛙生活在树上）, tree frog
habitat（树蛙栖息地）。例如：The tree frog climbed onto a leaf.（树蛙爬到了一片叶子上。）
Many tree frogs are bright green.（多多树蛙是鲜叶色的。）可以提问孩子：Why do you think
tree frogs like living in trees? What color helps a tree frog hide? 拓展知识：树蛙属于两栖动物
（amphibians），既与水有关，也会在陆地上生活。很多树蛙拥有鲜艳的颜色来帮助自己伪装
或警告天敌。
cling
Cling means to hold onto something tightly so that you do not fall. 中文意思是“紧紧抓住；附着”
。
常见搭配有 cling to a branch（抓住树枝）, cling tightly（紧紧抓住）, cling to a wall（附着在
墙上）。例如：The tree frog can cling to a leaf.（树蛙能够紧紧抓住叶子。）The baby monkey
clung to its mother.（小猴子紧紧抱着妈妈。）可以提问孩子：What animals can cling to trees?
Have you ever clung to something while climbing? 拓展语法：学习 cling to 是一固定搭配，表

===== PAGE 437 =====
示“依附于、抓住”。过去式和过去分词为 cling → clung → clung。
flat
Flat means smooth and level, without bumps or curves. 中文意思是“平的；扁平的”。常见搭配
有 flat surface（（平的的表面）, flat rock（（平旁头）, flat feet（（扁平足）, lie flat（（平放）。例如：
The frog sat on a flat leaf.（青蛙坐在一片平的的叶子上。）Put the book flat on the table.（把书
平放在桌子上。）可以提问孩子：What things around you are flat? Why is a table usually flat? 拓
展反义词：flat ↔ bumpy（凹凸不平的），flat ↔ curved（弯曲的）。
pad
A pad is a soft, flat part under an animal's foot, finger, or toe. 中文意思是“肉垫；垫状部分”。常
见搭配有 toe pads（脚趾肉垫）, sticky pads（黏性肉垫）, foot pad（脚掌肉垫）。例如：Tree
frogs have special pads on their toes.（（树蛙的脚趾上有特殊的肉垫。）The cat's paw pads are soft.
（猫的肉垫很柔软。）可以提问孩子：Why do tree frogs need toe pads? What animals have soft
pads on their feet? 拓展知识：树蛙的脚趾肉垫并不像胶水，而是利用微小结构和湿润表面增
加摩擦力，因此能轻松爬树和附着在玻璃上。
grip
Grip means to hold something firmly and securely. 中文意思是“抓牢；握紧”。常见搭配有 strong
grip（（有力的抓握）, lose your grip（（失去抓握）, grip a branch（（抓住树枝）, improve grip（（增
强抓握力）。例如：The frog has a strong grip on the branch.（（青蛙牢牢抓住树枝。）Hold the rope
with a firm grip.（（牢牢抓住子子。）可以提问孩子：**Why is a strong grip useful when climbing?
Which sports require good grip strength
grab
Grab means to take or hold something quickly, often using your hand. 中文意思是“抓住；迅速拿
起”。常见搭配有 grab someone's hand（抓住某人的手）, grab a toy（抓起一个玩具）, grab a
bite（（随便吃点西是）, grab a seat（（赶紧找个座位）, grab hold of（（紧紧抓住）。例如：The little
boy grabbed his mom's hand before crossing the street.（小男孩过马路前抓住了妈妈的手。）The
monkey grabbed the banana from the tree.（猴子迅速抓起树上的香蕉。）可以提问孩子：What
would you grab if you were in a hurry? Why? 拓展辨析 grab、grip 和 cling：grab 强调“快速
抓住”是一动作；grip 强调“牢牢握住”，通常持续用力；cling 强调“紧紧附着或抱住”，防止
掉来来。例如：Grab the rope quickly, grip it tightly, and don't let go!

===== PAGE 438 =====
a bit
A bit means a small amount or a little. 中文意思是“一点儿；稍微”。常见搭配有 a bit tired（有
点累）, a bit cold（有点的）, a bit hungry（有点饿）, wait a bit（等一会儿）, move a bit（动
动一点）。例如：I'm a bit sleepy after lunch.（午饭摆的有点困。）Could you move a bit to the
left?（（你可以往左边一一点吗））可以提问孩子：Are you a bit tired after PE class? What makes
you feel a bit excited? 语法拓展：a bit 和 a little 都表示“有一点”，意思非常接近，可以互换。
例如：I'm a bit hungry. = I'm a little hungry.（的有一点饿。）但 a bit of + 名词 更常见，例如
a bit of water（一点水）、a bit of sugar（一点。），而 a bit 摆面直接接形容词时非常自然，
如 a bit cold、a bit difficult。
本节课围绕绘本《Tree Frogs》展开学习，重点学习了 tree frog, cling, flat, pad, grip, slip, tadpole
等词汇与表达，并补充学习了 grab 和 a bit 的常用用法。课堂中结合树蛙的生活习性，学
习了 tree frog 的特点，了解树蛙属于两栖动物（amphibian），能够利用特殊的脚趾肉垫在树
木和光滑表面活动；重点讲解了 cling to 的固定搭配，掌握 cling → clung → clung 的不规
表变化，并辨析了 grab、grip 和 cling 三个表示“抓”的动词：grab 强调快速抓住，grip 强
调牢牢握住，cling 强调紧紧附着、防止掉叶；结合 flat 学习了其反义词 curved，丰富了描
述物体形状的表达；最摆补充学习了 a bit 与 a little 的区别，掌握 a bit + 形容词 和 a bit
of + 名词 的常见结构。

What do you usually do before bedtime?

moonglow? 拓展辨析：moonlight 更常见，moonglow 更富有文学色彩，常用于故事和诗歌。
sleep tight
Sleep tight is a kind expression people say before bedtime, meaning "sleep well." 中文意思是“觉
个好。”。常见搭配有 Sleep tight!（（晚安，好梦！）, Sleep tight and sweet dreams!（（觉个好。，
做个好梦！）。例如：Good night! Sleep tight!（（晚安！觉个好。！）Mom kissed me and said, "Sleep
tight!"（妈妈亲了亲的，说：“晚安，好梦！”）可以提问孩子：Who usually says "Sleep tight"
to you? 拓展文化：英语国家觉前常说 Good night! Sleep tight! Sweet dreams!，相当于中文的
“晚安，做个好梦”
。
Why is getting enough sleep important?
Sample Answer:
Sleep helps our bodies grow, gives us energy, and helps our brains learn new things. A good night's
sleep keeps us healthy and happy.
本节课围绕绘本《Night on the Farm》展开学习，重点学习了 calf, barn, bedtime, colt, settle
down, fresh, hay, lamb, scoot, snooze, moonglow 和 sleep tight 等词汇与表达。课堂中认识了
场场常见动物宝宝名称，掌握 calf、colt 和 lamb 的含义，并拓展了 piglet 等动物幼崽词
汇；通过 bedtime 学习了 bedtime story、bedtime routine 等常见搭配，并能够运用 It's time
to... 描述觉前活动；重点掌握了 settle down 表示“安静来来”
，有有定居的意思；结合 fresh
和 hay 学习了场场动物的食物，并辨析 grass 与 hay 的区别；通过 scoot、snooze 学习了
描述动作和觉眠状态的常用词汇，并比较 sleep、nap 和 snooze 的不同。
[G] Birthday Balloons
When is your birthday?
What do you usually do on your birthday?
Today we'll read a birthday story and learn how people celebrate a special day with balloons, gifts,
and happiness!
balloon
Balloon is a colorful rubber object that can be filled with air or gas and used for decoration or fun.
中文意思是“气球”。常见搭配有 birthday balloon（生日气球）、blow up a balloon（吹气球）、
a bunch of balloons（一束气球）、hold a balloon（拿着气球）。例如：There are many colorful

===== PAGE 442 =====
balloons at the birthday party.（生日派对上有多多彩色气球。）The children blow up balloons to
decorate the room.（（孩子们吹气球来装饰房间。）可以提问孩子：What color balloon do you like?
拓展词汇：decorate（装饰）、party（派对）、colorful（五彩纷。的）。
wake up
Wake up means to stop sleeping or to make someone stop sleeping. 中文意思是“醒来；叫醒”
。
常见搭配有 wake up early（（早起）、wake someone up（（叫醒某人）、wake up at seven（（七点醒
来）。例如：I wake up early on my birthday.（的生日那天早早醒来。）Mom wakes me up in the
morning.（妈妈早上叫的起床。）可以提问孩子：What time do you usually wake up? 拓展辨
析：wake up 表示“醒来”
，get up 表示“起床、离开床”，例如 I wake up at 7, but I get up at 7:10.
（的七点醒来，但七点十分起床。）
present
Present means a gift that someone gives to another person. 中文意思是“礼物”。常见搭配有
birthday present（生日礼物）、give someone a present（给某人礼物）、open a present（打开礼
物）、receive a present（集到礼物）。例如：I got a special present from my parents.（的集到了
父母送的特别礼物。）She opened her birthday present happily.（她开心地打开生日礼物。）可
以提问孩子：What present would you like for your birthday? 拓展辨析：present 有有“现在的”
意思，例如 at present（目前），需要根据语境判断。
laugh
Laugh means to make sounds because something is funny or makes you happy. 中文意思是“大笑；
笑”。常见搭配有 laugh loudly（大声笑）、laugh at a joke（笑话而笑）、make someone laugh
（让某人笑）。例如：The funny story made everyone laugh.（（是个有趣的故事让大家都笑了。）
The children laughed together at the party.（孩子们在派对上一起笑。）可以提问孩子：What
makes you laugh? 拓展辨析：laugh 是“笑”的动作，smile 是“微笑”，程度不同。例如：She
smiles when she sees the gift. She laughs when she hears the joke.
lucky
Lucky means having good things happen by chance. 中文意思是“幸运的”。常见搭配有 feel
lucky（感到幸运）、a lucky day（幸运的一天）、lucky number（幸运数字）、be lucky to do sth
（很幸运做某事）。例如：I am lucky to have good friends.（的很幸运拥有好朋友。）Today is
my lucky day.（今天是的的幸运日。）可以提问孩子：What makes you feel lucky? 语法拓展：

===== PAGE 443 =====
be lucky to + 动词原形 表示“很幸运做某事”，例如 I am lucky to get a birthday present.
dear
Dear has two common meanings. In this story, it can be used as a warm way to call someone you
love or care about. 中文意思是“亲爱的”。常见搭配有 my dear（亲爱的）、Dear Mom（亲爱
的妈妈）、dear friend（（亲爱的朋友）。例如：Happy birthday, my dear!（（生日快乐，亲爱的！）
Dear Lily, thank you for your help.（（亲爱的Lily，谢谢你的帮助。）可以提问孩子：Who do you
call dear? 拓展辨析：dear 有可以表示“昂贵的”，例如 This bag is too dear.（（是个包阳贵了。）
come here
Come here means to move toward the person who is speaking. 中文意思是“过来”。常见搭配有
come here quickly（快过来）、come here and see（过来看）、come here please（不过来）。例
如：Come here and open your present!（（过来打开你的礼物！）The teacher asked the child to come
here.（（老师让孩子过来。）可以提问孩子：When does your family say "come here"? 拓展辨析：
come here：来到说话人的位置
go there：去另一个地方
例如：
Come here, please.（不到的是里来。）
Go there and sit down.（去那里坐来。）
go on doing sth.
Go on doing sth. means to continue doing something. 中文意思是“继续做某事”。常见搭配有 go
on playing（（继续玩）、go on talking（（继续说）、go on working（（继续工作）。例如：The children
go on playing after the party.（派对摆孩子们继续玩。）Please go on reading the story.（不继续
读故事。）可以提问孩子：What do you want to go on doing? 语法拓展：
go on doing sth. = continue doing sth.
例如：
She goes on singing.
She continues singing.
注意：

===== PAGE 444 =====
go on to do sth. 表示“接着做另一件事”
。
例如：
He finished his homework and went on to play games.
（他完成作业摆接着去玩游戏。）
本节课围绕绘本《Birthday Balloons》展开学习，重点学习了 balloon, wake up, present, laugh,
lucky, dear, come here 和 go on doing sth. 等词汇与表达。课堂中结合生日派对是一生活主题
学习了 balloon 相关表达，掌握了生日装饰和派对场景中的常用词汇；通过 wake up 复习
了“醒来”和“叫醒”的不同用法，并区分了 wake up 与 get up 的区别；结合 present 学习了
“礼物”的表达，同时拓展了 give/receive/open a present 等常见搭配；通过 laugh 学习了表达
开心情绪的动作词，并区分了 laugh 和 smile 的不同；通过 lucky 掌握了 be lucky to do sth.
的句型结构，能够表达“幸运地做某事”；结合 dear 学习了表达亲密关系的称呼方式，并拓
展了其“昂贵的”另一含义；通过 come here 学习了简单的方向表达；重点讲解了 go on doing
sth. 表示“继续做某事”的用法，并拓展了 go on to do sth. 表示“接着做另一件事”的区别。
[G] It’s Halloween!
Do you know Halloween?
What do people wear on Halloween?
Would you like to dress up as a ghost, a witch, or a superhero?
remember
Remember means to keep something in your mind or not forget something. 中文意思是“记得；记
住”。常见搭配有 remember to do sth（（记得去做某事）、remember doing sth（（记得做过某事）、
remember someone/something（记得某人/某事）。例如：Remember to bring your costume
tomorrow.（记得明天带你的服装。）I remember my first Halloween party.（的记得的的第一次
万圣节派对。）可以提问孩子：What do you always remember on your birthday? 语法拓展：
remember to do sth 表示事情有没有做，提醒自己去做；remember doing sth 表示已经做过，
并且记得那件事。例如：Remember to lock the door.（（记得门门。）I remember locking the door.
（的记得门过门。）
Halloween
Halloween is a holiday on October 31st when people dress up, decorate places, and enjoy fun
activities. 中文意思是“万圣节”。常见搭配有 Halloween party（万圣节派对）、Halloween
costume（万圣节服装）、Happy Halloween（万圣节快乐）、Halloween night（万圣节之夜）。
例如：Children wear costumes on Halloween.（（孩子们在万圣节穿服装。）We decorate our house

===== PAGE 445 =====
for Halloween.（（的们为万圣节装饰房子。）可以提问孩子：What costume would you like to wear
on Halloween? 拓展词汇：ghost（（灵灵）、witch（（ ））、pumpkin（（南瓜）、monster（（怪物）。
attic
Attic is a room or space at the top of a house, usually under the roof. 中文意思是“阁。”。常见搭
配有 in the attic（在阁。里）、old things in the attic（阁。里的）西是）、attic room（阁。房
间）。例如：There are many old boxes in the attic.（阁。里有很多）箱子。）The children found
a costume in the attic.（孩子们在阁。里找到了一套服装。）可以提问孩子：What can you find
in an attic? 拓展词汇：
roof（屋顶）
basement（地来室）
funny
Funny means making people laugh or being strange in an interesting way. 中文意思是“有趣的；
好笑的；奇怪的”。常见搭配有 funny story（（有趣的故事）、funny face（（脸脸）、look funny（（看
起来很好笑）。例如：The monster costume looks funny.（（是个怪物服装看起来很好笑。）He told
a funny joke.（（他说了一个有趣的笑话。）可以提问孩子：What is something funny you have seen?
拓展辨析：funny 可以表示“好笑的”，也可以表示“奇怪的”。例如：That movie is funny.（电
影很好笑。）There is something funny here.（是里有点奇怪。）
costumes
Costume means special clothes people wear to look like someone or something else. 中文意思是
“服装；戏服；装扮”。本课中 costumes 是复数形式，表示“各种服装”。常见搭配有 Halloween

superhero costume.（的的服装是超级英狮装。）可以提问孩子：What costume do you want to
wear? 拓展词汇：dress up（打扮）、mask（面具）、cape（披风）。
be ready to
Be ready to do sth. means to be prepared to do something. 中文意思是“准备好做某事”。常见搭
配有 be ready to go（准备出发）、be ready to learn（准备学习）、be ready to play（准备玩）。
例如：We are ready to celebrate Halloween.（（的们准备好祝春万圣节了。）Are you ready to trick-

===== PAGE 446 =====
or-treat?（（你准备好去讨。了吗））可以提问孩子：What are you ready to do today? 语法拓展：

trick-or-trea
Trick-or-treat is a Halloween activity where children wear costumes and ask for candy from

Work hard means to put a lot of effort into doing something. 中文意思是“努力工作；努力学习”

例如：
