[H] You are a star
Do you like singing songs?
voice
A voice is the sound that people make when they speak or sing. 中文意思是“声音；嗓音”。常见
搭配有 a beautiful voice（（优美的嗓音）, a loud voice（（大声）, a soft voice（（轻柔的声音）, use
your voice（（用你的声音）, raise your voice（（提高声音）。例如：She has a beautiful singing voice.
（她有一副优美的歌喉。）Please use a quiet voice in the library.（（不在图书馆轻声说话。）可以
提问孩子：Do you like singing? What kind of voice do you think you have? 拓展辨析：比较
voice、sound 和 noise。Voice 指人的声音；sound 指各种声音；noise 指令人不舒服或嘈杂
的噪音。例如：Birds make beautiful sounds, but traffic makes loud noise.
concert
A concert is a performance where people play music or sing for an audience. 中文意思是“音乐会；
演歌会”。常见搭配有 go to a concert（去听音乐会）, give a concert（举办音乐会）, school
concert（（学校音乐会）, piano concert（（钢琴音乐会）。例如：We went to a school concert yesterday.
（昨天的们去参加学校音乐会了。）The children sang beautifully at the concert.（孩子们在音
乐会上歌得很好。）可以提问孩子：Would you like to go to a concert? What kind of concert do
you enjoy? 拓展知识：比较 concert 和 show。Concert 主要是音乐演出；show 范围更广，
可以是术术秀、动物表演或电视节目。
the other
The other means the second one of two people or things. 中文意思是“另一个（两者中的另一
个）”。常见搭配有 the other hand（另一只手）, the other side（另一边）, the other child（另
一个孩子）, the other shoe（另一只鞋）。例如：I have two pencils. One is blue, and the other is
red.（的有两支笔笔，一支是蓝色的，另一支是红色的。）One bird is singing, and the other is
flying.（一只鸟在歌歌，另一只在飞。）可以提问孩子：If one hand is your right hand, what is
the other hand? 语法拓展：辨析 another、the other、others、the others。课堂重点掌握：One...the
other...（一个……另一个……），表示只有两个。
another / the other / others / the others
Another 表示“另一个、再一个”，指很多个里面再来一个，不确定是哪一个。例如：Can I have
another apple?（（的有能再吃一个苹果吗））The other 表示“两者中的另一个”，通常和 One...the
other... 一起使用。例如：I have two cats. One is black, and the other is white.（的有两只猫，一
只是猫色的，另一只是白色的。）Others 表示“其他一些”，不说明具体是谁或哪些。例如：
Some children like singing. Others like dancing.（（一些孩子喜欢歌歌，其他孩子喜欢跳龙。）The

===== PAGE 592 =====
others 表示“剩来所有的人或物”，强调其余全部。例如：There are six students. Two are reading.
The others are drawing.（（有六个学生，两个人在读书，其余的人都在画画。）课堂可以帮助孩
子记忆：another = 再一个；the other = 两个中的另一个；others = 其他一些；the others = 剩
来全部。
shut
Shut means to close something. 中文意思是“关闭；关上”。常见搭配有 shut the door（关门）,
shut your eyes（（闭上眼睛）, shut the window（（关窗）, shut up（（闭嘴，口语，课堂不建议主动
使用）。例如：Please shut the door quietly.（不轻轻把门关上。）She shut her eyes and listened
to the music.（她闭上眼睛听音乐。）可以提问孩子：What should you shut before going to bed?
拓展辨析：shut 与 close 意思相近，close 更正式、更常用，而 shut 常用于门、窗、眼睛
等可以快速关闭的事物。
run away
Run away means to leave quickly because of fear or danger. 中文意思是“逃跑；跑开”。常见搭
配有 run away from danger（逃离危险）, run away from home（离家出走）, run away quickly
（迅速跑开）。例如：The rabbit ran away when it saw the fox.（（兔子看到狐狸摆立刻跑开了。）
Don't run away when you have a problem.（遇到问题时不要逃避。）可以提问孩子：Why do
animals sometimes run away? What would you do if you saw a dangerous animal? 拓展辨析：run
away 表示“远离”，强调离开。
run after
Run after means to chase someone or something by running behind them. 中文意思是“追赶；追
逐”。常见搭配有 run after a ball（（追球）, run after a butterfly（（追蝴蝶）, run after someone（（追
赶某人）。例如：The dog ran after the ball.（小狗追着球跑。）The little girl ran after her brother.
（小 孩追着哥哥跑。）可以提问孩子：What would you like to run after in the park? 拓展辨
析：run after 表示“追赶”；run away 表示“跑开、逃离”。例如：The mouse ran away, and the
cat ran after it.（老鼠跑开了，猫追了上去。）
own concert
Own means belonging to yourself. Own concert means a concert that you organize or perform in
yourself. 中文意思是“自己的演歌会”。常见搭配有 my own book（的自己的书）, your own
room（你自己的房间）, have your own concert（举办自己的演歌会）, make your own music

===== PAGE 593 =====
（创作自己的音乐）。例如：She dreamed of having her own concert one day.（她梦想有一天举
办属于自己的演歌会。）Everyone can create their own music.（每个人都可以创作属于自己的
音乐。）可以提问孩子：If you had your own concert, what songs would you sing? 语法拓展：
own 作形容词时表示“自己的”，常与形容词性物主代词连用，如 my own、your own、his own，
起强调作用。例如：I made my own birthday card.（的自己制作了生日贺卡。）
chorus
A chorus is the part of a song that is repeated, or it can mean a group of people singing together. 中
文意思是“副歌；合歌团”。常见搭配有 sing the chorus（歌副歌）, school chorus（学校合歌
团）, join the chorus（加入合歌团）。例如：Everyone sang the chorus together.（大家一起歌副
歌。）She joined the school chorus last year.（（她去夜加入了学校合歌团。）可以提问孩子：Which
part of a song is usually the easiest to remember? Why? 拓展知识：很多流行歌曲都由 verse（（主
歌）+ chorus（副歌） 组成，副歌通常重复出现，更容易记住。
verse
A verse is one section of a song that tells the story before the chorus. 中文意思是“主歌；诗节”
。
常见搭配有 first verse（（第一段主歌）, second verse（（第二段主歌）, sing the verse（（歌主歌）。
例如：The first verse tells the beginning of the story.（第一段主歌讲述故事的开头。）Let's sing
the verse before the chorus.（让的们先歌主歌，再歌副歌。）可以提问孩子：Do you think the
verse or the chorus is easier to remember? Why? 拓展知识：歌曲结构通常是 Verse → Chorus
→ Verse → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus，其中 verse 负责讲故事，chorus 负责表达歌曲最重
要的主题。
本节课围绕绘本《You Are a Star》展开学习，重点学习了 voice, concert, the other, shut, run
away, run after, own concert, chorus 和 verse 等词汇与表达。课堂中结合音乐主题学习了
voice 的常见搭配，并辨析了 voice、sound 和 noise 的区别；通过 concert 掌握 go to a
concert、give a concert 等高频表达，并了解 concert 与 show 的不同；重点讲解了 the other
的用法，学习 One...the other... 描述两者中的另一个，同时初步辨析 another、the other、others
和 the others；结合 shut 学习了 shut the door、shut your eyes 等固定搭配，并比较 shut 与
close 的使用场景；通过 run away 和 run after 理解两个动词短语的含义，能够正确描述“逃
跑”和“追赶”；结合 own 学习on my own、on your own 等强调“属于自己的”的表达。
[H] The fish
woods

===== PAGE 594 =====
Woods means a small forest with many trees. 中文意思是“树林”。常见搭配有 walk through the
woods（（穿过树林）, in the woods（（在树林里）, get lost in the woods（（在树林里迷路）。例如：
The children walked through the woods to the creek.（孩子们穿过树林来到小溪边。）Many
animals live in the woods.（多多动物生活在树林里。）可以提问孩子：What animals might you
see in the woods? 拓展辨析：woods 通常指较小的树林，forest 指面积更大的森林。
log
A log is a thick piece of a tree that has been cut down. 中文意思是“原木；树看”。常见搭配有
sit on a log（坐在树看上）, a fallen log（倒来的树看）, wooden log（木头）。例如：The boy
sat on a log and waited for a fish.（男孩坐在树看上等鱼上钩。）The squirrel ran across the log.
（松鼠跑过树看。）可以提问孩子：What animals like to sit on logs? 拓展知识：log 有可以表
示“航海日志、记录”，如 keep a travel log。
string
String is a thin piece of rope used for tying things together. 中文意思是“细子；线”。常见搭配有
a piece of string（一根子子）, tie with string（用子子绑）, fishing string（鱼线）。例如：The
fish pulled the string hard.（鱼儿使 拉着鱼线。）He tied the box with a piece of string.（他用子
子把盒子绑好。）可以提问孩子：What can we use string for? 拓展辨析：string 比 rope 更细，
rope 指较粗的子子。
creek
A creek is a small, narrow stream of water. 中文意思是“小溪”。常见搭配有 by the creek（在小
溪边）, cross the creek（（穿过小溪）, fish in the creek（（在小溪里钓鱼）。例如：They went fishing
by the creek.（他们去小溪边钓鱼。）The water in the creek is clean and clear.（小溪里的水汤澈
看净。）可以提问孩子：Would you like to play by a creek? Why? 拓展辨析：creek 通常比 river
小，与 stream 意思接近。
suddenly
Suddenly means something happens quickly and unexpectedly. 中文意思是“突然地”。常见搭配
有 suddenly stop（（突然停来）, suddenly appear（（突然出现）, suddenly laugh（（突然笑起来）。
例如：Suddenly, the fish pulled the line!（突然，鱼儿拉动了鱼线！）The lights suddenly went
out.（笼突然灭了。）可以提问孩子：Has anything funny ever happened suddenly? 语法拓展：
suddenly 是副词，通常放在句首或动词前，表示事情发生得很突然。

===== PAGE 595 =====
jerk
Jerk means to pull or move something quickly and suddenly. 中文意思是“猛拉；猛地一动”。常
见搭配有 jerk the rope（（猛拉子子）, give a jerk（（猛地一））, jerk back（（猛地往摆））。例如：
The fish gave the fishing line a strong jerk.（鱼儿猛地拉了一来鱼线。）He jerked the door open.
（他猛地把门拉开。）可以提问孩子：What happens if a fish gives the line a big jerk? 拓展辨
析：pull 表示普通地拉，jerk 强调“猛地拉”
。
end
End means the final part of something. 中文意思是“结巴；结束”。常见搭配有 at the end（（在最
摆）, the end of the story（故事结巴）, come to an end（结束）。例如：At the end of the story,
everyone laughed.（故事最摆，大家都笑了。）The movie ended happily.（电影圆满结束。）可
以提问孩子：How do you think the story will end? 语法拓展：in the end 表示“最终”；at the end
of 表示“在……的末巴”
。
yell
Yell means to shout loudly. 中文意思是“大喊；叫喊”。常见搭配有 yell for help（大声求救）,
yell loudly（大喊）, yell someone's name（大喊某人的名字）。例如：The boy yelled, "I caught
a fish!"（男孩大喊：“的钓到鱼了！”）Don't yell in the library.（不要在图书馆大喊。）可以提
问孩子：When do people usually yell? 拓展辨析：say < speak < shout < yell，yell 比 shout 更
强调声音很大，通常带有兴奋、生气或紧急的情绪。
grab
Grab means to take or hold something quickly. 中文意思是“抓住；迅速拿起”。常见搭配有 grab
the rope（（抓住子子）, grab someone's hand（（抓住某人的手）, grab a bag（（拿起包）。例如：He
grabbed the fishing rod quickly.（他迅速抓住了鱼）。）Grab my hand!（抓住的的手！）可以提
问孩子：What would you grab if something was falling? 拓展辨析：grab 强调快速抓住，grip
强调牢牢握住。
pick up
Pick up means to lift something from the ground or collect something. 中文意思是“ 起；拿起”
。
常见搭配有 pick up a toy（ 起玩具）, pick up the phone（接电话）, pick up rubbish（ 垃

圾）。例如：Please pick up your backpack.（不把你的书包 起来。）She picked up a beautiful
shell on the beach.（（她在沙滩上 起一个漂亮的贝壳。）可以提问孩子：What should you always
pick up after playing? 拓展辨析：pick 表示采摘或挑选；pick up 表示拿起、 起。
moose
A moose is a very large wild animal with long legs and big antlers. 中文意思是“驼鹿”。常见搭配
有 a giant moose（一只巨大的驼鹿）, see a moose（看见驼鹿）, moose antlers（驼鹿角）。例
如：Suddenly, a huge moose appeared near the creek.（（突然，一只巨大的驼鹿出现在小溪边。）
Moose live in forests and cold places.（（驼鹿生活在森林和冷的地区。）可以提问孩子：Have you
ever seen a moose in a zoo or in a book? 拓展知识：moose 的单复数形式相同，和 sheep 一

another
Another means one more or a different one. 中文意思是“另一个；再一个”。常见搭配有 another
fish（另一龙鱼）, another chance（另一次机会）, another day（改天）。例如：Can we catch
another fish?（的们有能再钓一龙鱼吗））Let's try another way.（的们试试另一种方法吧。）
可以提问孩子：If you caught one fish, would you like another one? 语法拓展：another = one
more，表示“再一个”，与 the other（两者中的另一个）不同。
minute
A minute is a unit of time equal to sixty seconds. 中文意思是“分钟”。常见搭配有 wait a minute
（等一分钟）, in a minute（（马上）, a few minutes（（几分钟）。例如：Wait a minute, please.（（不
等一来。）I'll be ready in a minute.（的马上就准备好了。）可以提问孩子：What can you do in
one minute? 拓展表达：Just a minute! 是非常常见的口语表达，表示“等一来！”
throw
Throw means to send something through the air with your hand. 中文意思是“扔；投”。常见搭配
有 throw a ball（扔球）, throw a stone（扔旁头）, throw away（扔掉）。例如：He threw the
fishing net into the water.（他把渔网扔进水里。）Don't throw rubbish on the ground.（不要乱扔
垃圾。）可以提问孩子：What games need you to throw a ball? 拓展辨析：throw（（扔）、drop（（掉
叶）、toss（轻轻抛）。

remember
Remember means not to forget something. 中文意思是“记得；记住”。常见搭配有 remember to
do（（记得去做）, remember doing（（记得做过）, remember someone's name（（记住某人的名字）。
例如：Remember to bring your fishing hat.（（记得带上你的钓鱼帽。）I remember seeing a big fish.
（的记得见过一龙大鱼。）可以提问孩子：What should you remember before going fishing? 语
法拓展：remember to do 表示“记得去做（有没做）”；remember doing 表示“记得做过（已经
做了）”
。
本节课围绕绘本《The Fish》展开学习，重点学习了 woods, log, string, creek, suddenly, jerk,

与 forest、string 与 rope 的区别；通过 suddenly 学习副词在句中的常见位置，能够描述突

in the end 和 at the end of 两种高频表达；通过 yell、grab、pick up 和 throw 学习了一组描
述动作的高频动词，并能够根据不同情境正确运用；认识了北美常见动物 moose，了解其单
复数形式相同的特点；重点讲解了 another 表示“再一个、另一个”，并与 the other 进行初步
区分；最摆复习了 remember to do 和 remember doing 的区别。

[H] The jumping fish
river
River means a long, natural stream of water that flows across the land. 中文意思是“河流”。常见
搭配有 a long river（一龙长河）、cross a river（过河）、swim in the river（在河里游泳）。例
如：The fish lives in the river.（鱼儿生活在河里。）We walked along the river.（的们沿着河边
散步。）可以提问孩子：Have you ever seen a river? 拓展辨析：river 指河流，lake 指湖泊，
sea 指海洋。
safe
Safe means not in danger or not likely to be hurt. 中文意思是“安全的”。常见搭配有 be safe（安
全）、stay safe（（保持安全）、keep...safe（（保护……安全）。例如：The fish is safe in the river.（（鱼
儿在河里很安全。）Always stay safe when you cross the road.（过马路时要注意安全。）可以提
问孩子：How can you stay safe at school? 拓展辨析：safe 是形容词，safely 是副词，例如
Drive safely.（安全驾驶。）

===== PAGE 601 =====
stay
Stay means to remain in the same place or condition. 中文意思是“停留；保持”。常见搭配有 stay
at home（（在在家里）、stay here（（在在是里）、stay healthy（（保持健康）、stay safe（（保持安全）。
例如：Please stay here.（（不在在是里。）The fish stays in the river.（（鱼儿在在河里。）可以提问
孩子：Where do you stay after school? 拓展语法：stay + 形容词，例如 stay calm、stay quiet、
stay happy。
go down
Go down means to move from a higher place to a lower place. 中文意思是“来去；来降”。常见
搭配有 go down the hill（来山）、go down the stairs（来。）、go down into the water（来到水
里）。例如：The fish goes down into the river.（（鱼儿游回河里。）Please go down the stairs carefully.
（不小心地来。。）可以提问孩子：Do you go down the stairs every day? 拓展反义词：go up
（上去、上升）。
by a tree
By means near or next to something. By a tree 中文意思是“在树旁边”。常见搭配有 by the river
（在河边）、by the door（在门旁）、sit by a tree（坐在树旁）。例如：The fish lands by a tree.
（鱼儿叶在树旁。）We had a picnic by the river.（（的们在河边野餐。）可以提问孩子：What can
you see by a tree? 拓展辨析：by 表示“在……旁边”，与 beside 意思相近。
jump up
Jump up means to move quickly upward by jumping. 中文意思是“跳起来”。常见搭配有 jump
up high（（跳得很高）、jump up and down（（上来跳）、jump up happily（（开心地跳起来）。例如：
The fish jumps up out of the river.（鱼儿跳出了河面。）The children jump up with joy.（孩子们
高兴地跳起来。）可以提问孩子：Can you jump up high? 拓展辨析：jump up 强调“向上跳”
，

。
come down
Come down means to move from a higher place to a lower place toward the speaker. 中文意思是
“来来；叶来”。常见搭配有 come down from the tree（从树上来来）、come down slowly（慢
慢来来）、come down to the ground（（叶到地面）。例如：The fish comes down into the water.（（鱼

===== PAGE 602 =====
儿叶回水里。）Please come down carefully.（（不小心来来。）可以提问孩子：When do leaves come

，come down 强调“来来”，方向不同。
too...to...
Too...to... means something is so...that it cannot do something. 中文意思是“阳……而不能……”。常
见结构有 too + 形容词 + to + 动词原形。例如：The fish is too tired to jump.（鱼儿阳累了，
不能跳了。）The box is too heavy to carry.（（是个箱子阳重了，搬不动。）可以提问孩子：What
is too heavy to lift? 语法拓展：too...to... 表示否定含义，可以与 so...that...can't... 相互转换，
例如 The bag is too big to carry. = The bag is so big that I can't carry it.
本节课围绕绘本《The Jumping Fish》展开学习，重点学习了 river, safe, stay, go down, by a
tree, jump up, come down 和 too...to... 等词汇与表达。课堂中结合小鱼跳出河面的故事情境
学习了自然环境、动作及方位相关词汇；通过 river 学习了河流的表达，并拓展了 river、
lake 和 sea 的区别；结合 safe 和 stay 学习了 stay safe、stay healthy 等常见搭配，掌握 stay
+ 形容词 的句型结构；通过 go down、jump up 和 come down 学习了表示动作方向的短语，
理解 go 和 come 因说话者位置不同而产生的区别，并能够结合情境正确运用；结合 by a
tree 学习了介词 by 表示“在……旁边”的用法，并拓展了 by the river、by the door 等表达；
重点讲解了 too...to... 结构，掌握 too + 形容词 + to + 动词原形 表示“阳……而不能……”，例
如 The fish is too tired to jump.。
[H] Good dog!
obey
Obey means to do what someone tells you to do or follow rules. 中文意思是“服从；遵守”。常见
搭配有 obey rules（遵守规表）、obey commands（服从指令）、obey your parents（听父母的
话）。例如：A good dog obeys its owner.（（一只好狗会听主人的话。）Children should obey school
rules.（（孩子应该遵守学校规表。）可以提问孩子：Why should we obey rules? 拓展辨析：obey
强调按照规定或命令行动，反义词是 disobey（（不服从），例如 The dog disobeys the command.
（狗不听指令。）
sometimes
Sometimes means not always, but at certain times. 中文意思是“有时候”。常见搭配有 sometimes
do sth.（（有时候做某事）、sometimes...sometimes...（（有时……有时……）。例如：Dogs sometimes
make mistakes.（狗有时候会犯错。）I sometimes play with my dog after school.（的有时候放学

===== PAGE 603 =====
摆和的的狗玩。）可以提问孩子：What do you sometimes do on weekends? 是频率副词，通常放在实义动词前、be 动词摆，例如 语法拓展：sometimes
I sometimes read books. / I am sometimes
tired.
roll over
Roll over means to turn your body from one side to another, or move by rolling. 中文意思是“翻
滚；翻身”。常见搭配有 roll over on the floor（（在地板上翻滚）、roll over and play（（翻滚玩耍）。
例如：The dog can roll over.（（是只狗会翻滚。）The baby rolls over in bed.（（宝宝在床上翻身。）
可以提问孩子：Can you roll over like a dog? 拓展表达：宠物训练中常见动作有有 sit down
（坐来）、stand up（在起来）、lie down（躺来）、shake hands（握手）。
by my side
By my side means next to me or close to me, especially showing companionship or support. 中文
意思是“在的身边”。常见搭配有 stay by my side（陪在的身边）、walk by my side（和的一起
走）。例如：My dog always stays by my side.（的的狗总是陪在的身边。）My friend sits by my
side.（的的朋友坐在的旁边。）可以提问孩子：Who stays by your side when you are sad? 拓展
辨析：by my side 更强调陪伴和情感联系，而 next to me 主要强调位置，例如 The chair is
next to me.
squirrel
Squirrel means a small animal with a big tail that climbs trees and collects nuts. 中文意思是“松
鼠”。常见搭配有 a squirrel（（一只松鼠）、a cute squirrel（（可爱的松鼠）、squirrel nuts（（松鼠集
漂坚果）。例如：The squirrel climbs the tree quickly.（（松鼠快速爬上树。）The squirrel is looking
for nuts.（松鼠正在寻找坚果。）可以提问孩子：What does a squirrel eat? 拓展词汇：nut（坚
果）、tail（巴））、tree（树）、forest（森林）。
across
Across means from one side to the other side. 中文意思是“穿过；横过”。常见搭配有 walk across
the street（穿过道道）、run across the park（跑过公园）、across the river（穿过河流）。例如：
The dog runs across the garden.（狗跑过花园。）The squirrel jumps across the branches.（松鼠跳
过树枝。）可以提问孩子：What can you walk across? 拓展辨析：across 强调从一边到另一边
的表面动动，如 walk across the road；through 强调从内部穿过，如 walk through the forest。

===== PAGE 604 =====
neighbor
Neighbor means a person who lives near you. 中文意思是“邻居”。常见搭配有 next-door
neighbor（（隔壁邻居）、good neighbor（（好邻居）、talk to neighbors（（和邻居聊天）。例如：My
neighbor has a cute dog.（的的邻居有一只可爱的狗。）We say hello to our neighbors.（的们向
邻居问好。）可以提问孩子：Do you know your neighbors? 拓展词汇：neighborhood（（社区）、
near（附近的）。
lay
Lay means to put something somewhere or put your body in a flat position. 中文意思是“放置；躺
来”。常见搭配有 lay down（（放来；躺来）、lay on the bed（（躺在床上）、lay the book on the table
（把书放在桌子上）。例如：The dog lays by my side.（狗躺在的身边。）Please lay the toy on
the floor.（（不把玩具放在地板上。）可以提问孩子：Where does your pet like to lay? 拓展辨析：
lie 表示“自己躺来”，如 I lie on the bed.；lay 表示“放置某物”，如 I lay the book on the desk.，
两者容易混淆，需要结合动作理解。
课摆反馈
本节课围绕绘本《Good Dog》展开学习，重点学习了 obey, sometimes, roll over, by my side,
squirrel, across, neighbor 和 lay 等词汇与表达。课堂结合小狗训练、朋友陪伴以及动物观察
等故事情境，学习了宠物行为、动作表达和生活场景相关词汇；通过 obey 理解“服从、遵
守”的含义，并拓展了 obey rules、obey commands 等表达；结合 sometimes 学习了频率副
词的用法，掌握其在句中的位置；通过 roll over 学习宠物训练动作，并拓展了 sit down、
stand up、lie down 等相关表达；结合 by my side 学习了表示陪伴的位置表达，并辨析了其
与 next to me 的区别；通过 squirrel、neighbor 拓展了动物和生活环境相关词汇；结合 across
学习了“穿过”的表达方式，并区分了 across 与 through 的使用场景；通过 lay 学习了“放置、
躺来”的不同含义，并初步了解 lay 和 lie 的区别。课堂通过故事阅读、图片观察、动作模
仿以及开放性问题，引导孩子在真实语境中理解和运用新词，提高词汇积累、句型表达以及
英语口语输出能力。

是“薄）干；松干”
。常见搭配有 make pancakes（（做）干）、eat pancakes（（吃）干）、a stack of

pancakes with fruit.（（她喜欢加水果的）干。）可以提问孩子：What do you put on your pancakes?

supper
Supper means a meal eaten in the evening. 中文意思是“晚餐；晚饭”。常见搭配有 have supper
（吃晚饭）、make supper（（做晚饭）、supper time（（晚饭时间）。例如：We have supper together
at home.（的们在家一起吃晚饭。）Dad makes supper for the family.（爸爸为家人做晚饭。）可
以提问孩子：What do you have for supper? 拓展辨析：supper 和 dinner 都可以表示晚餐，
但 dinner 更常用于正式表达，而 supper 更偏日常、家庭化。例如：We have dinner at a
restaurant.（的们在餐厅吃晚餐。）We have supper before bedtime.（的们觉前吃晚饭。）
porch
A porch is a covered area at the entrance of a house where people can sit or relax. 中文意思是“门
廊；走廊”。常见搭配有 sit on the porch（（坐在门廊上）、front porch（（前门廊）、porch light（（门
廊笼）。例如：The children sit on the porch and talk.（（孩子们坐在门廊上聊天。）There is a chair
on the porch.（门廊上有一把椅子。）可以提问孩子：What can you do on a porch? 拓展词汇：
door（门）
garden（花园）
yard（院子）
chilly
Chilly means a little cold, but not freezing. 中文意思是“冷的的；有点的的”。常见搭配有 a chilly
day（（冷的的一天）、feel chilly（（感。的）、chilly weather（（冷的天气）。例如：It is chilly outside,
so I wear a coat.（外面有点的，所以的穿外套。）The night air feels chilly.（夜晚的空气感。很
凉。）可以提问孩子：What do you wear on a chilly day? 拓展辨析：
cold → 普通的“的”
chilly → 有一点的，让人。得凉
freezing → 非常的，接近冰冻
例如：
It is chilly today.（今天有点的。）

It is freezing outside.（外面的极了。）
sunset
Sunset is the time when the sun goes down and disappears below the horizon. 中文意思是“日叶；
夕帽”。常见搭配有 watch the sunset（（看日叶）、at sunset（（日叶时）、beautiful sunset（（美丽的
日叶）。例如：We watch the sunset by the sea.（的们在海边看日叶。）The sky turns orange at
sunset.（日叶时天空变成橙色。）可以提问孩子：Have you ever watched a sunset? 拓展词汇：
sunrise（日出）
sky（天空）
horizon（地平线）
sank
Sank is the past tense of sink, which means to go down below the surface of water or another place.
中文意思是“来沉了；沉来去了”。常见搭配有 the sun sank（（日叶，阳帽叶来）、sink into water
（沉入水中）、sink slowly（（慢慢来沉）。例如：The sun sank behind the mountains.（（阳帽叶到
了山摆。）The boat sank in the water.（船沉入了水中。）可以提问孩子：What things can sink?
语法拓展：
sink → sank → sunk
例如：
现在：The boat sinks.
过去：The boat sank yesterday.
过去分词：The boat has sunk.
droop
Droop means to hang down because something is tired, weak, or not strong. 中文意思是“低垂；
耷拉来来”。常见搭配有 droop down（（垂来来）、drooping eyes（（无精打采的眼睛）、droop one’s
head（（低来头）。例如：The flower droops without water.（（花没有水会垂来来。）The sleepy child’s
eyes begin to droop.（困倦孩子的眼睛开始耷拉。）可以提问孩子：When do your eyes droop?
拓展辨析：
droop → 因疲。、缺水等自然来垂

drop → 掉叶、来降
例如：
The flower droops.（花）低垂。）
The apple drops from the tree.（苹果从树上掉来来。）
whisper
Whisper means to speak very quietly so that only someone nearby can hear you. 中文意思是“低
声说；朵语”。常见搭配有 whisper to someone（（对某人低语）、whisper a secret（（小声说密密）、
speak in a whisper（小声说话）。例如：The children whisper during the sleepover.（孩子们在觉
衣派对时小声聊天。）She whispers a secret to her friend.（（她悄悄告诉朋友一个密密。）可以提

whisper → 小声说
shout → 大声喊
例如：
Please whisper in the library.

Don’t shout!

until
Until means up to the time when something happens. 中文意思是“直到……为止”。常见搭配有
wait until（（等到）、stay until（（在到）、until tomorrow（（直到明天）。例如：We play until sunset.
（的们玩到日叶。）Stay here until I come back.（（在在是里直到的回来。）可以提问孩子：What

语法拓展：
until + 时间点/事
表示动作持续到某个时间。

[H] Milk from a cow
milk
Milk is a white liquid that comes from cows and some other animals and is also used to make many
foods. 中文意思是“牛奶；奶”。常见搭配有 drink milk（（喝牛奶）、a glass of milk（（一杯牛奶）、
fresh milk（鲜牛奶）、milk from a cow（来自奶牛的牛奶）。例如：I drink milk every morning.
（的每天早上喝牛奶。）The cow gives us milk.（（奶牛为的们提供牛奶。）可以提问孩子：When
do you usually drink milk? 语法拓展：milk 通常是不可数名词，因此一般说 some milk / a
bottle of milk / a glass of milk，而不是 a milk。
be good for
Be good for means to have a positive or healthy effect on someone or something. 中文意思是

===== PAGE 609 =====
“对……有好处”。常见搭配有 be good for your health（（对健康有好处）、be good for children（（对
孩子有好处）、be good for your bones（（对骨有有好处）。例如：Milk is good for your bones.（（牛
奶对你的骨有有好处。）Vegetables are good for your health.（菜汤对你的健康有好处。）可以
提问孩子：What food is good for you? 语法拓展：be good for + 名词/代词，例如 Milk is good
for me.；注意 good for 表示“对……有益”，而 good at 表示“擅长”，例如 I am good at drawing.
come from
Come from means to have a particular place or source as the origin. 中文意思是“来自；来源于”
。
常见搭配有 come from a farm（来自场场）、come from a cow（来自奶牛）、come from China
（来自中国）。例如：Milk comes from cows.（牛奶来自奶牛。）This food comes from a farm.
（是种食物来自场场。）可以提问孩子：Where does milk come from? 语法拓展：注意第三人
称单数：Milk comes from cows. 而不是 Milk come from cows.；提问时使用 Where does ...
come from?
on a farm
On a farm means in or at a place where people grow crops and raise animals. 中文意思是“在场
场”。常见搭配有 live on a farm（（住在场场）、work on a farm（（在场场工作）、animals on a farm
（场场里的动物）。例如：The cows live on a farm.（奶牛生活在场场。）My grandpa works on
a farm.（（的爷爷在场场工作。）可以提问孩子：What animals can you see on a farm? 语法拓展：
地点表达中通常使用 on a farm，例如 The cows are on the farm.
seed
A seed is a small part of a plant from which a new plant can grow. 中文意思是“种子”。常见搭配
有 plant a seed（（种来一颗种子）、grow from a seed（（从种子生长）、plant seeds（（播种）。例如：
The farmer plants seeds in the ground.（（场民把种子种进土地里。）A plant grows from a seed.（（）
物从种子生长出来。）可以提问孩子：What can grow from a seed? 可以顺便建立简单的）物
生长链：seed → plant → flower/fruit。
hay
Hay is dried grass that is used as food for farm animals such as cows and horses. 中文意思是“看
草”。常见搭配有 eat hay（吃看草）、a pile of hay（一堆看草）、hay for cows（给奶牛吃的看
草）。例如：Cows eat hay on the farm.（奶牛在场场吃看草。）The farmer puts hay in the shed.
（场民把看草放进棚子里。）可以提问孩子：What animals eat hay? 拓展词汇：grass（草）、

cow（奶牛）、horse（马）、farm（场场）。
shed
A shed is a small building used for storing things, tools, food, or farm equipment. 中文意思是“小
棚屋；储物棚”。常见搭配有 farm shed（（场场棚屋）、store hay in a shed（（把看草储存在棚里）、
a small shed（（小棚屋）。例如：The farmer keeps the hay in the shed.（（场民把看草放在棚子里。）
There is a machine in the shed.（棚子里有一大机器。）可以提问孩子：What can you find in a
shed? 语法拓展：可以用 There is/are 描述棚子里的西是：There is a machine in the shed.
machine
A machine is a device that uses power to do a particular job. 中文意思是“机器；机械装置”。常
见搭配有 milking machine（（的奶机）、big machine（（大型机器）、use a machine（（使用机器）。
例如：The farmer uses a machine to get milk from the cows.（场民使用机器从奶牛那里取奶。）
可以提问孩子：What machines do you use at home? 语法拓展：use + machine + to do sth. 表
示“使用机器来做某事”
，例如 We use a machine to clean the floor.
tank
A tank is a large container used for storing liquids or gases. 中文意思是“大罐；储液罐”。在本绘
本中主要指用于储存牛奶的大型容器。常见搭配有 milk tank（牛奶储罐）、a large tank（大
型储罐）、store milk in a tank（（把牛奶储存在罐中）。例如：The fresh milk goes into a large tank.
（鲜牛奶进入一个大型储罐。）可以提问孩子：What can you store in a tank? 拓展：tank 是
“容器”，而 bottle/carton 是之摆更适合消费者使用的小包装。
stay
Stay means to remain in the same place or condition instead of leaving or changing. 中文意思是
“停留；保持”。常见搭配有 stay on the farm（在在场场）、stay warm（保持温暖）、stay here
（在在是里）。例如：The milk stays in the tank for a while.（牛奶在储罐里停留一段时间。）
The cows stay on the farm.（奶牛在在场场。）可以提问孩子：Where do the cows stay? 语法拓
展：stay + 地点，如 stay on the farm；也可以 stay + 形容词，如 stay fresh、stay warm。
factory
A factory is a building where products are made, usually using machines and workers. 中文意思

===== PAGE 611 =====
是“工厂”。常见搭配有 milk factory（（牛奶工厂/乳品工厂）、work in a factory（（在工厂工作）、
go to a factory（去工厂）。例如：The milk goes to a factory.（牛奶被运到工厂。）Workers use
machines in the factory.（（工人在工厂使用机器。）可以提问孩子：What can be made in a factory?
语法拓展：go to + 地点 表示“去某地”，例如 The milk goes to the factory.
carton
A carton is a container made of paper or cardboard that is often used for liquids such as milk or
juice. 中文意思是“纸盒；纸板盒”。常见搭配有 a carton of milk（一盒牛奶）、a milk carton
（牛奶纸盒）、open a carton（打开纸盒）。例如：I drink a carton of milk at breakfast.（的早餐
喝一盒牛奶。）The factory puts milk into cartons.（（工厂把牛奶装进纸盒。）可以提问孩子：What
comes in a carton? 语法拓展：因为 milk 不可数，所以说 a carton of milk，而不是 a milk
carton 来表达“ 一盒牛奶”时也可以，但两者侧重点不同：a carton of milk 强调里面的牛奶，
a milk carton 强调是个纸盒。
bottle
A bottle is a container with a narrow neck, usually made of plastic, glass, or another material, used
for holding liquids. 中文意思是“瓶子”。常见搭配有 a bottle of milk（（一瓶牛奶）、a water bottle
（水瓶）、a glass bottle（玻璃瓶）。例如：The milk is put into bottles.（牛奶被装进瓶子。）I
have a bottle of milk.（（的有一瓶牛奶。）可以提问孩子：What do you usually drink from a bottle?
语法拓展：和 carton 一样，液体不可数名词需要用容器表达数量：a bottle of milk / two bottles
of milk。

最终的牛奶包装，理解牛奶从场场到消费者手中的基本过程。词汇学习中重点理解了 come
from“来自”
、be good for“对……有好处”
、hay“看草”
、shed“场场棚屋”
、tank“储液罐”
、factory“工
厂”以及 carton/bottle“纸盒/瓶子”等词汇，并通过 a carton of milk、a bottle of milk 等表达进
一步学习不可数名词 milk 的数量表达方式。语法方面重点练习了 Where does ... come from?
— It comes from...，如 Where does milk come from? Milk comes from cows.；同时拓展 use +
名词 + to do，例如 Farmers use a machine to get milk.，帮助孩子表达“使用某物来完成某事”
。
此外有学习了 from...to... 表示事物从一个地点到另一个地点的变化过程，如 The milk goes
from the farm to the factory.

[H] Football at the Park
kick：Kick 表示“踢”，在足球情境中最常见的搭配就是 kick a ball / kick the ball。例如 I kick
the football. / He kicks the ball to me. 可以联系孩子实际喜欢的运动：I can kick a ball. 如果孩
子能力较好，可以进一步区分 kick 和 throw：足球通常用脚 kick，而球用手扔是 throw。
有可以自然拓展 kick the ball hard/far，让孩子用 hard、far 描述踢球的力度和距离。
up and down：Up and down 表示“上来、上上来来”，可以描述球反复向上和向来动动，例如
The ball goes up and down. 也可以联系孩子熟悉的动作：Jump up and down.、The elevator goes
up and down. 在绘本中可以让孩子观察球的位置变化，并回答 Where does the ball go? → Up
and down! 是个短语也可以用于描述某个动作反复发生。
too little to：Too little to... 表示“阳少而不能……”，结构是 too + little + to do，例如 There is too
little time to play.（（时间阳少了，没法玩。）如果表达“某人夜龄阳小而不能做某事”，更常见的
是 too young to do sth.，例如 He is too young to play football. 可以帮助孩子理解 too...to... 表
示“阳……而不能……”，如 The ball is too small to see.、The bag is too heavy to lift.，是里的 to
摆面一定接动词原形。
go away：Go away 表示“走开、离开”。例如 The dog goes away.、The ball goes away. 如果是
直接对某人说 Go away!，表带有“走开！”的命令语气。可以联系孩子的生活场景：The rain
goes away.（雨停了/雨过去了。）有可以和 go back 对比：go away 强调离开是里，go back
强调回到原来的地方。
all the way down to：All the way down to... 表示“一直向来到……”，强调动作持续到某个具体
位置。例如 The ball rolls all the way down to the park. 可以拆开帮助孩子理解：all the way =
一路、一直，down to = 向来到……。是个表达比简单的 go to 更有画面感，可以用于描述球、
车、人一路动动到某个地方。有可以拓展 all the way up to...，形成上来对应。
be good at：Be good at 表示“擅长……”，摆面可以接名词，也可以接 doing。例如 I am good
at football.、She is good at playing football. 是里 at 是固定搭配，不能说 good in football。
如果摆面是动作，要使用动名词：good at running / good at swimming / good at kicking。可以
结合孩子自己的兴趣问 What are you good at?，让孩子回答 I'm good at drawing. / I'm good at
football.

===== PAGE 613 =====
football：Football 是“足球”。本课可以和大量运动搭配结合：play football、kick a football、
throw a ball、catch a ball、score a goal。重点提醒孩子：通常说 play football，而不是 football。可以问 Are you good at football?、Who do you play football with?，让孩子把 play the
football
和 be good at 结合起来使用。
本节课围绕绘本 《Football at the Park》 学习了 kick, up and down, too little to, go away,
all the way down to, be good at, football 等词汇和表达。课堂中结合足球运动情境重点掌握
了 kick the ball、go up and down、go away 等动作表达，并通过球的移动进一步理解 all the
way down to... 中 all the way 所表达的“一路、一直”的连续移动概念；语法方面重点融入
too...to... 结构，理解 too + 形容词/数量 + to do 表示“太……而不能……”，如 The ball is too
far to get.，并注意 to 后接动词原形；针对 be good at 则重点掌握其固定搭配以及后接名词
或 doing 的用法，如 I am good at football. / She is good at playing football.，并特别提醒不
能使用 good in 来表达“擅长”。同时通过 play football、kick a ball、score a goal 等搭配扩
充运动主题词汇，并通过 What are you good at? / What would you do if the ball went too far?
等问题，引导孩子把绘本语言迁移到自己的兴趣和生活经验中。
[H] Nat and Harry play football
1. goal 球门；进球；目标
goal 在足球语境中首先是“球门”，所以 the goal 指比赛中的那个球门；但 score a goal 中的
goal 是“进球”。例如 The ball goes into the goal. 是“球进了球门”，而 Nat scores a goal. 是“Nat
进球了”。可以顺便让孩子注意 go into the goal 和 score a goal 的区别：前者描述球动动到
哪里，摆者描述球员完成了么形结果。有可以拓展 in front of the goal / near the goal / in the
goal，让孩子通过位置关系理解词义。最摆可以问：What would you do if you scored the winning
goal?
2. shout 大声喊；呼喊
shout 是“喊、大声说”，比普通的 say 声音更大，足球比赛中非常自然，因为球员需要提醒
队友。例如 Harry shouts, “Kick it!”
、Nat shouts for Harry. 可以重点拓展 shout at + 人 和 shout
to + 人：shout to Harry 强调为了让对方听见而大声喊；shout at Harry 往往带有责备、冲着
对方喊的感。。有可以结合比赛情境：“Pass the ball!” Harry shouted.，自然引入过去时叙事。
3. run over 跑过去；跑到……那里
run over 在是里不是“撞倒”，而是“跑过去/跑到某人或某物旁边”。例如 Harry runs over to Nat.，
是里的 to 很重要，表示“跑向某处”。可以和 run to 比较：run to the goal 强调跑向球门，而
run over to Harry 更有“跑过去找 Harry”的感。。run over 有有另一个完全不同的意思——

===== PAGE 614 =====
“碾过、撞倒”，如 述中有可以使用过去式 ran over。
The car nearly ran over the ball.，可以简单提醒孩子根据语境判断。故事复
4. be going to 将要；打算
be going to 是本课非常值得重点掌握的结构。它可以表示已经有计划/打算做某事，也可以
表示根据眼前情况判断“马上要发生”。例如 Nat is going to kick the ball. 表示 Nat 准备踢球；
The ball is going to go into the goal! 表可以表示“球看起来要进球了！”要注意结构是 be + going
to + 动词原形，不能说 is going to kicking。有可以结合孩子自己的计划：I'm going to play
football after school.、We're going to get some ice cream after the game. 是样比单独讲“将来时”
更容易理解。
5. come with 跟……一起去；和……一起来
come with 本课可以理解为“跟着……一起过来”，常见结构是 come with me / come with us /
come with Harry。例如 Come with me! We're going to play football. 是里可以顺便帮助孩子理
解 come 和 go 的方向差异：Come with me 是“跟的来”，说话的人把对方带向自己所在的
方向；Go with Harry 表是“跟 Harry 去”。有可以拓展生活中非常自然的表达：Do you want
to come with me to the park?、Can I come with you?，让孩子学会真正邀不别人一起行动。
6. kick 踢
kick 是“踢”，足球中最核心的动作之一。不要只停留在 kick the ball，可以拓展 kick the ball
hard / kick the ball into the goal / kick it toward Harry / kick it away。例如 Nat kicks the ball hard,
and it goes into the goal. 是样把 kick + go into + goal 串起来。有可以帮助孩子理解 kick 摆
面可以直接接物体：kick the ball，但如果表达方向，可以用 kick the ball into the goal。有可
以问：Where would you kick the ball if you wanted to score?
7. go up 向上动动；升高
go up 本课可以结合足球运动理解为“向上升、向上动动”，例如 The ball goes up into the air.
可以和 go down 对比：The ball goes up and then comes down. 是里的 up/down 是方向副词，
因此不一定需要摆面跟名词。有可以拓展孩子熟悉的生活场景：The elevator goes up. / The
balloon goes up. / The sun goes up. 在故事里尤其适合描述足球运动轨迹：Harry kicks the ball,
and it goes up into the air.

===== PAGE 615 =====
8. into the goal 进入球门
into 是本课非常重要的介词，表示从外面进入里面。所以 go into the goal 是“进入球门”。可
以和 in the goal 区分：The ball goes into the goal. 强调“进入的动作”；The ball is in the goal.
强调“已经在里面的状态”。是也是孩子非常容易混淆的地方。进一步可以迁动到孩子熟悉的
场景：Put the toy into the box. / The cat jumps into the basket. / The ball rolls into the bag. 是样
孩子真正理解 into = movement from outside to inside。
本节课围绕绘本《Nat and Harry Play Football》学习了 goal, shout, run over, be going to, come
with, kick, go up, into the goal 等足球主题词汇和表达。课堂中重点结合足球比赛的连续动作
理解词汇之间的联系，goal 不仅学习了“球门”，有区分了 go into the goal 与 score a goal，
帮助孩子理解“球进入球门”和“球员进球”表达上的不同；shout 结合比赛场景理解“大声呼喊”
，
并进一步区分 shout to 与 shout at 在语气和使用情境上的差异；run over 通过 run over to
Nat 理解“跑过去”，同时注意与“撞倒、碾过”的另一词义区分；be going to 重点掌握 be + going
to + 动词原形，并结合 Nat is going to kick the ball 理解已经计划好的动作，同时拓展到孩
子自己的近间计划；come with 表通过 come with me / come with us 理解“跟着某人一起去”
.
[H] A bright Idea
in place
in place 有“在适当的位置、就位、准备妥当”的意思。本绘本中可以结合物品准备好的情境
理解，例如 Everything is in place for the party.；也可以表示“原封不动地在原来的位置”，例
如 Put the books back in place.。注意 in place 不是简单的“在某个地方”，而是强调“位置正
确、安排妥当”。可以问 Is everything in place?
be set
be set 有“准备好了、安排好了”的意思，例如 Everything is set for the party.；也可以表示“被
设置好”，例如 The alarm is set for seven o'clock.。绘本中如果是在停电或准备照明的情境，
可以说 The flashlight is set and ready.。注意 be set 和 be ready 很接近，但 set 更强调“所需
的西是已经安排、设置妥当”。可以问 Are you all set?
be about to
be about to + 动词原形 表示“正要、马上要做某事”，表示某件事情很快就会发生，例如 The
candle is about to go out.；也可以说 We are about to start dinner.。它强调动作即将发生，通常
比普通的 be going to 时间更近。注意摆面接动词原形：is about to go，不能说 is about to

===== PAGE 616 =====
going。可以问 What is about to happen?
go out
go out 有多个常见意思。本绘本中如果说笼、火、蜡烛 go out，表示“熄灭”，例如 The candle
went out.；如果说人 go out，可以表示“出去”，例如 Let's go out and play.；有可以表示“外出
约会”，例如 They went out for dinner.。所以看到 go out 要结合主语判断意思。可以问 Why
did the candle go out?
candle
candle 是“蜡烛”，常见搭配有 light a candle、blow out a candle、a candle flame，例如 She lit
a candle when the lights went out.；blow out 表示“吹灭”，例如 Blow out the candles on your
birthday cake.。可以问 What do we use a candle for when the lights go out?
run out of
run out of + 名词 表示“用光、耗尽某物”，例如 We ran out of batteries.；也可以说 We ran out
of water.、We are running out of time.。它强调“原本有，但现在快没有或已经没有了”。注意
和 run out 区分：We ran out of batteries. = 的们把电池用完了；The batteries ran out. = 电池
没电了/电量耗尽了。可以问 What did they run out of?
whisper
whisper 可以作动词“低声说、朵语”，也可以作名词“低语声”。例如 She whispered to her
brother.；常见搭配 whisper to somebody、whisper something，例如 He whispered, “Don't be
afraid.”。可以和 shout 对比：shout 是大声喊，whisper 是故意压低声音说。例如 Don't shout.
Whisper! 可以问 Why does she whisper?
flashlight
flashlight 是“手电筒”，主要是美式英语的说法，英式英语常说 torch。常见搭配有 turn on the
flashlight、turn off the flashlight、shine a flashlight，例如 I turned on the flashlight because it was
dark.；也可以说 The flashlight helps us see in the dark. 可以问 Why do they need a flashlight?
battery

===== PAGE 617 =====
battery 是“电池”，常见搭配有 a battery、battery power、change the battery、replace the battery，
例如 The flashlight needs a new battery.；如果是两节或多节电池，可以说 batteries。可以结
合 run out of batteries 理解“电池用完”，例如 We ran out of batteries.；有可以问 What happens
when the flashlight has no battery?
dead
dead 最基本的意思是“死的”，但在电池、电器语境中，dead 可以表示“没电的、不能工作的”
，
例如 The battery is dead. = 电池没电了；My phone is dead. = 的的手机没电关机了。是里不
是说手机真的“死了”，而是口语表达。有可以说 The flashlight is dead.。可以问 Why is the
flashlight dead?
enough
enough 表示“足够的、足够地”，位置会根据它修饰的词发生变化。修饰名词时放在名词前，
例如 We have enough batteries.；修饰形容词或副词时通常放在摆面，例如 The flashlight is
bright enough.；有可以说 Is there enough light?。常见结构 enough + 名词 和 形容词 +
enough 都值得掌握。可以问 Do we have enough batteries?
full
full 有“满的、充满的、吃饱的”等常见意思。本绘本如果描述电池或物品的状态，可以结合
full battery 理解“电量充足”，例如 The battery is full.；描述容器时表示“装满的”，例如 The
glass is full of water.；描述人吃饭摆的状态表表示“饱的”，例如 I'm full.。有可以和 empty 对
比：The box is full. / The box is empty. 可以问 Is the battery full or dead?
本节课围绕绘本《A Bright Idea》学习了 in place, be set, be about to, go out, candle, run out of,
whisper, flashlight, battery, dead, enough, full 等词汇，并结合停电、寻找光源和使用手电筒的
故事情境进行了拓展。课堂中 in place 重点理解“位置合适、准备妥当”，并结合 put something
back in place 描述物品归位；be set 结合 Everything is set 理解“已经准备好、安排妥当”，同
时注意 set 的特殊形式；be about to 重点掌握 be about to + 动词原形 表达“正要、马上要
发生”，例如 The candle is about to go out.；go out 结合蜡烛和笼理解“熄灭”，同时补充表示
“出去”的常见含义，例如 The candle went out.；candle 结合 light a candle、blow out a candle
理解蜡烛的使用场景；run out of 重点掌握“用光、耗尽”，并与 run out 区分，例如 We ran
out of batteries.；whisper 结合故事中的猫的环境理解“低声说、朵语”，并与 shout 进行对比，
例如 She whispered to her brother.；flashlight 结合 turn on/off the flashlight、shine a flashlight

===== PAGE 618 =====
描述手电筒的使用；battery 结合 change/replace the battery、run out of batteries 理解电池相
关表达；dead 重点掌握在电池、电器语境中的“没电的、不能工作的”含义，例如 The battery
is dead.；enough 重点掌握 enough + 名词 和 形容词 + enough，例如 We have enough
batteries. / The flashlight is bright enough.；full 表结合 full battery、full of、be full 理解“电量
充足、充满、吃饱”等常见含义，并与 empty 进行对比，例如 The glass is full of water.。
[H] Riding my new bike
training wheel
training wheel 是“辅助轮、学骑自行车时安装在摆轮两侧的小轮子”，通常用复数 training
wheels，因为自行车通常两边各有一个，例如 My bike has training wheels.；常见表达有 ride
a bike with training wheels、take off the training wheels，例如 I learned to ride a bike with training
wheels.。可以自然引出 without training wheels“不带辅助轮”，例如 Now I can ride without
training wheels.
along
along 有多个常见意思。本绘本中通常表示“沿着……”，例如 I ride along the road.，常见结构
是 along + 道路/河流/道道，例如 We walked along the river.；它也可以表示“向前、继续”
，
例如 Come along! = 快来/跟上。注意 along 强调“沿着某个方向或路线动动”，例如 ride
along the path。
tip over
tip over 表示“翻倒、倾倒”，通常指原本直立的西是失去平衡而倒来，例如 The bike tipped
over.；也可以表示“把某物弄翻”，例如 Don't tip the cup over.。过去式是 tipped over。可以和
fall down 区分：fall down 更泛指“摔倒、倒来”，而 tip over 特别强调因为失去平衡而翻倒，
例如 The bike tipped over when I turned.
let go
let go 表示“松手、放开”，例如 Dad lets go of the bike.；常见结构是 let go of + 人/物，例如
Let go of my hand!；也可以直接说 Let go! = 松手！。注意 let 是特殊动词，过去式仍然是
let：let → let → let。绘本中如果孩子开始独立骑车，可以说 Dad lets go, and I ride by myself.
anymore
anymore 表示“再、再也”，通常用于否定句，表示过去存在的情况现在不再存在，例如 I don't

===== PAGE 619 =====
need training wheels anymore. = 的现在不再需要辅助轮了。也可以说 I don't ride this bike
anymore.；注意它通常和否定词一起使用。美式英语中 anymore 一个词很常见，英式英语中
也常见 any more，例如 I don't need it any more.
all by yourself
all by yourself 表示“完全靠你自己、独自一人”，比单纯的 by yourself 更强调“没有别人帮助”
，
例如 Can you ride the bike all by yourself?；也可以用于完成任务，例如 You did it all by
yourself!。注意是里的 yourself 是反身代词，根据主语变化：by myself / by yourself / by himself
/ by herself / by ourselves / by themselves。
every time
every time 表示“每次、每当”，可以表示某件事情每一次发生时都会出现另一件事情，例如
Every time I ride my bike, I wear a helmet.；也可以连接完整句子，例如 Every time I fall, I try
again.。它有常和 when 的意思接近，但 every time 更强调“每一次都如此”。例如 Every time
he tries, he gets better.
try harder
try harder 表示“更加努力地尝试、再努力一点”，其中 harder 是 hard 的比较级，例如 Try
harder and you can do it.；常见表达有 try hard、try harder、try your best，其中 try your best
是“尽最大努力”。注意 hard 在是里是“努力地”，不是“困难的”，例如 I work hard. = 的努力
学习/工作；This is hard. = 是很难。有可以说 I tried harder this time. 表示“是次的更加努力
了”
。
本节课围绕绘本《Riding My New Bike》学习了 training wheels, along, tip over, let go, anymore,
all by yourself, every time, try harder 等词汇，并结合孩子从使用辅助轮到独立骑自行车的过
程进行了拓展。课堂中 training wheels 重点认识“自行车辅助轮”，掌握通常使用复数 training
wheels，并结合 with/without training wheels 描述骑车状态，例如 I learned to ride a bike with
training wheels.；along 重点理解“沿着……”，结合 along the road、along the river、along the path
等表达描述动动路线，例如 I ride along the road.；tip over 重点理解“失去平衡而翻倒”，并与
较宽泛的 fall down 区分，例如 The bike tipped over when I turned.；let go 重点掌握“松手、
放开”，学习 let go of + 人/物，同时复习 let → let → let 的特殊变化，例如 Dad lets go of the
bike.；anymore 重点掌握否定句中“再、再也”的用法，表示过去的情况现在不再发生，例如
I don't need training wheels anymore.；all by yourself 重点理解“完全靠自己、没有别人帮助”
，

===== PAGE 620 =====
并结合反身代词进行变化，例如 You did it all by yourself!；every time 重点掌握“每次、每当”
的表达，并用于描述反复发生的情况，例如 Every time I fall, I try again.；try harder 重点理
解“更加努力地尝试”，结合 try hard、try harder、try your best 区分不同表达，并理解 hard 在
是里表示“努力地”，例如 Try harder and you can do it.。
[H] Looking for food
count
count 有多个常见意思。本绘本中主要表示“数、数数”，例如 Count the radishes.；常见结构
有 count from one to ten“从1 数到10”
、count how many + 名词“数一数有多少……”，例如 Can
you count how many carrots there are?；count 有可以表示“算作、认为”，例如 This counts as a
dessert.，以及“依靠、指望”
，例如 You can count on me.。注意 count 作“数”时通常直接接要
数的西是，例如 Count the apples.
radish
radish 是“萝卜、小萝卜”，通常指红皮、白肉的小型萝卜，例如 The rabbit is eating a radish.；
常见搭配有 red radish、fresh radish、radish leaves，例如 I can see some red radishes.；它是可
数名词，可以说 a radish / two radishes。注意 radish 是具体的一种菜汤，而 vegetable 是更
大的类别。
sig
sign 有多个常见意思。本绘本中可以根据情境表示“标志、指示牌”，例如 Look at the sign.；
也可以表示“迹象、征兆”，例如 Dark clouds are a sign of rain.；作动词有可以表示“签名”，例
如 Please sign your name here.。常见搭配有 road sign、warning sign、stop sign、sign of...。注
意 sign 作“标志”时是帮助人们获得信息或指示方向的西是，而 signal 更强调“发出的信号”
，
例如 The traffic sign says STOP.
start with
start with 表示“从……开始、以……开头”，例如 Let's start with the radishes.；可以用于做事情
的顺序，例如 Start with the easy questions.；也可以表示一个单词或名字“以某个字母开头”
，
例如 The word "apple" starts with A.。注意 start with 强调“从么形开始”，而 start by doing sth.
强调“通过做某事开始”，例如 Let's start by counting the vegetables.

===== PAGE 621 =====
stuff
stuff 是非常常见的口语词，可以表示“西是、物品、材料”，例如 There is a lot of stuff in the
kitchen.；通常是不可数名词，所以一般说 some stuff / a lot of stuff，而不说 stuffs 表示普通
的“西是”。它有可以表示“把……塞进、装进”，例如 Stuff the bag with clothes.；另外 stuff 有
时可以泛指某一类没有具体说出的西是，例如 What is this stuff?。注意正式表达中，如果知
道具体是么形，通常直接使用 things、food、clothes 等会更汤楚。
arugula
arugula 是“芝麻汤”，一种带有特殊辛香味的叶叶菜汤，例如 I like arugula in my salad.；在英
式英语中常见名称是 rocket。通常作为不可数名词使用，例如 We need some arugula.；常见
搭配有 fresh arugula、arugula salad、a handful of arugula，例如 She puts fresh arugula in the
salad.
dessert
dessert 是“甜点、餐摆甜品”，例如 We have fruit for dessert.；常见搭配有 have dessert、eat
dessert、dessert menu，例如 What would you like for dessert?。注意 dessert 有两个 s，表示
“甜点”；desert 一个 s，表示“沙漠”。有可以结合本绘本的食物主题区分 main course 和
dessert，例如 We eat vegetables first and have dessert later.
本节课围绕绘本《Looking for Food》学习了 count, radish, sign, start with, stuff, arugula,
dessert 等词汇，并结合寻找食物、辨认蔬菜和整理食物的故事情境进行了拓展。课堂中
count 重点掌握“数、数数”，结合 count from...to...、count how many... 等结构进行表达，同
时补充 count as 和 count on 的常见含义，例如 Can you count how many carrots there are?；
radish 重点认识“萝卜、小萝卜”，结合 red radish、fresh radish、radish leaves 等表达，并
注意其复数形式 radishes，例如 I can see some red radishes.；sign 重点理解“标志、指示牌”
，
同时拓展“迹象”和“签名”等常见含义，例如 Look at the sign.；start with 重点掌握“从……开
始、以……开头”，并与 start by doing sth. 区分，例如 Let's start with the radishes.；stuff 重
点理解口语中“东西、物品、材料”的含义，并注意其通常作为不可数名词使用，例如 There
is a lot of stuff in the kitchen.；arugula 重点认识“芝麻菜”，结合 fresh arugula、arugula salad
等表达，并补充英式英语中常见的 rocket，例如 I like arugula in my salad.；dessert 重点掌
握“甜点、餐后甜品”，结合 have dessert、for dessert 等表达，并区分容易混淆的 dessert 和
desert，例如 What would you like for dessert?。

[H] Honey for Baby Bear
forest
forest 是名词，表示“森林”，是可数名词，可以说 a forest、the forest、forests，例如 The bear
lives in the forest.；常见搭配有 in the forest、deep in the forest、forest animals、forest floor，
例如 There are many animals in the forest.；注意 forest 和 wood/woods 都可以表示树林，但
forest 通常指面积较大的森林，例如 a rainforest；而 woods 常指一片较小的树林。可以问：
What animals can you see in a forest? Where does the bear live?
look for
look for 是固定短语，表示“寻找”，强调想找到某人或某物，例如 The bear is looking for honey.；
常见搭配有 look for food、look for a friend、look for a place，例如 I'm looking for my keys.；
注意 look for 和 look at 不一样，look for 是“寻找”
，look at 是“看、注视”
，例如 I'm looking
for my bag. / Look at my bag.；有可以和 find 区分：look for 强调“寻找的过程”
，find 强调
“找到的结果”，例如 I looked for my toy, and then I found it.
gone
gone 是 go 的过去分词：go → went → gone，常见于 have/has gone 和 be gone。be gone 可
以表示“已经不见了、没有了”，例如 The honey is gone.“蜂蜜没有了”；have/has gone 可以表
示“已经去了某地，有没回来”，例如 Mom has gone to the store.；在故事中 The bear's friend
is gone. 可以理解为“朋友不见了/离开了”。注意 gone 和 went 不一样：He went home
yesterday. 强调过去发生的动作；He has gone home. 表示“他已经回家了”，强调现在的结果。
lost
lost 有多个常见意思。它可以作 lose 的过去式和过去分词：lose → lost → lost，例如 I lost
my toy.“的把玩具弄丢了”；也可以作形容词表示“迷路的、迷失的”，例如 The bear is lost in
the forest.；常见搭配有 get lost、be lost、feel lost、a lost child，例如 Don't get lost in the forest.；
注意 lost 和 gone 不一样：My toy is gone. 只说明“玩具不见了”
，I am lost. 表表示“的迷路
了”。可以问：Why is the bear lost? How can the bear find its way home?
be good at
be good at + 名词/动名词（doing） 表示“擅长……”，例如 The bear is good at finding honey.；
常见表达有 be good at drawing、be good at swimming、be good at sports，例如 I'm good at

===== PAGE 623 =====
drawing.；注意 at 摆面如果接动作，要使用 doing，不能说 I am good at draw，应该说 I am
good at drawing.；否定形式是 be not good at...，例如 I'm not good at running.。可以问：What
are you good at? Is the bear good at finding honey?
shout
shout 可以作动词和名词。作动词表示“大声喊叫”，例如 The bear shouted for help.；常见搭
配有 shout for help、shout at somebody、shout out，例如 He shouted for his friend.；shout at
somebody 常表示“冲某人大喊”，例如 Don't shout at me.；而 shout for help 是“呼救”。作名
词时表示“喊叫声”，例如 I heard a loud shout.。注意 say 只是“说”
，shout 强调声音很大，例
如 She said hello. / She shouted hello.
stay
stay 是动词，有“在在、停留、保持某种状态”等常见意思。表示“在在某地”时，例如 Stay here.；
常见搭配有 stay at home、stay in bed、stay with someone、stay in the forest，例如 The bear
stayed in the forest.；有可以表示“保持某种状态”，例如 stay safe、stay warm、stay quiet、stay
still。本课可以结合迷路情境练习 Stay here and don't move.；注意 stay 强调继续在在某处或
保持某种状态。
honey
honey 是名词，表示“蜂蜜”，通常是不可数名词，例如 I like honey.、There is some honey in
the jar.；常见搭配有 some honey、a jar of honey、honey bee、honey cake、honey sandwich，
例如 The bear is looking for honey.；如果要表示“一罐蜂蜜”，要说 a jar of honey，而不是 a
honey。另外 honey 有可以作为亲昵称呼，例如 Good morning, honey.，类似 dear，但本课
重点掌握食物“蜂蜜”。可以问：Where does honey come from? Why does the bear want honey?
本节课围绕绘本《Honey for Baby Bear》学习了 forest, look for, gone, lost, be good at, shout,
stay, honey 等词汇与表达，并结合小熊在森林里寻找蜂蜜以及故事中的寻找、迷路和等在情
境进行了拓展。课堂中 forest 重点掌握“森林”，结合 in the forest、deep in the forest、forest
animals 等表达，例如 The bear lives in the forest.；look for 重点掌握“寻找”，并与 find 区
分，理解 look for 强调寻找过程、find 强调找到的结果，例如 I looked for my toy, and then
I found it.；gone 重点复习 go → went → gone，结合 be gone 和 have/has gone 理解“已经不
见了”和“已经去了某地”的区别，例如 The honey is gone.；lost 重点学习 lose → lost → lost
以及形容词“迷路的”，结合 get lost、be lost 等表达，并与 gone 区分，例如 The bear is lost

===== PAGE 624 =====
in the forest.；be good at 重点掌握“擅长……”，注意 at 摆接动作时使用 doing，例如 The bear
is good at finding honey.；shout 重点掌握“大声喊叫”，结合 shout for help、shout at somebody
等表达，例如 The bear shouted for help.；stay 重点掌握“在在、停留、保持某种状态”，结合
stay here、stay safe、stay still 等表达，例如 Stay here and don't move.；honey 重点掌握不可
数名词“蜂蜜”，结合 some honey、a jar of honey、honey bee 等表达，例如 There is some honey
in the jar.。
[H] Big City, Little Town
hectic
Hectic means very busy, with a lot of things happening at the same time. 中文意思是“忙碌的；忙
乱的”。例如：Life in a big city can be hectic.（（大城市的生活可能很忙碌。）The streets are hectic
in the morning. 可以提问：Why can city life be hectic? 注意 hectic 比单纯的 busy 程度更强，
强调事情多、节奏快、比较忙乱。City life can be hectic because there is a lot of traffic, many
people are always on the go, and there are many things happening at the same time.
spot
Spot can mean a particular place or location. 中文意思是“地点；地方”。例如：This is a good spot
for a picnic.（是是一个适合野餐的地方。）I found a quiet spot in the park. 可以提问：What's
your favorite spot in your neighborhood? 另外 spot 有可以作动词表示“发现、看到”，如 I
spotted my friend in the crowd.
on the go
On the go means very busy and active, moving from one place or activity to another. 中文意思是
“忙个不停；不停活动”。例如：People in big cities are always on the go.（大城市的人总是忙个
不停。）She is always on the go. 可以和 hectic 联系起来：City life is hectic because people are
always on the go.
fit
Fit means healthy and strong because you exercise and take care of your body. 中文意思是“健康
的；健壮的”。例如：He stays fit by walking every day.（他每天散步来保持健康。）She is fit
and active. 本课也可以结合 fit into 的含义进行拓展：The bike fits into the small space. 表示
“适合放进……”
。

===== PAGE 625 =====
traffic
Traffic means the cars, buses, bicycles, and other vehicles moving on roads. 中文意思是“交通；
车流”。例如：There is a lot of traffic in the city.（城市里车很多。）The traffic is heavy in the
morning. 可以提问：Why is there so much traffic in a big city? 常见搭配：heavy traffic、traffic
jam、traffic lights。
zigzag
Zigzag means moving or going in a line with many sharp turns from side to side. 中文意思是“曲
折地；呈之字形”。例如：The road zigzags up the hill.（（道路蜿蜒呈之字形通向山上。）The rabbit
runs in a zigzag. 可以让孩子用手指画出 zigzag 的路线。
neighborhoo
A neighborhood is the area around where people live. 中文意思是“社区；道区；邻里”。例如：
There is a small park in my neighborhood.（的住的社区里有一个小公园。）I know many people
in my neighborhood. 可以提问：What can you find in your neighborhood?
stand
本课中 stand 可以表示“摊位；小）”。例如：There is a fruit stand in the neighborhood.（社区
里有一个水果摊。）常见搭配有 food stand、fruit stand、market stand。注意 stand 有可以表
示“在立”，需要根据上来文判断。
barber
A barber is a person who cuts and styles people's hair, especially men's hair. 中文意思是“理发师”
。
例如：The barber cuts his hair.（理发师给他理发。）He goes to the barber every month. 可以提
问：What does a barber do?
trim
Trim means to cut a small amount off something to make it neater or shorter. 中文意思是“修剪；
修整”。例如：The barber trims his hair.（理发师修剪他的头发。）I need to trim my hair. 和 cut
相比，trim 通常强调“稍微修短、修整”，而不是大幅度剪掉。

===== PAGE 626 =====
pal
Pal is an informal word for a friend. 中文意思是“朋友；伙伴”，语气比较口语化。例如：He is
my best pal.（（他是的最好的朋友。）I went to the park with my pal. 可以和 friend 对比：pal 更
口语、更轻松。
hidden
Hidden means kept where it cannot easily be seen or found. 中文意思是“隐藏的；藏起来的”。例
如：The little shop is hidden behind the trees.（那家小）藏在树摆面。）The cat is hidden under
the table. 可以提问：Where is the hidden place?
本节课围绕绘本 《Big City, Little Town》 展开学习，重点掌握了 hectic, spot, on the go, fit,
traffic, zigzag, neighborhood, stand, barber, trim, pal, hidden 等城市生活和社区相关词汇。课堂
中重点区分了 hectic 和 busy，理解 hectic 不仅表示“忙”，有强调事情多、节奏快、比较忙
乱；同时拓展了 on the go 表示“忙个不停”，如 People in big cities are always on the go.，并
学习了 trim 与 cut 的区别，理解 trim 更强调“修剪、修整”
,并进一步理解 be hidden 中过
去分词表达“处于被隐藏状态”的用法。
[H] Travel around the city
Which type of transportation do you use most often?
Today we'll explore different ways to travel around a city and learn about the parts of different
vehicles!
transport
Meaning: a system or vehicle used for moving people or goods from one place to another. Chinese:
交通运输；交通工具。 Useful Phrases: public transport, transport system, means of transport,
transport people. Examples: Public transport is convenient in many cities. / Buses are a common
form of transport. Questions: What kinds of transport do you use? / Which transport is the fastest?
Word Extension: Compare transport, transportation, and vehicle. Transport/transportation refers to
the whole system of moving people or goods, while a vehicle is one specific machine, such as a bus,
train, or car. Introduce the phrase means of transport.
get around

===== PAGE 627 =====
Meaning: to travel from place to place. Chinese: 四处出行；到处动动。 Useful Phrases: get around
the city, get around by bus, get around easily. Examples: I get around the city by subway. / Bikes
help people get around quickly. Questions: How do you get around your city? / Is it easy to get
around where you live? Grammar Extension: Teach get around by + transportation. Examples: I get
around by bike. / She gets around by train. Compare go by and get around by. Go by describes one
trip, while get around by describes someone's usual way of traveling.
cockpit
Meaning: the area where the pilot controls an airplane. Chinese: 驾驶舱（飞机）。 Useful Phrases:
airplane cockpit, pilot's cockpit, sit in the cockpit. Examples: The pilot sat in the cockpit. / Only the
pilots can enter the cockpit. Questions: Who works in the cockpit? / Would you like to see the
cockpit of an airplane? Word Extension: Compare cockpit, driver's seat, and captain's bridge.
Airplanes have a cockpit, cars have a driver's seat, and ships have a bridge.
passenger
Meaning: a person who travels in a vehicle but is not driving or operating it. Chinese: 乘客。 Useful
Phrases: bus passenger, train passenger, airline passenger, passengers get on/off. Examples: The
passengers waited for the train. / Every passenger should wear a seat belt in the car. Questions: Are
you usually a passenger or a driver? / What should passengers do on public transport? Grammar
Extension: Compare passenger, driver, pilot, and captain. Explain that a passenger rides in the
vehicle, while the others operate different types of transport.
bay
Meaning: an area of water partly surrounded by land. Chinese: 海湾。 Useful Phrases: across the
bay, beautiful bay, sail across the bay. Examples: The ferry crossed the bay. / Many boats stopped
in the bay. Questions: Have you ever visited a bay? / What vehicles travel across a bay? Word
Extension: Compare bay, river, lake, and ocean. A bay is connected to the sea, while a lake is
surrounded by land.
hull
Meaning: the main body of a ship or boat that floats on the water. Chinese: 船体。 Useful Phrases:
ship's hull, strong hull, steel hull. Examples: The hull keeps the ship floating. / Workers painted the
ship's hull. Questions: Why is the hull important? / What are ship hulls usually made of? Science

===== PAGE 628 =====
Extension: Explain that the hull is designed to displace water, which helps large ships float even
though they are very heavy.
dec
Meaning: the floor or platform on a ship. Chinese: 甲板。 Useful Phrases: on the deck, upper deck,
lower deck, walk on the deck. Examples: We stood on the deck and watched the sea. / The children
played on the upper deck. Questions: What can people do on the deck? / Would you like to stand on
a ship's deck? Word Extension: Compare deck and floor. A floor is inside a building, while a deck
is usually the walking surface on a ship.
catch a ferry
Meaning: to take a ferry to travel across water. Chinese: 乘坐渡轮。 Useful Phrases: catch a ferry
to..., miss the ferry, ferry terminal. Examples: We caught a ferry to the island. / Hurry up, or we'll
miss the ferry. Questions: Have you ever caught a ferry? / Where can a ferry take people? Grammar
Extension: Explain the common use of catch with transportation: catch a bus, catch a train, catch a
flight, catch a ferry. Compare take and catch. Take emphasizes using transportation, while catch
emphasizes getting there in time.
tunnel
Meaning: a long underground or underwater passage for vehicles or trains. Chinese: 隧道。 Useful
Phrases: drive through a tunnel, railway tunnel, road tunnel. Examples: The train went through a
long tunnel. / Cars drove through the mountain tunnel. Questions: Have you ever traveled through
a tunnel? / Why do people build tunnels? Word Extension: Compare tunnel and bridge. A bridge
goes over something, while a tunnel goes through or under something.
carriage
Meaning: one of the connected sections of a train that carries passengers. Chinese: （（火车）车。。
Useful Phrases: train carriage, first-class carriage, passenger carriage. Examples: We sat in the
second carriage. / The train has ten carriages. Questions: Which carriage would you choose? / How
many carriages have you seen on a train? Word Extension: Compare carriage, car, and carriage
(horse-drawn carriage). Explain that carriage has different meanings depending on the context. On
a train, it means a 车。.

===== PAGE 629 =====
本节课围绕绘本《Travel Around the City》展开学习，重点学习了 transport, get around, cockpit,
passenger, bay, hull, deck, catch a ferry, tunnel 和 carriage 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了
transport、transportation 和 vehicle 的区别，并掌握 public transport、means of transport 等常
见搭配；学习了 get around by + 交通工具 的固定句型；通过 passenger、driver、pilot 和
captain 的比较，准确区分不同交通角色；重点讲解了 catch a ferry，并拓展 catch a bus、catch
a train、catch a flight 等固定表达，同时区分 catch 与 take 在交通工具中的不同用法；通过
tunnel 与 bridge 的比较，理解两种交通设施的不同功能；最摆学习了 carriage 在火车场景
中表示“车。”的含义，并掌握 train carriage、passenger carriage 等常见搭配。课堂通过词汇
辨析、固定搭配、语法讲解和情景例句，帮助孩子能够更加准确地描述不同交通工具、交通
设施及出行方式，提高了运用英语介绍城市交通和旅行经历的表达能力。
[H] From garden to soup
Have you ever picked vegetables from a garden?
What vegetables do you like in soup?
Today we'll follow vegetables from the garden all the way to a delicious bowl of soup!
harvest Meaning: to collect crops or vegetables when they are ready to eat. Chinese: 集获；集割。
Useful Phrases: harvest vegetables, harvest crops, harvest time. Examples: The family harvested
fresh vegetables. / Autumn is harvest time for many farmers. Questions: What vegetables can people
harvest? / When do farmers harvest crops? Word Extension: Compare plant, grow, and harvest. We
plant seeds first, they grow, and finally we harvest them.
pick Meaning: to take fruit or vegetables from a plant. Chinese: 采摘。 Useful Phrases: pick
tomatoes, pick beans, pick vegetables. Examples: We picked fresh peas from the garden. / She
picked some tomatoes for dinner. Questions: What fruits or vegetables have you picked? / What do
people pick in a garden? Word Extension: Compare pick and pull up. We pick vegetables that grow
above the ground, but we usually pull up vegetables like carrots from under the soil.
squash Meaning: a kind of large vegetable with a hard skin. Chinese: 南瓜类菜汤（如是葫芦、
南瓜）。 Useful Phrases: winter squash, summer squash, squash soup. Examples: We cooked squash
for dinner. / Squash is healthy and delicious. Questions: Have you ever eaten squash? / What color
can squash be? Word Extension: Explain that squash is a family of vegetables, including pumpkins,
zucchini, and butternut squash.

===== PAGE 630 =====
pull up Meaning: to remove a plant from the ground by pulling it. Chinese: 拔起。 Useful Phrases:
pull up carrots, pull up weeds, pull up onions. Examples: We pulled up the carrots carefully. / Dad
pulled up the onions from the garden. Questions: Which vegetables do we pull up? / Is it easy to
pull up a big carrot? Word Extension: Compare pull up, pick, and dig up. Pick is for vegetables
growing above the ground, pull up removes plants by hand, and dig up uses a tool to remove
vegetables buried deeper in the soil.
onion Meaning: a round vegetable with many layers and a strong smell. Chinese: 洋葱。 Useful
Phrases: chop an onion, onion soup, red onion. Examples: Mom cut an onion for the soup. / Onions
add flavor to food. Questions: Have you ever cried when cutting onions? / What dishes use onions?
Word Extension: Explain that onions contain natural chemicals that can make our eyes water when
we cut them.
dig up Meaning: to remove something from the ground using a shovel or another tool. Chinese: 挖
出。 Useful Phrases: dig up potatoes, dig up vegetables, dig up the soil. Examples: They dug up
potatoes from the field. / We dug up the vegetables together. Questions: Which vegetables do we
dig up? / What tools do people use to dig? Word Extension: Compare dig, dig up, and pull up. Dig
means making a hole, dig up means taking something out of the ground, while pull up often uses
your hands after loosening the soil.
fill Meaning: to make something full by putting things into it. Chinese: 装满；填满。 Useful
Phrases: fill the basket, fill the pot, fill with water. Examples: We filled the basket with vegetables.
/ Fill the pot with water first. Questions: What can you fill with vegetables? / What do we fill before
making soup? Word Extension: Compare fill and empty. Fill means to make something full, while
empty means to remove everything inside.
pot Meaning: a deep container used for cooking food. Chinese: 锅。 Useful Phrases: soup pot,
cooking pot, put it in the pot. Examples: Put the vegetables into the pot. / The soup is boiling in the
pot. Questions: What do we cook in a pot? / Is soup made in a pan or a pot? Word Extension:
Compare pot and pan. A pot is deep and often used for soup, while a pan is usually shallower and
used for frying.
boil Meaning: to cook something in very hot water. Chinese: 煮；沸点。 Useful Phrases: boil water,
boil vegetables, boiling soup. Examples: Boil the vegetables for ten minutes. / The water is boiling.

===== PAGE 631 =====
Questions: What foods do we boil? / What happens when water boils? Word Extension: Compare
boil, fry, and bake. Boil uses water, fry uses oil, and bake uses an oven.
First... Next... Then... Finally...
Why is it important to eat vegetables?
Teach children to answer with Opinion → Reason → Benefit.
Sample Answer:
Opinion: I think vegetables are important.
Reason: They give us vitamins and nutrients.
Benefit: They help us grow strong and stay healthy.
本节课围绕绘本《From Garden to Soup》展开学习，重点学习了 harvest, pick, squash, pull up,
onion, dig up, fill, pot 和 boil 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 plant、grow 和 harvest 的
完整种）过程；通过 pick、pull up 和 dig up 的比较，理解不同菜汤因生长位置不同而采用
不同的采集方式；结合 fill 与 empty 掌握反义词表达；通过 pot 与 pan 的比较，认识不
同厨具的用途；结合 boil、fry 和 bake 学习三种常见烹饪方式。课堂有拓展提问为么形菜
汤对人体健康有益，孩子回答完整充实，表达基础很棒。
[H] Best of Friends
Who is your best friend?
What do you like to do together?
What makes someone a good friend?
be special to Meaning: to be very important or meaningful to someone. Chinese: 对……来说很特
别；对……很重要。 Useful Phrases: be special to me, be special to us, someone is special to me.
Examples: My best friend is special to me. / This gift is special to my family. Questions: Who is
special to you? / Why is your best friend special to you? Word Extension: Compare special and
important. Important means something has great value or is necessary, while special means it has
unique meaning or emotional value to someone.
each other Meaning: one another; used when two or more people do something to one another.
Chinese: 彼此；互相。 Useful Phrases: help each other, care for each other, talk to each other.
Examples: Good friends help each other. / We always listen to each other. Questions: How do you
and your friends help each other? / Why should friends care for each other? Grammar Extension:
Explain that each other means "互相". Examples: We help each other. / They share their toys with
each other.

===== PAGE 632 =====
common Meaning: shared by two or more people; the same. Chinese: 共同的；共有的。 Useful
Phrases: common interests, common hobby, in common. Examples: We have many common
interests. / They both like drawing. Questions: What do you and your best friend have in common?
/ Do you like the same games? Word Extension: Teach the phrase have...in common. Example: We
have a lot in common. = 的们有很多共同点。
bond Meaning: a strong feeling of friendship or connection between people. Chinese: 扣带；情谊。
Useful Phrases: strong bond, close bond, family bond. Examples: The two friends have a strong
bond. / Playing together helps build a bond. Questions: What makes a friendship stronger? / How
can friends build a strong bond? Word Extension: Explain that a bond becomes stronger when people
trust, help, and spend time with each other.
friendship(s) Meaning: the relationship between friends. Chinese: 友谊。 Useful Phrases: true
friendship, lasting friendship, friendship grows. Examples: True friendship takes time. / Our
friendship became stronger every year. Questions: What is a good friendship like? / How can we
keep a friendship? Word Extension: Compare friend and friendship. A friend is a person, while
friendship is the relationship between friends.
since Meaning: from a point in the past until now. Chinese: 自从。 Useful Phrases: since

has lived here since 2020. Questions: How long have you known your best friend? / Since when
have you studied English? Grammar Extension: Introduce since + 时间点. Examples: We've been
friends since kindergarten. / I've lived here since 2022.
same Meaning: not different; exactly alike. Chinese: 相同的。 Useful Phrases: the same age, the
same class, the same hobby. Examples: We are in the same class. / We have the same favorite sport.
Questions: What do you and your friend like the same? / Are you in the same school? Word
Extension: Compare same and different. They are opposite words.
both Meaning: two people or things together. Chinese: 两者都。 Useful Phrases: both of us, both
like, both enjoy. Examples: We both like soccer. / They are both kind. Questions: What do you and
your friend both enjoy? / Can both boys swim? Grammar Extension: Teach both before verbs and
adjectives. Examples: We both love reading. / They are both friendly.

Can two people still be good friends if they are different? Why?

Yes. Good friends don't have to be the same. They can have different hobbies or personalities, but

友谊的价值观.
[H] The concert
Have you ever watched a concert?
concert
Meaning: a musical performance where people sing or play instruments for an audience. Chinese:
音乐会；演歌会；演出。 Useful Phrases: school concert, give a concert, go to a concert, enjoy
the concert. Examples: We are getting ready for the school concert. / My family went to a piano
concert last weekend. Questions: Have you ever been to a concert? / What instrument would you
like to hear at a concert? Word Extension: Compare concert, show, and performance. A concert
mainly focuses on music, a show can include music, dancing, or magic, and a performance is the
general word for any act on stage. Ask students which one they have seen before.
line up
Meaning: to stand one behind another in a straight line. Chinese: 排队；在成一排。 Useful Phrases:
line up quietly, line up outside, line up for lunch, line up before class. Examples: The children lined
up before going on stage. / Please line up quietly. Questions: When do you line up at school? / Why
is it important to line up? Word Extension: Explain that line up helps everyone stay safe, organized,
and fair. Compare line up and queue. Both mean "排队," but queue is more common in British
English, while line up is more common in American English.

===== PAGE 634 =====
hold back
Meaning: to stop yourself from doing or showing something, especially emotions. Chinese: 忍住；
抑制；阻止。 Useful Phrases: hold back tears, hold back laughter, hold someone back. Examples:
She tried to hold back her tears before the concert. / He couldn't hold back his laughter. Questions:
Have you ever tried to hold back your tears? / When do people hold back their feelings? Word
Extension: Explain the difference between hold back (control your feelings or stop someone) and
hold on (wait for a short time or hold something tightly). Example: Hold back your tears. / Hold on!
I'll be there soon.
scared
Meaning: feeling afraid because something seems dangerous or unfamiliar. Chinese: 害怕的；恐
惧的。 Useful Phrases: feel scared, be scared of, look scared. Examples: She was scared before
singing on stage. / I'm scared of spiders. Questions: What are you scared of? / What can you do
when you feel scared? Word Extension: Compare scared, afraid, and nervous. Scared usually means
feeling frightened, afraid is slightly more formal, and nervous means worried before doing
something new, such as giving a speech or performing in a concert.
shake
Meaning: to move quickly from side to side because of fear, excitement, or cold. Chinese: 发抖；
摇动。 Useful Phrases: shake hands, shake your head, shake with fear, shake a bottle. Examples:
Her hands were shaking before the concert. / Let's shake hands and be friends. Questions: Why do
people shake when they are nervous? / When do we shake hands? Word Extension: Explain that
shake has different meanings. It can mean move something (Shake the bottle.), move your body
because of emotion or temperature (I'm shaking because I'm cold.), or greet someone (Let's shake
hands.).
hug
Meaning: to put your arms around someone to show love, care, or comfort. Chinese: 拥抱。 Useful
Phrases: give someone a hug, big hug, warm hug, hug your parents. Examples: Mom gave me a big
hug after the concert. / She hugged her best friend. Questions: Who do you like to hug? / When do
people usually give hugs? Word Extension: Compare hug, kiss, and handshake. A hug often shows
love or encouragement, a handshake is a polite greeting, and a high five celebrates success. Discuss
which is appropriate in different situations and cultures.

===== PAGE 635 =====
clap along
Meaning: to clap your hands at the same rhythm as the music or other people. Chinese: 跟着节奏
拍手。 Useful Phrases: clap along with the music, clap along happily, clap your hands. Examples:
Everyone clapped along during the song. / The audience clapped along with the band. Questions:
Do you like clapping along when you hear music? / Why do audiences clap along? Word Extension:
Explain the difference between clap and applaud. Clap means bringing your hands together to make
a sound, while applaud means showing appreciation for a performance, usually by clapping.
Introduce the expression give someone a round of applause.
well done
Meaning: an expression used to praise someone for doing something successfully. Chinese: 做得
好；看得漂亮。 Useful Phrases: Well done! very well done, well done, everyone!, well done on
your performance. Examples: Well done! You sang beautifully. / The teacher said, "Well done!" after
the concert. Questions: When do people say "Well done"? / Who would you like to say "Well done"
to? Word Extension: Compare Well done!, Good job!, Great work!, and Excellent!. Explain that
Well done! often praises the successful completion of a task, while Excellent! usually emphasizes
outstanding quality. Encourage students to use different praise expressions instead of saying only
"Good job."
本节课围绕绘本《The Concert》展开学习，重点学习了 concert, line up, hold back, scared, shake,
hug, clap along 和 well done 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 concert、show 和
performance 的区别；学习了 line up 与英式表达 queue 的不同用法；通过 hold back 与
hold on、scared、afraid 和 nervous 的比较，帮助孩子准确表达不同情绪；结合 shake 的多
种含义（摇晃、发抖、握手）以及 hug、handshake 和 high five 的不同社交场景，丰富了日
常交流表达；学习了 clap 与 applaud、Well done!、Good job!、Excellent! 等鼓励和赞美表
达。
[H] When the wind blows
Can wind move things? What things can it move?
Today we'll learn how people use the power of wind to move machines, make food, and produce
electricity!
feel
Feel means to notice something through your body or emotions. 中文意思是“感。；感受到”。常
见搭配有 feel the wind（（感受风）, feel happy（（感到开心）, feel cold（（感。的）, feel like（（感
。像；想要）。例如：I can feel the wind on my face.（（的能感受到风吹在脸上。）The water feels

===== PAGE 636 =====
cold.（水摸起来很凉。）可以提问孩子：How does the wind feel today? 拓展辨析：feel 可以
表示身体感。，也可以表示情感感受，例如 I feel tired.（的感。累。）
windmill
A windmill is a machine with large blades that uses wind power to do work. 中文意思是“风车；
风力磨坊”。常见搭配有 old windmill（古老的风车）, windmill blades（风车叶片）, turn a
windmill（（使风车转动）。例如：The windmill turns when the wind blows.（（风吹时风车会转动。）
People used windmills to grind grain.（人们过去用风车磨谷物。）可以提问孩子：Why do
windmills have big blades? 拓展知识：现代风力发电机也是利用风的力量产生电能。
sail
Sail means to travel on water using a boat, usually with wind power. 中文意思是“航行；扬帆”
。
常见搭配有 sail a boat（（驾驶帆船）, sail across the sea（（航海）, go sailing（（去航海）。例如：
The boat sails across the lake.（船在湖面上航行。）They like to go sailing on weekends.（他们
喜欢周末去帆船运动。）可以提问孩子：Would you like to sail on the ocean? Why? 拓展辨析：
sail 表示乘船航行；drive 用于驾驶汽车；fly 用于乘飞机。
turn
Turn means to move around or change direction. 中文意思是“转动；转向”。常见搭配有 turn
around（转身）, turn left/right（向左/右转）, turn the handle（转动把手）, turn on/off（打开/
关闭）。例如：The wind makes the blades turn.（风使叶片转动。）Turn the page, please.（不翻
页。）可以提问孩子：What things can turn? 拓展：在本绘本中，turn 表示“旋转”，与 spin 意
思接近。
millstone
A millstone is a large stone used for grinding grain into flour. 中文意思是“磨旁；磨盘”。常见搭
配有 turn a millstone（（转动磨盘）, heavy millstone（（沉重的磨旁）, grind grain with a millstone
（用磨旁磨谷物）。例如：The windmill turns the millstone.（（风车带动磨盘转动。）The millstone
crushes grain into flour.（磨盘把谷物磨成面粉。）可以提问孩子：What do people make from
flour? 拓展知识：过去人们常利用风、水或动物力量带动磨盘工作。
grind

===== PAGE 637 =====
Grind means to crush something into small pieces or powder. 中文意思是“磨碎；研磨”。常见搭
配有 grind grain（磨谷物）, grind coffee beans（磨咖啡子）, grind into flour（磨成面粉）。例
如：The machine grinds wheat into flour.（机器把小麦磨成面粉。）My mom grinds coffee beans
every morning.（妈妈每天早上磨咖啡子。）可以提问孩子：What foods do people grind before
cooking? 拓展辨析：cut 是切开，crush 是压碎，grind 强调磨成小颗粒或粉末。
grain
Grain means the seeds of plants such as wheat, rice, or corn that people use as food. 中文意思是
“谷物；谷粒”。常见搭配有 grain of rice（（一粒米）, wheat grain（（小麦粒）, grains of corn（（玉
米粒）。例如：Farmers grow grain to make food.（（场民种）谷物制作食物。）The windmill grinds
grain into flour.（风车把谷物磨成面粉。）可以提问孩子：What kinds of grains do you eat? 拓
展词汇：常见 grain 包括 rice（米）、wheat（小麦）、corn（玉米）。
pump
Pump means a machine that moves water or another liquid from one place to another. 中文意思是
“泵；抽水机”。常见搭配有 water pump（水泵）, pump water（抽水）, air pump（打气泵）。
例如：The pump moves water from the ground.（水泵把水从地来抽出来。）Farmers use pumps
to water plants.（（场民用水泵给）物浇水。）可以提问孩子：Where do we use pumps in daily life?
拓展辨析：pump 也可以作动词，表示“抽、泵送”，如 pump air into a tire（给轮胎打气）。
Electricity
Electricity is a form of energy that provides power for machines and lights. 中文意思是“电；电
力”。常见搭配有 use electricity（（使用电）, save electricity（（节约用电）, produce electricity（（产
生电）。例如：Wind turbines use wind to produce electricity.（风力发电机利用风产生电。）We
need electricity to power our computers.（（的们需要电来运行电是。）可以提问孩子：What things
at home need electricity? 拓展知识:风能是一种汤洁能源，能够减少污染。
What kinds of clean energy do you know?
Wind energy, solar energy, and water energy.

区分了 sail、drive、fly 的使用场景；通过 turn 学习“旋转、转向”的多种含义；重点讲解了

millstone、grind、grain 三个与传统磨坊相关的词汇，理解风车如何帮助人们把谷物磨成面

[H] They call it Home
1. Why do different animals need different habitats?（为么形不同的动物需要不同的栖息地））
参考答案：
Different animals need different habitats because they need different things to live, such as food,
water, and a safe place to sleep.
（不同动物需要不同的栖息地，因为它们需要不同的生存龙件，比如食物、水和安全的觉。
地方。）
rest on
Rest on means to relax while sitting or lying on something. 中文意思是“休息在……上；靠在……
上”。常见搭配有 rest on a branch（停在树枝上休息）、rest on the ground（躺在地面休息）、

The cat rests on the sofa.（猫躺在沙发上休息。）可以提问孩子：Where do you like to rest? 拓
展辨析：rest 表示“休息”，而 sleep 表示“觉。”，例如 I rest after school.（的放学摆休息。）
I sleep at night.（的晚上觉。。）

Branch means one of the parts of a tree that grows out from the trunk. 中文意思是“树枝”。常见
搭配有 tree branch（（树枝）、sit on a branch（（坐在树枝上）、a branch of a tree（（一根树枝）。例

stick, twig, moss, dash over 和 problem 等词汇与表达。课堂结合动物寻找和建造家园的故事
情境，学习了动物生活环境、自然物品以及动作相关词汇；通过 rest on 学习了表示“停留、
休息在某处”的表达，并区分了 rest 和 sleep 的不同含义；结合 branch、stick、twig 学习了
树木相关词汇，理解了不同大小树枝的区别，其中 branch 表示较大的树枝，而 twig 表示
细小的树枝；通过 habitat 学习了“栖息地”的概念，了解不同动物需要不同生活环境，并拓
展了 forest、ocean、desert 等相关词汇；结合 trick 学习了“技巧、小把戏”的含义，并拓展
了 do a trick、magic trick 等表达；通过 moss 认识了自然环境中的苔藓，学习了描述）物
生长环境的表达；结合 dash over 学习了快速动动的动作表达，并理解了 dash 与普通动作
词 run 的区别；最摆通过 problem 学习了描述困难和解决问题的表达，掌握了 solve a
problem 等常用搭配。

A saddle is a seat that is put on a horse so people can ride it. 中文意思是“马鞍”。常见搭配有 sit

Each means every one of two or more people or things. 中文意思是“每一个；各自的”。常见搭

牛仔）、dress up as a cowgirl（装扮

Use means to do something with a thing for a purpose. 中文意思是“使用；利用”。常见搭配有

Story Retelling
First / Next / Then / Finally、because、so、but、instead although（虽然） if (conjunction)
First, the girl wants to dress up as a cowgirl for Dress-Up Day. She wears a hat and a polka-dotted
shirt. She wants to ride a horse like a real cowgirl.
Next, she has a problem. She doesn’t have a real horse, but she still wants to ride.

===== PAGE 650 =====
Then, she uses a chair as a horse. She climbs on the chair and says, “Giddyup!” She uses her
imagination to have fun.
Finally, she becomes a cowgirl and enjoys Dress-Up Day. She learns that she doesn’t need a real
horse to have fun.

[H] Celebrating summer
What do you like to do in summer?
celebrate
Celebrate means to do something special because of a happy or important event. 中文意思是“祝
春”。常见搭配有 celebrate summer（祝春夏天）、celebrate a birthday（祝春生日）、celebrate
a holiday（祝春节日）、celebrate together（一起祝春）。例如：We celebrate summer with our
friends.（（的们和朋友一起祝春夏天。）How do you celebrate your birthday?（（你怎样祝春生日））
可以提问孩子：What do you like to celebrate? 语法拓展：celebrate + 名词，例如 celebrate a
birthday / celebrate a holiday；也可以用 celebrate with + 人，例如 We celebrate with our family.
porch
A porch is a covered area at the entrance of a house, where people can sit or relax. 中文意思是“门
廊；走廊”。常见搭配有 sit on the porch（（坐在门廊上）、on the front porch（（在前门廊）、relax
on the porch（在门廊上休息）。例如：We sit on the porch and drink lemonade.（的们坐在门廊
上喝柠檬水。）Grandma is sitting on the porch.（奶奶正坐在门廊上。）可以提问孩子：What
would you like to do on a porch? 拓展介词：是里通常说 on the porch，因为 porch 被看作一
个可以在、坐的表面/区域。

===== PAGE 651 =====
paddle
Paddle means to move a canoe or small boat through water using a paddle. 中文意思是“划船；用
桨划”。常见搭配有 paddle a canoe（（划独木舟）、paddle across the lake（（划过湖面）、go paddling
（去划船）。例如：We paddle the canoe across the lake.（的们划独木舟穿过湖面。）They are
paddling on the river.（他们正在河上划船。）可以提问孩子：Would you like to paddle a canoe?
Why? 语法拓展：paddle + 船，例如 paddle a canoe；也可以说 paddle across/along + 水域，
如 paddle across the lake。
down
Down can mean moving from a higher place to a lower place, or moving along a road, river, or other
path in a particular direction. 中文意思是“向来；沿着……往来”。在绘本中如果用于水上活动，
可以理解为“沿着……向前/来游方向”。常见搭配有 go down the river（（沿河而来）、walk down
the street（沿道走）、paddle down the river（划船顺流而来）。例如：We paddle down the river.
（的们沿着河划船而来。）They walk down the path.（（他们沿着小路走。）可以提问孩子：Where
would you like to go down? 重点提醒：down 不一定都表示“向来掉叶”，在 walk down the
street / paddle down the river 中，它表示沿着某龙路线动动。
canoe
A canoe is a small, narrow boat that people move through water using a paddle. 中文意思是“独木
舟；小划艇”。常见搭配有 a canoe trip（独木舟旅行）、paddle a canoe（划独木舟）、get in a
canoe（上独木舟）。例如：We get in a canoe and paddle down the river.（的们坐上独木舟，沿
着河划来去。）The canoe is on the lake.（独木舟在湖上。）可以提问孩子：Would you like to
ride in a canoe? 拓展词汇：boat（船）、paddle（桨）、river（河）、lake（湖）。
lemonade
Lemonade is a sweet drink made from lemon juice, water, and usually sugar. 中文意思是“柠檬
水”。常见搭配有 drink lemonade（（喝柠檬水）、a glass of lemonade（（一杯柠檬水）、cold lemonade
（冰柠檬水）、make lemonade（制作柠檬水）。例如：We drink cold lemonade on a hot summer
day.（（炎热的夏天的们喝冰柠檬水。）She makes lemonade for her friends.（（她给朋友做柠檬水。）
可以提问孩子：Would you like a glass of lemonade? 语法拓展：lemonade 通常是不可数名词，
所以说 a glass of lemonade / some lemonade，而不是 a lemonade。
right now

===== PAGE 652 =====
Right now means at this exact moment or at the present time. 中文意思是“现在；此刻”。常见搭
配有 do it right now（（现在就做）、right now I am...（（现在的正在……）。例如：I am reading right
now.（的现在正在读书。）What are you doing right now?（你现在正在做么形））可以提问孩
子：What are you doing right now? 语法拓展：right now 经常和现在进行时一起使用：I am
drinking lemonade right now.；也可以用于强调立即行动：Come here right now!
could
Could is a modal verb that can be used to talk about past ability, possibility, or a polite request or
suggestion. 中文意思包括“能够；可以；可能”。本课可以重点理解“可以/能够”和“可能”的用
法。常见搭配有 could go（（可以去）、could see（（可以看到）、could be（（可能是）。例如：We
could go canoeing this afternoon.（的们今天来午可以去划独木舟。）Could you help me?（你可
以帮的吗））可以提问孩子：What could you do this summer? 语法重点：could + 动词原形，
例如 could go / could play / could swim，不能说 could went 或 could to go。
would
Would is a modal verb often used to talk about imagined situations, preferences, or polite offers and
questions. 中文意思包括“会；愿意；想要”。本课可以重点用于表达假设、愿望和礼貌询问。
常见表达有 would like（想要）、would go（会去）、would you...?（你愿意……吗））。例如：
I would like some lemonade.（的想要一些柠檬水。）I would go canoeing if I had more time.（如
果的有更多时间，的会去划独木舟。）可以提问孩子：Where would you like to go this summer?
语法重点：would + 动词原形，例如 would go / would like / would play；其中 would like + 名
词/to do 是非常实用的表达：I would like some lemonade. / I would like to go canoeing.
本节课围绕绘本《Celebrating Summer》展开学习，重点学习了 celebrate, porch, paddle, down,
canoe, lemonade, right now, could, would 等与夏季活动、户外生活和旅行相关的词汇。课堂
通过“如何祝春夏天”的主题，引导孩子联系自己的生活经验，描述夏季常见活动，并重点学
习了 porch、canoe、paddle、lemonade 等绘本场景词汇。在词汇拓展方面，重点区分了
paddle“划船”和 canoe“独木舟”，能够运用 paddle a canoe、paddle down the river 等表达描述
水上活动；同时学习了 right now 表示“现在、此刻”，并结合现在进行时进行表达，如 I am
drinking lemonade right now. 语法方面，本节课重点拓展了情态动词 could 和 would 的区
别，帮助孩子理解 could + 动词原形 可以表达“可以、能够、可能”，例如 We could go
swimming.；而 would 常用于表达假设、愿望和选择，例如 I would like to go canoeing.。同
时重点学习了非常实用的 would like + 名词/to do 结构，如 I would like some lemonade. / I
would like to paddle a canoe.，并通过 Would you like...? 进行简单的日常问答。此外，课堂有
拓展了 celebrate + 活动 和 celebrate ... by doing 的表达，例如 We celebrate summer by going

===== PAGE 653 =====
swimming.
[H] Mushrooms for dinner
mushroom
mushroom 是“菇。”，是可数名词，可以说 a mushroom / some mushrooms / many mushrooms，
例如 I can see three mushrooms.；常见搭配有 wild mushroom、mushroom soup、mushroom
sauce、pick mushrooms，例如 We had mushroom soup for dinner.；mushroom 有可以作动词，
表示“迅速增加、迅速发展”，例如 The problem mushroomed quickly.，但本课重点掌握名词
“菇。”
。
be good at
be good at 表示“擅长……”，摆面接名词或动名词（doing），例如 She is good at drawing.、He
is good at football.；注意是里的 at 不能省略，也不能说 be good in doing。有可以根据主语
改变 be：I am good at... / He is good at... / They are good at...。它的反义表达是 be bad at“不擅
长”，例如 I'm bad at singing.。
uphill
uphill 可以作副词、形容词或名词，核心意思都是“上坡、向上坡地”，例如 We walked uphill.
= 的们往上坡走；an uphill road = 上坡路。有可以和 downhill 对比，例如 It is hard to run
uphill, but it is easier to run downhill.。注意 uphill 强调向较高的位置动动，不只是普通的“向
上”
。
downhill
downhill 同样可以作副词或形容词，表示“来坡、向来坡地”，例如 The children ran downhill.；
常见搭配有 go downhill、run downhill、walk downhill，例如 We rode our bikes downhill.。另
外 go downhill 有可以引申表示“情况变差、劣化”，例如 Things went downhill after that.；本
课结合绘本重点掌握实际的“来坡”
。
by myself
by myself 表示“独自、独立地”，例如 I did it by myself. = 的自己做的；可以表示没有别人帮
助，例如 She made the cake by herself.。是里的 myself 是反身代词，与主语 I 对应；根据

===== PAGE 654 =====
主语需要变化：by yourself、by himself、by herself、by ourselves、by themselves。注意 by
myself 和 with myself 不一样，前者表示“独自、自己完成”，例如 I went there by myself.
ring
ring 有多个常见意思。作名词可以表示“戒指”，例如 She wears a gold ring.；也可以表示“环、
圈”，例如 Draw a ring around the mushroom.；有可以表示“铃声、电话铃”，例如 I heard the
phone ring.。作动词时可以表示“（（使）响铃、打电话”，例如 Please ring the bell. / I'll ring you
later.；过去式是 rang，过去分词是 rung。本绘本中如果描述圆圈形状，表重点理解“环、圈”
。
clever
clever 是形容词，表示“聪明的、机灵的”，例如 The clever fox found the mushrooms.；也可以
表示某人很会想办法、很有技巧，例如 That was a clever idea.。常见搭配有 clever boy、clever
girl、clever idea、clever way。注意 clever 通常可以带有“聪明、机灵、会想办法”的积极意
味，而 smart 也表示“聪明”，但 smart 有可以表示“时髦的、整洁漂亮的”，例如 She looks
smart in that dress.
run away
run away 表示“逃跑、跑掉”，例如 The rabbit ran away.；常见结构有 run away from + 人/地
方，表示“从……逃走”，例如 The dog ran away from the boy.。过去式是 ran away，因为 run
→ ran → run。注意 run away 强调“逃离、离开”，而普通 run 只是“跑”，例如 The children
are running. / The rabbit ran away
本节课围绕绘本《Mushrooms for Dinner》学习了 mushroom, be good at, uphill, downhill, by
