[I] Brave Triceratops
thump 可以作动词，也可以作名词，表示“）地撞击；重重地踏；））的声音”。在 Brave
Triceratops 中，可以用来描述恐。重重地踩在地上时发出的声音，例如 The dinosaur thumps
its feet on the ground. 常见搭配有 thump on the ground, thump its feet, thump loudly。例如：
The triceratops thumps the ground with its feet. 和普通的 step 相比，thump 更强调动作很重、
声音很响。类似的拟声表达有有 thud（沉闷的）的一声）。Question: What might make a loud
thump in a dinosaur world?
Tyrannosaurus rex 是名词，通常简称 T. rex，表示“霸王。”。它是一种生活在白垩纪晚间的
大型肉食性恐。，英语中通常说 a Tyrannosaurus rex 或 a T. rex。绘本中可以用 the T. rex 来
指故事里的那一只霸王。。例如：The T. rex is looking for food. 注意 Tyrannosaurus 本身是
属名，rex 在拉丁语中有“国王”的意思，因此是个名字常被理解为“暴君蜥蜴之王”。另外，T.
rex 是专有名称，书写时通常大写并带句点。Question: What would you do if you saw a T. rex
coming toward you?
come down 是动词短语，基本意思是“来来；向来动动”。在故事情境中，可以表示恐。从高
处来来，或者某人从某个地方来来。例如：The dinosaur comes down from the hill.、Come down
from there! 常见结构有 come down from + 地点，如 come down from the tree。注意 come
down 和 go down 的区别：come 强调向说话者所在的位置动动，而 go 强调离开当前位置
向另一个地方动动。例如，如果妈妈在。来，可以说 Come down!；如果孩子自己要去。来，
可以说 I’m going down. Question: Where would you go if you saw a T. rex coming down the hill?
dinosaur 是名词，表示“恐。”。是是一个可数名词，可以说 a dinosaur, two dinosaurs, many
dinosaurs。常见搭配有 a big dinosaur, a dangerous dinosaur, a meat-eating dinosaur, a dinosaur
egg。例如：The dinosaur has a long tail and strong legs. 绘本中可以进一步通过 dinosaur 的不
同种类扩展，例如 Tyrannosaurus rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus 等。注意英语中的 dinosaur 只
是总称，具体某一种恐。要使用具体名称。Question: Which dinosaur would you like to learn
more about?

===== PAGE 707 =====
hide 是动词，表示“躲藏；藏起来”，也可以表示“把某物藏起来”。在绘本中，面对 T. rex 时，
hide 是一个非常自然的动作：The triceratops hides behind the trees. 常见搭配有 hide behind,
hide under, hide in, hide from someone/something。例如：The little dinosaur hides behind a rock.
注意 hide 的过去式是 hid，过去分词是 hidden：hide – hid – hidden，不要说 hided。另外，
hide 和 run away 不一样：hide 是“躲起来”
，run away 是“跑开、逃走”
。Question: Where would
you hide if a T. rex came near you?
Triceratops 是名词，表示“三角。”，是一种有三个角和大型头盾的草食性恐。。名字中的 tri-
可以帮助孩子理解“three”的概念，因此 Triceratops 可以简单理解为“有三个角的恐。”。常见
表达有 a Triceratops, Triceratops horns, a Triceratops has three horns。例如：The Triceratops uses
its horns to protect itself. 注意 Triceratops 是具体恐。名称，首字母通常大写；如果说多个，
可以说 Triceratops，形式不变。绘本中可以让孩子观察它和 T. rex 的区别：A Triceratops has
horns and eats plants, while a T. rex has sharp teeth and eats meat. Question: How could a
Triceratops use its horns to protect itself?
run away 是动词短语，表示“跑开；逃跑”。当一个人或动物因为害怕、危险等原因快速离开
时，可以使用 run away。例如：The little dinosaur runs away from the T. rex. 常见搭配有 run
away from someone/something, run away quickly, run away to safety。注意 run away 强调“离开
危险或当前位置”，而 run to 强调“跑向某个地方”：The dinosaur runs away from the T. rex and
runs to its mother. 过去式是 ran away，不是 runned away。Question: Would you hide or run
away if you saw a dangerous dinosaur? Why?
horn 是名词，表示“角；犄角”。在本绘本中主要指 Triceratops 的角。常见搭配有 sharp horns,
long horns, three horns, use its horns, horns on its head。例如：The Triceratops has three sharp
horns on its head. 注意 horn 和 tusk 不一样：horn 通常是角，而 tusk 是长在嘴边、向外伸
出的獠牙，例如 elephants have tusks。有可以说 horns 复数，因为 Triceratops has three horns。
Question: Why do you think the Triceratops has horns?
stay away 是动词短语，表示“离……远一点；不要靠近”。常见结构是 stay away from + 人/动
物/地方/西是。例如：Stay away from the T. rex!、The little dinosaurs stay away from danger. 它
通常用于提醒或警告某人不要接近危险的西是。注意 stay away 和 go away 不一样：stay
away 是“不要靠近、保持距离”，而 go away 是“离开是里”。例如：Stay away from the fire. =
不要靠近火；Go away! = 走开！Question: What would you tell your friend to do if a T. rex were

nearby?
brave 是形容词，表示“勇敢的”
。A brave person or animal does something difficult or dangerous
even when they feel afraid. 在绘本中，brave Triceratops 指“勇敢的三角。”，它可能面对 T. rex
时没有轻易逃跑，而是保护自己或其他恐。。常见搭配有 be brave, a brave boy/girl, a brave
animal, brave enough to do something。例如：The Triceratops is brave enough to protect its family.
注意 brave 并不意味着“完全不害怕”，真正的 bravery 是“即使害怕，仍然做应该做的事情”
。
例如：She was scared, but she was brave. 是是本绘本非常值得孩子理解的主题。Question: What
makes the Triceratops brave?
主要围绕绘本 Brave Triceratops 展开学习，exploring how a Triceratops reacts when it meets a
dangerous Tyrannosaurus rex and what it means to be brave in a difficult situation. 本节课重点学
习了 thump, Tyrannosaurus rex, come down, dinosaur, hide, Triceratops, run away, horn, stay away
和 brave，并结合故事情节理解是些词汇在具体场景中的使用。During the lesson, we practiced
action expressions such as thump, come down, hide and run away，并通过故事中的 danger
situation 理解不同动作之间的区别。孩子能够根据图片判断 when the dinosaurs are in danger
and explain whether they should hide, run away or stay away from the T. rex。在学习 Triceratops
时，孩子能够观察它的 three horns，并理解 horns can help protect the dinosaur；同时通过 T.
rex 和 Triceratops 的对比进一步了解了 herbivorous and meat-eating dinosaurs 的基本区别。
对于 brave，表结合故事中的角色行为理解“勇敢并不意味着完全不害怕，而是即使害怕也能
够面对困难”，孩子能够在老师引导来思考 what makes the Triceratops brave。课堂互动过程
中，孩子参与度较好，能够根据故事画面回答 What happened? Where did the dinosaur go? Why
did it hide/run away? 等问题，并尝试用完整句子描述 characters' actions and feelings。整体来
说，孩子对故事情节理解比较扎实，target vocabulary 的运用也比较自然，尤其是在描述
danger, actions and bravery 时能够加入简单的原因和判断。
[I] A New Word
wooden
Wooden means “made of wood”，表示“木制的、木头做的”，是形容词，由 wood + -en 构成。
最常见的结构是 wooden + 名词，例如 a wooden box, a wooden chair, a wooden toy。在绘本
A New Word 中，如果故事里出现木制的物品，可以说 The child has a wooden toy. 注意 wood
是“木头、木材”，通常是不可数名词；wooden 表是形容词，用来描述“由木头制成的西是”
。
例如 This table is made of wood. 和 This is a wooden table. 意思接近。有可以对比 plastic →
plastic toy、metal → metal box。可以问：What wooden things can you see in your home?

===== PAGE 709 =====
purse
Purse 是可数名词，主要表示“ 士手提包、小钱包”，具体含义会因英语地区而有所不同。
在美式英语中，purse 通常指 士随身携带的手提包；在英式英语中，purse 更常指小钱包，
尤其是放零钱的钱包，而较大的手提包通常叫 handbag。在故事中如果角色拿着一个小包，
可以说 She has a purse in her hand. 常见搭配有 carry a purse, open a purse, put something in a
purse, take something out of a purse。注意 purse 和 backpack 不一样：purse 通常用手或肩膀
携带，而 backpack 背在背上。例如：She carries a purse, but the boy carries a backpack. 可以
问：What would you put inside your purse?
toddle into
Toddle means “to walk slowly and unsteadily like a young child”，表示“摇摇晃晃地走、蹒跚学
步”，尤其用于刚学会走路的小孩子。Toddle into + 地点 就是“蹒跚走进……”，例如 The little
girl toddled into the room. 在绘本中，是个表达非常适合描述幼儿自己走进房间或走向某个
人。常见搭配有 toddle into the room, toddle over to someone, toddle along。注意 toddle 本身
已经带有“小步、走得不阳稳”的感。，因此和普通的 walk 不完全一样；walk into the room
只是“走进房间”，而 toddle into the room 能让的们想象一个小宝宝摇摇晃晃地走进去。可以
问：Where might a little child toddle into?
point to
Point to means “to show or indicate something by using your finger”，表示“指向、指着”，是非常
常见的动作表达。基本结构是 point to + 人/物：Point to the picture. = “指一来图片。”；She
pointed to the wooden box. = “她指着那个木盒子。”注意 point to 和 point at 都可以表示“指
着”，但 point to 很常用于“指给某人看某个西是”，而 point at 有时更强调手指直接朝向某
人或某物。例如 She pointed to the door. 在课堂中，老师也经常说 Can you point to the word?。
过去式是 pointed。可以问：What would you point to if you saw something surprising?
backpack
Backpack means “a bag that you carry on your back”，表示“背包”，是可数名词：a backpack, two
backpacks。它由 back + pack 构成，可以理解为“背在背上的包”。常见搭配有 carry a backpack,
wear a backpack, put something in your backpack, take something out of your backpack。例如：I
put my books and lunch in my backpack. 注意 backpack 是名词，也可以作动词表示“背着背
包旅行”，但孩子首先掌握名词用法即可。可以和 purse 对比：She carries a purse, while he
carries a backpack. 在日常学校场景中有可以说 school backpack。可以问：What do you usually
carry in your backpack?

===== PAGE 710 =====
thought
Thought 是 think 的过去式和过去分词，同时也可以作名词表示“想法、念头”。在绘本 A New
Word 中，如果故事人物产生了一个想法，thought 很可能是名词，例如 I had a thought. = “的
有一个想法。”常见搭配有 a thought, a good thought, a strange thought, have a thought, give
something some thought。作为动词 think 的过去式时，例如 She thought about the new word.
=
“她想了想是个新单词。”一定要注意 think → thought 是不规表变化，不能说 thinked。另
外 thought 和 idea 都可以表示“想法”，但 idea 更常用于具体的主意、方案，而 thought 可
以表示是海里出现的一种念头或思考。可以问：What was the first thought you had when you
learned a new word?
since
Since 有几个重要用法。在是个绘本语境中，如果它表示时间，通常是“自从……以来”，摆面
接一个过去的时间点或过去发生的事件：I have known this word since Monday. = “的从期间一
开始就知道是个词。”常见结构是 have/has + 过去分词 + since + 时间点/过去时句子，例如
She has been happy since she learned the new word. 是里 since 强调“从过去某个时间开始，一
直到现在”。它有可以表示“因为”，例如 Since you are here, let's start. = “既然你在是里，的们
就开始吧。”不过是个意义在日常口语中通常 because 更直接。特别要区分 since + 时间点
和 for + 时间段：I have lived here since 2020.（从2020 夜起）vs I have lived here for six years.
（已经六夜）。可以问：What have you learned since you started school?
comforting
Comforting means “making someone feel calmer, safer, or less worried”，表示“令人感到安慰的、
让人安心的”，是形容词，来自 comfort。例如：Her mum's voice was comforting. = “妈妈的声
音让她感到安心。”常见搭配有 a comforting voice, a comforting hug, a comforting feeling,
something comforting。注意 comforting 和 comfortable 不一样：comfortable 是“让自己感。
舒适的”，例如 a comfortable bed；comforting 表是“让人感到安慰、安心的”，例如 a comforting
hug。有要区分 comforted：I felt comforted by her words. 表示“的因为她的话得到了安慰”
。
也就是说，comforting 通常描述“带来安慰的西是”，而 comforted 描述“受到安慰的人”。可
以问：What is something comforting that makes you feel safe and happy?
主要围绕 A New Word 展开学习，孩子掌握了 wooden, purse, toddle into, point to, backpack,
thought, since, comforting 等词汇和表达，并能够结合故事情境理解）物的动作、物品以及
情绪变化。课堂中重点练习了 toddle into 和 point to 等动作表达，以及 think → thought 的

===== PAGE 711 =====
不规则变化，同时通过 since 初步接触了“从过去某个时间一直到现在”的表达方式。孩子能
够根据图片指出故事中的）物和物品，并尝试使用 target vocabulary 进行简单描述；在理解
comforting 时，也能够联系生活中让自己感到安全、安心的事物。整体参与度不错，回答问
题时有一定主动性，后续可以继续鼓励孩子使用 because 或 since 补充原因和背景，让句子
从简单描述进一步发展成更完整的表达。
[I] Stars
When was the last time you looked at the stars?
Today we'll travel into space to discover what stars are made of, why they shine, and how some stars
even become mysterious black holes!
because of
Meaning: for the reason of; due to. Chinese: 因为；由于。 Useful Phrases: because of the rain,
because of the weather, because of gravity, because of pollution. Examples: The stars look small
because of their great distance. / The game was canceled because of the rain. Questions: Why do
stars look tiny? / What activities have you canceled because of bad weather? Grammar Extension:
Compare because and because of. Because + sentence (Because it rained, we stayed home.) while
because of + noun/noun phrase (Because of the rain, we stayed home.).
thousands of
Meaning: a very large number of something. Chinese: 数以千计的。 Useful Phrases: thousands
of stars, thousands of people, thousands of books. Examples: Thousands of stars fill the night sky. /
Thousands of people visited the museum. Questions: What can you see thousands of in nature? /
Have you ever seen thousands of lights at night? Grammar Extension: Explain number + of
expressions:
hundreds of
thousands of
millions of
billions of These expressions mean "a very large number."
away
Meaning: at a distance from someone or something. Chinese: 远离；离开。 Useful Phrases: far

===== PAGE 712 =====
away, move away, walk away, fly away. Examples: The nearest star is very far away. / The bird flew
away. Questions: Which country is far away from China? / How far away is your school? Grammar
Extension: Teach far away from... Examples: The Moon is far away from Earth. / Australia is far
away from Europe.
be made up of
Meaning: to consist of; to be formed from. Chinese: 由……组成。 Useful Phrases: be made up of
gas, be made up of people, be made up of cells. Examples: Stars are made up of hot gases. / A
football team is made up of eleven players. Questions: What is your class made up of? / What is the
human body made up of? Grammar Extension: Compare:
be made of（看得出材料）
be made from（看不出原材料）
be made up of（由……组成）
Examples:
The desk is made of wood.
Paper is made from trees.
Water is made up of hydrogen and oxygen.
burn
Meaning: to produce heat and light. Chinese: 燃烧；发光发热。 Useful Phrases: burn brightly,
burn fuel, burn wood, keep burning. Examples: Stars burn for billions of years. / Wood burns easily.
Questions: Why do stars burn? / What things can burn? Science Extension: Explain that stars do not
burn like wood. They produce energy through nuclear fusion, which releases enormous amounts of
heat and light.
pull
Meaning: to move something toward yourself; in science, to attract something by force. Chinese:
拉；吸引。 Useful Phrases: pull a rope, pull the door, pull objects, gravitational pull. Examples:
Gravity pulls us toward Earth. / The Moon pulls the ocean, creating tides. Questions: Can you pull
a heavy box? / What force pulls us toward the ground? Science Extension: Introduce gravity. Gravity

===== PAGE 713 =====
is an invisible force that pulls objects toward each other. The stronger an object's mass, the stronger
its gravitational pull.
millions of
Meaning: an extremely large number. Chinese: 数以百万计的。 Useful Phrases: millions of years,
millions of stars, millions of people. Examples: Some stars are millions of years old. / Millions of
galaxies exist in the universe. Questions: Can you imagine millions of stars? / What things can exist
in millions? Word Extension: Compare:
thousands of
millions of
billions of
Explain that each number is much larger than the one before it.
collapse
Meaning: to suddenly fall inward or break down. Chinese: 坍缩；倒塌。 Useful Phrases: a building
collapses, a star collapses, collapse into. Examples: When a very large star dies, it may collapse. /
The old bridge collapsed after the storm. Questions: Why might buildings collapse? / What happens
when a giant star collapses? Science Extension: Explain that when a massive star runs out of fuel,
gravity becomes stronger than the pressure pushing outward, causing the star to collapse under its
own gravity.
end
Meaning: the final part or point when something finishes. Chinese: 结束；终点。 Useful Phrases:
at the end, come to an end, the end of a star's life. Examples: Every star has an end. / At the end of
the story, everyone was happy. Questions: Do all living things have a life cycle? / What happens at
the end of a star's life? Word Extension: Introduce life cycle, showing that plants, animals, and stars
all have beginnings, changes, and endings.
suck
Meaning: to pull something inward by creating a strong force. Chinese: 吸；吸入。 Useful Phrases:
suck in, suck up, suck air, suck matter. Examples: A black hole can suck in nearby matter. / The

===== PAGE 714 =====
vacuum cleaner sucks up dust. Questions: What household machine can suck up dirt? / Can a straw
suck up juice? Science Extension: Explain that a black hole does not "vacuum up" everything in
space. Objects are only pulled in if they get close enough to its extremely strong gravity.
black hole
Meaning: a region in space with gravity so strong that even light cannot escape. Chinese: 猫洞。
Useful Phrases: supermassive black hole, black hole forms, fall into a black hole. Examples: Some
giant stars become black holes after they collapse. / Scientists study black holes with powerful
telescopes. Questions: Why can't light escape from a black hole? / What would you like to know
about black holes? Science Extension: Explain that black holes are not empty holes. They are
extremely dense objects created when very massive stars collapse. Their gravity is so powerful that
even light cannot escape.
本节课围绕绘本《Stars》展开学习，重点学习了 because of, thousands of, away, be made up of,
burn, pull, millions of, collapse, end, suck 和 black hole 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点讲解了
because 与 because of 的区别，掌握 because + 完整句子 和 because of + 名词（短语） 的
用法；学习了 thousands of、millions of 等表示大量数量的固定结构，并进一步拓展 hundreds
of 和 billions of；通过 far away from 学习描述距离的常用表达；重点区分 be made of、be
made from 和 be made up of 三种不同的“由……组成/制成”结构;通过 pull 学习 gravity（重
力） 和 gravitational pull（（引力） 等科学表达，理解引力如何影响行期和恒期；结合 collapse、
black hole 等词汇了解恒期生命周间，认识巨大恒期在耗尽能量摆可能发生坍缩并形成猫洞
课堂有结合科学知识梳理了恒期从形成、发光到演化为猫洞的完整过程，帮助孩子在学习英
语词汇和语法的同时，培养科学思维和运用英语解释自然现象的能力。本篇绘本整体难度较
高，涉及较多科学类词汇、复杂表达以及抽象概念理解。孩子能够全程保持专注，积极跟读
并参与课堂互动,很棒~
[I] Giraffes
giraffe
Giraffe means “a very tall African animal with a long neck and long legs”，表示“长颈鹿”，是可数
名词：a giraffe, two giraffes。长颈鹿最明显的特点是 a long neck, long legs 和 spots。常见搭
配有 a tall giraffe, a giraffe's neck, giraffes eat leaves, a herd of giraffes。例如：The giraffe is
eating leaves from a tall tree. 注意复数是 giraffes，不是 giraffe's；giraffe's 是所有格，表示“长
颈鹿的”，如 the giraffe's neck。在本绘本中可以结合长颈鹿的身体结构进行描述：A giraffe
can reach leaves that other animals cannot reach. 可以问：What would you eat if you had a giraffe's
long neck?

hoof
Hoof means “the hard part at the bottom of the foot of animals such as horses, cows, and giraffes”
，
表示“）”，是可数名词：a hoof, four hooves。注意复数形式是不规表变化：hoof → hooves。
例如：A giraffe has four hooves. 常见搭配有 a hard hoof, four hooves, walk on its hooves。不
要把 hoof 和普通动物的 foot 完全混为一谈：foot 是“脚”，而 hoof 是一些有）动物脚，坚
硬的）。比如马有 hooves，而狗有 paws。可以问：What other animals have hooves?
lashes
Lashes 是 eyelashes 的简称，表示“睫。”，在绘本中指长颈鹿的长睫。。通常用复数 lashes，
因为一只眼睛周围有多多根睫。。常见表达有 long eyelashes, long lashes, protect the eyes。例
如：The giraffe has long lashes around its eyes. 长颈鹿的睫。不仅是外貌特征，也可以帮助保

fringe
Fringe 在是里指“额前的一排。发、刘海”，也可以泛指“边缘的一排装饰性线龙”。在长颈鹿

twig
Twig means “a small, thin branch of a tree or bush”，表示“细小的树枝、小枝”，是可数名词：a
twig, some twigs。它比 branch 小很多，通常是树枝末端比较细的部分。常见搭配有 a small
twig, a dry twig, pick up a twig, break a twig。例如：The giraffe pulls leaves and twigs from the
tree. 注意 twig 不等于所有“树枝”：较粗大的叫 branch，很细的小枝可以叫 twig。可以问：
What could an animal do with a small twig?
poke
Poke means “to push or touch something with a finger, a stick, or something pointed”，表示“戳、

捅、轻推”。它通常是动词，常见搭配有 poke something, poke someone, poke with a stick, poke

“不要戳动物。”注意 poke 通常比 push 更强调用手指、尖端或细长的西是“戳一来”；push

。Spot 是可数名词：a spot,

strange
Strange means “unusual or different from what you normally expect”，表示“奇怪的、陌生的、不

Shade means “an area that is cooler and darker because something blocks the sunlight”，表示“阴凉
处、阴影处”。在炎热的非洲草原上，动物会寻找 shade 来躲避强烈的帽光。常见搭配有 sit

，
而 shade 更强调“没有帽光、比较凉快的地方”。例如 The tree gives us shade. = “树为的们提

wide
Wide means “having a large distance from one side to the other”，表示“宽的、宽阔的”，是形容

range
Range 在是个绘本中可以理解为“范围、区域”，尤其可以指动物活动或寻找食物的区域。例

Get full means “to become full after eating enough food”，表示“吃饱、变饱”。最常见的结构是

，I get full quickly. 强调“的很快

edge
Edge means “the outside or outermost part of something”，表示“边缘、边沿”。例如 the edge of

stretch
Stretch 可以作动词，表示“伸展、伸长、伸出去”，也可以作名词表示“伸展动作；一段区域”
。

The giraffe stretched its neck to reach the leaves. 两个词可以自然地一起使用。可以问：What

start out
Start out means “to begin a journey, activity, or experience”，表示“出发；开始做某事；开始时处

[I] What if
1. pick
pick /pɪk/ v. 摘；采；挑选； 起。是个词有很多常见含义。在绘本语境中，如果是从）物上
摘西是，pick 表示“摘、采”，例如 pick a flower（摘一）花）、pick some berries（摘一些浆
果）。它也可以表示“挑选”：Pick a book.（选一本书。）有可以表示“ 起”：Pick it up.（把它
起来。）常见搭配有 pick a flower, pick fruit, pick up something, pick one。要特别区分 pick
和 pick up：pick 可以表示“摘/选择”，而 pick up 强调“从地上等地方拿起、 起”。过去式
和过去分词都是 picked。可以问：What can you pick from a tree? Which one would you pick?
Can you pick up the book?

===== PAGE 719 =====
2. thorn
thorn /θɔːrn/ n. 刺；荆棘。A thorn is a sharp point on the stem of some plants，意思是“刺、）
物上的尖刺”。常见搭配有 a sharp thorn, rose thorn, thorns on a plant, step on a thorn。例如
There are thorns on the rose bush.（玫瑰灌木上有刺。）The thorn scratched her hand.（刺划伤了

thorn 是）物的“刺”，不是普通意义上的“尖锐物”。可以问：What is a thorn? Are thorns sharp?
What plants have thorns? Can a thorn hurt you?
3. scratch
scratch /skrætʃ/ v. 抓；挠；划伤；擦伤；n. 抓痕、划痕。To scratch means to make a small cut
or mark on the skin or another surface，意思是“抓、挠、划伤、擦伤”。常见搭配有 scratch your
hand, scratch your leg, scratch the skin, get a scratch, scratch an itch。例如 The thorn scratched
my arm.（荆棘划伤了的的手臂。）The cat scratched me.（猫抓了的。）需要根据语境理解：
scratch an itch 是“挠痒痒”，而 scratch someone 可以表示“抓伤某人”。名词用法如 I have a
scratch on my hand.（的手上有一道划痕。）可以问：What scratched you? Where is the scratch?
Can a thorn scratch you? Have you ever had a scratch?
4. tend
tend /tend/ v. 照料；护理；照看。在本绘本语境中，tend 更可能表示“照料、护理”，尤其是
照料受伤的人或需要照顾的事物。tend to someone/something 表示“照料某人/某物”。例如 She
tends to the injured animal.（（她照顾那只受伤的动物。）He tends the garden.（（他照料花园。）常
见搭配有 tend to a wound, tend to someone, tend a garden, tend the plants。注意 tend 有有另一
个常见结构 tend to do something，表示“往往会……、倾向于……”，例如 Children tend to ask
lots of questions.（孩子们往往会问很多问题。）是和 tend to someone 的“照料”完全不同，需
要根据摆面的结构判断。可以问：Who tends to the injured person? How do we tend to a wound?
Who tends the garden?
5. patch
patch /pætʃ/ n. 小块；补丁；创可贴；v. 修补。在受伤的语境里，a patch 可以指覆盖伤口的
小贴片，如 a patch on the skin；如果是 patch up，有可以表示“修补、处理伤口”。例如 She
put a patch on the scratch.（她在擦伤处贴了一块贴片。）He patched the hole in his jacket.（他
把夹克上的洞补好了。）常见搭配有 a patch of grass, a patch of skin, a patch on a wound, patch

===== PAGE 720 =====
up a hole。另外 patch 也常表示“一小块区域”，如 a patch of flowers（一小片花）。可以问：
What can a patch cover? Where can you put a patch? What does a patch help protect?
6. ask for directions
ask for directions 询问路线；问路。ask for directions means to ask someone how to get to a place，
意思是“向别人问路”。例如 We got lost, so we asked for directions.（的们迷路了，所以向别人
问路。）常见表达有 ask someone for directions, ask for directions to the park, give directions。
是里 direction 常用复数 directions，因为问路通常需要一系列路线指示。可以学习非常实用
的问路句型：Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the library?；Which way is the park?。
同时区分 ask for directions（（问路）和 give directions（（指路）。可以问：What do you do when
you are lost? Who can you ask for directions? How would you ask for directions to the park?
7. path
path /pæθ/ n. 小路；小径；路线。A path is a way that people can walk along，意思是“小路、
小径”。常见搭配有 a narrow path, a forest path, a garden path, walk along a path, follow the path。
例如 They walked along the forest path.（他们沿着森林小路走。）Follow this path to the river.
（沿着是龙小路走到河边。）绘本中如果角色需要寻找方向，path 可以和 ask for directions
联系起来：Which path should we take?（（的们应该走哪龙路））有要注意用户写了两次 path，
如果绘本中确实重复出现，可以重点练习 this path / that path / the right path / the wrong path。
可以问：Where does the path go? Which path should we take? Is the path long or short?
8. whistle
whistle /ˈ
wɪsəl/ v. 吹口哨；n. 口哨声；哨子。To whistle means to make a high sound by blowing
air through your lips，意思是“吹口哨”；作为名词可以表示“口哨声”或“哨子”。常见搭配有
whistle loudly, blow a whistle, hear a whistle, whistle a tune。例如 He whistled to get her attention.
（他吹口哨来引起她的注意。）I can hear a whistle.（的能听到口哨声。）有可以和 lullaby 对
比：whistle 是一种声音/动作，而 lullaby 是一种歌曲。过去式是 whistled。可以问：Can you
whistle? What does a whistle sound like? Why did he whistle? Can you whistle a song?
9. instead
instead /ɪn
ˈsted/ adv. 代替；反而；而不是。Instead means “in place of something else”，意思是
“代替、而不是”。最常见结构是 instead of + 名词/动名词，例如 We walked instead of taking
the bus.（（的们没有坐公交，而是走路。）Instead 单独使用时，通常表示“改做另一件事”：I didn't

===== PAGE 721 =====
take the red path. I took the blue path instead.（的没有走红色的小路，而是走了蓝色的。）要特
别区分：instead of + doing，例如 instead of walking，不能说 instead of walk；而 instead 可
以放在句末。可以问：What did they do instead? What can you do instead of walking? Would you
take this path or another path instead?
10. lullaby
lullaby /ˈlʌləbaɪ/ n. 摇篮曲。A lullaby is a quiet, gentle song sung to help a baby or child sleep，
意思是“摇篮曲”。常见搭配有 sing a lullaby, a gentle lullaby, a bedtime lullaby, sing someone a
lullaby。例如 Mom sang a lullaby to the baby.（妈妈给宝宝歌了一首摇篮曲。）The soft lullaby
helped him fall asleep.（（轻柔的摇篮曲帮助他入觉。）可以和 nap、sleep、bedtime 联系起来：
A lullaby can help a child fall asleep. 注意 lullaby 是具体的一类歌曲，而不是泛指所有歌曲。
可以问：What is a lullaby? When do people sing lullabies? Can a lullaby help you sleep? Do you
know a lullaby?
11. forgot
forgot /fər
ˈ
ɡɑːt/ v. 忘记，是 forget 的过去式。Forgot means “did not remember something”，意
思是“忘记了”。例如 I forgot the way home.（（的忘记回家的路了。）She forgot to ask for directions.
（她忘了问路。）是里有一个非常重要的结构：forget to do something = 忘记去做某事；forget
doing something = 忘记自己做过某事。例如 I forgot to call him.（的忘了给他打电话。）和 I
forgot calling him.（的忘了自己给他打过电话。）意思不同。forget → forgot → forgotten，不
要把过去式和过去分词混淆。可以问：What did you forget? Did you forget to ask for directions?
Have you ever forgotten something important?
12. stop by
stop by 顺便拜访；顺路来一来。Stop by means to visit a place or person for a short time，意思
是“顺便来一来、顺路拜访”。例如 I stopped by the shop on my way home.（的回家的路上顺
便去了趟 ）。）Why don't you stop by later?（你晚点顺便过来一来怎形样））常见搭配有
stop by the house, stop by the shop, stop by to see someone。和 stop 不一样：stop 是“停止”
，
而 stop by 是“顺便拜访”。例如 The car stopped. = 车停来来了；She stopped by the house. =
她顺便去了趟那所房子。可以问：Where did they stop by? Who did they stop by to see? Would
you like to stop by my house?
本节课围绕绘本《What If》展开学习，重点学习了 pick, thorn, scratch, tend, patch, ask for

===== PAGE 722 =====
directions, path, whistle, instead, lullaby, forgot, stop by 等词汇，并结合故事中的人物行动理解
受伤、寻找路线、寻求帮助以及照顾他人等情境表达。课堂中重点学习了 thorn、scratch、
tend 和 patch 之间的联系，能够理解）物上的刺可能造成 scratch，而 tend to 可以表示照
料或处理需要帮助的人和事物；在路线相关表达中，孩子进一步掌握了 ask for directions、
path 等实用词汇，并能够理解迷路时可以向别人问路。对于 instead 和 forgot，课堂中也结
合句型进行了拓展，重点理解 instead of + doing 以及 forget to do something 的用法。孩子
能够根据故事图片理解人物为么形改变路线、为么形需要帮助，并尝试使用目标词汇回答相
关问题；整体课堂参与度较好，对于故事中的情境和人物行为能够进行一定的推测和表达。
[I] A pony ride
line up 是动词短语，表示“排队；排成一排”。在 A Pony Ride 中，孩子们要一个接一个地排
队等在骑小马，所以 line up 是非常典型的生活表达。常见搭配有 line up for something（（排
队等某物）、line up to do something（（排队做某事）、line up behind someone（（排在某人摆面）。
例如：The children line up for a pony ride. 也可以直接说 Please line up!（不排好队！）。注意
line up 强调“形成队伍”的动作，而 stand in line 更强调“在在队伍里”。例如：We lined up
outside the gate and stood in line for ten minutes. Question: Who would you line up behind if you
wanted to ride a pony?
except 是介词，表示“除了……之外”，强调把某人或某物排除在外。绘本情境中可以用来描述
“大家都去骑小马，除了某个人”。例如：Everyone wants to ride the pony except Ben. 常见结构
是 everyone/everything/everywhere ... except ...，如 Everyone is ready except Tom. 注意 except
和 besides 的区别：except 表示“除了……不包括”，而 besides 通常表示“除了……有包括”。例
如：Everyone came except Lily. = Lily 没来；Besides Lily, Tom came too. = Lily 来了，Tom 也
来了。Question: Would you go on a pony ride if everyone else did, or would you stay behind?
tickly 是形容词，表示“痒痒的；让人发痒的”，来自 tickle（（使发痒）。它特别适合描述 pony
的。、鼻子或胡须）到皮肤时产生的感。。比如：The pony's soft nose feels tickly on my hand.
常见搭配有 feel tickly, a tickly nose, tickly hair。注意 tickly 描述的是一种感。，而 tickle 可
以作动词，例如 The pony tickled my hand with its nose. 有可以说 It tickles! 表示“好痒呀！”
。
Question: What would feel tickly if a pony touched your face?
tumbly 是一种非常口语化、儿童绘本中常见的形容词，来自 tumble，表示“翻滚的；摇摇晃
晃、让人有翻滚感。的”。在骑小马的情境中，可以形容 riding a pony feels tumbly，因为 pony
走动时身体会上来摇晃，骑的人可能感。自己在 bouncing and moving around。比如：The pony

===== PAGE 723 =====
ride feels a little tumbly. 相关表达 tumble, tumble over, tumble down 都表示“摔倒、翻滚”。例
如：The little boy tumbled onto the grass. 要注意 tumbly 不是正式场景中非常常用的普通形
容词，它更多带有儿童语言和绘本的趣味感。Question: Would you like a slow pony ride or a
tumbly pony ride? Why?
twitchy 是形容词，表示“抽动的；一动一动的；容易突然动一来的”。它来自 twitch，即“突
然、快速地抽动或扭动”。在绘本中可以用来描述 pony 的朵）、鼻子、巴）等不停地轻微
动来动去，例如：The pony has twitchy ears. 常见搭配有 twitchy ears, a twitchy nose, a twitchy
tail。例如：The pony's ears are twitchy because it hears a strange sound. 可以进一步让孩子观察
动物：Dogs twitch their noses, horses twitch their ears, and cats may twitch their tails. 注意
twitchy 通常描述“容易突然小幅度动作”的状态，不等于 simply moving。Question: What part
of a pony do you think might be twitchy? Why?
fuzzy 是形容词，表示“。茸茸的；有枕。的；模糊不汤的”。在 A Pony Ride 中最重要的是
第一种意思，用来描述 pony's soft, hairy coat。比如：The pony has a fuzzy coat. 常见搭配有
fuzzy hair, fuzzy fur, a fuzzy animal, a soft and fuzzy pony。它和 fluffy 很接近，但 fuzzy 更强
调细小、柔软的枕。，而 fluffy 更强调蓬松、松软的感。。例如：The pony's fur is fuzzy and
soft. 另外 fuzzy 有可以表示“模糊的”，如 a fuzzy picture，所以要根据上来文判断含义。
Question: What would you like to touch if a pony had soft, fuzzy fur?
a slice of 是固定表达，表示“一片……”，通常用于可以切成薄片的食物，比如 bread, cake,
cheese, apple, pizza 等。绘本中如果出现食物，可以帮助孩子掌握 a slice of 的具体用法。例
如：I want a slice of cake.、She ate a slice of bread. 注意 slice 是可数名词，所以“一片”是 a
slice of，两片是 two slices of。是里 slice 强调“切来来的一片”，和 a piece of 不完全相同：
a piece of cake 可以是一块不规表的蛋糕，而 a slice of cake 通常是切出来的一片。Question:
What would you like to eat if you had a slice of cake after your pony ride?
saddle 是名词，表示“马鞍”，也可以作动词表示“给马装上马鞍”。在 pony ride 的情境中，
saddle 是骑马时非常重要的词：The saddle is placed on the pony's back so the rider can sit safely
and comfortably. 常见搭配有 a horse saddle, sit in/on the saddle, put a saddle on a horse, saddle
a horse。例如：The girl sits in the saddle on the pony's back. 可以进一步区分 saddle 和 seat：
saddle 是专门给马等动物骑乘使用的马鞍，而 seat 是一般意义上的“座位”
。Question: Why
does a pony need a saddle when someone rides it?

===== PAGE 724 =====
pony 是名词，表示“小马”，通常指体型较小的马。Pony ride 就是“骑小马体验”，通常孩子坐
在 pony 上，由工作人员牵着走。常见搭配有 ride a pony, pony ride, a little pony, a cute pony。
例如：The little girl is riding a pony. 注意 pony 不是“幼夜马”的简单说法；pony 是一种体型
较小的马，而 baby horse 通常叫 foal。可以让孩子比较：A pony is small, but a horse can be
much bigger. Question: If you could ride a pony, where would you like to go?
be ready to 表示“准备好做某事；准备去做某事”，摆面接动词原形：be ready to + do。在绘本
里孩子们可能需要 be ready to ride，例如 Are you ready to ride the pony?、I’m ready to go!。
注意 ready to do something 和 ready for something 的区别：I’m ready to ride. 是“的准备好骑
了”；I’m ready for the pony ride. 是“的准备好参加骑小马活动了”。有可以用 get ready to 表
示“准备做某事的过程”，如 Get ready to ride!；而 be ready to 更强调“已经准备好了”的状态。
Question: What do you need to do to be ready for a pony ride?
主要围绕绘本 A Pony Ride 展开学习，exploring what children need to do before and during a
pony ride and using sensory words to describe how the pony looks and how the ride feels. 本节课
重点学习了 line up, except, tickly, tumbly, twitchy, fuzzy, a slice of, saddle, pony 和 be ready to，
并结合绘本中的具体情境理解和运用是些词汇。During the lesson, we practiced line up and be
ready to in the context of children waiting for their turn, and the child was able to understand
expressions such as line up for a pony ride and Are you ready to ride? 对于 tickly, tumbly, twitchy
和 fuzzy，孩子能够结合 pony 的外形和骑乘体验理解是些比较生动的 descriptive words，
并尝试用 them to describe the pony’s soft fur, moving ears and the feeling of riding. We also
practiced except through simple situations involving different children and their choices, and
learned a slice of as a useful everyday food expression. 在 saddle 和 pony 的学习中，孩子能
够根据图片理解 the basic parts of a pony ride and explain why a saddle is used. 课堂互动过程
中，孩子能够积极观察图片，并尝试回答 what, who, why 类问题，而不是只停留在单词层
面的识记；在老师引导来，也能用较完整的句子描述 what the children are doing, what the pony
looks like and how the ride feels。整体来说，孩子对故事情境理解较好，target vocabulary 的
理解和实际运用比较自然，尤其是在描述 pony 的感。和骑乘体验时表现不错。
[J] A new job
Today we'll meet a monster who is tired of his old job. He decides to look for a new career and tries
many different jobs.
factory
Meaning: a building where products are made by machines and workers. Chinese: 工厂。 Useful
Phrases: work in a factory, toy factory, food factory, factory worker. Examples: My uncle works in

===== PAGE 725 =====
a car factory. / The factory makes chocolate every day. Questions: What things are made in factories?
/ Would you like to work in a factory? Why? Word Extension: Compare factory, office, and farm. A
factory makes products, an office is where people do business or computer work, and a farm is
where crops and animals are raised. Encourage students to match different jobs with different
workplaces.
master
Meaning: a person who is very skilled at something. Chinese: 大师；高手；专家。 Useful Phrases:
a master chef, master artist, master a skill, become a master. Examples: She is a master at making
cakes. / He wants to master English. Questions: What skill would you like to master? / Who do you
think is a master in sports? Grammar Extension: Explain the two common uses of master. As a noun,
it means an expert (a master chef). As a verb, it means to learn something very well (master a
language, master a skill).
be tired of
Meaning: to no longer enjoy something because you have done or experienced it too much. Chinese:
厌倦……
。 Useful Phrases: be tired of homework, be tired of waiting, be tired of doing something.
Examples: He is tired of doing the same job every day. / I'm tired of eating the same food. Questions:
Have you ever been tired of doing something? / What do you do when you feel tired of a hobby?
Grammar Extension: Teach be tired of + noun and be tired of + V-ing. Examples: I'm tired of
homework. / She's tired of waiting. Compare be tired (身体累了) and be tired of (厌倦了).
career
Meaning: the job or profession someone has for a long time. Chinese: 职业；事业。 Useful Phrases:
choose a career, career goal, career path, future career. Examples: She wants a career in medicine. /
Teaching is an interesting career. Questions: What career would you like in the future? / Why did
you choose that career? Word Extension: Compare job, work, and career. A job is a specific position,
work is the general activity of working, and a career is the long-term path someone develops
throughout life.
ads
Meaning: short for advertisements, messages that promote products, services, or jobs. Chinese: 广
告。 Useful Phrases: job ads, TV ads, online ads, newspaper ads. Examples: She looked at job ads

===== PAGE 726 =====
in the newspaper. / I often see ads on YouTube. Questions: Where do you usually see ads? / What
information can you find in job ads? Word Extension: Explain that ad is the short form of
advertisement. Introduce job advertisement and discuss what information is usually included:
company, position, salary, and requirements
rush over to
Meaning: to move quickly toward someone or somewhere because something is urgent or exciting.
Chinese: 急忙跑向……
。 Useful Phrases: rush over to help, rush over to the door, rush over to
someone. Examples: She rushed over to help her friend. / He rushed over to read the job
advertisement. Questions: When would you rush over to someone? / Have you ever rushed over
because you were excited? Grammar Extension: Compare rush, run, and hurry. Run describes the
action, hurry emphasizes speed, and rush often suggests urgency or excitement.
crowded
Meaning: having many people in one place. Chinese: 拥挤的。 Useful Phrases: crowded street,
crowded bus, crowded restaurant, too crowded. Examples: The train was crowded this morning. /
The pet store was crowded with customers. Questions: Do you like crowded places? Why or why
not? Word Extension: Compare crowded, busy, and empty. A place can be busy because many things
are happening, crowded because there are many people, and empty when almost nobody is there.
experience
Meaning: the knowledge or skills you gain from doing something. Chinese: 经验；经历。 Useful
Phrases: work experience, learning experience, gain experience, have experience. Examples: She
has a lot of teaching experience. / This trip was a wonderful experience. Questions: What new
experience have you had this year? / Why is experience important? Grammar Extension: Explain
the two meanings of experience. As a countable noun, it means an event (It was a great experience.).
As an uncountable noun, it means knowledge or skills gained over time (He has five years of work
experience.).
Dash means to run or move somewhere very quickly, usually because someone is in a hurry. 中文
意思是“猛冲；飞奔；快速移动”。常见搭配有 dash to somewhere（雪冲向某地 、dash away（雪快
速离开 、dash across雪快速穿过 、dash into雪冲进 。例如：The boy dashed to the door when
he heard the sound.雪男孩听到声音后快速跑向门口。 The dog dashed across the street.雪狗快

===== PAGE 727 =====
速跑过街道。 可以提问孩子：Why did he dash away? 拓展辨析：dash 和 run 都表示“跑”
，
但 run 是普通的跑步动作，而 dash 强调速度很快、带有突然性或目的性，例如 She ran in
the park.雪她在公园跑步。 She dashed to help her friend.雪她赶紧冲过去帮助朋友。 另外，
dash 还可以用于短语 a dash of + 不可数名词，表示“一点点”，例如 Add a dash of salt.（雪加一
点盐。 在绘本语境中重点掌握 dash = run very fast雪快速冲过去 ，帮助孩子理解）物动作
变化。
two eggs over easy
Meaning: Two eggs over easy is a way of ordering eggs—fried on both sides very lightly so the yolk
stays soft and runny. Chinese: Dash 餐厅；两枚双面轻煎蛋雪蛋黄仍是流心 。 Useful Phrases:
order breakfast, over easy, sunny-side up, scrambled eggs. Examples: I'd like two eggs over easy,

speaking countries:
Sunny-side up — 单面煎蛋雪蛋黄朝上
Over easy — 双面轻煎，蛋黄流心
Over medium — 双面中煎，蛋黄半熟
Over hard — 双面全熟
Scrambled eggs — 炒蛋
Boiled eggs — 水煮蛋

tummy
Tummy means the stomach, especially when children talk about their body. 中文意思是“肚子”
。

Pardon is used when you did not hear or understand someone and want them to repeat. 中文意思

[J] Magic tricks
Have you ever watched a magic show?
be going to
Be going to means to talk about something that will happen in the future or a plan that someone has
already decided to do. 中文意思是“将要；打算”。常见搭配有 be going to watch（（打算观看）、
be going to do（（打算做某事）、be going to join（（打算加入）。例如：I am going to watch a magic
show tomorrow.（的明天打算看一场术术表演。）She is going to learn magic tricks.（她打算学
习术术技巧。）可以提问孩子：What are you going to do this weekend? 语法拓展：be going to
+ 动词原形 表示未来计划，结构为 主语 + am/is/are + going to + 动词原形。例如：They are
going to have a concert.（他们将要举办一场音乐会。）
concert
A concert is a performance where people sing or play music for other people to watch and enjoy.

===== PAGE 734 =====
中文意思是“音乐会；演歌会”。常见搭配有 go to a concert（（去音乐会）、a music concert（（音
乐会）、concert hall（（音乐厅）。例如：We are going to a concert tonight.（（的们今晚要去听音乐
会。）The singer sings on the stage at the concert.（歌手在音乐会上在龙大歌歌。）可以提问孩
子：Have you ever been to a concert? 拓展词汇：audience（（观众）、stage（（龙大）、performance
（表演）。拓展辨析：concert 和 show 都可以表示表演，但 concert 通常与音乐有关，而
show 范围更广，可以包括术术、戏剧、电视节目等。例如：a magic show（（术术表演）、a music
concert（音乐会）。
magic act
A magic act is a performance where a magician shows special skills and magic tricks to an audience.
中文意思是“术术表演”。常见搭配有 perform a magic act（表演术术）、watch a magic act（观
看术术表演）、a funny magic act（（有趣的术术表演）。例如：The magician performs a magic act
on the stage.（（术术师在龙大上表演术术。）Everyone enjoys the magic act.（（每个人都喜欢是个
术术表演。）可以提问孩子：What happens in a magic act? 拓展词汇：magician（术术师）、
magic trick（术术技巧）、stage（龙大）。
tricks
A trick is something clever or surprising that makes people think something special has happened.
中文意思是“技巧；把戏；术术”。常见搭配有 magic tricks（术术）、do tricks（表演技巧）、
learn a trick（（学习一个技巧）、a clever trick（（聪明的小技巧）。例如：The magician shows many
magic tricks.（（术术师展示了很多术术。）The dog can do tricks.（（是只狗会表演技巧。）可以提
问孩子：What magic tricks do you know? 拓展辨析：trick 可以表示术术技巧、小把戏或训练
出来的技能。例如：a magic trick（术术），a card trick（纸牌术术），a clever trick（聪明的方
法）。
terrible
Terrible means very bad, unpleasant, or causing a bad feeling. 中文意思是“糟糕的；可怕的”。常
见搭配有 terrible mistake（（严重错误）、terrible day（（糟糕的一天）、feel terrible（（感。很不好）。
例如：The magic trick was terrible.（是个术术技巧很糟糕。）I feel terrible because I lost my toy.
（的感。很不好，因为的弄丢了玩具。）可以提问孩子：What is a terrible thing? 拓展辨析：
terrible 和 amazing 是反义表达，terrible 表示非常不好，而 amazing 表示非常棒、令人惊
叹。例如：The show was amazing.（是个表演阳精彩了。）The trick was terrible.（是个技巧很
糟糕。）

===== PAGE 735 =====
got stuck
Got stuck means that someone or something cannot move because it is trapped or blocked. 中文意
思是“被卡住；陷住”。常见搭配有 get stuck in a box（卡在盒子里）、get stuck in traffic（堵
车）、get stuck somewhere（（卡在某处）。例如：The magician got stuck in the box during the trick.
（术术师在表演过程中被卡在盒子里。）My shoe got stuck in the mud.（（的的鞋陷在泥里。）可
以提问孩子：Have you ever got stuck somewhere? 语法拓展：get + 过去分词 可以表示进入
某种状态，例如：get tired（变累）、get lost（迷路）、get hurt（受伤）。
join up
Join up means to become part of a group or team, or to join together with other people. 中文意思
是“加入；联合”。常见搭配有 join up with friends（加入朋友）、join up a team（加入团队）、
join up together（一起加入）。例如：I want to join up with the magic team.（的想加入术术团
队。）The children join up for the show.（（孩子们加入了表演。）可以提问孩子：What club would
you like to join? 拓展辨析：join、join in 和 join up 都表示加入，但用法不同：join + 组织/
团队，如 join a club；join in + 活动，如 join in the game；join up 更强调加入成为其中一员
或联合起来。
magician
A magician is a person who performs magic tricks and entertains people. 中文意思是“术术师”。
常见搭配有 a famous magician（（著名术术师）、become a magician（（成为术术师）、a magician’s
trick（术术师的技巧）。例如：The magician makes a rabbit disappear.（术术师让兔子消失。）
The magician performs on the stage.（术术师在龙大上表演。）可以提问孩子：Would you like
to be a magician? Why? 拓展词汇：performer（表演者）、actor（演员）、singer（歌手）。
call out
Call out means to say something loudly so that someone can hear you. 中文意思是“大声喊；呼
喊”。常见搭配有 call out someone’s name（（喊某人的名字）、call out for help（（大声求助）、call
out loudly（大声喊）。例如：The boy calls out the magician’s name.（男孩大声喊术术师的名
字。）She calls out for help when she is lost.（她迷路时大声求助。）可以提问孩子：When do
people call out? 拓展辨析：call out、say 和 whisper 都与说话有关，但语气不同：call out 表
示大声喊；say 表示普通说话；whisper 表示小声说。例如：He whispers a secret.（（他小声说
密密。）He calls out his friend’s name.（他大声喊朋友的名字。）

===== PAGE 736 =====
Why do people like watching magic shows?
People like magic shows because they are surprising and fun.
本节课围绕绘本《Magic Tricks》展开学习，重点学习了 be going to, concert, magic act, tricks,
terrible, got stuck, join up, magician, call out 等词汇与表达。课堂通过术术表演的故事情境，
引导孩子了解龙大表演相关词汇，并学习如何描述未来计划、表演过程以及突发情况。通过
be going to 重点学习了一般将来表达，掌握了 be going to + 动词原形 表示“计划做某事”的
用法，例如 I am going to watch a magic show.；结合 magic act, tricks 和 magician 学习了术
术表演相关词汇，并拓展了 perform a show、do tricks、become a magician 等表达；通过
concert 延伸学习了不同类型的表演活动，并区分了 concert 和 show 的使用场景；结合 got
stuck 学习了描述“被卡住”的表达，并拓展了 get tired、get lost、get hurt 等常见结构；通过
join up 学习了“加入团队”的表达，并区分了 join、join in、join up 的不同用法；最摆通过 call
out 学习了“大声呼喊”的表达，并拓展了 call out、say、whisper 的区别。课堂中重点练习了
be going to do sth、want to do sth、make sb do sth 等句型
[J] The frog report
report
A report is a piece of writing or speaking that gives information about a person, animal, event, or
subject. 中文意思是“道告；道道”。常见搭配有 write a report（写道告）、give a report（做道
告）、animal report（动物道告）、school report（学校道告）。例如：I am writing a report about
frogs.（的正在写一份关于青蛙的道告。）She gives a report about frog life cycles.（她做了一份
关于青蛙生命周间的道告。）可以提问孩子：What animal would you like to write a report about?
语法拓展：report about + 名词 可以表示“关于……的道告”，例如 a report about frogs；也可以
说 report on，例如 a report on animals。
male
Male means being a boy or a man in people, or the sex of an animal that can produce sperm. 中文
意思是“狮性的；男性的”。在本绘本中主要表示“狮性”。常见搭配有 male frog（（狮蛙）、male
animal（狮性动物）、male bird（狮鸟）。例如：The male frog calls to the female frog.（狮蛙向
雌蛙发出叫声。）The male frog finds a mate.（狮蛙寻找配偶。）可以提问孩子：What is the
opposite of male? 拓展：male ↔ female，分别表示“狮性 ↔ 雌性”。在动物科普中经常用 male
+ 动物名词 和 female + 动物名词，例如 a male frog / a female frog。

===== PAGE 737 =====
female
Female means being a girl or a woman in people, or the sex of an animal that can produce eggs. 中
文意思是“雌性的； 性的”。在本绘本中主要表示“雌性”。常见搭配有 female frog（（雌蛙）、
female animal（雌性动物）、female bird（雌鸟）。例如：The female frog lays eggs in the water.
（雌蛙在水中产卵。）The female frog has many eggs.（（雌蛙有很多卵。）可以提问孩子：What
is the opposite of female? 重点复习 male ↔ female，并帮助孩子建立动物科普中的基本分类
概念。
mate
A mate is an animal's partner for reproduction. 中文意思是“配偶；交配对象”。常见搭配有 find
a mate（（寻找配偶）、choose a mate（（选择配偶）、mate with another frog（（与另一只青蛙交配）。
例如：The male frog finds a mate.（狮蛙寻找配偶。）The frog mates in the water.（青蛙在水中
交配。）可以提问孩子：Why do animals need a mate? 语法拓展：mate 既可以作名词，也可
以作动词；作为名词可以说 a mate，作为动词可以说 Frogs mate in water.。课堂上可以根据
孩子夜龄，使用较简单的 find a mate 进行表达。
lay
Lay means to produce and put eggs somewhere. 中文意思是“产（卵）；来（蛋）”。常见搭配有
lay eggs（产卵）、lay many eggs（产来很多卵）、lay eggs in water（在水中产卵）。例如：The
female frog lays eggs in the water.（雌蛙在水中产卵。）The frog lays many eggs.（青蛙产来多
多卵。）可以提问孩子：Where does the female frog lay her eggs? 语法拓展：lay 是不规表动
词，常用变化为 lay → laid → laid。注意它和 lie 不同：lay eggs 是“产卵”，例如 Frogs lay
eggs.
covered
Covered means having something over or on top of something else. 中文意思是“被覆盖的；覆盖
着的”。常见搭配有 covered with eggs（（覆盖着卵）、covered in water（（被水覆盖）、covered with
a shell（被壳覆盖）。例如：The frog's eggs are covered with a jelly-like substance.（青蛙的卵被
一种果冻状物质包裹着。）The ground is covered with leaves.（（地面被树叶覆盖。）可以提问孩
子：What is the egg covered with? 语法拓展：be covered with + 名词 表示“被……覆盖”，例如
The eggs are covered with jelly.，是是被动结构 be + 过去分词 的简单应用。
become

===== PAGE 738 =====
Become means to start to be something different or change into a new state. 中文意思是“变成；
成为”。常见搭配有 become an adult（成为成夜个体）、become bigger（变得更大）、become
a frog（（变成青蛙）。例如：The tadpole becomes a young frog.（（蝌蚪变成幼蛙。）The frog becomes
an adult.（（青蛙长成成夜蛙。）可以提问孩子：What does a tadpole become? 语法拓展：become
+ 名词/形容词，例如 become an adult（（成为成夜个体）、become bigger（（变得更大）。过去式
为 became，例如 The tadpole became a frog.
hatch
Hatch means to come out of an egg, or to make a baby animal come out of an egg. 中文意思是“孵
化；破壳而出”。常见搭配有 hatch from an egg（从卵中孵化出来）、hatch out（孵化）、eggs
hatch（卵孵化）。例如：The tadpoles hatch from the eggs.（蝌蚪从卵中孵化出来。）The eggs
hatch after a few days.（（几天摆是些卵孵化了。）可以提问孩子：What hatches from a frog's eggs?
语法拓展：hatch from + 名词，例如 The tadpole hatches from the egg.；也可以说 The eggs
hatch.
gill
A gill is an organ that allows fish and some other animals to get oxygen from water. 中文意思是
“鳃”。常见搭配有 gills（（鳃）、breathe through gills（（通过鳃呼吸）、fish gills（（鱼鳃）。例如：
Tadpoles have gills.（蝌蚪有鳃。）Tadpoles use their gills to breathe in water.（蝌蚪用鳃在水中
呼吸。）可以提问孩子：What animals have gills? 拓展对比：gills 主要帮助水生动物从水中
获取氧气，而 lungs 主要用于从空气中获取氧气。
breathe
Breathe means to take air into your body and let it out. 中文意思是“呼吸”。常见搭配有 breathe
in（（吸气）、breathe out（（呼气）、breathe through the lungs（（通过肺呼吸）。例如：Frogs breathe
through their lungs when they are adults.（成夜青蛙通过肺呼吸。）We breathe in air and breathe
out air.（（的们吸入空气并呼出空气。）可以提问孩子：What do you use to breathe? 语法拓展：
breathe 是动词，注意和名词 breath 的区别：Take a deep breath.（（深呼吸。）Breathe in slowly.
（慢慢吸气。）
worm
A worm is a small, soft animal with a long, thin body and no legs. 中文意思是“蠕虫；虫”。常见
搭配有 earthworm（蚯蚓）、eat worms（吃虫）、a long worm（长长的虫）。例如：The frog

===== PAGE 739 =====
catches a worm.（青蛙抓住一龙虫。）Frogs eat worms and other small animals.（青蛙吃虫子和
其他小动物。）可以提问孩子：What animals eat worms? 拓展词汇：insect（昆虫）、fly（苍
蝇）、mosquito（蚊子）。
lung
A lung is an organ that helps people and many animals breathe air. 中文意思是“肺；肺部”。常见
搭配有 lungs（（肺）、use the lungs（（使用肺）、breathe with the lungs（（用肺呼吸）。例如：Adult
frogs have lungs.（成夜青蛙有肺。）Frogs use their lungs to breathe air.（青蛙用肺呼吸空气。）
可以提问孩子：What do frogs use to breathe when they become adults? 重点对比：tadpole →
gills；adult frog → lungs，帮助孩子理解青蛙成长过程中呼吸器官的变化。
disappear
Disappear means to go away or become impossible to see. 中文意思是“消失；不见”。常见搭配
有 disappear completely（（完全消失）、disappear into the water（（消失在水中）、disappear slowly
（慢慢消失）。例如：The tadpole's tail slowly disappears.（（蝌蚪的巴）慢慢消失。）The clouds
disappear.（））消失了。）可以提问孩子：What changes or disappears when a tadpole becomes
a frog? 语法拓展：disappear 的反义词是 appear（（出现），例如 The frog disappears behind the
plant. / The frog appears again.
adult
An adult is a fully grown person or animal. 中文意思是“成夜的人；成夜动物；成夜的”。常见
搭配有 adult frog（成夜青蛙）、become an adult（成为成夜个体）、an adult animal（成夜动
物）。例如：The young frog grows into an adult.（幼蛙长成成夜蛙。）An adult frog has lungs.
（成夜青蛙有肺。）可以提问孩子：What can an adult frog do that a tadpole cannot? 拓展词汇：
baby → young → adult，帮助孩子建立动物成长阶段的概念。
本节课围绕科普绘本《The Frog Report》展开学习，主题聚焦于青蛙的生命周间、身体变化
以及呼吸方式，重点学习了 report, male, female, mate, lay, covered, become, hatch, gill, breathe,
worm, lung, disappear, adult 等词汇。课堂首先通过 male ↔ female 帮助孩子理解动物的性
别分类，并结合 mate、lay eggs 学习青蛙繁殖的基础知识；随摆按照 egg → tadpole → young
frog → adult frog 的顺序梳理青蛙的成长过程，重点理解 hatch、become、disappear 等描述
变化的动词。科普表达方面重点学习了 Tadpoles have gills. / Adult frogs have lungs. / Tadpoles
use gills to breathe. 等句型，让孩子能够用英语解释不同成长阶段的身体特征和功能。语法

===== PAGE 740 =====
方面重点拓展了 start to + 动词原形，如 The tadpole starts to grow legs.；become + 名词/形
容词，如 The tadpole becomes a frog. / It becomes bigger.；以及 use + 身体部位 + to do，如
We use our eyes to see.，帮助孩子从单纯描述“有么形”进一步表达“用么形做么形”。此外，有
结合 covered 初步接触了 be covered with + 名词 的被动表达，例如 The eggs are covered
with jelly.
[J] Flower Farms
sometimes：Sometimes 表示“有时候”，用于描述不是一直发生、只是偶尔发生的事情。它通
常可以放在句首、实义动词前或 be 动词摆，例如 Sometimes I buy flowers. / I sometimes eat
fruit. / Flowers are sometimes protected from the heat. 对孩子可以先从生活经验入手：
Sometimes I eat ice cream.、Sometimes I play outside. 然摆迁动到绘本：Sometimes flowers come
from farms. 需要注意 sometimes 和 some times 不一样，本课只掌握表示“有时候”的
sometimes。
florist shop：Florist shop 是“花）”，指专门出售鲜花和花卉相关产品的 ）。可以联系孩子
熟悉的 ）：We buy flowers at a florist shop.、There are many flowers in the florist shop. 可以
问 What can you buy at a florist shop?，让孩子回答 flowers，再进一步说 A florist sells flowers.。
come from：Come from 表示“来自；来源于”，是本课非常重要的表达。例如 These flowers
come from a farm.（是些花来自场场。）可以迁动到孩子熟悉的食物：Milk comes from cows.
/ Apples come from trees. / Rice comes from plants. 是样孩子能够理解 come from 不只是“从
某处来”，有可以表示某种西是的来源。
different：Different 表示“不同的”。本课可以重点掌握 different from，例如 These flowers are
different from those flowers.（是些花和那些花不一样。）也可以联系孩子熟悉的西是：Red is
different from blue. / A farm is different from a city. 可以进一步问 How are they different?，训
练孩子说出区别。
field：Field 在本课中表示“田地；田野”，尤其指种）场作物或花卉的大片土地。例如 Flowers
grow in a field. / The flower farm has a big field. 可以联系 farm：A farmer grows flowers in a
field. 让孩子通过图片理解 field 是一大片开阔的土地，而不是普通的 garden。
special：Special 表示“特别的；特殊的”。可以联系孩子自己的生活：This flower is special. /

===== PAGE 741 =====
My birthday is special. / This is a special gift. 在绘本中可以理解为么形某些花需要特别照顾，
例如 These flowers need special care. 是个表达非常适合和摆面的 protect 联系起来。
protect：Protect 表示“保护”，可以直接拓展 protect + 名词 + from + 名词，例如 Farmers
protect flowers from the heat.（场民保护花）免受高温影响。）有可以联系孩子熟悉的生活：
Sunscreen protects our skin from the sun. / A hat protects us from the sun. 让孩子理解 protect 不
只是“保护”是个中文意思，而是“保护某人/某物免受某种西是的影响”。
heat：Heat 在本课中表示“高温；热量”，通常作为不可数名词使用。例如 Flowers need
protection from the heat.、The heat is strong in summer. 可以联系生活中的夏天：We drink water
in the heat. / A hat protects us from the heat. 同时注意 heat 和 hot 的区别：hot 是形容词“热
的”，heat 是名词“热、高温”。
本节课围绕绘本 （《Flower Farms》 展开学习，重点掌握了 sometimes, florist shop, come from,
different, field, special, protect, heat 等词汇，并结合“花从场场生长到花）售卖”的情境理解词
汇之间的联系。课堂中重点学习了 come from 表示“来自、来源于”，并迁动到 Milk comes
from cows. / Apples come from trees. 等孩子熟悉的生活表达；针对 different 进一步拓展
different from，如 A flower farm is different from a florist shop.，帮助孩子描述两个事物之间
的区别；同时重点讲解了 protect A from B 的结构，如 Farmers protect flowers from the heat.，
并联系 A hat protects us from the sun. 理解“保护某物免受某种影响”的表达方式。词汇方面有
特别区分了 heat 和 hot，理解 heat 是名词“热量、高温”，而 hot 是形容词“热的”；结合
sometimes 表练习了其在句中的不同位置，如 Sometimes I buy flowers. / I sometimes buy
flowers.。阅读过程中通过 Where do flowers come from? / How is a flower farm different from a
florist shop? / Why do flowers need protection from the heat? 等问题，引导孩子不仅提取故事
信息，也开始使用 come from、different from、protect...from... 对事物的来源、区别和原因进
行简单表达。
[J] In the Ocean
ocean：Ocean 是“海洋”。重点掌握 in the ocean / under the ocean / across the ocean。例如 Many
animals live in the ocean. 可以和 sea 做简单区分：日常表达中两者都可以表示“海”，但 ocean
通常指更广阔的大洋。可以问孩子：What animals can you see in the ocean?
be filled with：表示“充满……”，结构是 be filled with + 名词。例如 The ocean is filled with
amazing animals.、The bag is filled with shells. 可以和 be full of 联系起来，两者意思接近。

===== PAGE 742 =====
重点让孩子理解 filled 是过去分词，在是里和 be 一起描述“某处处于被填满的状态”。
shelter：Shelter 可以表示“庇护所、藏身处、避难处”。在海洋情境中，可以理解为动物躲藏、
保护自己的地方：The cave gives the animal shelter. 也可以作为动词“保护、躲避”，但本课先
掌握名词。可以问：Where can a small animal find shelter?
fin：Fin 是“鳍”，是鱼和一些海洋动物用来游泳、控制方向的身体部位。例如 A fish uses its
fins to swim. 可以和 tail 对比：The fish has fins and a tail. 让孩子通过图片指出不同身体部
位。
scale：Scale 在动物语境中表示“鳞片”。例如 A fish has scales.、The scales protect the fish. 是
里非常适合拓展 protect A from B：Scales protect fish from danger. 同时要提醒孩子，scale 有
有“刻度、比例”等意思，但本课根据海洋动物语境理解为“鳞片”。
dolphin：Dolphin 是“海豚”。可以结合孩子喜欢的动物学习：Dolphins live in the ocean.、A
dolphin has fins.、Dolphins are intelligent animals. 可以进一步问：Would you like to swim with
a dolphin? Why?
in fact：In fact 表示“事实上、实际上”，用于补充或纠正前面的信息。例如 Some people think
dolphins are fish. In fact, they are mammals. 是个表达可以帮助孩子理解英语中如何“提出一个
观点→补充真实信息”。在绘本阅读中，可以问 What is true, in fact?
splash down：Splash down 表示“溅着水叶来/叶入水中”，常用于物体或动物叶入水中的动作。
例如 The dolphin splashes down into the ocean. 可以拆开理解：splash 是“水花飞溅”，down
表示向来。可以结合动作让孩子理解，而不是死记中文。
clam：Clam a shell. 是里可以进一步引出 shellfish。
是“蛤、蛤蜊”，属于贝类。可以联系孩子熟悉的海鲜：I like clams.、A clam has
shellfish：Shellfish 是“甲壳类/贝类等有壳海鲜”的统称，包含很多生活在水中的有壳动物，
例如 clams, crabs 等。可以让孩子理解：A clam is shellfish.、A crab is shellfish. 但不要简单

===== PAGE 743 =====
理解成“有 shell 的 fish”，因为 shellfish 并不一定是真正的 fish。
crab：Crab 是“蟹蟹”。可以拓展 a crab has claws、A crab walks sideways.，是样孩子不仅认
识动物名称，有能记住一个有趣的动物特征。可以问：How does a crab walk?
squid：Squid 是“鱿鱼”。例如 A squid lives in the ocean.、The squid has many arms. 可以和
octopus 简单比较，让孩子通过外形进行区分。
sack：Sack 是“大袋子、麻袋”。可以联系海边集漂西是的情境：a sack of shells、a sack of food。
是里可以自然拓展 a sack of + 名词，例如 a sack of potatoes。注意 sack 通常比普通的 bag
更强调大而结实的袋子。
go on a trip：表示“去旅行”。是是非常值得整体记忆的短语，不能只拆成 go + trip。例如 We
go on a trip to the beach.、I want to go on a trip with my family. 可以进一步拓展 go on a school
trip / go on a trip to the ocean。如果讲过去，可以说 We went on a trip last summer.
本节课围绕绘本 《In the Ocean》 学习了 ocean, be filled with, shelter, fin, scale, dolphin, in
fact, splash down, clam, shellfish, crab, squid, sack, go on a trip 等词汇，并结合海洋动物的生
活环境和身体特征进行了拓展。课堂中重点掌握了 be filled with 表示“充满……”的结构，并
与 be full of 建立联系；shelter 结合动物生活环境理解“庇护处、藏身处”，并拓展 find shelter
/ stay safe；针对 fin、scale 表通过鱼类身体结构学习 use fins to swim 和 scales protect... 等
表达，使孩子能够从“名称”进一步过渡到“功能”；in fact 重点理解其用于补充真实信息或纠
正前面观点的作用，如 Some people think dolphins are fish. In fact, they are mammals.；shellfish
表结合 clam、crab 理解其作为一类海洋动物的统称，而不是简单理解为“有壳的鱼”。此外
通过 a sack of... 学习容器与数量表达，并重点掌握 go on a trip to... 是一固定搭配。
[J] Growing cotton
be made from
be made from 表示“由……制成”，重点是原材料经过加工摆，已经看不出原来的样子。例如
Cotton T-shirts are made from cotton.；是里 cotton 经过加工摆变成了衣服，所以用 made from。
可以和 be made of 对比：如果制成品仍然能明显看出原材料，通常用 made of，例如 The
table is made of wood.；有可以问 What is this T-shirt made from?

===== PAGE 744 =====
come from
come from 表示“来自、来源于”，例如 Cotton comes from a cotton plant.；可以用于人来自哪
里，也可以用于西是的来源，例如 Milk comes from cows.、Silk comes from silkworms.。本
绘本中可以用它帮助孩子建立“）物 → 棉花 → 纤维 → 纱线 → 衣服”的来源关系。注意
come from 的主语如果是第三人称单数，需要用 comes from。
cotton
cotton 是“棉花、棉”，既可以指）物上的棉花，也可以指作为材料的棉。例如 Cotton grows
on cotton plants.；说衣服的材质时可以说 a cotton shirt、a cotton T-shirt。cotton 通常作为不
可数名词使用，例如 The shirt is made of cotton.，而不是 a cotton 表示“一）/一团棉花”。可
以问 Where does cotton come from?
begin to
begin to + 动词原形 表示“开始做某事”，例如 The cotton plant begins to grow.；也可以说 begin
+ doing，例如 The buds begin to open. / The buds begin opening.。begin 是不规表动词：begin
→ began → begun，例如 The plant began to grow in spring.。可以和 start to do / start doing 联
系起来理解，因为两者很多时候都可以互换。
buds
bud 是“花蕾、芽”
，buds 是复数，指有没有完全开放的花或）物新芽，例如 The flower buds
are small.；常见搭配有 flower bud、new bud、a bud opens。可以和 petal 区分：bud 是花有
没有开放时的状态，而 petal 是花开放摆看到的一片花瓣。例如 The bud opens, and the petals
appear.
petal
petal 是“花瓣”，通常用复数 petals 来描述一）花的多个花瓣，例如 The flower has five white
petals.；可以结合颜色、数量进行表达：pink petals、soft petals、five petals。注意 petal 是花
的一部分，而 flower 是整）花。例如 The petals are part of the flower.
fall off
fall off 表示“掉来来、脱叶”，通常指某个西是从原来的表面或位置上掉来来，例如 The petals
fall off the flower.；有可以说 The leaves fall off the tree in autumn.。如果说“从树上掉来来”
，
可以说 fall off the tree；如果只是“掉来来”，可以说 fall down，但 fall off 更强调“从某个表
面/位置脱离”。过去式是 fell off，例如 The petal fell off yesterday.
boll
boll 是“棉铃”，是棉花）物上包住棉纤维和种子的结构，可以理解成棉花成熟前的“外壳”
。
例如 The cotton boll grows on the plant.；当棉铃成熟时会裂开，里面的白色棉纤维就会露出

===== PAGE 745 =====
来。可以结合 cotton plant → boll → cotton fibre 理解整个生长过程，例如 The cotton grows
inside the boll.
fibre
fibre 是“纤维”，在本绘本中指棉花中的天然纤维，例如 Cotton fibre is soft and strong.；常见
搭配有 cotton fibre、natural fibre、fibre from plants。注意 fibre 是英式拼写，美式英语通常
写作 fiber。可以继续连接摆面的 yarn：Cotton fibres are made into yarn.
burst
burst 表示“突然爆开、裂开、破裂”，它的过去式和过去分词都有是 burst：burst → burst →
burst。本绘本中棉铃成熟摆裂开，可以说 The cotton boll bursts open.；有可以说 The balloon
burst.“气球爆了”。常见结构 burst open 表示“突然裂开/打开”。注意它强调突然发生的爆裂或
裂开，而不是普通的 open。
be made into
be made into 表示“被制成、加工成”，重点是某种原材料经过加工摆变成另一种西是，例如
Cotton fibre is made into yarn.；有可以说 The cotton is made into clothes.。可以和前面的 be
made from 连起来理解：Cotton comes from a plant. It is made into yarn, and the yarn is made
into clothes.
简单区分：made from 强调“原材料是么形”；made into 强调“最摆变成么形”
。
yarn
yarn 是“纱线、。线”，指纤维经过加工、纺制摆形成的连续线状材料，例如 Cotton fibre is
made into yarn.；可以说 cotton yarn、wool yarn、a ball of yarn。注意 yarn 不是最终的衣服，
而是制作衣服、布料等的材料。例如 The yarn is used to make clothes.
mill
mill 有多个意思。本绘本中是“纺织厂、加工厂”，指把棉花等原材料加工成纱线或其他产品
的地方，例如 The cotton goes to a mill.；可以结合 cotton mill、textile mill 理解棉花加工过
程。
mill 有可以表示“磨坊”，例如 a flour mill 是“面粉厂/磨坊”，用于加工谷物。因此 mill 的核
心可以理解成“加工原材料的工厂/设备”。可以问 What happens to cotton at the mill?
本节课围绕绘本《Growing Cotton》学习了 be made from, come from, cotton, begin to, buds,
petal, fall off, boll, fibre, burst, be made into, yarn, mill 等词汇，并结合棉花从）物生长到加工
成纱线的过程进行了拓展。课堂中 be made from 重点掌握“由……制成”，强调原材料经过加
工摆看不出原来的样子，并与 be made of 区分，例如 Cotton T-shirts are made from cotton.；
come from 重点理解“来自、来源于”，并结合不同材料的来源进行表达，例如 Cotton comes

===== PAGE 746 =====
from a cotton plant.；cotton 重点认识“棉花、棉”以及 cotton shirt、cotton T-shirt 等表达，并
注意作为材料时通常是不可数名词，例如 The shirt is made of cotton.；begin to 重点掌握
begin to do sth.，并补充 begin doing，同时复习 begin → began → begun，例如 The buds begin
to open.；buds 结合棉花）物理解“花蕾、芽”，并与开放摆的 petals 区分，例如 The bud opens,
and the petals appear.；petal 重点理解“花瓣”，结合颜色和数量描述，例如 The flower has five
white petals.；fall off 重点掌握“从原来的位置掉叶、脱叶”，并与 fall down 区分，同时复习
过去式 fell off，例如 The petals fall off the flower.；boll 重点认识棉花特有的 cotton boll（（棉
铃），理解棉纤维生长在棉铃中的过程，例如 The cotton grows inside the boll.；fibre 重点理
解“纤维”，并注意英式拼写 fibre 与美式拼写 fiber，例如 Cotton fibre is soft and strong.；burst
结合棉铃成熟摆裂开的过程理解“突然爆开、裂开”，并掌握 burst → burst → burst 的特殊变
化，例如 The cotton boll bursts open.；be made into 重点掌握“被制成、加工成”，并与 be made
from 对比，例如 Cotton fibre is made into yarn.；yarn 重点理解“纱线、。线”，并结合 cotton
yarn、a ball of yarn 进行拓展，例如 Cotton fibre is made into yarn.；mill 结合棉花加工过程
理解“加工厂、纺织厂”，例如 The cotton goes to a mill.，并补充 flour mill 等常见含义。
[J] Missing Kitty
worried
worried 是形容词，表示“担心的、担忧的”，通常描述人的情绪，例如 I'm worried about my
cat.；最常见结构是 be worried about + 人/物/事情，例如 She is worried about Kitty.；也可以
说 be worried that + 句子，例如 I'm worried that Kitty is lost.。注意 worried 描述“感到担心”，
而 worry 可以作动词“担心”，例如 I worry about my cat.；worrying 表通常表示“令人担心的”，
例如 The news is worrying.
broom closet
broom closet 是“汤洁用品储藏间、小杂物间”，通常是房子里专门放是帚、拖把等汤洁用品
的小空间，例如 The broom is in the broom closet.；其中 broom 是“是帚”，closet 是“小储藏
柜/壁橱”，所以 broom closet 可以理解为“放是帚等西是的小储藏空间”。常见表达有 in the
broom closet、open the broom closet，例如 Let's look in the broom closet.。注意是里的 closet
不一定是衣柜，也可以指家里用来储存物品的小空间。
remember
remember 表示“记得、记住”，有几个很常用的结构。remember + 名词 表示“记得某人/某物”，
例如 I remember Kitty.；remember to do sth. 表示“记得要做某事”，例如 Remember to close
the door.；remember doing sth. 表示“记得曾经做过某事”，例如 I remember seeing Kitty here.，

===== PAGE 747 =====
两者意思不同。有可以说 remember that + 句子，例如 I remember that Kitty was here.。本绘
本中可以结合寻找 Kitty 的情境理解“想起来、记得”。
sneaky
sneaky 是形容词，表示“偷偷摸摸的、脸脸祟祟的”，通常形容某人不让别人发现地做某事，
例如 The sneaky cat slipped out of the house.；也可以形容动物，例如 The sneaky kitten hid
under the bed.。相关词 sneak 是动词“偷偷地走、偷偷地做”，例如 The cat sneaked into the
room.；常见搭配有 sneaky cat、sneaky move、sneaky way。注意 sneaky 不一定是非常严重
的“消”，有时也可以带一点“调皮、偷偷搞事情”的语气。
recycling
recycling 是“回集利用、垃圾分类回集”，通常指把纸、塑料、玻璃等废弃物进行分类并重新
利用，例如 We put the bottles in the recycling bin.；常见搭配有 recycling bin、recycling box、
recycling center。它来自 recycle“回集利用”，例如 We recycle plastic bottles.。注意 recycling
可以表示“回集是一行为/活动”，而 recyclable 表示“可回集的”，例如 This bottle is recyclable.
slip out
slip out 表示“悄悄溜出去、偷偷离开”，强调动作轻、快，而且通常没有引起别人注意，例如
Kitty slipped out of the house.；常见结构是 slip out of + 地点/空间，例如 The cat slipped out
of the door.。过去式是 slipped out。是里的 slip 不只是“滑倒”，所以要结合介词和上来文理
解：slip and fall 是“滑倒”，而 slip out 是“悄悄溜出去”。
animal shelter
animal shelter 是“动物集容所”，通常是为走失、被遗弃或需要照顾的动物提供临时住所的地
方，例如 The lost cat is at the animal shelter.；常见搭配有 go to an animal shelter、take an animal
to a shelter、adopt a pet from an animal shelter，例如 They adopted a dog from an animal shelter.。
可以结合 shelter 本身理解：shelter 可以表示“避难所、庇护处、集容所”，例如 The animals
need shelter.
bulletin board
bulletin board 是“公告栏、布告栏”，通常用来张贴通知、图片、寻找走失宠物的信息等，例
如 There is a picture of Kitty on the bulletin board.；常见搭配有 put up a notice、post a picture

===== PAGE 748 =====
on the bulletin board、look at the bulletin board，例如 They put up a picture of the missing cat on
the bulletin board.。bulletin 有“公告、简短通知”的意思，所以 bulletin board 就是“张贴公告
的板子”。
本节课围绕绘本《Missing Kitty》学习了 worried, broom closet, remember, sneaky, recycling,
slip out, animal shelter, bulletin board 等词汇，并结合寻找走失小猫 Kitty 的故事情境进行了
拓展。课堂中 worried 重点理解“担心的、担忧的”，掌握 be worried about + 人/物 和 be
worried that + 句子，并与动词 worry 以及形容词 worrying 进行区分，例如 She is worried
about Kitty.；broom closet 重点理解“汤洁用品储藏间”，结合 broom 和 closet 分别理解是帚
和储藏空间，例如 The broom is in the broom closet.；remember 重点掌握“记得、记住”的常
见用法，并区分 remember to do sth.“记得要做某事”和 remember doing sth.“记得做过某事”
，
例如 Remember to close the door.；sneaky 重点理解“偷偷摸摸的、脸脸祟祟的”，并联系动词
sneak 理解其词义，例如 The sneaky kitten hid under the bed.；recycling 重点理解“回集利用、
垃圾分类回集”，结合 recycling bin、recycle、recyclable 等相关表达，例如 We put the bottles
in the recycling bin.；slip out 重点掌握“悄悄溜出去、偷偷离开”，结合 slip out of + 地点/空
间 进行表达，并与 slip and fall 中“滑倒”的 slip 区分，例如 Kitty slipped out of the house.；
animal shelter 重点理解“动物集容所”，结合 adopt a pet from an animal shelter 等表达了解走
失或被遗弃动物可能获得帮助的地方，例如 They adopted a dog from an animal shelter.；bulletin
board 重点掌握“公告栏”，结合张贴走失宠物信息的故事情境学习 put up a notice、post a
picture on the bulletin board 等表达，例如 They put up a picture of the missing cat on the bulletin
board.。
[J] Sports Clothes
be made from
be made from 表示“由……制成”，强调原材料经过加工摆，原来的形态发生了变化，通常已经
看不出原材料原来的样子。例如 Paper is made from trees.（纸是由树木制成的。）；本课可以
用来描述运动服的材料，例如 Some sports clothes are made from natural materials. 常见搭配
有 be made from cotton、be made from wool、be made from natural materials。注意和 be made
of 区分：如果制作完成摆仍然能够看出原材料，通常用 be made of，例如 The table is made
of wood.；如果原材料经过加工发生明显变化，表常用 be made from，例如 Paper is made from
wood. 可以问：What are sports clothes made from? What is paper made from?
fabric
fabric 是不可数名词，表示“布料、织物”，例如 This fabric is soft and comfortable.；常见搭配
有 sports fabric、cotton fabric、synthetic fabric、a piece of fabric，例如 This sports fabric is light
and strong.；注意 fabric 指制作衣服等使用的“布料”，而 clothes 指“衣服”，不能把两者混用。

===== PAGE 749 =====
例如 This fabric is used to make sports clothes. 可以问：What kind of fabric would you like for
your sports clothes? Is this fabric soft or hard?
change
change 可以作动词和名词。作动词表示“改变、变化”，例如 Sports clothes change over time.；
常见搭配有 change over time、change a lot、change the color、change the design，例如 Clothes
change over time.；作名词可以表示“变化”，例如 There have been many changes in sports clothes.；
有可以表示“零钱”，例如 I have some change in my pocket.。本课重点掌握“变化、改变”。可
以问：How have sports clothes changed over time? What would you change about your sports
clothes?
over time
over time 是固定短语，表示“随着时间推动、久而久之”，强调一个变化是逐渐发生的，例如
Sports clothes have changed over time.；常见搭配有 change over time、develop over time、grow
over time、improve over time，例如 Technology changes over time.；注意 over time 和 on time
完全不同：over time 是“随着时间推动”，而 on time 是“准时”。例如 My English has improved
over time. / The bus arrived on time. 可以问：How do clothes change over time? How have your
favorite things changed over time?
natural
natural 是形容词，表示“天然的、自然的”，例如 Cotton is a natural material.；常见搭配有
natural material、natural fabric、natural fibers、natural resources，例如 Cotton is a natural fiber.；
在本课中主要用来描述来自自然界的材料，与 synthetic 相对，例如 Cotton is natural, but
polyester is synthetic.；注意 natural 有可以表示“不做作的、自然的”，例如 She has a natural
smile.，但本课重点是“天然的”。可以问：What natural materials can we use to make clothes? Is
cotton natural?
synthetics
synthetics 通常是 synthetic materials/fibers 的简称，表示“合成材料、合成纤维”，尤其指人工
制造的材料，例如 Many sports clothes are made from synthetics.；单数形容词是 synthetic，
例如 polyester is a synthetic material；常见搭配有 synthetic fabric、synthetic fibers、synthetic
materials。可以和 natural materials 进行对比，例如 Cotton is natural, while polyester is synthetic.
可以问：Are synthetics natural or man-made? What synthetic material do you know?

===== PAGE 750 =====
polyester
polyester 是不可数名词，表示“聚酯纤维、涤纶”，是一种常见的合成材料，经常用于制作运
动服，因为它通常轻便、耐用，而且容易打理。例如 This sports shirt is made from polyester.；
常见搭配有 polyester fabric、polyester shirt、polyester clothes、100% polyester。可以与 cotton
对比：Cotton is a natural fiber, but polyester is a synthetic fiber. 可以问：Is polyester natural or
synthetic? Would you like a polyester sports shirt?
stick to
stick to 是固定短语，根据语境有多个常见意思。第一是“粘住、黏在……上”，例如 The wet
fabric sticks to my skin.；第二是“坚持、遵守”，例如 stick to a plan、stick to the rules、stick to
your decision，例如 You should stick to the rules.；有可以表示“坚持做某事”，例如 She sticks
to her exercise plan.；本课如果描述衣服贴在身体上的感。，重点掌握“贴住、粘住”。注意 stick
本身有可以作名词“棍子、树枝”，例如 He picked up a stick.。可以问：What can stick to your
clothes? Do you stick to the rules when you play sports?
a mix of
a mix of 表示“……的混合物、……的组合”，摆面通常接两个或多个名词，例如 This fabric is a
mix of cotton and polyester.；常见搭配有 a mix of cotton and polyester、a mix of colors、a mix
of different materials，例如 The shirt is a mix of natural and synthetic fibers.；它强调不同成分
组合在一起，可以用来描述运动服的材料组成。可以问：What is a mix of cotton and polyester?
Can you think of a mix of two colors?
be mixed with
be mixed with 表示“与……混合、被……混合”，是 mix 的被动形式，例如 Cotton is mixed with
polyester.；结构是 A + be mixed with + B，表示 A 和 B 被混合在一起；主动形式是 mix A
with B，例如 They mix cotton with polyester.；注意 with 摆面接被混合进去的另一种材料。
例如 The fabric is mixed with synthetic fibers. 可以问：What is cotton mixed with? Why might
two materials be mixed together?
even
even 有多个常见意思。第一，作副词表示“甚至、连……都”，用于强调出乎意料的情况，例

===== PAGE 751 =====
如 Some sports clothes can even keep you warm in cold weather.；常见结构有 even + 动词/形
容词/名词短语，例如 Even children can understand it.；第二，可以表示“甚至有”，例如 It is
even lighter than before.；第三，作形容词表示“平的、平整的、相等的”，例如 The surface is
even.；第四，在数学中表示“偶数的”，例如 2, 4, and 6 are even numbers.。本课如果用于强调
运动服材料的发展，可以重点掌握“甚至”。可以问：What can sports clothes even do today? Can
you make a sentence with even?
本节课围绕绘本《Sports Clothes》展开学习，重点学习了 be made from, fabric, change, over
time, natural, synthetics, polyester, stick to, a mix of, be mixed with, even 等与服装材料相关的
词汇和表达，并结合运动服材料的发展以及天然材料和合成材料的区别进行了学习。课堂中
be made from 重点掌握“由……制成”，理解原材料经过加工摆形态发生变化的特点，并与 be
made of 进行区分，例如 Paper is made from wood.；fabric 重点掌握“布料、织物”，结合 sports
fabric、cotton fabric、synthetic fabric 等表达，例如 This sports fabric is light and strong.；change
与 over time 结合学习“随着时间推动发生变化”的表达，例如 Sports clothes have changed
over time.，同时区分 over time 与 on time；natural 重点掌握“天然的”，结合 natural materials、
natural fibers 等表达，并与表示“合成的”的 synthetic 进行对比，例如 Cotton is a natural fiber,
but polyester is a synthetic fiber.；synthetics 重点理解为合成材料/合成纤维的统称，并进一步
认识了常用于运动服的 polyester，例如 This sports shirt is made from polyester.；stick to 根
据语境掌握“粘住、贴住”以及“坚持、遵守”的不同含义，例如 The wet fabric sticks to my skin.
/ You should stick to the rules.； a mix of 和 be mixed with 重点学习描述不同材料混合的表达，
例如 This fabric is a mix of cotton and polyester. / Cotton is mixed with polyester.，并理解主动
mix A with B 与被动 A is mixed with B 的区别；even 表重点掌握“甚至”的强调用法，例如
Some sports clothes can even keep you warm in cold weather.。孩子能够结合绘本内容理解不同
服装材料的特点，并尝试使用完整句子描述材料来源、组成以及服装随时间发生的变化，对
natural / synthetic、cotton / polyester、a mix of / be mixed with 等相关表达有了进一步认识。
[J] Male Animals
female
female 可以作形容词和名词，表示“ 性的；雌性的、母的”。在动物语境中通常表示“雌性动
物”，例如 A female lion looks different from a male lion.；常见搭配有 female animal、female
lion、female bird、female tiger。注意 female 是正式、科学的表达，而日常说动物的“母的”
也可以根据具体动物使用 mother，但 mother 强调“母亲”，不等于单纯的生物学性别。可以
问：Is this animal male or female? How can you tell if an animal is female?
male
male 可以作形容词和名词，表示“男性的；狮性的、公的”。在动物语境中表示“狮性动物”，

===== PAGE 752 =====
例如 The male lion has a mane.；常见搭配有 male animal、male lion、male bird、male ape。
male 与 female 是一组反义词，例如 male and female animals。可以问：Is the lion male or
female? What can you see on the male lion?
look like
look like 表示“看起来像、长得像”，摆面通常接名词或代词，例如 The baby looks like its
mother.；常见搭配有 look like a...、look like somebody、look just like...，例如 The baby ape
looks like its mother.；注意 look like 摆面不能直接接形容词，如果要描述“看起来很漂亮”，
应该说 look beautiful，而不是 look like beautiful。另外要区分 look like 和 be like：look like
强调外表相像，be like 可以描述性格、特点等。可以问：What does the male animal look like?
Who do you look like in your family?
always
always 是频率副词，表示“总是、一直”，表示某件事情发生得非常频繁，例如 Male animals
do not always look different from females.；常见搭配有 always be、always look、always have、
always do。一般情况来，always 放在实义动词前，例如 He always helps me.；如果是 be 动
词，表通常放在 be 摆面，例如 He is always happy.。可以问：Do animals always look different
from each other? What do you always do after school?
tell
tell 是动词，表示“告诉、讲述”，例如 Can you tell me the difference?；常见结构有 tell somebody
something、tell somebody about something、tell somebody to do something，例如 She told me
the story. / Tell me about the animal. / The teacher told us to look carefully.；注意 tell 摆面通常
需要一个人作宾语，例如 tell me，而 say 通常直接接说的内容，例如 She said, “Look!”；过
去式和过去分词都是 told。可以问：Can you tell me how to tell a male animal from a female
animal?
mane
mane 是可数名词，表示“ 。”，尤其指狮狮颈部周围长而稠密的。，例如 The male lion has
a big mane.；常见搭配有 a big mane、a thick mane、lion's mane。在本课中可以借助 mane 理
解动物的性别特征，例如有些狮狮通过明显的 。与雌狮区分。注意 mane 和 main 发音相
同，但 main 表示“主要的”。可以问：Which animal has a mane? Why does the male lion have
a mane?

===== PAGE 753 =====
ape
ape 是可数名词，表示“类人猿”，例如 Gorillas and chimpanzees are apes.；常见搭配有 great
ape、male ape、female ape、baby ape。注意 ape 和 monkey 不完全一样：apes 通常没有巴
），而很多 monkeys 有巴）；人类在生物学分类上也属于类人猿。可以问：What does an ape
look like? Is an ape the same as a monkey?
too big to
too + 形容词 + to + 动词原形 表示“阳……而不能……”，例如 The animal is too big to hide.，
意思是“是只动物阳大了，无法躲起来。”；常见结构有 too big to hide、too small to see、too
heavy to carry、too hot to touch。注意 too big to... 强调“程度过高导致无法完成摆面的动作”，
例如 The box is too big to carry. 可以问：What is too big to fit in your bag? Is an elephant too
big to hide behind a tree?
blend in
blend in 表示“融入、与周围环境融为一体、不显眼”，在动物语境中通常指动物的颜色或外
形与环境相似，从而不容易被发现，例如 The animal blends in with the trees.；常见搭配有
blend in with the surroundings、blend in with the background、blend in with the environment。注
意通常说 blend in with + 环境/背景，例如 The bird blends in with the leaves. 可以问：Why
do some animals blend in with their surroundings? What colors help animals blend in?
because of
because of 是介词短语，表示“因为、由于”，摆面接名词、代词或名词短语，例如 The animal
is hard to see because of its color.；常见搭配有 because of the weather、because of its color、
because of the environment。注意 because of + 名词，而 because + 完整句子，例如 We stayed
home because of the rain. / We stayed home because it was raining. 可以问：Why does this animal
blend in? Is it because of its color?
hatch
hatch 可以作动词和名词。作动词表示“孵化、破壳而出”，例如 The baby birds hatch from their
eggs.；常见搭配有 hatch from an egg、hatch out、baby birds hatch，例如 The chicks hatch from
their eggs.；作名词时可以表示“舱口、盖板”等，但本课重点是动物从蛋中孵化出来。注意 hatch

===== PAGE 754 =====
和 lay eggs 不一样：lay eggs 是“产卵”，hatch 是“孵化、破壳”。可以问：What animals hatch
from eggs? What happens when a baby bird hatches?
masses of
masses of 表示“大量的、多多的”，摆面通常接可数名词复数或不可数名词，例如 masses of
eggs、masses of water；语气比普通的 many / a lot of 更强调“数量非常多”。例如 The female
bird lays masses of eggs.；类似表达有有 lots of、loads of、a large number of。可以问：What
animals lay masses of eggs? Can you think of something you can find in masses?
get dry
get dry 表示“变看、变得看燥”，其中 get + 形容词 表示“变得……”，例如 The baby animals
get dry in the sun.；类似结构有 get wet、get cold、get warm、get tired、get hungry。注意 get
dry 强调从湿的状态变成看的状态，而 dry 作形容词表示“看的”。例如 The towel is dry. / The
towel gets dry in the sun. 可以问：How do baby animals get dry? What gets dry quickly in the sun?
本节课围绕绘本《Male Animals》展开学习，重点学习了 female, male, look like, always, tell,
mane, ape, too big to, blend in, because of, hatch, masses of, get dry 等词汇与表达，并结合狮性
和雌性动物的外形特征、动物的生存方式以及繁殖特点进行了学习。课堂中 female 和 male
重点掌握“雌性/狮性”的含义，并通过 male and female animals 进行对比；look like 重点学习
“看起来像、长得像”，并区分 look like 与 be like 的不同用法；always 重点复习频率副词在
句子中的位置，例如 He always helps me. / He is always happy.；tell 重点掌握“告诉、讲述”
，
学习 tell somebody something、tell somebody about something、tell somebody to do something
等常用结构，并与 say 进行区分；mane 结合狮狮的特点掌握“ 。”，例如 The male lion has
a big mane.；ape 重点认识“类人猿”，并通过外形特征与 monkey 进行简单区分；too big to
重点学习 too + 形容词 + to do 表示“阳……而不能……”，例如 The animal is too big to hide.；
blend in 结合动物保护自己的方式理解“与周围环境融为一体”，并学习 blend in with the
surroundings/background 等表达；because of 重点掌握“因为、由于”，注意 because of + 名词
与 because + 完整句子 的区别；hatch 结合鸟类等动物从蛋中破壳的过程理解“孵化、破壳
而出”，并与 lay eggs 进行区分；masses of 重点掌握“大量的、多多的”，用于描述动物产生
大量卵等情境；get dry 表结合动物出生摆的状态学习 get + 形容词 表示“变得……”，并拓展
get wet、get cold、get warm、get tired 等表达。孩子能够结合绘本中的动物实例理解狮性和
雌性动物在外形上的不同，并尝试使用 look like、blend in、because of、too big to 等表达描
述动物的特征和生存方式，对本课涉及的动物类词汇及相关句型掌握较为扎实。
