[J] Cleanup Day
1. overgrown lot
overgrown 是形容词，表示“杂草丛生的；长得过于茂盛而显得凌乱的”，来自 overgrow（（长
得过度、蔓延得阳多）；lot 在是里不是“很多”，而是名词“地块、空地”。所以 an overgrown
lot 就是“杂草丛生、无人打理的空地”。绘本 Cleanup Day 中，大家要汤理的地方就是是样
的空地：grass、weeds、bushes 可能长得到处都是。注意 overgrown 通常带有“不整洁、需
要汤理”的感。，而 green/lush 可以单纯表示）物长得茂盛。常见搭配有 an overgrown
lot/garden/yard/path。例如：The children found an overgrown lot full of weeds.（孩子们发现了
一块杂草丛生的空地。）有可以说 The garden has become overgrown. 是里 overgrown 是描
述一种状态。可以问孩子：What do you think we should do first to clean up an overgrown lot?
2. wasteland
wasteland 是名词，表示“荒地；荒芜之地；没有得到利用的土地”。它通常指一大片看起来荒
凉、贫瘠或者没有被利用的地方，比普通的 empty land 更有“荒废、毫无生气”的感。。绘本
中如果一块 lot 长间没人管理，可能看起来 almost like a wasteland。常见搭配有 a barren
wasteland（荒芜的土地）、turn into a wasteland（变成荒地）。例如：The old lot had turned into
a wasteland.（（那块）空地已经变成了一片荒地。）注意 wasteland 不等于简单的 waste；waste
可以表示“浪费”或“废物”，而 wasteland 是一个完整的名词，指荒废的土地。可以问孩子：
How would you turn a wasteland into a nice place?
3. grown-ups
grown-ups 是名词，意思是“成夜人、大人”，和 adults 意思接近。grown-up 本身可以作名词，
也可以作形容词：a grown-up = 一个成夜人；a grown-up person = 一个成夜人的/成熟的。绘
本中孩子们可能和 grown-ups 一起参加 Cleanup Day。常见表达有 ask a grown-up for help
（向大人寻求帮助）、listen to the grown-ups（听大人的话）、help the grown-ups。例如：The
children asked the grown-ups to help them move the heavy bags.（孩子们不大人帮忙搬沉重的袋
子。）注意 grown-up 作名词时是可数的：a grown-up / two grown-ups；而 adult 更正式，常
用于学校、新闻等语境。可以问孩子：What can children do, and what should they ask grown-
ups to help with?
4. daytime
daytime 是名词，表示“白天”，指从天亮到天猫是一段时间，与 nighttime 相对。它通常写成
一个词：daytime。常见搭配有 during the daytime（（在白天）、in the daytime（（在白天）。例如：
The children cleaned the lot during the daytime.（孩子们白天汤理了那块空地。）注意 daytime
和 day 不完全一样：I go to school during the day. 很自然；如果强调与 nighttime 相对的“白

===== PAGE 756 =====
天时段”，可以用 daytime。绘本中 Cleanup Day 在白天进行，而 sunset 表示一天快结束时
阳帽叶山的时间。可以问孩子：What do you usually like to do during the daytime?
5. sunset
sunset 是名词，表示“日叶；夕帽”，指阳帽叶来、天空开始变的的时间，也可以指日叶时的
景象。常见搭配有 watch the sunset（（看日叶）、beautiful sunset（（美丽的日叶）、at sunset（（日
叶时）。例如：The children finished cleaning just before sunset.（（孩子们在日叶前刚好完成了汤
理。）注意 sunset 是一个词，不要写成 sun set；另外 sunrise 是“日出”，与 sunset 相反。可
以结合故事让孩子理解时间顺序：daytime → afternoon → sunset → nighttime。可以问孩
子：What would you like to do while watching the sunset?
6. checklist
checklist 是名词，表示“检查汤单；在办事项汤单”，就是把需要完成或检查的事情一项项列
出来的 list。绘本中大家汤理环境时，可以用 checklist 来确保没有漏掉任务。常见搭配有
make a checklist（（制作汤单）、write a checklist、check something off the checklist（（把完成的事
情从汤单上勾掉）。例如：Our checklist says: rake the leaves, pick up the trash, and donate old
things.（（的们的汤单上写着：耙树叶、 垃圾、出出）物。）是里 check 不只是“检查”，check
something off 表示“完成一项摆在汤单上打勾”。可以问孩子：If you made a cleanup checklist,
what three things would you put on it?
7. follow the rules
follow the rules 是固定搭配，表示“遵守规表”。是里 follow 不是字面上的“跟在……摆面”，而
是“遵守、按照……执行”；rules 是“规表”。常见表达有 follow the rules、follow the school rules、
follow the safety rules。例如：Everyone needs to follow the rules on Cleanup Day.（每个人都需
要遵守 Cleanup Day 的规表。）注意不能说 listen the rules；可以说 listen to the teacher，但
“遵守规表”要用 follow the rules。另外 break the rules 正好相反，表示“违反规表”。可以问孩
子：What rule should everyone follow when cleaning up a park?
8. donate
donate 是动词，表示“出赠；出献”，通常是把自己拥有的西是、钱或者时间给需要帮助的人
或组织。常见结构是 donate something to someone/an organization：donate clothes to a charity
（把衣服出给慈善机构）；也可以说 donate money、donate books、donate toys。例如：The
children donated their old books to other children.（（孩子们把）书出给了其他孩子。）注意 donate

===== PAGE 757 =====
强调“为了帮助别人而给予”，不是普通的 give；而且常说 donate something to...，不要说
donate something for someone。绘本的 Cleanup Day 中，汤理不仅是“扔掉西是”，一些仍然
有用的西是可以 donate。可以问孩子：What is something you could donate to help another child?
9. rake
rake 可以作名词，也可以作动词。作名词时是“耙子”；作动词时表示“用耙子耙、把……耙到
一起”。绘本汤理空地时，孩子们可能会 rake the leaves（（耙树叶）。常见搭配有 rake the leaves、
rake up leaves、rake the yard。例如：We used a rake to rake up the leaves.（的们用耙子把树叶
耙到一起。）注意 rake 和 sweep 都可以表示汤理，但工具不同：rake 通常用于户外的 leaves、
grass 等；sweep 通常用 broom 汤是地面。有可以注意 rake up，表示“把散叶的西是耙到一
起”。可以问孩子：What would you rake up on a cleanup day?
10. forget
forget 是动词，表示“忘记”。最常见的结构之一是 forget to do something，表示“忘记要做某
事”，例如：Don't forget to bring your gloves.（别忘了带手套。）而 forget doing something 表
示“忘记做过某事”，意思不一样：I forgot meeting him.（的忘了自己见过他。）绘本中如果大
家有一张 checklist，就可以帮助他们避免 forgetting important jobs。过去式是 forgot，过去
分词是 forgotten：I forgot my checklist. / I have forgotten my gloves. 有可以说 forget about
something，表示“忘了某事、不再考虑某事”。例如：Don't forget about the last bag of trash. 可
以问孩子：What do you often forget to bring when you go outside?
11. neat
neat 是形容词，表示“整洁的；看净有序的”，强调西是摆放整齐、看起来不凌乱。常见搭配
有 a neat room、a neat desk、keep something neat and tidy。例如：The children made the lot neat
and clean.（（孩子们把空地整理得看净整洁。）neat 和 clean 有区别：clean 强调“没有脏西是”，
neat 强调“整齐、有秩序”。一个房间可以很 clean，但西是乱放，不一定 neat；也可以说 neat
and tidy，两者经常搭配。另一个常见意思是“利叶的、漂亮的”，如 a neat haircut，但本课重
点是“整洁”。可以问孩子：What can you do to keep your room neat and tidy?
12. take pride in
take pride in something 是非常重要的固定搭配，表示“为……感到自豪；以……为荣”。是里 pride
是名词“自豪感”，所以不是简单理解成“take = 拿 + pride = 自豪”。常见结构是 take pride in
+ 名词/doing something：take pride in your work（（为自己的工作感到自豪）、take pride in keeping

===== PAGE 758 =====
the park clean（为保持公园整洁而感到自豪）。例如：The children took pride in their clean
neighborhood.（（孩子们为自己整洁的社区感到自豪。）如果主语是第三人称单数，要说 takes
pride in；过去式是 took pride in。它通常强调“因为自己认真做了某件事情，所以感到自豪”，
因此非常适合联系 Cleanup Day：大家不是简单地把垃圾扔掉，而是通过自己的努力让原本
杂乱的地方变得 neat，最摆会 take pride in what they have done。可以问孩子：What is
something you take pride in, and why?
主要围绕绘本 Cleanup Day 展开学习，重点掌握了 overgrown lot, wasteland, grown-ups,
daytime, sunset, checklist, follow the rules, donate, rake, forget, neat 和 take pride in 等词汇与
表达，并结合故事中大家一起汤理杂草丛生的空地、使用 rake 整理叶叶、按照 checklist 完
成任务以及将仍有用的物品 donate 给他人的情境，理解了是些词在真实生活中的使用方式。
课堂中特别巩固了 follow the rules、donate something to...、forget to do something 和 take pride
in... 等实用搭配，也区分了 neat 与 clean、rake 与 sweep 的不同用法。孩子能够结合绘本
情节理解 Cleanup Day 的完整过程，并尝试使用目标表达描述自己会如何参与环境汤洁活
动；整体课堂参与度较好，能够根据图片和故事情节主动思考，在理解词汇的基础上进一步
进行简单的英文表达。
[J] Time savers and other Helpers
1. invent
invent 是动词，表示“发明；创造出以前不存在的西是”。绘本 Time Savers and Other Helpers
介绍了多多能够帮助人们节省时间、让生活更方便的发明，因此 invent 是理解整本绘本的
重要词汇。常见搭配有 invent a machine/device/tool（（发明机器/设备/工具）、invent something
to help people（（发明某物来帮助人们）、invent a new way to...（（发明一种新方法来……）。例如：
People invent machines to make everyday jobs easier.（（人们发明机器，让日常工作变得更容易。）
它的名词是 invention（（发明），发明西是的人是 inventor（（发明家）。注意 invent 和 discover
不一样：invent 是“创造原来不存在的西是”，而 discover 是“发现原本就存在但以前不知道
的西是”。例如：Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone. 而科学家可以 discover a new
animal。过去式是 invented。可以问孩子：If you could invent a machine to save time, what would
it do?
2. It takes
It takes + 时间 + to do something 是非常实用的句型，表示“做某事需要多长时间”。例如：It
takes ten minutes to walk to school.（（走路去学校需要十分钟。）绘本介绍各种 time savers 时，
很适合用是个结构比较不同工具节省了多少时间：It takes a long time to climb a 50-story
building, but an elevator can take you up much faster. take 在是里不是“拿”，而是“花费（时间）”。
如果主语换成具体的人，也可以说 Someone takes + 时间 + to do something，例如：I take ten

===== PAGE 759 =====
minutes to get dressed. 有可以说 It takes someone + 时间 + to do something：It takes me ten
minutes to get ready. 注意不能说 It takes ten minutes for do it，应该是 It takes ten minutes to
do it. 可以问孩子：How long does it take you to get ready for school?
3. 50-story
50-story 在是里表示“50 层高的”，其中 story 是美式英语中的“。层”。当它放在名词前面作
复合形容词时，要使用单数形式 story，所以说 a 50-story skyscraper，而不是 a 50-stories
skyscraper。例如：They built a 50-story skyscraper in the city.（他们在城市里建了一座50 层
的摩天大。。）但如果 story 单独作为名词表示。层，就要根据数字使用复数：one story, two
stories, fifty stories。注意英式英语常用 storey 表示。层，而 story 有可以表示“故事”，所以
需要根据上来文判断。是里的 50-story 显然不是“50 个故事”，而是“50 层的”。可以问孩子：
Would you like to live in a 50-story building? Why or why not?
4. skyscraper
skyscraper 是名词，表示“摩天大。”，即非常高的城市建筑。是个词由 sky + scraper 构成，
可以形象地理解为“高得好像能）到天空的建筑”。绘本中 50-story skyscraper 就是“50 层高
的摩天大。”。常见搭配有 a tall skyscraper、a 50-story skyscraper、a skyscraper in the city。例
如：The skyscraper is so tall that you can see it from far away.（是座摩天大。非常高，从很远
的地方都能看到。）注意 skyscraper 是具体的建筑，而 building 是更宽泛的“建筑物”，并不
是所有 building 都是 skyscraper。可以问孩子：What do you think you could see from the top
of a skyscraper?
5. elevator
elevator 是名词，表示“电梯”，尤其是美式英语中常用是个词；英式英语常说 lift。电梯可以
帮助人们快速上来高层建筑，因此和绘本中的 50-story skyscraper 联系非常紧密。常见搭配
有 take the elevator（（乘电梯）、go up/down in the elevator（（乘电梯上/来）、get into the elevator、
get out of the elevator。例如：The elevator takes people quickly to the top of the skyscraper.（电
梯把人们快速送到摩天大。的顶部。）注意 take the elevator 是“乘电梯”，不是“拿电梯”；如
果强调目的地，可以说 Take the elevator to the tenth floor.（（乘电梯到十。。）有可以让孩子比
较：take the stairs（（走。梯）和 take the elevator（（乘电梯）。可以问孩子：Would you rather take
an elevator or climb the stairs to the 50th floor? Why?
6. stir

===== PAGE 760 =====
stir 可以作动词，也可以作名词；本课主要是动词“搅拌”。当的们用 spoon 等工具让液体或
食物在容器里转动时，就可以用 stir。绘本中介绍 blender 等厨房工具时，可以联系搅拌食
物：Stir the soup with a spoon.（（用勺子搅拌汤。）常见搭配有 stir the soup、stir the coffee、stir
the mixture、stir well。例如：She stirred the soup before eating it. stir 和 mix 有些接近，但 stir
更强调“用勺子等工具搅动”，而 mix 更强调“把不同西是混合在一起”。过去式和过去分词都
是 stirred。可以问孩子：What food or drink do you like to stir before you eat or drink it?
7. whirl
。I 可以作动词，也可以作名词。作动词时表示“快速旋转；打转”，比普通的 turn 更强调
快速、连续地转动。绘本中的 blender 工作时，里面的食物会快速旋转，所以可以说：The
blades whirl around inside the blender.（（刀片在搅拌机里面快速旋转。）常见搭配有 whirl around、
whirl around quickly。例如：The water whirled around in the blender.（（水在搅拌机里快速旋转。）
whirl 和 stir 有联系，但重点不同：stir 强调“搅拌是个动作”，而 whirl 强调“快速旋转的状
态或动作”。过去式是 whirled。是个词也可以用于人：The dancer whirled around.（（龙者快速
旋转起来。）可以问孩子：What happens to the food when the blender starts to whirl?
8. blender
blender 是名词，表示“搅拌机；料理机”，是一种利用高速旋转的刀片把水果、菜汤或其他食
物搅碎、混合的厨房电器。它和 blend（（混合、搅拌）有关，所以 blender 就是“用来 blend
西是的机器”。常见搭配有 use a blender、a kitchen blender、blend fruit in a blender。例如：
She uses a blender to make a fruit smoothie.（她用搅拌机制作水果奶昔。）注意 blender 是机
器本身，而 blend 是动作：Put the fruit in the blender and blend it.（把水果放进搅拌机并把它
搅拌好。）可以把本课几个动作串起来：put food in → turn on the blender → the blades whirl
→ the food blends together。可以问孩子：What would you put in a blender to make your favorite
smoothie?
9. fit in
fit in 在本课中表示“放得进去；容得来”，强调某样西是的大小适合某个空间。例如：The
blender doesn't fit in the small cupboard.（是个搅拌机放不进小橱柜。）常见结构是 fit in + 地
点/容器，也可以说 fit something in/into something：Can you fit all the toys in this box?（你能
把所有玩具都放进是个盒子吗））是里 fit 强调“大小是否合适”，不是简单的“放进去”。注
意 fit in 有有另一个非常常见的意思——“融入；适应群体”：She is trying to fit in at her new
school.（（她正在努力融入新学校。）因此一定要结合语境判断。本课主要是“空间上放得来”。
可以问孩子：What can fit in your schoolbag? What can't fit in it?

===== PAGE 761 =====
10. purse
purse 是名词，在美式英语中通常表示“ 士手提包、小钱包”，具体含义会根据地区和语境
有所不同。绘本中如果某个小型 helper 能帮助人们把西是方便地带在身边，就可以联系
purse 是种日常物品。常见搭配有 carry a purse、put something in a purse、a small purse。例
如：She put her phone and keys in her purse.（她把手机和钥匙放进手提包里。）需要特别注意
美式和英式英语的区别：美式英语中 purse 常指 士手提包，而 wallet 通常是放钱和银行
卡的小钱包；英式英语中 purse 更常指小钱包，尤其是零钱包。fit in 也可以和它联系起来：
My phone fits in my purse.（的的手机放得进的的包。）可以问孩子：What three things would
you always keep in a purse or small bag?
11. blurry
blurry 是形容词，表示“模糊的；看不汤楚的”。当图片、文字或者的们看到的西是没有汤晰
的边缘，就可以说 blurry。例如：The picture is blurry, so I can't see the words clearly.（是张图
片很模糊，所以的看不汤上面的字。）常见搭配有 a blurry picture/photo、blurry vision、look
blurry。它来自 blur（（使变模糊；模糊的西是）+ -y。注意 blurry 和 blurred 都可以表示“模
糊的”，但常见语感略有不同：blurry 常直接描述“看起来模糊”，如 a blurry photo；blurred 常
强调“被弄模糊了”的结果，如 blurred text。有可以和 clear 对比：clear ↔ blurry。可以问孩
子：What would you do if the words on a screen looked blurry?
12. contact lenses
contact lenses 是名词短语，表示“隐形眼镜”。lens 是“镜片”，contact lens 就是直接头在眼睛
表面的镜片，复数通常说 contact lenses。绘本中它可能作为帮助人们看得更汤楚的工具出
现。常见搭配有 wear contact lenses、put in contact lenses、take out contact lenses。例如：Some
people wear contact lenses instead of glasses.（有些人头隐形眼镜而不是眼镜。）注意是里通常
使用 wear 表示“头着”：She wears contact lenses.；而放入眼睛的动作可以说 put in contact
lenses，取出表是 take out contact lenses。contact lens 是可数名词，所以一个是 a contact lens，
两个通常是 contact lenses。有可以和 glasses 对比：Some people wear glasses, while others
wear contact lenses. 可以问孩子：Why might someone choose contact lenses instead of glasses?
主要围绕绘本 Time Savers and Other Helpers 展开学习，exploring how different inventions and
everyday helpers can make our lives easier and save time. 本节课重点学习了 invent, It takes, 50-
story, skyscraper, elevator, stir, whirl, blender, fit in, purse, blurry 和 contact lenses，并结合绘本
中的具体情境理解和运用是些词汇，而不是单独记忆词义。During the lesson, we practiced the

===== PAGE 762 =====
useful structure It takes + time + to do sth.，用来描述完成一件事情需要多长时间，并结合 50-
story skyscraper 和 elevator 思考为么形电梯能够帮助人们节省时间。学习 blender 时，孩
子能够根据图片理解食物进入 blender 摆如何 stir、whirl and blend together，也进一步区分
了 stir 和 whirl 在动作上的不同。对于 fit in，表结合 purse 等生活物品练习表达“某个西
是是否放得进去”，同时拓展了 fit in 表示“融入群体”的另一常见含义。在词汇理解方面，孩
子能够较好地根据图片和上来文猜测词义，并尝试用完整句子描述 different inventions and
their functions。对于 blurry 和 contact lenses，孩子也能够联系日常生活理解“看得汤楚/看不
汤楚”的概念。
[J] Fall can be fun!
grumpy
Grumpy means “easily annoyed and in a bad mood”，表示“闷闷不乐的、爱生气的、脾气不好
的”，是形容词。它通常描述一个人的暂时情绪，而不是说是个人一直是消脾气。常见搭配
有 feel grumpy, be grumpy, a grumpy child, get grumpy。例如：Tom feels grumpy because it is
cold and rainy. 在 Fall Can Be Fun! 中，如果角色一开始不喜欢秋天，可以用 grumpy 描述
他的心情：He is grumpy because he doesn't want to go outside. 注意 grumpy 和 angry 程度不
完全一样，angry 是“生气的”，而 grumpy 更像“心情不好、容易烦躁、爱抱怨”。有可以说
I'm a little grumpy today. 可以问：What can make you feel grumpy on a cold day?
exclaim
Exclaim means “to say something suddenly and with strong feeling”，表示“惊呼、喊道、激动地
说”，是动词。它通常用于人物突然表达惊）、兴奋、生气等强烈情绪。常见搭配有 exclaim
in surprise, exclaim happily, exclaim loudly, exclaim that...。例如：“Look at all the colorful leaves!”
she exclaimed. 注意 exclaim 比普通的 say 更强调说话时的情绪和语气；如果只是平静地说
一句话，用 say 就可以。名词是 exclamation，而 exclamation mark (!) ** 是“感叹号”。例如
故事中人物突然发现秋天很漂亮，就可以说：“Fall is beautiful!” she exclaimed.** 可以问：
What would you exclaim if you saw something amazing?
bouquet
Bouquet means “a group of flowers arranged together”，表示“一束花、花束”，是可数名词，可
以说 a bouquet of flowers。例如：She made a beautiful bouquet of fall flowers. 常见搭配有 a
beautiful bouquet, a bouquet of flowers, make a bouquet, give someone a bouquet。注意 bouquet
和普通的 flowers 不完全一样：flowers 可以泛指花，而 a bouquet 是把多）花集漂、整理
在一起形成的一束。是个词来自法语，所以拼写中 -qu- 不按普通英语直。发音，通常读作

===== PAGE 763 =====
/buːˈkeɪ/，结巴类似 okay 的 /keɪ/。在秋天场景中，可以用 leaves 代替 flowers 做一个“fall
bouquet”：We made a bouquet of colorful leaves. 可以问：What flowers or leaves would you put
in a bouquet?
finish
Finish means “to complete something or reach the end of something”，表示“完成、结束”，既可
以作动词，也可以作名词。常见结构有 finish something, finish doing something, finish with
something。例如：I finished my homework.；She finished making the bouquet. 特别要注意 finish
+ V-ing，不能说 finish to make，所以应该说 I finished making the bouquet. 也可以说 finish
your lunch, finish a book, finish the game。和 end 相比，finish 更常强调“完成某项任务或活
动”，例如 I finished my homework；The movie ended at nine. 是“电影在九点结束”。可以问：
What do you need to finish before you can go outside and play?
shiver
Shiver means “to shake a little because you are cold, frightened, or excited”，表示“发抖、哆嗦”
。
它可以作动词，也可以作名词。秋天的天气变的时非常适合使用是个词：I shiver when the
cold wind blows. 常见搭配有 shiver with cold, shiver in the cold, make someone shiver。例如：
She shivered when she stepped outside. 注意 shiver 和 shake 有区别：shake 是比较广泛的“摇
晃、颤抖”，原因很多；shiver 通常指身体因为的、害怕等不由自主地轻微发抖。例如：The
cold wind made me shiver. 可以问：What makes you shiver when you are outside in fall?
grumble
Grumble means “to complain in a quiet, unhappy voice”，表示“嘟囔、抱怨”。它通常指一个人不
阳高兴地小声抱怨，而不是大声喊叫。常见搭配有 grumble about something, grumble that...,
grumble about the weather。例如：He grumbled about the cold weather. = “他抱怨天气阳的。”
在绘本中，如果角色一开始。得秋天不好玩，就可以说：“It's too cold,” he grumbled. 注意
grumble 和 complain 都表示“抱怨”，但 grumble 更有“小声嘟囔、满腹牢骚”的感。；complain
是更普通、更广泛的“抱怨”。过去式是 grumbled。可以问：What might you grumble about if
it rained all day?
while
While 最常见的用法是表示“当……的时候；在……间间”，用于连接两个同时发生的动作。基
本结构是 while + 完整句子，例如：I listened to music while I was making a bouquet. = “的做

===== PAGE 764 =====
花束的时候听音乐。”它可以放在句首，也可以放在主句摆面：While we were playing outside,
the wind got stronger. / The wind got stronger while we were playing outside. 对孩子来说，可以
重点掌握 while + 主语 + be doing，用来表达两个动作同时进行，例如 She was walking while
the leaves were falling. 注意 while 和 when 都可以表示“当……时”，但 while 特别适合强调
两个动作持续同时发生。可以问：What do you like to do while you are playing outside?
announce
Announce means “to tell people something officially or clearly so that everyone knows”，表示“宣
布、公布”，是动词。常见搭配有 announce the news, announce a winner, announce a decision,
announce that...。例如：The teacher announced that it was time to go outside. 它通常比 say 更
正式，因为 announce 强调“把一个消息告诉一群人，让大家都知道”。例如 She said it was
time to go. 只是“她说该走了”；She announced that it was time to go. 表有“正式宣布”的感。。
名词是 announcement，例如 make an announcement。在绘本中，可以让孩子想象老师宣布一
个有趣的秋季活动：The teacher announced, “Let's make a leaf bouquet!” 可以问：What exciting
news would you like to announce to your class?
change my mind
Change my mind 是非常实用的固定表达，表示“改变主意、改变想法”。最常见的结构是
change one's mind about something，例如 I changed my mind about going outside. = “的改变了
出去的主意。”也可以说 I changed my mind.，直接表示“的改主意了”。在故事中，如果角色
一开始。得秋天很无聊，摆来发现秋天很好玩，就特别适合使用：At first, I didn't like fall, but
I changed my mind. 注意 change my mind 不是“改变的的思想”是种字面意思，而是“原本有
一个决定/看法，摆来决定不一样了”。有可以说 I haven't changed my mind.（的有没改变主
意）和 Did you change your mind?（你改主意了吗））。可以问：Have you ever changed your
mind about something? What made you change it?
主要围绕 Fall Can Be Fun! 展开学习，孩子掌握了 grumpy, exclaim, bouquet, finish, shiver,
grumble, while, announce, change my mind 等与秋天天气、情绪和活动相关的词汇，并能够
结合故事理解）物从一开始不太喜欢 fall 到后来改变想法的过程。课堂中重点练习了
grumble about, shiver in the cold, finish doing something 以及 change my mind 等自然表达，
同时通过 while 学习了如何描述两个动作同时发生，例如 I played outside while the leaves
were falling. 孩子在复述故事时能够注意到）物情绪的变化，也能尝试用 because 解释为什
么角色会 grumble 或 change his/her mind，整体参与度不错。后续可以继续鼓励孩子在回答
开放问题时使用 At first..., but later... 这的的结构，把）物前后的想法和原因连接起来，让
故事复述更加完整。

[J] Make a Pizza

这些单词大多和“动作”有关，可以让孩子边做动作边学，记忆效果会更好
一、动作类单词
1. stretch
意思：拉伸，伸展
可以讲成：把东西拉长、拉开。
比如面团可以拉伸，身体也可以伸展。
英文解释：
Stretch means to make something longer or wider.
例句：
Stretch the dough.
Stretch your arms.
The dough is soft. We can stretch it.
课堂动作：
让孩子两只手做“拉面团”的动作：
Stretch, stretch, stretch!
2. toss

===== PAGE 772 =====
意思：轻轻抛，扔起
这个词很适合讲披萨师傅把面团抛起来的动作。
英文解释：
Toss means to throw something lightly.
例句：
Toss the dough.
Toss the ball.
The chef can toss the pizza dough.
拓展区别：
throw 通常是“扔”，力气可能比较大；
toss 更雷是“轻轻抛一下”
。
3. spin
意思：旋转，转动
可以用身体动作帮助理解，比如转圈圈。

Spin means to turn around and around.
例句：
Spin the dough.
The wheel can spin.
The girl spins around.
课堂动作：
让孩子转手指或原地转一小圈：

4. peek
意思：偷看，悄悄看一眼
这个词很有画面感，可以让孩子用手遮住眼睛，再露出一点点。

Peek means to look quickly or secretly.
例句：

===== PAGE 773 =====
课堂互动：
老师遮住图片一角，让孩子猜：

5. spread
意思：涂开，铺开，展开
做披萨时可以说 spread the sauce，把酱涂开。

Spread means to put something over a surface.

6. sprinkle
意思：撒，洒一点点

Sprinkle sugar on the cake.

今天的们围绕 “Make a Pizza!” 相关主题展开学习，课堂中学习了与制作食物相关的词汇和
动作表达，包括 stretch, dough, toss, spin, spread, sprinkle, bake, slice 等，孩子通过图片、

本节课重点拓展了 join 的用法。Join 可以表示“加入某个群体、组织或活动”，例如 join the
club / join the group / join us；也可以表示“连接、合并”，如 join two pieces together。在表达
“参加某个活动”时，也可以和 take part in 进行对比：join 更强调“加入到某个群体或行动中”
，
而 take part in 更强调“参与某项活动并成为其中的一员”。例如，He joined the group and took
part in the activity. 表示“他加入了小组并参与了活动”
。
还拓展了 plenty 的用法。Plenty 表示“很多、充足、足够多”，常见搭配是 plenty of + 名词，
既可以接可数名词复数，也可以接不可数名词。例如 plenty of cheese / sauce / time 表示“很
多芝士 / 酱料 / 时间”。与 many / much 相比，plenty of 不只是强调“数量多”，还带有“足够、
很充足”的意思。

water.；以及 be afraid of... 表示“害怕……”，如 I am afraid of thunder. 课堂中也练习了 while +
sentence 的表达，用于描述两个事情同时发生，例如 While it rains, the well fills up. 整体来
看，孩子能够结合故事情境理解词汇，并能在老师引导下尝试用完整句描述暴风雨来临、情
绪变化和雨水积聚的过程。
[J]Don’t Panic, Be safe

1. rule

这里要结合语境重点讲 match = 火柴，不是“比赛”

It depends on the situation.

1. could not

Grammar / Pattern:

She could not see.

===== PAGE 809 =====
Finally, + sentence

shore Meaning: the land next to a lake, river, or sea. Chinese: 岸边；海岸。 Useful Phrases: on the

Before..., people... After..., people... Because of..., life became...
例如：

move away Meaning: to leave one place and begin living in another place. Chinese: 搬走；搬家。

/ How would you feel if your friend moved away? Word Extension: Compare move away and move

stuffed Meaning: filled with something soft inside. Chinese: 填满的；毛绒填充的。 Useful Phrases:

Stuffed animal means a soft toy, not a real animal. Common stuffed animals include bears, rabbits,

then. After that tells what happens next, while from then on emphasizes that something continues.
carrier Meaning: someone or something that carries people or things from one place to another.

Extension: Zoom is often used to describe something moving so fast that it is hard to see clearly.
Examples: The race car zoomed past us. / The bee zoomed around the flowers.
wait up Meaning: to stop and wait for someone to catch up. Chinese: 等一等。 Useful Phrases:

Questions: Who do you usually wait for? / What do you say if your friend walks too fast? Word
Extension: Compare wait and wait up. Wait means stop for a while, while wait up is usually said
when asking someone not to go ahead without you.
warn Meaning: to tell someone about danger so they can stay safe. Chinese: 警告；提醒。 Useful

[J] A day at water camp
Have you ever played with water?
Today we're going to read A Day at Water Camp and become little scientists!
comic Meaning: a book or story with lots of pictures and speech bubbles. Chinese: 漫画；连环画。
Useful Phrases: comic book, read a comic, funny comic. Examples: I like reading comic books. /
This comic is very funny. Questions: Do you like comics? / What's your favorite comic character?
Word Extension: Compare comic and storybook. A comic tells a story mostly with pictures, while a
storybook usually has more words. Encourage children to describe which one they prefer and why.
tell jokes Meaning: to say something funny that makes people laugh. Chinese: 讲笑话。 Useful
Phrases: tell a joke, funny joke, make people laugh. Examples: My dad tells funny jokes. / She likes
telling jokes at school. Questions: Who tells the funniest jokes? / Can you tell a simple joke? Word

===== PAGE 843 =====
Extension: Compare tell jokes and tell stories. We tell jokes to make people laugh, but we tell stories
to share an adventure or an experience.
solo Meaning: done by one person alone. Chinese: 独自的；单独完成的。 Useful Phrases: solo
trip, solo game, work solo. Examples: She finished the game solo. / He sang a solo song. Questions:
Do you like working solo or with friends? / Can you do this activity by yourself? Word Extension:
Compare solo and together. Solo means by yourself, while together means with other people.
Examples: I read solo. / We build the boat together.
camp Meaning: a place where people stay and do fun outdoor activities. Chinese: 夏令营；营地。
Useful Phrases: summer camp, water camp, go camping. Examples: We had fun at water camp. / I
went to summer camp last year. Questions: Have you ever been to a camp? / What activities can
you do at camp? Word Extension: Different camps have different themes, such as sports camp,
science camp, art camp, music camp, and water camp. Ask children which camp they would like to
join.
predict Meaning: to guess what will happen before it happens. Chinese: 预测。 Useful Phrases:
predict the ending, make a prediction, predict what will happen. Examples: Can you predict what
will happen next? / I predict the boat will float. Questions: What do you think will happen? / Can
you make a prediction? Word Extension: Teach the science process: Predict → Test → Observe →
Find out. Explain that scientists predict first, then test their ideas to see if they are correct.
float Meaning: to stay on top of the water without sinking. Chinese: 漂浮。 Useful Phrases: float
on water, floating leaf, float away. Examples: The leaf floats on the water. / The boat can float.
Questions: Can a boat float? / What else can float? Word Extension: Compare float and sink. Float
means staying on the water, while sink means going down into the water. Examples: The duck floats.
/ The rock sinks.
sink Meaning: to go down to the bottom of the water. Chinese: 下沉。 Useful Phrases: sink to the
bottom, sinking stone. Examples: The rock sinks quickly. / The coin sinks in the water. Questions:
What things sink? / Does a rock float or sink? Word Extension: Encourage children to compare
objects using I think... will float/sink because... Then verify through observation.
Which objects floated? Which objects sank?

===== PAGE 844 =====
The leaf, the wooden block, and the plastic bottle floated. The rock, the coin, and the spoon sank.
Look at the objects that floated. What do they have in common?
Sample Answer:
Many of them are made of wood or plastic, and they are lighter for their size.
Look at the objects that sank. What do they have in common?
Sample Answer:
Many of them are made of metal or stone, and they are heavier for their size.
It depends on what they are made of and how heavy they are for their size.
本节课围绕绘本《A Day at Water Camp》展开学习，重点学习了 comic, tell jokes, solo, camp,
predict, float 和 sink 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 tell jokes 与 tell stories 的区别，理
解不同表达的用途；通过 solo 对比学习了 together 的用法，能够运用 I can do it solo.、Let's
work together. 等句型进行表达；结合 camp 学习了 summer camp、science camp、water camp
等常见搭配。课堂还重点学习了 predict 的含义，引导孩子运用 I think... will float/sink
because... 对实验结果进行预测，并通过观察不同物体在水中的表现，学习使用 float 和 sink
描述沉浮现象。通过比较树叶、材块、塑料瓶、石头、硬币和勺子等物品，孩子能够总结出：
Some things float, and some things sink. It depends on what they are made of and how heavy they
are for their size. 同时能够理解 big things don't always sink, and small things don't always float，
例如 a big boat can float, but a small rock sinks。整体来看，孩子能够积极参与预测与实验活
动，并尝试运用完整句子表达自己的猜想、观察结果和结论，英语表达与科学思维都有进一
步提升。

ripe Meaning: ready to eat because a fruit has fully grown. Chinese: 成熟的。 Useful Phrases: ripe

Compare ripe and unripe. Ripe fruit is sweet and ready to eat, while unripe fruit is still hard or sour.
Examples: This peach is ripe. / That banana is still unripe.

===== PAGE 845 =====
plum Meaning: a small, round fruit with a pit inside. Chinese: 李子。 Useful Phrases: purple plum,

Have you ever eaten a plum? / What color can plums be? Word Extension: Compare plum and

stroll off Meaning: to walk away slowly and casually. Chinese: 悠闲地走开。 Useful Phrases: stroll

badger Meaning: a wild animal with black-and-white stripes on its face. Chinese: 獾。 Useful

fruit. Questions: Have you seen a badger before? / What does a badger look like? Word Extension:
Describe the badger using It has... Examples: It has black-and-white stripes and strong claws.
delicious Meaning: very tasty. Chinese: 美味的；好吃的。 Useful Phrases: delicious food, delicious
fruit, taste delicious. Examples: The apricots are delicious. / This cake tastes delicious. Questions:
What's the most delicious food you've eaten? / Is ice cream delicious? Word Extension: Compare
delicious, sweet, and yummy. Sweet describes a taste, delicious describes excellent flavor, and

raccoon Meaning: a small animal with a black mask around its eyes and a striped tail. Chinese: 浣
熊。 Useful Phrases: little raccoon, hungry raccoon. Examples: The raccoon found some fruit. / The
raccoon has a striped tail. Questions: What does a raccoon look like? / What color is its tail? Word
Extension: Children can describe it with It has...: It has a black mask, a striped tail, and little hands.
surprise Meaning: something unexpected, or the feeling when something unexpected happens.
Chinese: 惊喜；使惊讶。 Useful Phrases: a big surprise, surprise gift, surprise party. Examples:
What a surprise! / Dad gave me a surprise. Questions: Do you like surprises? / What's the best
surprise you've ever had? Word Extension: Surprise can be both a noun and a verb. Noun: It was a
surprise. Verb: You surprised me!

===== PAGE 846 =====
apricot Meaning: a small orange fruit with a pit inside. Chinese: 杏子。 Useful Phrases: ripe apricot,

Have you ever eaten an apricot? / What color is an apricot? Word Extension: Compare apricot, peach,
and plum by their color, skin, and taste to build fruit vocabulary.

[J] Help is on the way
Who helps us when there is an emergency?
Today we're going to read Help Is on the Way and learn about people who help keep us safe!
get a call Meaning: to receive a phone call. Chinese: 接到电话。 Useful Phrases: get a call, get an
emergency call, answer a call. Examples: The firefighter got a call. / The doctor got an emergency

===== PAGE 847 =====
call. Questions: Have you ever gotten a phone call? / Who usually calls your parents? Word
Extension: Compare get a call and make a call. Get a call means receive a phone call, while make a
call means call someone. Examples: I got a call from my mom. / I made a call to my friend.
stay out of the way Meaning: move to a safe place and don't block others. Chinese: 不挡路；避开。
Useful Phrases: stay out of the way, move aside, stay safe. Examples: Stay out of the way when
firefighters arrive. / Please stay out of the way. Questions: Why should we stay out of the way during
an emergency? / Where should you stand? Word Extension: Compare stay out of the way and help.
Sometimes the best way to help is to stay safe and give emergency workers enough space.
delay Meaning: to make something happen later than expected. Chinese: 延误；耽搁。 Useful
Phrases: cause a delay, traffic delay, without delay. Examples: Heavy rain caused a delay. / Don't
delay calling for help. Questions: What can cause a delay? / Why shouldn't we delay asking for help?
Word Extension: Compare delay and be on time. Delay means something is late, while be on time
means arriving or acting as planned.
rescue Meaning: to save someone from danger. Chinese: 营救；救援。 Useful Phrases: rescue
people, rescue animals, rescue team. Examples: The rescue team saved the family. / Firefighters
rescued the cat. Questions: Who rescues people in emergencies? / What animals have you heard
being rescued? Word Extension: Compare save and rescue. Save is a general word, while rescue is
often used when someone is in danger and needs help immediately.
aid Meaning: help or support given to someone. Chinese: 帮助；援助。 Useful Phrases: first aid,
give aid, medical aid. Examples: The nurse gave first aid. / Volunteers gave aid after the storm.
Questions: What is first aid? / Who can give first aid? Word Extension: Introduce first aid,
explaining that it means giving quick help before a doctor arrives. Examples include cleaning a
small cut or putting a bandage on a scrape.
spray Meaning: to send out water or liquid in many small drops. Chinese: 喷洒；喷射。 Useful
Phrases: spray water, spray the fire, water spray. Examples: Firefighters sprayed water on the fire. /
The hose sprays water. Questions: What do firefighters spray on a fire? / Have you used a spray
bottle? Word Extension: Compare spray and pour. Spray sends out tiny drops over an area, while
pour lets liquid flow in one stream.

===== PAGE 848 =====
chop down Meaning: to cut down a tree. Chinese: 砍倒。 Useful Phrases: chop down a tree, chop
down branches. Examples: Workers chopped down the broken tree. / They chopped down the dead
tree safely. Questions: Why do people sometimes chop down a tree? / Should we chop down healthy
trees? Word Extension: Discuss that trees are only chopped down when necessary, such as when
they are dead, dangerous, or blocking a rescue route. Encourage protecting healthy trees.
maintain Meaning: to keep something in good condition. Chinese: 维护；保养。 Useful Phrases:
maintain equipment, maintain safety, maintain roads. Examples: Workers maintain the fire truck. /
We maintain the playground every year. Questions: Why is it important to maintain equipment? /
What things need regular maintenance? Word Extension: Compare fix and maintain. Fix means
repairing something after it breaks, while maintain means taking care of it regularly to prevent
problems.
What Should We Do in an Emergency?
Teach children to answer with Situation → Action → Reason.
Situation: What happened? (发生了什么？)
Action: What should you do? (你应该怎么做？)
Reason: Why should you do that? (为什么要这的做？)
Question:
What should you do if you see a fire?
Sample Answer:
Situation: If I see a fire,
Action: I will tell an adult or call the emergency number. Then I will stay out of the way and wait
for the firefighters.
Reason: Because I want to stay safe and let the firefighters do their job.
你还可以再给孩子个个不同场景练习同一个答题框架：
Question 1
What should you do if someone gets hurt?
Sample Answer:

Situation: If someone gets hurt,
Action: I will tell a teacher or another adult and ask for help.
Reason: Because they can give first aid and keep the person safe.
Question 2
What should you do if you see an ambulance coming?
Sample Answer:
Situation: If I see an ambulance coming,
Action: I will stay out of the way and let it pass.
Reason: Because it is helping someone in an emergency.
Question 3雪联系绘本
Why is it important not to delay asking for help?
Sample Answer:
Situation: If there is an emergency,
Action: We should ask for help right away.
Reason: Because acting quickly can save lives.
这的孩子不仅能回答这一个问题，还能学会一个通用的开放题框架：
Situation: Explain what happened.
Action: Explain what you would do.
Reason: Explain why your action is important.
这个框架适用于以后所有 If... 类型的开放性问题，例如 What would you do if you got lost?、
What would you do if your friend was sad?、What would you do if you saw someone fall down?，
孩子会更容易形成有逻辑的英语表达。

Job → What they do → Why they are important

Sample Answer 3

Sample Answer 4

I'd like to be a firefighter because I want to help people in emergencies. Although the job is difficult

[J] Our Sea adventure
What sea animals do you know?
Plants: Seaweed
Animals: Octopus, fish, whale, crab, turtle
Natural features: Coral reefs, waves, rocks
Today we're going on an exciting sea adventure and discover the amazing world under the water!
supposed to do Meaning: expected or required to do something. Chinese: 应该；按理说应该。
Useful Phrases: be supposed to do, be supposed to help, be supposed to wear. Examples: We are
supposed to wear life jackets on a boat. / You're supposed to listen to the guide. Questions: What
are you supposed to do at school? / What are you supposed to do before swimming? Word Extension:
Compare have to, must, and be supposed to. Must is very strong, have to often talks about rules,
while be supposed to means something is expected or the right thing to do. Example: We're supposed
to keep the beach clean.
patio Meaning: an outdoor area next to a house where people can sit or relax. Chinese: 露台；庭
院。 Useful Phrases: sit on the patio, patio table, patio chair. Examples: We had lunch on the patio.
/ The family relaxed on the patio. Questions: Have you ever sat on a patio? / What can people do on
a patio? Word Extension: Compare patio, balcony, and garden. A patio is on the ground outside a
house, a balcony is attached to an upper floor, and a garden is an area where plants grow.
dive in Meaning: to jump into the water. Chinese: 跳入雪水中 ；潜入。 Useful Phrases: dive into
the water, dive in carefully, dive under the water. Examples: The diver dived into the sea. / The
children wanted to dive in. Questions: Can everyone dive into the sea? / What should you do before
diving? Word Extension: Compare dive, jump, and swim. Dive means entering the water headfirst

===== PAGE 852 =====
or going underwater, jump means leaving the ground, and swim means moving through the water.
giant Meaning: very large or enormous. Chinese: 巨大的。 Useful Phrases: giant octopus, giant
whale, giant waves. Examples: They saw a giant octopus. / A giant whale swam by. Questions:
What's the biggest sea animal you know? / Have you ever seen something giant? Word Extension:
Compare big, large, huge, and giant. Giant describes something extremely large and often surprising.
seaweed Meaning: plants that grow in the sea. Chinese: 海藻。 Useful Phrases: green seaweed,
seaweed forest, eat seaweed. Examples: Fish hide in the seaweed. / Seaweed grows in the ocean.
Questions: Have you ever eaten seaweed? / Why do sea animals hide in seaweed? Word Extension:
Explain that seaweed gives animals food, shelter, and a place to hide, just like forests do for land
animals.
octopus Meaning: a sea animal with eight arms. Chinese: 章鱼。 Useful Phrases: giant octopus,
eight arms, squirt ink. Examples: The octopus has eight arms. / An octopus can squirt ink to escape
danger. Questions: How many arms does an octopus have? / Why does an octopus squirt ink? Word
Extension: Introduce two interesting facts: an octopus can change color to hide and squirt ink to
protect itself from predators.
adventure Meaning: an exciting or unusual experience. Chinese: 冒险；探险。 Useful Phrases: go
on an adventure, exciting adventure, sea adventure. Examples: We went on a sea adventure. / It was
an exciting adventure. Questions: What adventure would you like to have? / Would you like to
explore the ocean or space? Word Extension: Compare adventure and trip. A trip is any journey,
while an adventure is usually exciting, new, or full of surprises.
How come...? Mea inevning: an informal way to ask "Why?". Chinese: 为什么？怎么会？ Useful
Phrases: How come?, How come you're late?, How come it happened? Examples: How come the
octopus changed color? / How come the sea is so deep? Questions: How come fish can breathe
underwater? / How come boats float? Word Extension: Explain that How come...? has the same
meaning as Why...?, but is more conversational. Compare:
Why are you late
How come you're late?
Both are correct, but How come sounds more natural in everyday conversation.

===== PAGE 853 =====
How can we protect the ocean?
Teach children to answer with Problem → Action → Result.
Sample Answer:
Problem: The ocean is polluted by plastic and rubbish
Action: We should recycle, use less plastic, and never throw trash into the sea.
Result: Then sea animals can live in a clean and safe home.

[J] Water Quiz: True or False?
Where can we find water in nature?
Today we'll take a fun water quiz and discover whether different facts are true or false!
suppose Meaning: to think something is probably true or to imagine something. Chinese: 认为；假
设。 Useful Phrases: I suppose, suppose that, be supposed to. Examples: I suppose the answer is
true. / Suppose you lived in the desert. What would you do? Questions: What do you suppose will
happen next? / Can you suppose why camels can live in the desert? Word Extension: Compare
suppose, guess, and think. Guess means you are not sure, think expresses your opinion, and suppose
means you believe something is probably true based on what you know.
propose Meaning: to suggest an idea or plan. Chinese: 提议；建议。 Useful Phrases: propose an
idea, propose a plan, propose a solution. Examples: She proposed a new way to save water. / I

===== PAGE 854 =====
propose we work together. Questions: Can you propose a way to save water? / What idea would you
like to propose? Word Extension: Compare propose and suggest. Both mean "建议", but propose is
often used for more formal or carefully considered ideas.
quiz Meaning: a short test to check what you know. Chinese: 小测验；知识问答。 Useful Phrases:
take a quiz, science quiz, pop quiz. Examples: We took a water quiz today. / The quiz was fun and
interesting. Questions: Do you like quizzes? / What kind of quiz would you like to take? Word
Extension: Compare quiz and test. A quiz is usually shorter and more relaxed, while a test is often
more formal.
cactus Meaning: a plant that grows in dry places and stores water. Chinese: 仙）掌。 Useful Phrases:
desert cactus, cactus plant, grow a cactus. Examples: A cactus stores water in its stem. / Cacti grow
well in deserts. Questions: Where do cacti grow? / Why can a cactus live with little water? Word
Extension: Explain that a cactus stores water in its thick stem instead of its leaves, helping it survive
in the desert.
spot Meaning: a small round mark or dot. Chinese: 斑点。 Useful Phrases: black spots, white spots,
spot pattern. Examples: The fish has blue spots. / I saw a ladybug with many spots. Questions:
Which animals have spots? / What color are the spots? Word Extension: Compare spot and stripe.
Spots are small round marks, while stripes are long lines.
stem Meaning: the main part of a plant that supports leaves and flowers. Chinese: 茎。 Useful
Phrases: plant stem, thick stem, green stem. Examples: The cactus has a thick stem. / Water moves
through the stem. Questions: What does a stem do? / Which plants have thick stems? Word
Extension: Explain that the stem carries water and nutrients to the rest of the plant.
wax Meaning: a waterproof layer that protects a plant or object. Chinese: 蜡；蜡质层。 Useful
Phrases: wax coating, waxy leaves, candle wax. Examples: The cactus has a waxy coating. / Wax
helps keep water inside the plant. Questions: Why does a cactus have wax? / What else is made of
wax? Word Extension: Explain that the waxy coating reduces water loss, helping desert plants
survive.
hump Meaning: the raised part on a camel's back. Chinese: 驼峰。 Useful Phrases: camel's hump,

===== PAGE 855 =====
one hump, two humps. Examples: A camel stores fat in its hump. / The hump helps camels survive
in the desert. Questions: How many humps does a camel have? / Does a camel store water in its
hump? Word Extension: Correct a common misconception: Camels do not store water in their
humps. They store fat, which provides energy when food is scarce.
skip on Meaning: to move or bounce lightly across the surface of something. Chinese: 在……上跳
跃；掠过。 Useful Phrases: skip on water, skip across, skip over. Examples: Some insects can skip
on water. / The stone skipped across the lake. Questions: Which animals can move on water? / Have
you ever skipped stones across a lake? Word Extension: Explain that water striders can walk or skip
on water because of surface tension.
fin Meaning: a flat body part that helps fish swim. Chinese: 鳍。 Useful Phrases: fish fin, dorsal
fin, tail fin. Examples: Fish use their fins to swim. / Sharks have large fins. Questions: What do fins
help fish do? / Which animals have fins? Word Extension: Compare fin and flipper. Fins are used
by fish, while flippers are used by animals such as seals, penguins, and sea turtles.
slope Meaning: a surface that goes up or down at an angle. Chinese: 斜坡；倾斜。 Useful Phrases:
steep slope, gentle slope, mountain slope. Examples: Water flows down the slope. / The children ran
down the slope. Questions: Which way does water flow on a slope? / Is a mountain slope steep or
flat? Word Extension: Explain that water always flows from higher places to lower places because
of gravity.
gill Meaning: the organ fish use to breathe underwater. Chinese: 鳃。 Useful Phrases: fish gills,
breathe through gills, open the gills. Examples: Fish breathe with their gills. / Gills take oxygen
from the water. Questions: Do people have gills? / How do fish breathe underwater? Word Extension:
Compare gills and lungs. Fish use gills to get oxygen from water, while people and most land
animals use lungs to breathe air.
科学知识总结雪Water Facts
How do living things adapt to water?
Guide children to summarize the science behind the story.
Cacti store water in their thick stems and have a waxy coating to reduce water loss.
Camels store fat in their humps, not water, helping them survive in dry places.

===== PAGE 856 =====
Fish breathe through their gills and swim with their fins.
Water flows down slopes because of gravity.
Some insects can move across water because of surface tension.
If you could design a plant for the desert, what would it be like?
Teach children to answer with Feature → Function → Reason.
Sample Answer:
Feature: My plant would have thick leaves and deep roots.
Function: It could store water and reach water underground.
Reason: This would help it survive in the hot desert.

cactus, spot, stem, wax, hump, skip on, fin, slope 和 gill 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了
suppose、guess 和 think 的区别，以及 propose 与 suggest 的不同用法；通过 quiz 与 test 的
比较，理解不同类型的测验；结合 spot 与 stripe、fin 与 flipper、gills 与 lungs 等词汇比较，
进一步丰富了生物学相关表达。课堂还学习了仙）掌通过粗壮的茎和蜡质层储存并减少水分
流失、骆驼驼峰储存脂肪而不是水、鱼类利用鳃呼吸、鳍游泳以及水因重力沿斜坡向下流动
等科学知识，引导孩子运用 Fact → Explanation → Conclusion 和 Feature → Function →
Reason 的答题逻辑解释自然现象，并进一步理解生物会根据生活环境形成不同的适应方式，
在提升英语表达能力的同时培养了科学探究与逻辑思维能力。
[J] Quiet Now
What sounds do you hear at home every day?
Which sounds are loud? Which sounds are quiet?
blender Meaning: a kitchen machine that mixes food and drinks. Chinese: 搅拌机。 Useful Phrases:
use a blender, make smoothies, turn on the blender. Examples: Mom uses a blender to make
smoothies. / The blender is very loud. Questions: Have you ever used a blender? / What can we
make with a blender? Word Extension: Compare blender and mixer. A blender is mainly used for
drinks and soft foods, while a mixer is often used to mix cake batter or dough.
smoothie(s) Meaning: a cold drink made by blending fruit, milk, or yogurt. Chinese: 奶昔；水果
冰沙。 Useful Phrases: fruit smoothie, strawberry smoothie, make a smoothie. Examples: I like
mango smoothies. / We made a banana smoothie this morning. Questions: What's your favorite
smoothie? / What fruit would you put in a smoothie? Word Extension: Compare smoothie and juice.
A smoothie contains blended fruit and is usually thicker, while juice is a thinner drink made by

===== PAGE 857 =====
squeezing fruit.
vacuum Meaning: a machine used to clean floors by sucking up dust. Chinese: 吸尘器；用吸尘器
打扫。 Useful Phrases: vacuum the floor, robot vacuum, use a vacuum. Examples: Dad is
vacuuming the living room. / The vacuum makes a loud noise. Questions: Is a vacuum louder than
a broom? / Who vacuums the floor at your home? Word Extension: Compare vacuum and broom. A
vacuum uses electricity, while a broom is used by hand and is much quieter.
blow-dryer Meaning: a machine that blows hot or warm air to dry hair. Chinese: 吹风机。 Useful
Phrases: use a blow-dryer, dry your hair, hair dryer. Examples: Mom used a blow-dryer after
washing her hair. / The blow-dryer is noisy. Questions: Do you use a blow-dryer or let your hair dry
naturally? / Why do people use a blow-dryer? Word Extension: Compare blow-dryer and fan. Both
blow air, but a blow-dryer uses warm air to dry hair, while a fan cools the air.
do one's hair Meaning: to brush, style, or make your hair look nice. Chinese: 梳头；做发型；整理
头发。 Useful Phrases: do my hair, do her hair, do his hair. Examples: She is doing her hair before
school. / Dad helped his daughter do her hair. Questions: How do you do your hair every morning?
/ Who helps you do your hair? Grammar Extension: Explain that one's changes with the subject. I
→ my, you → your, he → his, she → her, they → their. Example: I do my hair. / She does her hair.
bomber Meaning: a military airplane designed to drop bombs. Chinese: 轰炸机。 Useful Phrases:
bomber plane, military aircraft. Examples: The bomber flew across the sky. / The bomber was very
loud. Questions: Have you ever heard an airplane flying overhead? / Which is louder, a car or a
bomber? Word Extension: Compare bomber and passenger plane. A bomber is a military aircraft,
while a passenger plane carries people. (This word is introduced only as a type of aircraft in the
story.)
headphones Meaning: a device worn over or in the ears to listen to sound privately. Chinese: 耳机。
Useful Phrases: wear headphones, wireless headphones, noise-cancelling headphones. Examples: I
wear headphones to listen to music. / Headphones help block outside noise. Questions: When do
you use headphones? / Why do people wear headphones? Word Extension: Compare headphones
and speakers. Headphones let one person listen quietly, while speakers play sound for everyone to
hear.

What do you do when a place is too noisy?

Action: I wear headphones or go to a quieter place.

本节课围绕绘本《Quiet Now》展开学习，重点学习了 blender, smoothies, vacuum, blow-dryer,
do one's hair, bomber 和 headphones 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 blender 与 mixer、
smoothie 与 juice、vacuum 与 broom、blow-dryer 与 fan、headphones 与 speakers 等易混词
汇的区别；通过 do one's hair 学习了固定搭配。同时围绕生活中的声音展开讨论，引导孩子
区分 loud 和 quiet 的不同，学习运用比较级句型 A is louder/quieter than B 和 noisy → noisier
来比较不同声音的大小，并尝试表达在嘈杂环境中的应对方式以及保持安静的重要性，帮助
孩子在提升英语表达能力的同时增强对生活环境和声音安全的观察与思考能力。
[K] Surprise!
Have you ever planned a surprise for someone?
disappointed
Meaning: feeling unhappy because something did not happen as you hoped. Chinese: 失望的。
Useful Phrases: feel disappointed, be disappointed with, disappointed face. Examples: She was
disappointed because no one came at first. / I felt disappointed when the game was canceled.
Questions: When do you feel disappointed? / What can you do when you feel disappointed? Word
Extension: Compare disappointed, sad, and upset. Disappointed means your expectations were not
met, sad is a general feeling of unhappiness, and upset often means emotionally disturbed or
bothered by something. Encourage students to express disappointment politely instead of giving up.

===== PAGE 859 =====
wonder
Meaning: to think about something because you are curious or unsure. Chinese: 想知道；好奇。
Useful Phrases: I wonder..., wonder why, wonder if, no wonder. Examples: I wonder who planned
the surprise. / She wondered if her friends forgot her birthday. Questions: What do you wonder
about? / Have you ever wondered how birds can fly? Grammar Extension: Teach I wonder + wh-
question/if-clause. Examples: I wonder where my friends are. / I wonder if they are coming.
Introduce No wonder! meaning "难怪！"
laughter
Meaning: the sound people make when they laugh. Chinese: 笑声。 Useful Phrases: happy laughter,
burst into laughter, hear laughter, fill the room with laughter. Examples: The room was full of
laughter after the surprise. / Everyone's laughter made the party more exciting. Questions: What
usually makes you laugh? / Why is laughter important? Word Extension: Compare laugh (verb),
laughing (action), and laughter (noun). Example: The joke made us laugh. / Her laughter was
contagious.
ring
Meaning: to make a bell or phone produce a sound. Chinese: 雪铃、电话 响。 Useful Phrases:
the phone rings, ring the bell, doorbell rings, give someone a ring. Examples: The doorbell rang
suddenly. / Please ring the bell before you come in. Questions: What usually rings at school? / What
should you do when the phone rings? Word Extension: Explain that ring has different meanings. It
can be a verb (The bell rings.), a noun (a gold ring), or an informal expression give someone a ring,
meaning "give someone a phone call."
puzzled
Meaning: confused because you do not understand something. Chinese: 困惑的；疑惑的。 Useful
Phrases: look puzzled, feel puzzled, puzzled expression. Examples: She looked puzzled when
nobody answered the door. / We were puzzled by the strange noise. Questions: When do you feel
puzzled? / What do you do when you don't understand something? Word Extension: Compare
puzzled, confused, and surprised. Puzzled means trying to understand something, confused means
you don't understand, and surprised means something unexpected happens.

===== PAGE 860 =====
burst
Meaning: to suddenly happen or begin with great force. Chinese: 突然爆发；突然发生。 Useful
Phrases: burst into laughter, burst into tears, burst out laughing, balloon burst. Examples: Everyone
burst into laughter when the surprise was revealed. / The balloon burst with a loud pop. Questions:
What made everyone burst into laughter? / Have you ever heard a balloon burst? Grammar
Extension: Teach the pattern burst into + noun (burst into laughter, burst into tears) and burst out +
V-ing (burst out laughing, burst out crying). Explain that both describe sudden emotional reactions.
be set with
Meaning: to be decorated or filled with something. Chinese: 布置着；装饰着；摆放着。 Useful
Phrases: be set with balloons, be set with flowers, table set with food. Examples: The room was set
with colorful balloons. / The table was set with delicious cakes and drinks. Questions: How would
you decorate a birthday party? / What would you like the room to be set with? Word Extension:
Compare decorate and be set with. Decorate describes the action, while be set with describes the
final result. Example: They decorated the room with balloons. → The room was set with balloons.
afterwards
Meaning: after something has happened; later. Chinese: 后来；之后。 Useful Phrases: afterwards
we..., shortly afterwards, go home afterwards. Examples: We ate cake afterwards. / Afterwards,
everyone took photos together. Questions: What do you usually do after a birthday party? / What
did you do afterwards? Grammar Extension: Compare after, afterward(s), and then. After needs an
object (after school), afterwards can stand alone (We went home afterwards.), and then emphasizes
the next step in a sequence.
First, the character felt disappointed.
Then, the character became puzzled and started to wonder what was happening.
Finally, everyone shouted "Surprise!", and the room was filled with laughter.
本节课围绕绘本《Surprise》展开学习，重点学习了 disappointed, wonder, laughter, ring, puzzled,
burst, be set with 和 afterwards 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 disappointed、sad 和 upset
的区别；学习了 I wonder + wh-从句/if 从句 以及 No wonder! 的常见表达；通过 laugh、
laughing 和 laughter 理解动词、动名词和名词的不同用法；结合 ring 学习了其作为动词、
名词及短语 give someone a ring 的多重含义；掌握了 burst into + 名词 与 burst out + V-ing
的固定搭配；通过 decorate...with... 和 be set with... 理解动作与结果的不同表达；并区分了
after、afterwards 和 then 的使用场景。

[K]Push the Buttons
What machines do you use every day?
Which machine do you think is the most useful at home?
1. button
A button is something we press to make a machine work. We press the elevator button, the power
button, or the doorbell button. Press the button is the most common expression. Question: What
buttons do you press every day? Can you name three?
2. take turns
Take turns means everyone has a chance to do something fairly, one after another. We often say take
turns + V-ing, such as take turns reading, take turns playing, or take turns pressing the button.
Question: Why is it important to take turns at school?
3. microwave
A microwave is a machine that heats food quickly. We often say heat food in the microwave or put
food in the microwave. A microwave is usually faster than an oven, but it is mainly used for heating
instead of baking. Question: What food do you usually heat in the microwave?
4. oven
An oven is used for baking or cooking food. We usually say bake bread in the oven, bake a cake in
the oven, or cook chicken in the oven. Unlike a microwave, an oven cooks food more slowly and is
better for baking. Question: Which do you prefer, food from a microwave or an oven? Why?
5. dishwasher
A dishwasher is a machine that washes dishes automatically. We often say put the dishes in the
dishwasher. A dishwasher saves time and keeps dishes clean. Question: Would you rather wash
dishes by hand or use a dishwasher? Why?
6. tap

===== PAGE 862 =====
A tap is where water comes from. We usually say turn on the tap and turn off the tap. In British
English, tap also means to touch something lightly, as in tap the screen, tap the button, or tap
someone on the shoulder. Question: Why should we turn off the tap after using it?
7. elevator
An elevator takes people up and down in a building. We usually say take the elevator, go up, and go
down. We press a button to call the elevator before getting inside. Question: When do you take the
elevator instead of the stairs?
8. mash
Mash means pressing food until it becomes soft. We often say mash potatoes, m
wash bananas, or mash carrots. Remember the third-person form is mashes, as in She mashes the
potatoes. Question: Which foods can you mash?
9. unlock
Unlock means opening something with a key, card, password, or button. We often say unlock the
door, unlock the car, or unlock the phone. The opposite word is lock. Question: How do you usually
unlock your phone?
10. grocery store
A grocery store is a place where people buy food and daily necessities. We usually say go to the
grocery store and buy fruit at the grocery store. Question: What do you usually buy at a grocery
store?
11. front
Front means the part that faces forward. The phrase in front of tells us the position of something,
such as The park is in front of my school. The opposite word is behind. Question: What is in front
of your classroom?
12. on tiptoe

===== PAGE 863 =====
On tiptoe means standing on the front part of your feet to make yourself taller. We often say stand
on tiptoe to reach something. Question: When do people stand on tiptoe?
13. stretch
Stretch means making your body, arms, or legs longer. We often use stretch to + verb, such as stretch
to reach, stretch to touch, or stretch to see. People also stretch before exercising to warm up their
bodies. Question: Why do athletes stretch before sports?
14. reach
Reach means trying to touch or get something. We often say reach for something, reach up, and
reach down. Stretch means making your body longer, while reach means getting close enough to
touch something. Question: Can you reach the top shelf at home?
15. poke
Poke means touching or pushing something quickly with your finger. We often say poke something
with your finger. For buttons, press is more natural than poke, while tap means a lighter touch,
especially on screens. Question: Which word is better for a button, press, poke, or tap?
16. lift
Lift means moving something upward. We often say lift the box, lift your backpack, or lift your
hand. Its verb forms are lift – lifts – lifted. Question: What heavy things can you lift?
17. ring
Ring means making a bell produce a sound. We can say ring the bell, ring the doorbell, or the phone
rings. Notice the difference between I ring the bell (我按铃) and The bell rings (铃响了). Question:
When do you usually ring a doorbell?
① use...to...
We use a microwave to heat food.
We use an elevator to go upstairs.
We use a dishwasher to wash dishes.

===== PAGE 864 =====
Practice
What do we use a refrigerator to do?
③ too...to...
The boy is too short to reach the button.
The box is too heavy to lift.
④ enough to...
She is tall enough to press the button.
He is strong enough to lift the box.
Can you retell the story in your Let's play a game. I'll think of a word and you have to guess it by
asking questions. I can only answer "yes" or "no".own words?
本节课重点学习了 button, take turns, microwave, oven, dishwasher, tap, elevator, mash, unlock,
grocery store, front, on tiptoe, stretch, reach, poke, lift, ring 等与日常生活场景相关的词汇。课
堂中通过家庭、厨房、电梯和商店等情境，帮助孩子理解不同物品的功能和常见动作表达，
例如 take turns pressing the button, heat food in the microwave, bake food in the oven, put dishes
in the dishwasher, take the elevator, unlock the door, go to the grocery store 等。本节课也重点拓
展了动作类表达，如 stand on tiptoe to reach the button, stretch to reach, lift the box, ring the bell，
并补充了 tap 作动词时“轻点、轻敲”的用法，如 tap the screen, tap the button, tap on the door。
整体来看，孩子能够结合生活场景理解词汇含义，并能在老师引导下尝试用完整句描述日常
动作、物品功能和位置关系。建议课后继续复习 use...to... / take turns doing... / stand on tiptoe
to... / reach for... 等句式，帮助孩子提升词汇在真实语境中的运用能力。
[K] A big party
If you were planning a party, what food would you like to make?
ingredients
Meaning: the foods or materials used to make a dish. Chinese: 食材；原料。 Useful Phrases: fresh
ingredients, cooking ingredients, prepare the ingredients, simple ingredients. Examples: We need
fresh ingredients to make guacamole. / Let's get all the ingredients before we start cooking.
Questions: What ingredients do you need to make a sandwich? / Why are fresh ingredients important?
Word Extension: Compare ingredient, food, and recipe. Ingredients are the things you use to cook,
food is what you eat, and a recipe tells you how to cook the dish. Teach the sentence pattern: The
main ingredients are...
stand

===== PAGE 865 =====
Meaning: to be in an upright position on your feet. Chinese: 站；站立。 Useful Phrases: stand up,
stand still, stand in line, stand next to. Examples: Please stand in a line. / Everyone stood around the
table to help. Questions: When should we stand quietly? / Can you stand on one foot? Grammar
Extension: Explain that stand has different meanings. It can mean 站立 (stand up) and also 忍受
in expressions like can't stand... Examples: I can't stand spicy food. / She can't stand waiting for a
long time. This is a useful everyday expression for older students.
enough
Meaning: as much or as many as needed. Chinese: 足够的。 Useful Phrases: enough food, enough
water, good enough, big enough. Examples: We have enough food for everyone. / Is the bowl big
enough? Questions: How much food is enough for a party? / Do you get enough sleep every night?
Grammar Extension: Teach the two common patterns:
enough + noun (enough time, enough money)
adjective + enough + to do (old enough to cook, big enough to hold the fruit)
Examples: The table is big enough for eight people.
medium-sized
Meaning: neither small nor large. Chinese: 中等大小的。 Useful Phrases: medium-sized bowl,
medium-sized apple, medium-sized avocado. Examples: Use two medium-sized tomatoes. / We
need a medium-sized bowl. Questions: Can you name something medium-sized? / Is your backpack
small, medium-sized, or large? Word Extension: Compare small, medium-sized, and large. Explain
that medium-sized is commonly used in recipes and shopping to describe the size of food or
containers.
chilli
Meaning: a spicy pepper used in cooking. Chinese: 辣椒。 Useful Phrases: chilli pepper, chilli
sauce, spicy chilli, fresh chilli. Examples: Don't add too much chilli. / The chilli makes the soup
spicy. Questions: Do you like chilli? / What foods are spicy? Word Extension: Compare spicy, hot,
and mild. Spicy describes food with strong flavors from peppers, hot can describe both temperature
and spicy food, while mild means not very spicy.
avocado

===== PAGE 866 =====
Meaning: a green fruit with soft flesh, often used in salads or guacamole. Chinese: 牛油果；鳄梨。
Useful Phrases: ripe avocado, avocado salad, avocado toast, cut an avocado. Examples: Mash the
avocado with a fork. / Avocados are healthy and delicious. Questions: Have you ever eaten avocado?
/ What color is an avocado inside? Word Extension: Introduce common collocations ripe avocado,
slice an avocado, mash an avocado. Explain that avocado is rich in healthy fats and is often used in
Mexican dishes like guacamole.
ripe
Meaning: fully grown and ready to eat. Chinese: 成熟的。 Useful Phrases: ripe fruit, ripe banana,
ripe tomato, ripe avocado. Examples: This avocado is ripe and soft. / Don't eat the banana until it is
ripe. Questions: How can you tell if a fruit is ripe? / Which fruits do you like to eat when they are
ripe? Word Extension: Compare ripe, unripe, and rotten. Ripe means ready to eat, unripe means not
ready yet, and rotten means too old to eat. This helps children describe fruit accurately.

chilli, avocado 和 ripe 等词汇与表达。课堂中重点拓展了 ingredient、food 和 recipe 的区别，
掌握 prepare the ingredients、fresh ingredients 等常见搭配；学习了 stand 的两种常见含义—
—表示“站立”以及在 can't stand... 中表示“无法忍受”；重点讲解了 enough + 名词 和 形容词
+ enough + to do 的语法结构，帮助孩子熟练运用 enough food、old enough to、big enough to
等表达；通过 small、medium-sized 和 large 的比较，掌握描述物品大小的常用词汇；结合
chilli 学习 spicy、hot 和 mild 的区别，理解描述食物辣度时的不同表达；通过 avocado 拓
展 slice、cut、mash 等烹饪动词及 ripe avocado 等固定搭配；最后重点区分 ripe、unripe 和
rotten 的含义，能够准确描述水果不同的成熟状态。课堂还结合食谱学习了表示步骤的连接
词 first、next、then、finally 以及句型 We need + 数量 + 食材，帮助孩子能够更加自然地用
英语介绍食材、描述烹饪过程，并提高日常生活场景中的英语表达能力。
[K] The magic word
What are the two most important polite words you use every day?
How do you feel when someone says "please" or "thank you" to you?
Today we'll read a story about a "magic word." It isn't real magic, but it has the power to make
people feel respected, happy, and willing to help others!
spinach
Meaning: a green leafy vegetable that is rich in vitamins. Chinese: 菠菜。 Useful Phrases: fresh

===== PAGE 867 =====
spinach, eat spinach, spinach salad, spinach soup. Examples: Spinach is good for your health. / I
like spinach in my sandwich. Questions: Do you like spinach? / What vegetables do you eat every
week? Word Extension: Compare spinach, lettuce, and cabbage. They are all leafy vegetables, but
they have different tastes and textures. Introduce the phrase be good for your health.
forget
Meaning: to fail to remember something. Chinese: 忘记。 Useful Phrases: forget to do, forget about,
don't forget, forget someone's name. Examples: Don't forget to say "please." / I forgot to bring my
homework. Questions: What do you sometimes forget? / How can you help yourself remember
important things? Grammar Extension: Teach the difference between forget to do and forget doing.
Forget to do means you didn't do something because you forgot (I forgot to lock the door.). Forget
doing means you don't remember an action in the past (I forgot meeting him before.). For younger
learners, focus mainly on forget to do.
still
Meaning: continuing to happen or exist. Chinese: 仍然；还是。 Useful Phrases: still hungry, still
waiting, still here, still learning. Examples: She is still waiting for her food. / I still remember my
first teacher. Questions: Are you still learning English every day? / Do you still play with your
favorite toy? Grammar Extension: Explain that still is usually placed before the main verb but after
the verb be. Examples: I still like reading. / She is still busy.
repeat
Meaning: to say or do something again. Chinese: 重复。 Useful Phrases: repeat after me, repeat
the question, repeat again. Examples: Please repeat after me. / Could you repeat that sentence?
Questions: Why do teachers ask students to repeat new words? / Which English word can you repeat
three times quickly? Grammar Extension: Teach repeat + noun and repeat after + someone.
Examples: Repeat the sentence. / Repeat after your teacher.
magic
Meaning: something that seems impossible or wonderful, or special powers in stories. Chinese: 魔
法；神奇的。 Useful Phrases: magic word, magic trick, magic show, magical moment. Examples:
"Please" is called the magic word. / The magician performed a magic trick. Questions: What magic
power would you like to have? / Why is "please" called a magic word? Word Extension: Compare

===== PAGE 868 =====
magic (noun) and magical (adjective). Example: Magic can make stories exciting. / It was a magical

best
Meaning: better than all the others. Chinese: 最好的。 Useful Phrases: my best friend, do your best,
the best choice, best wishes. Examples: Always do your best. / She is my best friend. Questions:

best is the superlative form of good. Teach the irregular comparison:
good → better → best
Examples: Math is good, but English is better. Reading is my best subject.
quesadillas

tortillas
Meaning: thin, round flatbreads commonly used in Mexican food. Chinese: 墨西哥薄饼。 Useful

[K] Planting Seeds
Have you ever planted a flower or a vegetable?
What do plants need to grow?
If you had a small garden, what would you like to grow?
Teacher: Today we'll become little gardeners and learn how to plant seeds, take care of them, and
watch them grow!
helper
Meaning: a person who helps someone do something. Chinese: 帮手；助手。 Useful Phrases: a
helpful helper, classroom helper, garden helper, be a helper. Examples: My little brother is my
garden helper. / Everyone can be a helper at home. Questions: How can you be a helper at home? /
Who helps you when you have a problem? Word Extension: Compare help (verb), helpful
(adjective), and helper (noun). Examples: I help my mom water the flowers. / She is very helpful. /
He is a great helper.
soil
Meaning: the top layer of the ground where plants grow. Chinese: 土壤。 Useful Phrases: rich soil,
healthy soil, plant in the soil, soft soil. Examples: Seeds grow best in healthy soil. / Put the seeds
into the soil. Questions: Why is soil important for plants? / Can plants grow without soil? Science
Extension: Explain that soil provides water, nutrients, air, and support for plant roots. Different
plants grow better in different kinds of soil.
pour
Meaning: to make a liquid flow from one container into another. Chinese: 倒；浇。 Useful Phrases:
pour water, pour milk, pour into, pour over. Examples: Please pour some water onto the soil. / She
poured juice into the glass. Questions: What do you usually pour into a cup? / Why should we pour
water gently onto plants? Grammar Extension: Compare pour and fill.
Pour = 倒雪动作

===== PAGE 870 =====
Fill = 装满雪结果
Example:
Pour the water into the bottle.
Fill the bottle with water.
dig
Meaning: to make a hole in the ground using your hands or a tool. Chinese: 挖；掘。 Useful Phrases:
dig a hole, dig in the garden, dig carefully. Examples: We dug a small hole for the seeds. / The dog
likes to dig in the yard. Questions: Why do we dig holes before planting seeds? / What animals like

dig → dug → dug
Examples:
Yesterday we dug a hole.
We have dug many holes today.
shovel
Meaning: a tool used for digging or moving soil, sand, or snow. Chinese: 铲子；铁锹。 Useful
Phrases: use a shovel, garden shovel, small shovel, dig with a shovel. Examples: The gardener used
a shovel to dig the soil. / Please put the shovel away after using it. Questions: What jobs use a shovel?
/ Which is better for digging, your hands or a shovel? Word Extension: Compare shovel, spade, and
rake.
Shovel: move or dig soil.
Spade: dig more precisely.
Rake: collect leaves or level the soil.
in rows
Meaning: arranged in straight lines. Chinese: 成排地；一行一行地。 Useful Phrases: plant in rows,
stand in rows, trees in rows. Examples: The students planted carrots in rows. / The flowers grew in
neat rows. Questions: Why do farmers plant crops in rows? / Can you think of other things that are
arranged in rows? Word Extension: Explain that planting in rows makes watering, weeding, and
harvesting easier because every plant has enough space to grow.

===== PAGE 871 =====
hose
Meaning: a long tube used to carry water. Chinese: 水管；软管。 Useful Phrases: garden hose,
turn on the hose, water with a hose. Examples: We watered the vegetables with a hose. / Don't leave
the hose running. Questions: When do people use a hose? / Is a watering can or a hose better for a
small plant? Word Extension: Compare hose, watering can, and sprinkler.
Hose waters a large area.
Watering can is better for small plants.
Sprinkler sprays water automatically.
chilli
Meaning: a spicy pepper used in cooking. Chinese: 辣椒。 Useful Phrases: grow chillies, fresh
chilli, red chilli, chilli plant. Examples: We planted chilli seeds in the garden. / My grandparents
grow chillies every summer. Questions: Have you ever eaten chilli? / What foods become spicy

Plants Need Five Things
Sunlight
Water
Soil
Air
The right temperature
Without these things, plants cannot grow well.
Why do farmers plant crops in rows instead of putting them anywhere?
Sample Answer:
Farmers plant crops in rows because each plant has enough space, sunlight, and water. Rows also
make it easier to water the plants, remove weeds, and harvest the crops.

结合 itch、thorn 学习了身体感觉及植物相关词汇；通过 squeeze 掌握了 squeeze into、squeeze
through 等常见搭配，理解其表示“挤进、挤压”的含义；结合 snug 学习了表示“温暖舒适”的

If you could make a sign for your room, what would it say and why?
sign
Sign means a mark, picture, or words that give information or instructions. 中文意思是“标志；标
牌；信号”。常见搭配有 a road sign雪路标 、a warning sign雪警告标志 、a sign of...雪……的

雪红灯是停止的信号。 可以提问孩子：What signs do you see every day? 拓展辨析：sign 可
以表示“标志”，也可以表示“迹象”，例如 a sign of happiness雪快乐的迹象 。
keep out

===== PAGE 882 =====
Keep out means to stay away from a place and not go inside. 中文意思是“不要进入；禁止进入”
。
常见搭配有 keep out of...雪远离…… 、keep people out雪阻止）进入 。例如：The sign says
“Keep out.”（雪标牌写着“禁止进入”。 Keep out of the water.（雪不要进入水里。 可以提问孩子：
Why do some places need to keep people out? 语法拓展：keep + 宾语 + 形容词 表示“使……保
持某种状态”，例如 keep the door open雪让门保持打开 。
instead
Instead means in place of something or as an alternative. 中文意思是“代替；反而”。常见搭配有
instead of + 名词/动词-ing雪代替…… 、do sth. instead雪改做某事 。例如：I wanted tea, but I

雪我们不要出去，改在里面玩吧。 可以提问孩子：What do you do instead when it rains? 语
法拓展：
instead 通常放在句我：I stayed home instead.
instead of + 名词/doing：I read books instead of watching TV.
grouch

[K] Animal Disguises
disguise
Disguise means to change the way someone or something looks so that people cannot recognize it.
中文意思是“伪装；伪装物”。常见搭配有 a disguise雪伪装 、disguise oneself雪伪装自己 、
in disguise雪伪装状态 。例如：The animal uses a disguise to hide from enemies.雪动物利用伪
装躲避敌）。 The fox is in disguise.雪狐狸处于伪装状态。 可以提问孩子：Why do animals
use disguises? 拓展词汇：hide雪隐藏 、change雪改变 、look like雪看起来雷 。语法拓展：
disguise oneself as + 名词 表示“把自己伪装成……”，例如：The animal disguises itself as a leaf.
雪动物把自己伪装成一片叶子。
enemy
An enemy is a person or animal that may hurt or fight against someone. 中文意思是“敌）；敌对
者”。常见搭配有 an enemy（雪一个敌） 、fight an enemy（雪对敌敌） 、hide from enemies（雪躲
避敌） 。例如：The small animal hides from its enemies.雪小动物躲避它的敌）。 A predator
can be an enemy of small animals.雪捕食者可能是小动物的敌）。 可以提问孩子：Why do
animals need to hide from enemies? 拓展辨析：enemy ↔ friend，enemy 表示敌），friend 表
示朋友。例如：A friend helps you. An enemy may hurt you.（雪朋友帮助你，敌）可能伤害你。
camouflage
Camouflage means using colors, shapes, or patterns to help an animal hide and look like its
surroundings. 中文意思是“伪装；保护色”。常见搭配有 use camouflage雪使用伪装 、natural
camouflage（雪自然伪装 、camouflage pattern（雪伪装图） 。例如：The chameleon uses camouflage
to hide on a tree.雪变色龙利用伪装隐藏在树上。 Camouflage helps animals stay safe.雪伪装帮
助动物保持安全。 可以提问孩子：What animals use camouflage? 拓展词汇：color雪颜色 、
pattern（雪图） 、environment（雪环境 。拓展辨析：camouflage 和 disguise 都表示“伪装”，但

===== PAGE 885 =====
camouflage 更强调通过颜色、形状融入环境，而 disguise 范围更广，可以指任何改变外表的
伪装。例如：A leaf insect uses camouflage.（雪叶虫使用保护色。 A person wears a disguise.（雪）
戴伪装。
carpet shark
A carpet shark is a type of shark with patterns on its body that help it hide on the ocean floor. 中文
意思是“地毯鲨”。常见搭配有 a carpet shark雪一条地毯鲨 、ocean floor雪海底 、hide on the
seabed雪隐藏在海床上 。例如：The carpet shark blends into the ocean floor.雪地毯鲨融入海底
环境。 A carpet shark uses camouflage to catch prey.雪地毯鲨利用伪装捕捉猎物。 可以提问
孩子：Why does a carpet shark need camouflage? 拓展词汇：shark（雪鲨鱼 、ocean（雪海洋 、sea
floor（雪海床 。知识拓展：carpet shark 的身体有类似地毯的花纹，因此能够隐藏在海底等待
猎物。
hold on to
Hold on to means to keep something tightly and not let it go. 中文意思是“抓住；紧紧握住；保
留”。常见搭配有 hold on to a branch雪抓住树枝 、hold on to something tightly雪紧紧抓住某
物 、hold on to a friend’s hand雪抓住朋友的手 。例如：The gecko holds on to the wall.雪壁虎
紧紧贴在墙上。 Hold on to your bag.雪抓好你的包。 可以提问孩子：What do you hold on to
when you climb? 拓展辨析：hold on to ≠ hold on。
hold on to something = 抓住某物；保留某物。
hold on = 等一下，坚持住。
例如：
Hold on to the rope.雪抓住绳子。
Hold on! Wait for me.雪等一下！等等我。
trick
Trick means something done to fool or surprise someone. 中文意思是“技巧；花招；欺骗”。常见
搭配有 play a trick雪恶作剧 、trick someone雪欺骗某） 、a magic trick雪魔术 。例如：The
animal uses a trick to escape from danger.（雪动物使用技巧离离危险。 The magician shows a magic
trick.（雪魔术师展示魔术。 可以提问孩子：What tricks can animals use? 拓展词汇：clever（雪聪
明的 、smart雪机灵的 、escape雪离脱 。拓展辨析：trick ↔ skill，trick 通常强调为了达到
目的的小技巧或策略，skill 强调长期训练形成的能力。例如：The fox uses a trick.雪狐狸使

===== PAGE 886 =====
用计谋。 Swimming is a useful skill.雪游泳是一项有用的技能。
get away
Get away means to escape or move away from a dangerous situation. 中文意思是“离脱；离开”
。
常见搭配有 get away from danger（雪离离危险 、get away quickly（雪快速离走 、get away safely
雪安全离脱 。例如：The animal gets away from its enemy.雪动物离离敌）。 The rabbit runs

gecko
A gecko is a small lizard that can climb walls and ceilings. 中文意思是“壁虎”。常见搭配有 a

知识拓展：壁虎的脚上有特殊结构，可以帮助它吸附在墙壁上，因此能够快速移动和躲避敌
）。
本节课围绕绘本《Animal Disguises》展开学习，重点学习了 disguise, enemy, camouflage, carpet

需要防御的对象，并通过 enemy ↔ friend 进行词义辨析；通过 camouflage 学习了“保护色、
自然伪装”的概念，重点区分了 camouflage 和 disguise 的不同使用场景；结合 carpet shark

并拓展了与 hold on 的区别；结合 trick 学习了“技巧、策略”的含义，拓展了 play a trick、
magic trick 等常见搭配；通过 get away 学习了“离脱、离离危险”的表达，并区分了 get away
和 run away；最后通过 gecko 认识了壁虎这一动物，并结合故事学习了 use something to do
